domains.name: shipment
domains.description: Core operational domain managing end-to-end shipment lifecycle from booking through delivery across express parcel, freight, and cross-border movements. Owns shipment identity, tracking events, POD/ePOD, ETA/ETD milestones, exception management, and AWB/BOL/HAWB/MAWB document references. Serves as the transactional backbone integrating TMS, FourKites visibility, and carrier execution data for D2D services.
domains.references: IATA Resolution 600 Series, IMO FAL Convention, WCO

products.name: consignment
products.description: Core master entity representing a shipment booking/consignment record — the primary business object in the shipment domain. Captures the full lifecycle identity of a shipment from booking through final delivery, including service type (express parcel, freight, cross-border), origin/destination, declared weight, volumetric/DIM weight, CBM, number of pieces, incoterms code, COD flag, DDP/DAP/FOB terms, booking channel, booking date, committed SLA type, committed delivery date, transit time commitment, SLA source (customer contract/rate card/spot booking), priority level, delivery instructions (instruction type, preferred time window, special access notes, safe place, alternative address, contact phone), current lifecycle status, and OTD/OTIF target. Serves as the anchor entity integrating SAP TM freight orders, Oracle TMS shipment execution records, and FourKites visibility events. SSOT for shipment identity and service commitment across the enterprise.

products.name: shipment_leg
products.description: Represents an individual transport leg within a multi-leg shipment journey, including ETA/ETD milestone predictions and last-mile dispatch details. Each consignment may traverse multiple legs (e.g., first-mile pickup → origin hub → linehaul → destination hub → last-mile delivery). Captures leg sequence number, transport mode (air/ocean/road/rail), carrier SCAC/IATA code, origin and destination location codes, planned and actual departure/arrival timestamps (ETD/ETA), predicted ETA with confidence score and prediction source (FourKites AI/carrier EDI/manual), vehicle/vessel/flight reference, leg status, distance, delivery agent ID (for last-mile legs), route code, dispatch sequence, and delivery attempt number. Enables end-to-end route visibility, SLA milestone tracking per leg, ETA prediction, and last-mile delivery performance measurement. Sourced from SAP TM route segments, Oracle TMS load plans, and FourKites predictive ETA engine.

products.name: manifest_line
products.description: This association product represents the loading record between a freight manifest and a consignment. It captures the operational act of loading a specific consignment onto a specific manifest, including line-level loading details such as sequence, loaded pieces, weight, volume, and line status. Each record links one freight manifest to one consignment with attributes that exist only in the context of this loading relationship. This is a core operational entity in TMS and freight systems, enabling load reconciliation, carrier handover documentation, and multi-leg shipment tracking.. Existence Justification: In freight logistics operations, manifest consolidation is a core operational process where multiple consignments are physically loaded onto a single transport vehicle, vessel, or aircraft (the manifest). Reciprocally, a single consignment can appear on multiple manifests across its multi-leg journey (e.g., origin terminal → hub → destination terminal). The manifest line is a recognized operational entity in TMS and WMS systems, representing the loading record with line-level data such as sequence, loaded pieces, weight, volume, and status that belongs to neither the manifest nor the consignment alone, but to the specific loading relationship.

attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance permitted for this customer account in the account's billing currency. Enforced by SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management module. Exceeding this limit triggers automatic shipment booking blocks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: credit_status
attributes.description: Current credit standing of the customer account as assessed by the Finance team in SAP S/4HANA. 'approved' allows standard credit terms; 'on_hold' blocks new shipment bookings pending payment; 'suspended' indicates credit facility withdrawn; 'under_review' indicates active credit reassessment; 'cash_only' requires prepayment for all services.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Credit Management; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: crm_account_code
attributes.description: External account identifier sourced from Salesforce CRM Account object. Used to trace the master record back to the system of record and support bi-directional synchronisation with Salesforce.

attributes.name: ctpat_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) Member Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is a validated member of the US Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) program. C-TPAT membership enables expedited US Customs and Border Protection processing and reduced examination rates for US-bound shipments.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Program (US CBP); ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: ddp_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is approved for Delivered Duty Paid (DDP) shipments, where Transport Shipping assumes responsibility for import duties and taxes on behalf of the customer. Requires credit approval and customs power of attorney on file.
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020 DDP; Descartes Customs GTM; C-TPAT Program Requirements

attributes.name: denied_party_screen_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent denied party and sanctions screening was performed for this customer account in Descartes Customs GTM. Used to enforce periodic re-screening compliance and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: US OFAC; EU Sanctions Regulation; Descartes Customs GTM Screening Log

attributes.name: denied_party_screened
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has passed the most recent denied party and sanctions screening check in Descartes Customs GTM. Must be True before any shipment booking is permitted. Automatically reset to False when screening expires or a watchlist update occurs.
attributes.references: US OFAC Sanctions List; EU Consolidated Sanctions List; UN Security Council Sanctions; Descartes Customs GTM; WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: duns_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit Dun & Bradstreet Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS) number uniquely identifying the customer's legal business entity globally. Used for credit risk assessment, supplier onboarding, and enterprise account hierarchy resolution.
attributes.references: Dun & Bradstreet DUNS Standard; ISO 6523 Organisation Identifier

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account is configured for Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) integration for automated shipment booking, Advanced Shipping Notices (ASN), and status updates. EDI-capable accounts bypass manual data entry workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo-XML Standards; UN/EDIFACT; ANSI X12 EDI Standards

attributes.name: eori_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) Number
attributes.description: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) number assigned by EU customs authorities to the customer for cross-border trade within the European Union. Required on all EU import/export customs declarations filed via Descartes Customs GTM.
attributes.references: EU Customs Code (Regulation EU 952/2013); WCO Data Model; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary industry sector of the customer's business (e.g., Automotive, Retail, Pharmaceutical, Technology, Perishables, Energy). Used for industry-specific SLA configuration, dangerous goods handling rules, and targeted sales analytics. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Retail|Pharmaceutical|Technology|Perishables|Energy|Aerospace|Consumer Goods|Industrial|Healthcare — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Classification; IMDG Code Chapter 1; ISO 3166 Industry Codes

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the KYC verification was last completed for this customer account. Used to enforce periodic KYC renewal cycles and regulatory audit compliance.
attributes.references: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations; EU AML Directives; US Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: kyc_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer account has completed Know Your Customer (KYC) identity verification as required by anti-money laundering (AML) regulations and Transport Shipping's customer onboarding policy. Required for high-value accounts and cross-border trade.
attributes.references: FATF AML/CFT Recommendations; EU 4th/5th AML Directive; US Bank Secrecy Act

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the customer account record, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Sourced from Salesforce CRM Account LastModifiedDate. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Silver Layer lakehouse pipeline.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC Pattern

attributes.name: last_shipment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent shipment booked or executed under this customer account. Used for dormancy detection, account health monitoring, and proactive retention outreach by the account management team.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Account Health KPI Framework

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the customer entity as recorded with the relevant national business registry. Used for customs declarations, trade compliance screening, and financial invoicing. For B2C individuals this is the full personal name.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; WCO Data Model; FATF AML Guidelines

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the customer account was formally activated and approved for shipment booking. Marks the start of the commercial relationship. Used for customer tenure analysis, anniversary-based tier reviews, and SLA effective date calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Created Date; ISO 8601 Date Format

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code assigned to the customer account (e.g., NET30, NET60, COD, PREPAID). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance customer master. Determines invoice due dates and early payment discount eligibility. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: NET30|NET60|NET90|COD|PREPAID|EOM|NET15 — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Payment Terms; IFRS 15; Incoterms 2020

attributes.name: preferred_incoterms_code
attributes.description: Customer's default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms 2020) code governing risk and cost transfer in shipments (e.g., DDP, FOB, CIF, EXW). Pre-populated on new shipment bookings and freight orders in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Data Model; IATA Cargo Tariff Rules

attributes.name: preferred_service_mode
attributes.description: Customer's preferred primary freight transport mode: air (express/freight), ocean (FCL/LCL), road (FTL/LTL), rail, or multimodal. Used by SAP TM for default carrier and route selection and by Blue Yonder for demand forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transport Mode Configuration; IATA; IMO; EU Regulation 2015/757

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the account's main operational contact. Used for shipment notifications, Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) alerts, invoice delivery, and service case communications via Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 & Article 6; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL

attributes.name: primary_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary operational contact person at the customer account. Used for shipment documentation, customs declarations, and account management correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; WCO Data Model Party Name

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the account's main operational contact in E.164 international format. Used for last-mile delivery coordination, exception management, and Proof of Delivery (POD) confirmation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 Numbering Plan

attributes.name: salesforce_owner_code
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM User ID of the account owner record. Retained for bi-directional synchronisation and audit traceability back to the Salesforce system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; GDPR Article 30 Records of Processing

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the contracted Service Level Agreement (SLA) tier applicable to this customer account. Determines On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, exception escalation thresholds, and guaranteed transit time commitments. Linked to the SLA entitlement configuration in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Configuration; IATA Service Level Standards; Transport Shipping SLA Policy

attributes.name: tax_number
attributes.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN) or Tax Identification Number (TIN) assigned by the national tax authority (e.g., IRS EIN for US entities). Used for financial reporting, 1099/W-9 compliance, and customs importer of record identification.
attributes.references: IRS EIN Requirements; SOX Section 302; WCO Importer of Record Standards

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: Operating or 'doing business as' (DBA) name used commercially by the customer, which may differ from the registered legal name. Used in customer-facing communications and shipment documentation.

attributes.name: vat_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Value Added Tax (VAT) / Goods and Services Tax (GST) Registration Number
attributes.description: Customer's VAT or GST registration number issued by the relevant tax authority. Required for cross-border invoicing, customs declarations, and EU VAT compliance. Null for B2C customers or entities in non-VAT jurisdictions.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC; WCO Data Model; IATA Resolution 010a

products.name: contact
products.description: Individual contact persons associated with customer accounts, including shipping coordinators, procurement managers, finance contacts, and authorized signatories. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact object. Captures full name, job title, department, communication preferences, language, time zone, and contact role (e.g., billing contact, operational contact, escalation contact).

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the contact person record in the Transport Shipping data platform. Primary key for the contact entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent customer account this contact is associated with. Links the contact to the B2B enterprise account, B2C shipper, or 3PL/4PL partner account in the customer domain.

attributes.name: mailing_address_book_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address_book. Business justification: Contact persons have mailing addresses used for correspondence, GDPR notifications, and regulatory communications. The contact table currently stores mailing_city, mailing_country_code, mailing_postal

attributes.name: reports_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the contact's managerial or supervisory contact within the same account. Mirrors the Salesforce CRM 'Reports To' relationship. Enables organizational hierarchy navigation for escalation routing and account planning.

attributes.name: contact_description
attributes.description: Free-text notes or description about the contact person, capturing additional context such as areas of responsibility, special handling instructions, relationship history, or account-specific notes entered by the account management team in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Functional role the contact plays in the customer relationship with Transport Shipping. Determines routing of communications, invoices, and service cases. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|operational|escalation|authorized_signatory|procurement|customs|compliance|executive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role; IATA Ground Handling Agreement

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Active contacts receive communications and are eligible for service interactions. Inactive contacts have left the organization or are no longer relevant. Do_not_contact respects opt-out or legal restrictions per GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact record indicating its priority and purpose within the account relationship. Primary contacts receive all standard communications; emergency contacts are activated for critical shipment exceptions or SLA breaches.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the contact record was first created in the source Salesforce CRM system. Represents the start of the contact's lifecycle in the customer relationship management process. Used for cohort analysis and data lineage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object (CreatedDate); GDPR Article 30; SOX

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for the contact record in Salesforce CRM (Contact object ID, e.g., 003XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Used for cross-system reconciliation and lineage tracing back to the operational system of record.

attributes.name: data_retention_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date after which the contact's personal data must be reviewed for deletion or anonymization in compliance with GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure) and the organization's data retention policy. Calculated based on the last active engagement date plus the applicable retention period.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17; GDPR Article 5(1)(e) (Storage Limitation); ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or business unit the contact belongs to within their company (e.g., Logistics, Procurement, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain). Supports targeted communications and service routing.

attributes.name: do_not_call
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of phone-based outreach. When true, outbound calls to this contact are suppressed in CRM workflows. Supports GDPR consent management and national do-not-call registry compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact person. Used for shipment notifications, EDI communications, invoice delivery, and CRM-driven customer service case correspondence. Governed under GDPR as personal data.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object; PCI DSS

attributes.name: email_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of marketing and non-transactional email communications. When true, only transactional emails (e.g., shipment confirmations, POD notifications) are permitted. Enforces GDPR Article 7 consent requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: fax
attributes.description: Fax number for the contact, used in legacy customs documentation, trade compliance filings, and formal freight forwarding communications where fax remains an accepted channel per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; WCO Data Model; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the contact person as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for personalized communications, correspondence, and identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full display name of the contact person (typically first_name + last_name). Sourced directly from Salesforce CRM Name field. Used as the primary human-readable identity label for the contact across logistics operations, EDI communications, and customer service interactions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact provided or last updated their GDPR data processing consent. Required for audit trail and regulatory compliance demonstration under GDPR Article 7(1).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities)

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Status
attributes.description: Current GDPR data processing consent status for the contact. Tracks whether the contact has given, withdrawn, or not yet provided consent for personal data processing. Mandatory for contacts in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives data retention and communication eligibility.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: is_authorized_signatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is an authorized signatory for shipping contracts, customs declarations, power of attorney for customs brokerage, and trade compliance documents. Critical for Descartes Customs and AEO/C-TPAT compliance validation.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; C-TPAT; AEO; Descartes Customs GTM; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is designated to receive invoices, freight charges, and financial communications. Billing contacts receive freight invoices, duty and tax statements, and payment reminders from SAP S/4HANA Finance AR processes.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR; SOX

attributes.name: is_customs_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated point of contact for customs clearance, trade compliance queries, ISF (Importer Security Filing), and AMS (Automated Manifest System) communications. Used by Descartes Customs for routing compliance notifications.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; US CBP ISF; AMS; C-TPAT; AEO; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary contact for the associated customer account. Only one contact per account should be flagged as primary. Drives default routing for shipment notifications, invoice delivery, and account management communications.

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Professional job title or designation of the contact person within their organization (e.g., Shipping Coordinator, Procurement Manager, Logistics Director, Finance Controller). Used for routing communications to the appropriate decision-maker and for account segmentation analytics.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the contact's preferred language for communications, shipping documents, and customer service interactions (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'zh-CN', 'de'). Ensures localized AWB, BOL, and customs documentation.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; IATA Resolution 600a; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: last_activity_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent logged activity (call, email, meeting, task) associated with this contact in Salesforce CRM. Used to identify dormant contacts, prioritize re-engagement campaigns, and measure account health.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the contact record in the source Salesforce CRM system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name or surname of the contact person as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for communications and reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: lead_source
attributes.description: Original source or channel through which this contact was acquired or entered the CRM system. Used for marketing attribution, sales pipeline analysis, and customer acquisition cost reporting in Salesforce CRM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|referral|trade_show|partner|cold_call|existing_customer|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn profile URL for the contact person. Used by account management and sales teams for relationship intelligence, opportunity tracking, and professional network engagement within Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile or cellular phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for SMS-based shipment tracking alerts, last-mile delivery notifications, and ePOD (Electronic Proof of Delivery) confirmations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number of the contact in E.164 international format. Used for shipment exception notifications, customs clearance coordination, and direct customer service interactions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: portal_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the contact's user account in the Transport Shipping customer self-service portal. Links the CRM contact to the portal login for shipment tracking, document retrieval, and service case submission. Enables single-sign-on (SSO) correlation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Community/Experience Cloud; ISO/IEC 27001; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: preferred_contact_channel
attributes.description: The contact's preferred communication channel for receiving shipment updates, service notifications, and account communications. Drives automated notification routing in TMS and CRM systems.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 7 (Consent)

attributes.name: salutation
attributes.description: Honorific or salutation prefix for the contact person (e.g., Mr., Ms., Dr.). Used in formal correspondence, shipping documentation, and customer communications to ensure professional address.

attributes.name: shipment_notification_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is subscribed to receive automated shipment status notifications including ETA updates, departure confirmations, POD (Proof of Delivery) alerts, and exception notifications from FourKites or the TMS.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Oracle TMS; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: sla_notification_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Notification Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is configured to receive SLA breach notifications and KPI performance alerts. When true, the contact is included in automated SLA exception communications from the TMS and FourKites visibility platform.
attributes.references: SLA Management Best Practices; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier representing the contact's local time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Singapore'). Used to schedule communications, SLA notifications, and delivery window alerts at appropriate local times.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

products.name: account_hierarchy
products.description: Defines parent-child relationships within enterprise customer account structures, supporting multi-national corporate hierarchies, subsidiary relationships, and regional account groupings. Enables consolidated billing, group-level SLA management, and enterprise revenue roll-up across global accounts. Tracks hierarchy level, relationship type (parent/subsidiary/affiliate), effective dates, and consolidation flags.

attributes.name: account_hierarchy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account hierarchy relationship record in the Transport Shipping customer domain. Primary key for the account_hierarchy data product.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 11179 Data Element Naming and Definition

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or framework agreement governing the enterprise account hierarchy relationship. Links to the contract and agreement domain for SLA entitlements, pricing terms, and service scope.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contract Object; SAP TM Contract Logistics

attributes.name: child_account_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the child (subsidiary, affiliate, or regional) account in the hierarchy. References the subordinate account linked to the parent for group-level management and revenue roll-up.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.compliance_program. Business justification: Multinational logistics customers manage AEO/C-TPAT compliance at the corporate hierarchy level for group-wide certification. Account hierarchy records must reference the group compliance program for

attributes.name: primary_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the parent account in the hierarchy. References the account that sits one level above the child account, enabling enterprise roll-up for consolidated billing and group SLA management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: Account hierarchies with pricing_inheritance_flag=true require a reference to the rate card that applies at the hierarchy level. Consolidated pricing for global corporate accounts — where a parent ent

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Account hierarchies in enterprise logistics are associated with a market segment that governs consolidated commercial terms, pricing inheritance, and SLA inheritance across the hierarchy. The account_

attributes.name: annual_contracted_revenue
attributes.description: Total annual contracted revenue committed by the enterprise account group under the master agreement. Used for group-level P&L reporting, EBITDA analysis, and account tier classification in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers; SOX Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the account hierarchy relationship was formally approved by the designated authority. Supports SOX audit trail and change management governance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Finance Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the Transport Shipping commercial or finance authority who approved the account hierarchy relationship. Required for SOX internal controls and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP S/4HANA Finance Approval Workflow

attributes.name: child_account_count
attributes.description: Number of direct child accounts linked to the parent account at this hierarchy level. Provides a structural summary for account management and hierarchy governance without requiring recursive queries.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy

attributes.name: consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's shipment charges and invoices are consolidated into the parent account's billing statement. When true, enables group-level invoice generation and payment management in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Consolidated Billing; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements

attributes.name: country_of_domicile
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the parent account's legal domicile. Determines applicable trade compliance regulations, customs requirements, and tax jurisdiction for the enterprise group.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; WCO Customs Compliance; WTO Trade Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the account hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Provides audit trail for record provenance and SOX compliance. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: credit_consolidation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's credit exposure is pooled with the parent account for group-level credit limit management. When true, credit checks in SAP S/4HANA Finance are evaluated at the parent account level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Credit Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure approved for the enterprise account group at the parent hierarchy level. Applied when credit_consolidation_flag is true. Managed in SAP S/4HANA Finance credit management module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Credit Management; SOX Section 404 Internal Controls

attributes.name: crm_account_hierarchy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Account Hierarchy ID
attributes.description: Salesforce CRM system identifier for the account hierarchy record. Enables cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the Salesforce CRM source of record for account management and opportunity tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy Object; EDI Cross-Reference Standards

attributes.name: data_privacy_region
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code indicating the primary data privacy jurisdiction applicable to the account hierarchy record. Determines GDPR, CCPA, or other regional data protection obligations for customer data handling.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 and Article 44; ISO/IEC 27001 Information Security Management

attributes.name: denied_party_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent denied party and sanctions screening was performed for the enterprise account group. Ensures compliance screening currency per regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs Denied Party Screening; OFAC Regulations; WCO Customs Compliance

attributes.name: denied_party_check_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent denied party and sanctions screening check for the enterprise account group. Managed in Descartes Customs denied party screening module. Flagged accounts require compliance review before shipment execution.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs Denied Party Screening; WCO Customs Compliance; US DOT Sanctions Compliance; OFAC Regulations

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the account hierarchy relationship becomes binding and operationally active. Used to manage time-bound corporate restructuring, mergers, and acquisitions in the customer master.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; Salesforce CRM Effective Dating

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which the account hierarchy relationship ceases to be binding. Nullable for open-ended relationships. Populated upon corporate restructuring, divestiture, or account termination.
attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; Salesforce CRM Effective Dating

attributes.name: erp_customer_hierarchy_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Customer Hierarchy ID
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Finance customer hierarchy node identifier for the account group. Enables reconciliation between CRM account structures and ERP financial hierarchies for consolidated billing and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy; IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: global_account_manager
attributes.description: Name of the Transport Shipping global account manager responsible for the enterprise account hierarchy. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account ownership for escalation routing and relationship management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Ownership; Transport Shipping Commercial Policy

attributes.name: hierarchy_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the account hierarchy relationship, used in Salesforce CRM and SAP S/4HANA Finance for cross-system reference and consolidated billing linkage.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy Standard; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric depth of the child account within the corporate hierarchy tree, where level 1 represents the ultimate parent (global account). Enables multi-tier enterprise account navigation and reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy Level

attributes.name: hierarchy_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the account hierarchy relationship, typically reflecting the corporate group name (e.g., 'Acme Corp Global Group'). Used in CRM dashboards and enterprise account reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: hierarchy_path
attributes.description: Materialized path string representing the full ancestry chain from root to child account (e.g., '/1001/2045/3087'). Enables efficient tree traversal queries for enterprise account reporting and consolidated billing without recursive joins.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy Path

attributes.name: hierarchy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the account hierarchy relationship. Controls whether the parent-child linkage is operationally active for billing consolidation, SLA management, and enterprise reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Status; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master Status

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classifies the purpose of the hierarchy structure. Corporate hierarchies reflect legal ownership; billing hierarchies drive consolidated invoicing; operational hierarchies manage service delivery; 3PL/4PL hierarchies manage logistics partner structures.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Hierarchy; SAP S/4HANA Customer Hierarchy Type

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: relationship_type

attributes.name: restructure_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for the creation or modification of the account hierarchy relationship. Supports audit trail and change management for corporate restructuring events. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: merger|acquisition|divestiture|reorganization|new_subsidiary|account_migration|other — promote to reference product if additional reasons are needed]
attributes.references: IFRS 3 Business Combinations; IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; SOX Change Management

attributes.name: revenue_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual contracted revenue amount. Ensures consistent multi-currency financial reporting across global enterprise accounts.

attributes.name: revenue_roll_up_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child account's revenue is rolled up to the parent account for enterprise-level P&L reporting and EBITDA analysis. Enables group revenue visibility in SAP S/4HANA Finance and CRM dashboards.

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM SLA Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: voting_rights_percentage

attributes.references: IFRS 10 Consolidated Financial Statements; FMC Ownership Disclosure Requirements

products.name: shipper_profile

Serves as the unified operational defaults profile for shipment booking automation and personalized service delivery.

attributes.name: aeo_certification_expiry
attributes.business_glossary_term: Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) Certification Expiry Date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the shipper's AEO certification. Used to trigger renewal alerts and to validate AEO status at the time of shipment booking in Descartes Customs.

attributes.name: ctpat_certification_expiry

attributes.name: default_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the shipper's default billing and invoicing currency. Used in freight charge calculation, COD amounts, and SAP S/4HANA Finance revenue recognition.

attributes.name: default_incoterms

Pre-populated on freight orders in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Data Model; IATA

attributes.name: default_packaging_type
attributes.description: Shipper's default packaging type used for shipment booking and warehouse operations. Drives packaging material selection, DIM weight calculation, and stacking rules in Manhattan WMS and SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA ULD Regulations; IMDG Code; ISO 3676

attributes.name: eori_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) Number
attributes.description: EU-issued Economic Operators Registration and Identification number used for customs declarations and cross-border trade compliance within the European Union. Required for EU import/export filings in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: EU Customs Code (UCC) Regulation 952/2013; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_expiry
attributes.description: Expiry date of the shipper's hazmat handling certification. Shipments tendered after this date will be blocked from hazmat routing until recertification is confirmed.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: hazmat_certification_number
attributes.description: Regulatory certification or registration number authorizing the shipper to tender dangerous goods. Required for IMDG (ocean) and IATA DGR (air) hazmat shipments. Validated in Descartes Customs during shipment booking.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: iata_shipper_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Shipper Code
attributes.description: IATA-assigned shipper identification code used in air freight documentation including House Air Waybills (HAWB) and Master Air Waybills (MAWB). Required for IATA-regulated air cargo bookings.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: is_cod_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) is enabled for shipments from this shipper. When true, COD collection instructions are appended to delivery orders and ePOD workflows.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: is_fragile_handling_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether shipments from this shipper require fragile handling by default. Triggers special handling instructions on freight orders and warehouse pick/pack operations in Manhattan WMS.

attributes.name: is_hazmat_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipper is authorized to tender hazardous materials shipments. When true, hazmat-specific handling, documentation, and carrier routing rules are applied. Validated against IMDG Code for ocean and IATA DGR for air shipments.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shipper regularly tenders temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipments. When true, temperature-controlled handling, equipment, and carrier capabilities are applied by default in SAP TM routing.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines (WHO); ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the shipper profile record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the shipper as it appears on Air Waybills (AWB), Bills of Lading (BOL), and customs declarations. Required for trade compliance and carrier documentation.

attributes.name: notification_channel

attributes.name: notification_email

attributes.name: notification_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for SMS-based shipment notifications and alerts. Used when notification_channel is set to sms. Must be in E.164 international format.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code

attributes.name: preferred_service_mode

attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing)

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA entitlement tier assigned to the shipper, determining priority handling, On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, exception escalation thresholds, and dedicated account management levels. Sourced from Salesforce CRM contract records.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any additional special handling requirements for shipments from this shipper that are not covered by structured flags (e.g., 'Do not stack', 'Keep upright', 'Requires liftgate at delivery'). Appended to freight orders in SAP TM.

attributes.name: tax_number

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments from this shipper. Used to specify cold chain equipment requirements and validate carrier capabilities.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or doing-business-as (DBA) trade name of the shipper, which may differ from the legal name. Used for customer-facing communications and account management in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.description: HTTPS endpoint URL registered by the shipper to receive real-time shipment event push notifications via webhook. Used when notification_channel is set to webhook. Must use HTTPS for security compliance.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; GDPR Article 32; FourKites API

attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS Last-Mile Scheduling

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_window_end
attributes.description: Consignee-preferred latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for delivery attempts. Defines the close of the acceptable delivery window for last-mile scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP TM Delivery Window Configuration; Oracle TMS Scheduling

attributes.name: preferred_delivery_window_start
attributes.description: Consignee-preferred earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour format) for delivery attempts. Used by last-mile routing engines in Oracle TMS and SAP TM to schedule delivery slots within SLA windows.
attributes.references: SAP TM Delivery Window Configuration; Oracle TMS Scheduling

attributes.name: profile_created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the consignee profile record was first created in the Transport Shipping data platform. Represents the record audit creation event for lineage and compliance tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing); SOX; ISO 28000

attributes.name: profile_updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the consignee profile record. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver layer and audit trail compliance.

attributes.name: requires_appointment
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee requires a pre-scheduled delivery appointment before a driver can attempt delivery. True triggers appointment scheduling workflow in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Appointment Scheduling; SAP TM

attributes.name: salesforce_account_code
attributes.description: External reference identifier from Salesforce CRM linking this consignee profile to the corresponding CRM account record for B2B consignees. Null for one-time B2C recipients.

attributes.name: signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a consignee signature is mandatory for proof of delivery (POD). When True, drivers must capture a digital signature via ePOD before completing the delivery event.
attributes.references: IATA ePOD Standards; Transport Shipping POD Policy

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: SLA entitlement tier assigned to this consignee profile, determining delivery time commitments, exception handling priority, and OTD/OTIF performance targets. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account entitlements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Entitlement Object; Transport Shipping SLA Policy

attributes.name: special_delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing consignee-specific delivery instructions such as dock number, gate access codes, forklift requirements, temperature-controlled unloading bay, or security check-in procedures.
attributes.references: SAP TM Delivery Note; Oracle TMS Shipment Instructions

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued tax identification number (TIN, VAT number, EIN, or equivalent) for the consignee. Required for customs declarations, duty invoicing, and trade compliance filings in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; GDPR Article 4; IFRS

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the consignee delivery location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to convert delivery window times to UTC for scheduling in SAP TM and FourKites.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; SAP TM Location Master

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: Operating or doing-business-as (DBA) trade name of the consignee, which may differ from the legal name. Used for operational labeling and customer-facing communications.

attributes.name: warehouse_dock_number
attributes.description: Specific dock door or bay number at the consignee's receiving facility. Used by drivers and Manhattan WMS for directed unloading and dock scheduling.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Dock Management; SAP TM Delivery Point

products.name: address_book
products.description: Centralized repository of all customer-associated addresses including origin pickup locations, delivery destinations, billing addresses, and warehouse addresses. Supports address validation, geocoding coordinates, address type classification (residential/commercial/warehouse/port), and address lifecycle management. Used across shipment booking, last-mile delivery, and customs declarations to ensure address standardization.

attributes.name: address_book_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each address record in the centralized address book. Primary key for the address_book data product.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (shipper, consignee, or account holder) who owns or is associated with this address record. Links the address to the customer master.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.facility. Business justification: Address book entries of type 'warehouse' or 'distribution_center' must link to actual facility records for dock scheduling, address validation, and facility-based shipment routing in transport logisti

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Customer addresses map to network nodes for routing and planning. Powers address-to-node geocoding, route optimization, network design, and facility assignment. Essential for translating customer loca

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: Address book entries must be mapped to delivery zones for last-mile routing, surcharge calculation (residential, remote area), and service availability checks. Zone-to-address mapping is a fundamental

attributes.name: address_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier or short code assigned to this address record, used in shipment booking, EDI transactions, and TMS integrations (e.g., SAP TM location code, Oracle TMS address code). Enables cross-system address referencing.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Location Master; Oracle TMS - Address Reference

attributes.name: address_label
attributes.description: Human-readable display name or alias for this address record (e.g., 'London Heathrow Warehouse', 'NYC HQ Billing', 'Shanghai Port CFS'). Used in shipment booking UIs, ePOD systems, and customer-facing communications to identify addresses without displaying full address details.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Address Label; GDPR Article 5 (Data Minimisation)

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and any suite or unit designation. This is the first and most critical line of the physical address used on shipping labels, AWBs, BOLs, and customs declarations.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Address Standard; WCO Customs Declaration

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, industrial estate, or complex name. Optional field used when the primary address line is insufficient to uniquely identify the delivery location.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Address Standard

attributes.name: address_line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line for additional location context such as district, neighborhood, or landmark reference. Commonly used in international addresses where additional geographic context is required for customs or last-mile delivery.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Address Standard; WCO Customs Declaration

attributes.name: address_role
attributes.description: Functional role this address plays in logistics operations. An address may be classified as an origin pickup location, delivery destination, billing address, return address, warehouse address, or notify party address. A single physical address may have multiple roles across different shipments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: origin|destination|billing|return|warehouse|notify_party — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM - Location Role; Incoterms 2020 (ICC); IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the address record. Active addresses are available for shipment booking. Pending_validation addresses are awaiting address verification. Deprecated addresses are retained for historical reference but not available for new bookings. Blacklisted addresses are blocked due to compliance or fraud concerns.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 - Quality Management; C-TPAT Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the physical address by its operational nature. Drives last-mile delivery rules, customs declaration requirements, and carrier surcharge logic. Residential addresses may attract residential delivery surcharges; port/airport addresses trigger terminal handling charge (THC) logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|warehouse|port|airport|border_crossing|free_trade_zone — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Ground Handling Manual; IMO Port Facility Standards; US DOT Address Classification

attributes.name: aeo_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official AEO certificate number issued by the relevant customs authority (e.g., EU EORI-based AEO number, C-TPAT account number). Required for customs pre-clearance, reduced inspection, and trusted trader benefits. Validated in Descartes Customs during shipment processing.
attributes.references: WCO AEO Framework; EU AEO Programme; C-TPAT (US CBP); AEO (Authorized Economic Operator Program)

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the entity at this address holds Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, which grants expedited customs clearance and reduced inspection rates. AEO-certified addresses enable simplified customs procedures and are prioritized in Descartes Customs trade compliance workflows.
attributes.references: WCO AEO Framework; EU AEO Programme (Regulation EC 648/2005); C-TPAT (US CBP)

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name of the address. Used in route planning, carrier zone determination, customs declarations, and last-mile delivery assignment. Critical for TMS routing and freight rate calculation.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42; WCO Customs Declaration; SAP TM Location Master

attributes.name: company_name
attributes.description: Name of the company, organization, or business entity at this address. Required for commercial shipments, customs declarations, and B2B delivery. Used on shipping labels, air waybills (AWB), bills of lading (BOL), and customs documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Air Waybill Standards; IMO Bill of Lading Requirements; WCO Customs Declaration Standards

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary contact at this address. Used for shipment notifications, electronic proof of delivery (ePOD) dispatch, customs pre-arrival notifications, and delivery exception alerts.

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary contact person at this address. Used for last-mile delivery coordination, customs notifications, and proof of delivery (POD) capture. Required for residential and commercial delivery addresses.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4 - Personal Data Definition; IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for the contact person at this address, in E.164 international format. Used for last-mile delivery notifications, exception management, and customs clearance coordination. Required by many carriers for residential delivery.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ITU-T E.164 International Numbering Plan

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the address (e.g., USA, GBR, CHN, DEU). Mandatory for cross-border shipments, customs declarations, Incoterms application, trade compliance screening, and international freight rate determination.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Customs Declaration; IATA Air Waybill Standards; IMO Bill of Lading

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides audit trail for address master data governance, GDPR data subject access requests, and SOX compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: customs_zone
attributes.description: Customs and trade compliance zone classification for this address. Free Trade Zone (FTZ) and bonded warehouse addresses require special customs handling in Descartes Customs. Special Economic Zone (SEZ) addresses may have preferential duty treatment. Drives customs declaration routing and duty calculation.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Convention; Descartes Global Trade Management; US CBP FTZ Regulations; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether dangerous goods (DG) shipments are permitted at this address. When False, the TMS and booking systems will block DG shipments to/from this address. Governed by IMDG Code for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR/RID for road/rail transport.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; ADR European Agreement on Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: delivery_window_close
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format) when deliveries or pickups are accepted at this address. Used alongside delivery_window_open to define the acceptable delivery time window for route planning and SLA management.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Time Window Constraints; Oracle TMS - Delivery Scheduling

attributes.name: delivery_window_open
attributes.description: Earliest time of day (HH:MM in 24-hour format) when deliveries or pickups are accepted at this address. Used by TMS route optimization to schedule delivery windows and ensure SLA compliance. Critical for warehouse and commercial addresses with restricted receiving hours.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Time Window Constraints; Oracle TMS - Delivery Scheduling

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is valid and available for use in shipment bookings and logistics operations. Supports address lifecycle management and temporal validity for contract logistics, where addresses may be activated on a specific date aligned with contract start.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP TM - Location Validity Period

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this address record is no longer valid for new shipment bookings. Null indicates an open-ended validity. Used for address lifecycle management when customers relocate, close facilities, or terminate contracts. Historical shipments referencing this address are retained for audit purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Date Standard; SAP TM - Location Validity Period; SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: eori_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Economic Operators Registration and Identification (EORI) Number
attributes.description: EORI number assigned by EU customs authorities to identify economic operators in customs declarations and trade transactions. Required for all import/export customs filings within the EU. Stored at the address level to support multi-site customers with different EORI registrations per facility.
attributes.references: EU Customs Code (Regulation EU 952/2013); WCO Customs Declaration Standards; Descartes Global Trade Management

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Type of logistics facility at this address when applicable. Drives specialized handling requirements in Manhattan WMS, carrier selection in SAP TM, and customs processing in Descartes. Cold storage facilities require temperature-controlled transport; bonded warehouses require customs bond management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: distribution_center|cross_dock|cold_storage|bonded_warehouse|cfs|icd|airport_cargo|seaport_terminal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS - Facility Configuration; IMO Port Facility Standards; IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded latitude/longitude coordinates. Rooftop indicates exact building-level precision; range_interpolated is street-level; geometric_center is centroid of a postal area; approximate is city/region level; unverified means coordinates have not been validated. Drives confidence in GPS-based routing and geofencing.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API Standards; FourKites Geofencing Configuration

attributes.name: hs_code_restriction
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of HS Code prefixes (Harmonized System codes per WCO) that are restricted or prohibited at this address due to local regulations, facility licensing, or trade compliance requirements. Used by Descartes Customs to flag non-compliant shipments during booking.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System (HS) Nomenclature; Descartes Global Trade Management; C-TPAT Compliance

attributes.name: is_default_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the customer's default billing address for invoice generation and accounts receivable processing in SAP S/4HANA Finance. When True, this address is used for all financial documents unless overridden at the shipment level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance - Customer Master; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: is_default_destination
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the customer's default delivery destination. When True, this address is pre-populated as the destination in shipment booking workflows, supporting frequent lane customers and e-commerce fulfillment automation.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Default Location Configuration; Oracle TMS - Shipment Booking

attributes.name: is_default_origin
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the customer's default pickup/origin location for shipment booking. When True, this address is pre-populated as the origin in shipment booking workflows in SAP TM and Oracle TMS, reducing data entry errors.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Default Location Configuration; Oracle TMS - Shipment Booking

attributes.name: is_residential
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is classified as a residential location. Residential addresses trigger carrier-specific residential delivery surcharges (e.g., FedEx, UPS residential fees), require different last-mile delivery protocols, and may affect SLA commitments for D2D (door-to-door) services.
attributes.references: US DOT Residential Delivery Classification; IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this address record was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for change data capture (CDC) in ETL pipelines, optimistic locking in concurrent update scenarios, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 27001 Audit Logging

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), ranging from -90 to +90. Used for GPS-based last-mile routing, geofencing in FourKites real-time visibility, proximity-based warehouse assignment, and route optimization in TMS.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum (ISO 6709); FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS84 datum), ranging from -180 to +180. Used alongside latitude for GPS-based routing, geofencing, real-time shipment tracking, and network design optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: WGS84 Geodetic Datum (ISO 6709); FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address. Used for carrier zone mapping, freight rate calculation, last-mile delivery routing, dimensional weight (DIM weight) zone surcharges, and address validation. Format varies by country.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Address Standard; IATA Rate Construction Manual

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this address record originated. Enables data lineage tracking, conflict resolution during master data synchronization, and audit compliance. Salesforce CRM is the primary source for customer-facing addresses; SAP TM and Oracle TMS for logistics locations.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS; Salesforce CRM; Manhattan WMS; Descartes Customs; ISO/IEC 27001 Data Governance

attributes.name: source_system_address_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this address record in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce CRM Address ID, SAP TM Location ID, Oracle TMS Address Code). Enables bidirectional synchronization, change data capture (CDC), and cross-system reconciliation during EDI processing.
attributes.references: SAP TM - Location Master; Salesforce CRM - Address Object; Oracle TMS - Address Reference

attributes.name: special_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text field for special handling or access instructions at this address (e.g., 'Deliver to loading dock B', 'Call 30 minutes before arrival', 'Gate code: 1234', 'No deliveries before 08:00'). Transmitted to last-mile carriers and drivers via TMS dispatch notes.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS - Delivery Instructions; Manhattan WMS - Outbound Shipping Notes

attributes.name: standardized_address
attributes.description: Full normalized and standardized address string as returned by the address validation provider, conforming to postal authority formatting rules. Used as the canonical address for printing on shipping labels, AWBs, and customs declarations to ensure deliverability.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42 Address Standard; USPS Publication 28

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes where applicable. Required for domestic routing, tax jurisdiction determination, and US/Canada customs filings (AMS, ISF).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2 Country Subdivision Codes; US CBP AMS/ISF Filing Requirements

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the address location (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Used to correctly interpret delivery windows, calculate ETA/ETD in local time, and schedule last-mile delivery notifications across global operations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IATA Timetable Standards

attributes.name: validation_provider
attributes.description: Name of the third-party address validation service or postal authority database used to validate this address (e.g., USPS, Loqate, SmartyStreets, Google Maps, HERE). Enables audit trail for address quality and supports provider performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Address Quality Standards

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the address standardization and validation process against postal authority databases (e.g., USPS, Royal Mail, Deutsche Post). Validated addresses have been confirmed deliverable. Failed addresses contain errors. Partial addresses are incomplete but usable. Used to enforce address quality gates in shipment booking workflows.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Address Quality Standards; USPS Address Standardization

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the address was last validated against a postal authority or address verification service. Used to determine if re-validation is required based on address data freshness policies.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union (UPU) Address Quality Standards; ISO 9001 Quality Management

products.name: segment
products.description: Market segmentation classification for customer accounts defining commercial tiers, revenue bands, and strategic groupings used for pricing, SLA assignment, and account management. Captures segment code, segment name, revenue threshold ranges, assigned account management model (strategic/commercial/digital), eligible service lines, and segment review cycle. Supports differentiated service delivery and targeted commercial strategies.

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer segment record. Primary key for the customer_segment data product in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Customer segments are often governed by segment-level master agreements defining pricing models, SLA tiers, and volume commitments for all accounts in that segment. Commercial management and segment p

attributes.name: primary_trade_lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Customer segments are scoped to primary trade lanes (e.g., Asia-Pacific exporters). Segment has primary_trade_lane as a denormalized text field — replacing with a proper FK enables lane-level segment

attributes.name: tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.tariff. Business justification: Customer segments reference standard published tariffs for regulatory compliance and baseline pricing. In transport logistics, segments often map to tariff classes (e.g., retail vs wholesale). Require

attributes.name: account_management_model
attributes.description: Defines the assigned account management approach for customers in this segment: STRATEGIC = dedicated named account manager with executive sponsorship; COMMERCIAL = shared account management team; DIGITAL = digital-first with inside sales support; SELF_SERVE = fully automated self-service with no dedicated account manager.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management Framework; Transport Shipping Commercial Policy

attributes.name: api_access_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: Application Programming Interface (API) Access Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are entitled to direct API (Application Programming Interface) access to Transport Shipping's TMS and WMS platforms for automated shipment booking, tracking, and reporting.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Digital Integration Policy; ISO/IEC 27001 API Security

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the commercial authority (e.g., VP Commercial, Regional Pricing Director) who approved this segment definition. Required for SOX audit trail and commercial governance compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Date on which this segment definition was formally approved by the designated commercial authority. Used for audit trail, governance reporting, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy

attributes.name: commercial_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier classification indicating the level of service, pricing, and account management investment assigned to this segment. STRATEGIC = top-tier enterprise accounts with dedicated account teams; PREMIUM = high-value accounts with enhanced SLAs; STANDARD = mid-market accounts; BASIC = transactional accounts; DIGITAL = self-serve digital-only accounts.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Segmentation Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment record was first created in the system of record (Salesforce CRM) and ingested into the Databricks Silver Layer. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform convention.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO/IEC 11179; Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum credit exposure in USD extended to customers within this segment. Used by SAP S/4HANA Finance Accounts Receivable for credit control and order release decisions. Confidential financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance AR; SOX Compliance; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this segment record in Salesforce CRM (15 or 18-character Salesforce record ID). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Databricks Silver Layer and the Salesforce CRM source of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Segmentation; Transport Shipping Data Integration Standards

attributes.name: customs_facilitation_level
attributes.description: Level of customs clearance facilitation entitlement for customers in this segment. AEO_FAST_TRACK applies to segments serving Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certified customers eligible for expedited customs processing via Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs Global Trade Management; WCO AEO Programme; C-TPAT; EU AEO Regulation 2015/2446

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are eligible to ship dangerous goods (DG) under IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) and IMDG Code. When TRUE, additional compliance checks and documentation requirements apply.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: dedicated_warehouse_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment qualify for dedicated warehouse space and labour allocation within Transport Shipping's distribution network, as managed by Manhattan WMS.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS; Transport Shipping Warehouse Service Catalogue; ISO 9001

attributes.name: discount_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the discount tier applicable to this segment, governing base rate reductions, General Rate Increase (GRI) exemptions, Bunker Adjustment Factor (BAF) caps, and Terminal Handling Charge (THC) waivers. Confidential as it reflects commercial negotiation outcomes.
