attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy; FMC Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: ecommerce_fulfillment_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are entitled to access e-commerce fulfillment services including last-mile delivery, returns management (RMA), and Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) processing.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping E-Commerce Fulfillment Service Catalogue; Manhattan WMS

attributes.name: edi_integration_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are required to exchange transactional data (shipment orders, ASNs, invoices) via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI). Drives onboarding and integration requirements.
attributes.references: IATA EDI Standards; UN/EDIFACT; Transport Shipping Integration Policy

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this segment definition becomes effective and can be used for customer assignment, pricing, and SLA entitlement. Supports temporal validity management in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy; IFRS 15; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this segment definition expires and is no longer valid for new customer assignments. NULL indicates the segment is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used for segment lifecycle management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy; IFRS 15; ISO/IEC 11179

attributes.name: eligible_service_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of logistics service lines that customers in this segment are eligible to access (e.g., 'EXPRESS_PARCEL,FREIGHT_AIR,FREIGHT_OCEAN,CUSTOMS_BROKERAGE,ECOMMERCE_FULFILLMENT'). Governs service entitlement and product catalogue access. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXPRESS_PARCEL|FREIGHT_AIR|FREIGHT_OCEAN|FREIGHT_ROAD|FREIGHT_RAIL|CUSTOMS_BROKERAGE|WAREHOUSE|ECOMMERCE_FULFILLMENT|LAST_MILE|CONTRACT_LOGISTICS — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS; Transport Shipping Service Catalogue

attributes.name: erp_segment_code
attributes.description: Segment code as recorded in SAP S/4HANA Finance for revenue allocation, cost center assignment, and P&L reporting by customer segment. Enables financial reporting alignment between the data lakehouse and ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; SOX Financial Reporting; IFRS; Transport Shipping Finance Policy

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage scope of the segment, indicating whether it applies to global enterprise accounts, regional accounts, domestic-only shippers, or cross-border trade customers. Influences route and network planning in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Transport Shipping Network Design; WTO Trade Regulations

attributes.name: incoterms_preference
attributes.description: Preferred International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to customers in this segment, defining the allocation of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee. Sourced from contract agreements and Salesforce CRM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product if full Incoterms 2020 set required]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO; Descartes Customs; Transport Shipping Trade Compliance Policy

attributes.name: invoice_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated and issued to customers in this segment. Drives billing cycle configuration in SAP S/4HANA Finance and impacts cash flow planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Transport Shipping Billing Policy

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this segment record in the source system or Silver Layer. Used for incremental data loading, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Accuracy); ISO/IEC 11179; Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: otd_target_pct
attributes.description: Contractual On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance target expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for customers in this segment. Used in KPI reporting, SLA compliance monitoring, and carrier performance management.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping SLA Framework; ISO 9001; IATA Performance Standards

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.description: Contractual On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance target expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00) for customers in this segment. Measures both delivery timeliness and order completeness. Used in supply chain performance reporting.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping SLA Framework; ISO 9001; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Standard payment terms code applicable to customers in this segment (e.g., NET30, NET60, PREPAID, COD). Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance and governs invoice due dates and cash collection processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance AP/AR; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; Transport Shipping Credit Policy

attributes.name: preferred_transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary transport mode preference for customers in this segment (AIR, OCEAN, ROAD, RAIL, or MULTIMODAL). Used in SAP TM carrier selection and route planning to pre-configure default routing for segment accounts.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; IATA; IMO; DOT; Transport Shipping Network Policy

attributes.name: pricing_model_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the pricing model applied to customers in this segment (e.g., CONTRACTED_RATE, SPOT_RATE, VOLUME_DISCOUNT, TARIFF_PUBLISHED). Drives charge calculation in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. Confidential as it reflects commercial pricing strategy.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy; IATA Rate Regulations

attributes.name: real_time_visibility_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are entitled to real-time shipment tracking and predictive ETA services via FourKites. Typically reserved for STRATEGIC and PREMIUM commercial tiers.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; Transport Shipping Digital Service Catalogue

attributes.name: revenue_band_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annualised revenue threshold in USD defining the upper boundary of this segment's revenue band. NULL indicates an open-ended upper bound (e.g., for the highest-tier segment). Used alongside revenue_band_min_usd for segment qualification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy

attributes.name: revenue_band_min_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annualised revenue threshold in USD that a customer account must meet to qualify for this segment. Used in segment assignment logic and periodic segment review cycles. Expressed in USD for global comparability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition; IFRS 15; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy

attributes.name: revenue_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the revenue band thresholds (revenue_band_min_usd, revenue_band_max_usd) are denominated. Defaults to USD for global segments; may be set to local currency for region-specific segments.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: review_criteria
attributes.description: Narrative description of the criteria used during the segment review cycle to determine whether a customer account should be upgraded, downgraded, or retained in this segment (e.g., revenue performance, shipment volume, strategic partnership status).
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which customer accounts assigned to this segment are reviewed for re-segmentation based on updated revenue, volume, and strategic criteria. Drives the account management review calendar in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management; Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the customer segment (e.g., ENT-GOLD, SME-SILVER, B2C-STANDARD). Used as the business key across CRM, TMS, and billing systems. Sourced from Salesforce CRM account segmentation module.

attributes.name: segment_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment's commercial profile, target customer characteristics, and strategic intent. Used for onboarding account managers and informing pricing strategy.

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the customer segment (e.g., 'Enterprise Gold', 'SME Silver', 'B2C Standard'). Used in reporting dashboards, account management workflows, and commercial strategy documents.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment definition: ACTIVE = in use for customer assignment and pricing; INACTIVE = suspended from new customer assignments; DRAFT = under review and not yet published; DEPRECATED = retired segment retained for historical reporting only.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Commercial Governance Policy; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Broad classification of the segment by customer relationship type: B2B (business-to-business enterprise accounts), B2C (individual consumer shippers), 3PL (Third-Party Logistics partners), 4PL (Fourth-Party Logistics orchestrators), GOVERNMENT (public sector entities), or INTERNAL (intra-company accounts).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; IATA; IMO; Transport Shipping Commercial Policy

attributes.name: shipment_volume_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum annualised shipment volume (number of shipments) defining the upper boundary of this segment's volume band. NULL indicates open-ended upper bound for the highest-volume segment tier.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Management; Oracle TMS; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy

attributes.name: shipment_volume_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum annualised shipment volume (number of shipments) threshold for segment qualification. Complements revenue thresholds for volume-based segmentation used in logistics pricing and SLA assignment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Management; Oracle TMS; Transport Shipping Pricing Policy

attributes.name: sla_tier_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the SLA tier entitlement assigned to customers in this segment. Determines On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, On-Time In-Full (OTIF) commitments, claims response times, and escalation thresholds. Linked to the SLA tier reference product.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping SLA Framework; ISO 9001 Quality Management; IATA Service Standards

attributes.name: sustainability_reporting_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether customers in this segment are entitled to receive Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) and Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions reporting for their shipments. Supports customer ESG compliance and EU ETS reporting obligations.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; GHG Protocol; Transport Shipping Sustainability Policy

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this segment definition, incremented each time the segment criteria, thresholds, or entitlements are revised. Supports change history tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Transport Shipping Data Governance Policy; SOX; ISO/IEC 11179

products.name: sla_entitlement
products.description: Defines service level entitlements and volume commitments granted to a customer account, specifying OTD targets, OTIF commitments, transit time guarantees, pickup cut-off times, claims resolution SLAs, escalation thresholds, and minimum volume thresholds (TEU, kg, shipment count) by service line or lane. Captures SLA tier, applicable service modes, performance measurement methodology, penalty/incentive clauses for under/over-performance, measurement periods, and effective date ranges. Distinct from contract domain SLA templates — this is the customer-specific instantiated entitlement.

attributes.name: sla_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer-specific SLA entitlement record in the silver layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: SLA entitlements in logistics are often fulfilled by specific customs brokers or freight agents contractually responsible for meeting transit and clearance SLAs. Agent-specific SLA measurement and bre

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent commercial contract or agreement under which this SLA entitlement is granted. Distinct from the entitlement itself — the contract domain holds the template; this record is the customer-specific instantiation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Contract Management; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Enterprise SLA agreements often specify carrier-specific performance guarantees (e.g., 'Carrier X: 99% OTD on EU lanes'). Contract management, performance measurement, and penalty/incentive calculatio

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: SLA transit time guarantees are tied to specific carrier services (e.g., 'DHL Express Worldwide 2-day'). SLA measurement and OTD reporting require knowing which carrier service the entitlement applies

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this SLA entitlement is instantiated. Links to the customer master in the customer domain.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: SLA entitlements are lane-specific contractual commitments. Required for lane-level performance monitoring, OTD/OTIF measurement by lane, penalty/incentive calculation, and contractual compliance repo

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.partner. Business justification: Freight forwarders and 3PLs (network partners) are often contractually responsible for SLA delivery, distinct from carriers. SLA entitlements with freight forwarder partners require a partner FK for p

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: SLA entitlements are co-negotiated with rate cards in logistics contract management. The rate card defines pricing commitments while the SLA defines service commitments — both are referenced together

attributes.name: reporting_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary customer contact who receives SLA performance reports and is the designated recipient for escalation notifications under this entitlement.

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.service_corridor. Business justification: SLA entitlements are scoped to service corridors (e.g., Asia-Europe express). Corridor-level SLA reporting and customer commitment tracking require this link. Logistics domain experts expect entitleme

attributes.name: sla_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_sla_commitment. Business justification: Customer SLA entitlements must be traceable to the specific contract SLA commitment that backs them. Compliance audits, SLA breach investigations, and penalty calculations require verifying that each

attributes.name: tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: E-commerce fulfillment SLA entitlements are commonly with 3PL providers (pick-pack-ship SLAs, same-day dispatch). No existing 3PL FK on sla_entitlement. Required for 3PL SLA breach reporting, penalty

attributes.name: transit_time_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.transit_time_standard. Business justification: SLA compliance measurement requires linking customer entitlements to the published transit time standard they are measured against. Logistics KPI reporting (OTD, OTIF) depends on comparing actual vs.

attributes.name: auto_renewal
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA entitlement automatically renews at the end of the effective period without requiring explicit renegotiation. When True, the entitlement rolls over under the same terms unless terminated.
attributes.references: SAP TM Contract Management; Salesforce CRM Entitlement

attributes.name: claims_resolution_sla_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Claims Resolution Service Level Agreement (SLA) Days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days within which a cargo claim must be acknowledged, investigated, and resolved under this SLA entitlement. Drives claims team prioritization and escalation triggers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; CMR Convention; Montreal Convention (Air Cargo Claims)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA entitlement record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Provides audit trail for record provenance and data lineage in the silver layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: crm_entitlement_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this SLA entitlement record in Salesforce CRM. Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system of record.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary fields in this SLA entitlement record (penalty_cap_amount, incentive amounts). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-currency customer accounts.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS Financial Reporting; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_end
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) by which delivery must be completed to be considered on-time under this SLA entitlement. Defines the close of the delivery window for time-definite commitments.
attributes.references: SAP TM Delivery Window; Oracle TMS Time-Definite Delivery

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_start
attributes.description: Earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) within which delivery must be attempted to be considered on-time under this SLA entitlement. Used for time-definite delivery commitments (e.g., AM delivery windows).
attributes.references: SAP TM Delivery Window; Oracle TMS Time-Definite Delivery

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination geography of the lane covered by this SLA entitlement. Null if the entitlement is not lane-specific.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this SLA entitlement becomes binding and enforceable. Performance measurement begins on or after this date.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP TM Contract Validity

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this SLA entitlement expires and ceases to be enforceable. Null indicates an open-ended entitlement with no fixed expiry. Aligns with contract renewal cycles.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP TM Contract Validity

attributes.name: entitlement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name for this SLA entitlement, e.g., 'Gold Express OTD Commitment — APAC Lane'. Used in customer-facing documents and CRM dashboards.

attributes.name: entitlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for this SLA entitlement, used in customer communications, CRM service cases, and operational reporting. Format: SLA- followed by alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Entitlement Object; SAP TM Service Level Agreement

attributes.name: entitlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the SLA entitlement. 'active' means the entitlement is in force; 'suspended' means temporarily paused (e.g., force majeure); 'expired' means the effective period has lapsed; 'pending_activation' means approved but not yet in effect; 'terminated' means cancelled before natural expiry; 'draft' means under negotiation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Entitlement Status; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours after a shipment misses its committed delivery time before an automatic escalation is triggered to the account management or operations team. Enables proactive exception management for high-value customers.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Escalation Rules; FourKites Exception Management

attributes.name: exclusion_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text description of conditions under which SLA performance failures are excluded from penalty calculations, such as force majeure events, customs delays, natural disasters, consignee unavailability, or regulatory holds. Sourced from contract terms.
attributes.references: Incoterms 2020; WCO Customs Procedures; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: grace_period_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours beyond the committed delivery time that are tolerated before a shipment is classified as a late delivery for SLA measurement purposes. Accounts for minor operational variances and is agreed upon at contract negotiation.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Configuration; Oracle TMS Tolerance Window

attributes.name: incentive_clause_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial incentive or rebate clause is in effect for over-performance against the SLA targets. When True, the incentive_rate_pct field defines the reward structure.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance Contract Accounting

attributes.name: incentive_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the applicable freight charge or contract value awarded as a financial incentive or rebate for each percentage point of SLA over-performance above the committed target. Active only when incentive_clause_applicable is True.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this SLA entitlement record was most recently updated, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports change detection, incremental processing, and audit compliance in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Audit Trail Requirements

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this SLA entitlement was last formally reviewed with the customer in a business review meeting. Used to track review cadence compliance and trigger upcoming review scheduling.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology used to measure SLA performance, including how on-time is defined (e.g., first delivery attempt, POD scan time, ePOD timestamp), exclusions (e.g., force majeure, customs delays, consignee unavailability), and data source (e.g., FourKites, SAP TM, Oracle TMS).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; SAP TM Performance Reporting

attributes.name: measurement_period
attributes.description: Frequency at which SLA performance is measured and reported against the committed targets. Determines the rolling window for OTD, OTIF, and volume threshold calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP TM SLA Reporting

attributes.name: min_volume_shipment_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of shipments the customer commits to tender per measurement period to qualify for the SLA entitlement terms. Failure to meet this threshold may trigger tier renegotiation or penalty clauses.
attributes.references: SAP TM Volume Commitment; Oracle TMS Volume Threshold

attributes.name: min_volume_teu
attributes.description: Minimum volume in Twenty-Foot Equivalent Units (TEU) the customer commits to tender per measurement period. Applicable to ocean freight FCL/LCL services. TEU is the standard unit of container capacity measurement per IMO and FMC conventions.
attributes.references: IMO Container Standards; FMC Ocean Shipping Reform Act; SAP TM Volume Commitment

attributes.name: min_volume_weight_kg
attributes.description: Minimum chargeable weight in kilograms the customer commits to tender per measurement period. Applicable primarily to air freight and express services where weight-based volume commitments are standard.
attributes.references: IATA Air Cargo Tariff; SAP TM Volume Commitment

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal SLA performance review with the customer. Derived from last_reviewed_date and review_frequency but stored explicitly to support scheduling and CRM activity management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days advance notice required by either party to terminate or renegotiate this SLA entitlement before its effective_until_date. Governs contract exit obligations.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP TM Contract Management

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin geography of the lane covered by this SLA entitlement. Null if the entitlement is not lane-specific.

attributes.name: otd_target_pct
attributes.description: Contractually committed On-Time Delivery (OTD) rate expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Defines the minimum proportion of shipments that must be delivered within the agreed transit time window to meet the SLA. Core KPI for logistics SLA performance measurement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP TM SLA Configuration; IATA Performance Standards

attributes.name: otif_target_pct
attributes.description: Contractually committed On-Time In-Full (OTIF) rate expressed as a percentage (0.00–100.00). Measures the proportion of shipments delivered both on time and with complete quantity/content as ordered. Stricter than OTD alone; commonly required by retail and e-commerce customers.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP TM SLA Configuration

attributes.name: penalty_cap_amount
attributes.description: Maximum financial penalty amount (in the contract currency) that can be levied against Transport Shipping in a single measurement period for SLA under-performance. Caps total financial exposure under the penalty clause.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: penalty_clause_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial penalty clause is in effect for under-performance against the SLA targets. When True, the penalty_rate_pct and penalty_cap_amount fields define the financial exposure.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance Contract Accounting

attributes.name: penalty_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the applicable freight charge or contract value applied as a financial penalty for each percentage point of SLA under-performance. Active only when penalty_clause_applicable is True.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: pickup_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) by which a shipment must be tendered for pickup to qualify for same-day transit under this SLA entitlement. Shipments tendered after this time are counted against the next business day for OTD measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Pickup Window; Oracle TMS Cut-Off Configuration; IATA Cargo Acceptance

attributes.name: review_frequency
attributes.description: Agreed frequency at which SLA performance is formally reviewed with the customer in a business review meeting. Drives scheduling of Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and account management activities.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Management; ISO 9001 Management Review

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Business service line or product family to which this SLA entitlement applies, e.g., Express Parcel Delivery, Freight Forwarding, E-Commerce Fulfillment, Contract Logistics, Customs Brokerage. Aligns with the core business processes of Transport Shipping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|supply_chain_mgmt|customs_brokerage|warehouse_distribution|ecommerce_fulfillment|last_mile|contract_logistics|cross_border — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Product; Oracle TMS Service Configuration

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: Transport or logistics service mode to which this SLA entitlement applies, e.g., Air Express, Ocean FCL, Road FTL, Road LTL, Rail, Parcel. Determines which operational processes are governed by this entitlement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: air_express|ocean_fcl|ocean_lcl|road_ftl|road_ltl|rail|parcel|last_mile|warehouse — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Air Cargo Standards; IMO SOLAS; SAP TM Transport Mode

attributes.name: sla_tier
attributes.description: Commercial tier classification of the SLA entitlement, reflecting the level of service commitment and associated pricing. Platinum represents the highest commitment level; standard represents baseline service.
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Level Agreement; Salesforce CRM Entitlement

attributes.name: transit_time_guarantee_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days from shipment pickup to delivery guaranteed under this SLA entitlement. Defines the transit time window used to evaluate OTD compliance. Expressed in whole days; fractional-day commitments use transit_time_guarantee_hours.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time; Oracle TMS Transit Commitment; IATA Air Cargo SLA

attributes.name: transit_time_guarantee_hours
attributes.description: Maximum number of hours from shipment pickup to delivery guaranteed under this SLA entitlement. Used for express and time-definite services where day-level granularity is insufficient (e.g., next-day AM, same-day delivery). Takes precedence over transit_time_guarantee_days when both are populated.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time; IATA Express Delivery Standards

products.name: service_preference
products.description: Stores customer-level operational preferences governing how shipments are handled, routed, and communicated. Includes preferred transport modes, carrier preferences, packaging requirements, notification preferences (SMS/email/EDI), tracking visibility settings, default Incoterms, COD preferences, and special handling instructions (e.g., fragile, temperature-controlled, IMDG hazmat). Enables automated shipment booking defaults and personalized service delivery.

attributes.name: service_preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the customer service preference record. Primary key for the service_preference data product within the customer domain.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Customer service preferences (incoterms, service level, transport mode) are contractually defined in a master agreement. Logistics ops teams must validate that preferences align with contracted terms;

attributes.name: compliance_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.compliance_program. Business justification: Customers with AEO or C-TPAT compliance program membership require specific service preferences (expedited clearance, reduced examination). Logistics operators configure service preferences directly a

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom these service preferences are defined. Links to the master customer record in the customer domain.

attributes.name: edi_partner_id
attributes.description: The customer's EDI interchange partner identifier (ISA qualifier + ID or EDIFACT interchange address) used for automated B2B document exchange including ASNs, invoices, and shipment status messages. Applicable for enterprise B2B customers.
attributes.references: EDI X12 ISA Segment; EDIFACT UNB Segment; ANSI ASC X12

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's preferred warehouse or distribution center for order fulfillment and storage operations. Used in Manhattan WMS for inventory slotting and order routing.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Facility Master; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: preferred_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: customs_clearance_preference is plain text on service_preference. Customers designate preferred customs brokers/agents for import and export clearance. This drives automated agent assignment in custom

attributes.name: preferred_carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Customer service preferences specify preferred_service_level as plain text. Automated booking systems require a FK to the actual carrier service record to apply correct rates, transit times, and equip

attributes.name: preferred_lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Customer service preferences specify preferred lanes for routing optimization. Powers TMS routing engine, enforces customer-specific lane selection rules, and ensures service level compliance. Critica

attributes.name: preferred_service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.service_corridor. Business justification: Customer service preferences specify preferred corridors driving TMS lane selection and rate negotiation. Existing FK covers preferred_lane_id but not corridor. Logistics domain experts expect service

attributes.name: preferred_tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Customers in e-commerce logistics designate a preferred 3PL for warehousing and fulfillment. This preference drives automated warehouse assignment and WMS integration. No existing 3PL FK on service_pr

attributes.name: primary_service_preferred_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's preferred carrier for shipment execution. Used in SAP TM carrier selection and Oracle TMS freight audit to prioritize carrier assignment when capacity and rates are comparable.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Master; Oracle TMS Carrier Configuration

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: Service preferences specify which rate card applies to customer's shipments. Critical for multi-rate-card customers (different cards for air vs ocean, domestic vs international). Drives rating engine

attributes.name: service_scope_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.service_scope. Business justification: Service preferences must be validated against the contracted service scope to ensure customers only request services covered by their agreement. Booking validation and order acceptance processes depen

attributes.name: transit_time_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.transit_time_standard. Business justification: Customer service preferences define the applicable transit time standard (e.g., 3-day express vs. 7-day economy). TMS uses this during shipment planning to apply the correct standard. Logistics domain

attributes.name: aeo_certificate_number
attributes.description: Official AEO certificate number issued by the relevant customs authority. Used in Descartes Customs for automated declaration pre-population and expedited clearance routing. Applicable only when aeo_certified is true.
attributes.references: WCO AEO Framework; EU AEO Regulation; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer holds an Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, entitling them to expedited customs processing and reduced inspection rates. Stored to enable AEO-based routing and compliance benefits in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO AEO Framework; EU AEO Regulation (EC) No 648/2005; C-TPAT

attributes.name: asn_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires an Advanced Shipping Notice (ASN) to be transmitted prior to shipment departure. When true, ASN generation is triggered in Manhattan WMS and transmitted via EDI (X12 856 or EDIFACT DESADV) to the customer.
attributes.references: EDI X12 856 ASN; EDIFACT DESADV; Manhattan WMS

attributes.name: awb_type_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preference for Air Waybill (AWB) type on air freight shipments. 'HAWB' (House Air Waybill) is issued by the freight forwarder; 'MAWB' (Master Air Waybill) is issued by the airline; 'either' allows system-driven selection. Impacts IATA cargo documentation and customs filing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a (AWB); IATA Cargo Services Conference

attributes.name: bl_type_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preference for Bill of Lading (BOL) type on ocean freight shipments. 'HBL' (House Bill of Lading) is issued by the NVOCC or freight forwarder; 'MBL' (Master Bill of Lading) is issued by the ocean carrier. Impacts FMC compliance and customs filing in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: FMC Regulations; IMO; Descartes Customs; NVOCC Rules

attributes.name: co2e_offset_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preference for carbon offset participation. 'none' means no offset; 'voluntary' means the customer opts into voluntary carbon offset programs; 'mandatory' means offset is contractually required. Supports CORSIA compliance and sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: CORSIA; EU ETS; GHG Protocol Corporate Standard

attributes.name: cod_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) collection is enabled for this customer's shipments. When true, delivery drivers are authorized to collect payment at the point of delivery. Relevant for B2C and e-commerce fulfillment scenarios.
attributes.references: SAP TM COD Configuration; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR

attributes.name: cod_max_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary value authorized for COD collection per shipment for this customer. Enforced during last-mile delivery dispatch to manage cash handling risk. Expressed in the customer's default currency.
attributes.references: SAP TM COD Rules; SAP S/4HANA Finance; PCI DSS

attributes.name: container_load_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preference for ocean freight container loading. 'FCL' (Full Container Load) provides exclusive use of a container; 'LCL' (Less Than Container Load) consolidates cargo with other shippers. Drives container booking logic in SAP TM and Oracle TMS load optimization.
attributes.references: IMO; FMC; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service preference record was first created in the system. Sourced from Salesforce CRM customer preference creation event. Used for audit trail and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); SOX Section 404; ISO/IEC 27001

attributes.name: customs_clearance_preference
attributes.description: Indicates how the customer prefers customs clearance to be managed. 'self_clearance' means the customer handles their own customs filings; 'broker_managed' means a third-party customs broker is used; 'transport_managed' means Transport Shipping handles clearance as part of the service. Drives workflow routing in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO Kyoto Convention; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: declared_value_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is required to declare the cargo value on all shipments. When true, shipment booking validation enforces declared value entry, which is used for customs valuation in Descartes Customs and insurance calculation.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Valuation Agreement; Descartes Customs; IATA

attributes.name: default_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the customer's preferred billing and invoicing currency for freight charges. Used in SAP S/4HANA Finance revenue recognition and SAP TM charge calculation.

attributes.name: default_incoterms
attributes.description: Customer's default International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) governing risk and cost transfer for shipments. Applied automatically during shipment booking in SAP TM. Aligns with ICC Incoterms 2020 rules and WTO trade compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO; Descartes Customs Trade Compliance

attributes.name: dim_weight_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate dimensional weight (DIM weight) for rating and billing purposes. Determines whether IATA volumetric divisor, carrier-specific divisor, or IMDG rules apply. Impacts freight charge calculation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 502; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this service preference profile becomes active and is applied to shipment bookings. Supports seasonal and project-based preference management.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this service preference profile expires and is no longer applied. Nullable for open-ended preferences. Supports contract-aligned and seasonal preference windows.

attributes.name: epod_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires an electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) to be captured and transmitted upon shipment completion. When true, last-mile delivery drivers must capture digital signature or photo confirmation. Supports SLA compliance and invoice release workflows.
attributes.references: FourKites ePOD; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: hazmat_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer is authorized to ship hazardous materials (hazmat) under IMDG Code (ocean), IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (air), or DOT regulations (road). When true, hazmat documentation and compliance checks are triggered in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICAO Technical Instructions; US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: insurance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer requires cargo insurance to be arranged by Transport Shipping for their shipments by default. When true, insurance coverage is automatically included in shipment booking and charge calculation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; IMO; IATA; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: label_format
attributes.description: Customer's preferred shipping label output format for parcel and freight labels. ZPL (Zebra Programming Language) is standard for thermal printers; PDF for laser printing; EPL for legacy Eltron printers; PNG for digital/web display. Configured in Oracle TMS shipment execution.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Label Configuration; IATA Resolution 606 (Air Waybill)

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service preference record was most recently updated. Tracks preference changes for audit compliance under SOX and GDPR accountability requirements. Used for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; SOX Section 404; Salesforce CRM Audit Trail

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Customer's preferred channel for shipment status notifications and alerts. Drives automated notification dispatch in FourKites real-time visibility platform and Salesforce CRM service communications. EDI applies to B2B enterprise customers using EDIFACT or X12 messaging.
attributes.references: FourKites Notification Configuration; EDI X12 / EDIFACT; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: notification_events
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of shipment lifecycle events that trigger customer notifications (e.g., 'booked,picked_up,in_transit,customs_cleared,out_for_delivery,delivered,exception'). Configures FourKites exception management and Salesforce CRM service case alerts.
attributes.references: FourKites Event Configuration; Salesforce CRM; IATA Cargo Tracking Standards

attributes.name: preference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this service preference profile, used in EDI integrations, API calls, and customer-facing communications. Sourced from Salesforce CRM customer preference records.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; EDI X12 / EDIFACT Standards

attributes.name: preference_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for this service preference profile, enabling customers and operations staff to distinguish between multiple preference sets (e.g., 'Standard B2B Freight', 'E-Commerce Express').
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM; SAP TM Customer Profile

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service preference record. 'active' means preferences are applied to new shipment bookings; 'inactive' means preferences are archived; 'pending' means awaiting customer or operations approval; 'suspended' means temporarily disabled.

attributes.name: preference_type
attributes.description: Classification of the preference profile indicating its scope and application context. 'default' applies to all shipments unless overridden; 'override' supersedes defaults for specific lanes or periods; 'seasonal' applies during defined date windows; 'project' is tied to a specific contract or project.

attributes.name: preferred_destination_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customer's default shipment destination country. Used in SAP TM route planning and Descartes Customs trade compliance screening for import declarations and HS code validation.

attributes.name: preferred_origin_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the customer's default shipment origin country. Used in SAP TM route planning and Descartes Customs trade compliance screening for export declarations.

attributes.name: preferred_packaging_type
attributes.description: Customer's default packaging format for shipments, used to pre-populate booking forms and drive warehouse packing instructions in Manhattan WMS. Supports slotting optimization and labor management.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Packaging Configuration; ISO 780 Packaging Marking

attributes.name: preferred_service_level
attributes.description: Customer's preferred shipment service level tier governing transit time and cost trade-off. Maps to SLA entitlements and carrier product codes in SAP TM charge calculation and Oracle TMS load optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Level Configuration; IATA Service Categories

attributes.name: preferred_transport_mode
attributes.description: Customer's preferred primary mode of transport for shipments. Drives automated carrier and route selection in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. Values align with IATA (air), IMO (ocean), and DOT (road/rail) modal classifications.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: road_load_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preference for road freight load type. 'FTL' (Full Truckload) provides exclusive truck capacity; 'LTL' (Less Than Truckload) consolidates with other shipments. Used in SAP TM route planning and Oracle TMS load optimization.
attributes.references: US DOT; SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this service preference record originated. Supports data lineage tracking and conflict resolution in the Databricks Silver Layer. 'manual' indicates direct data entry by operations staff.

attributes.name: special_handling_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of special handling instruction codes applicable to this customer's shipments by default (e.g., 'FRAGILE,TEMP_CTRL,HAZMAT,PERISHABLE,HIGH_VALUE,OVERSIZED'). Drives warehouse handling procedures in Manhattan WMS and carrier booking requirements in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Special Handling Codes (SPH); IMDG Code; Manhattan WMS

attributes.name: sustainability_reporting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted into carbon emissions reporting for their shipments. When true, GHG (Greenhouse Gas) and CO2e (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent) data is calculated and included in customer sustainability reports, aligned with EU ETS and CORSIA requirements.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; GHG Protocol; ISO 14064

attributes.name: temp_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Used to configure cold chain monitoring alerts in FourKites and warehouse environment controls in Manhattan WMS. Applicable only when temperature_controlled is true.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines; FourKites IoT Monitoring

attributes.name: temp_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable temperature in degrees Celsius for temperature-controlled shipments. Used to configure cold chain monitoring alerts in FourKites and warehouse environment controls in Manhattan WMS. Applicable only when temperature_controlled is true.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines; FourKites IoT Monitoring

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer's shipments require temperature-controlled handling and transport by default. When true, cold chain equipment and monitoring requirements are applied during booking in SAP TM and warehouse slotting in Manhattan WMS.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines; Manhattan WMS Cold Chain

attributes.name: tracking_visibility_level
attributes.description: Granularity of shipment tracking data shared with the customer via FourKites or customer portal. 'full' provides GPS-level real-time updates; 'milestone' provides key event updates (pickup, customs, delivery); 'summary' provides ETA and final status only; 'none' disables customer-facing tracking.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; IATA Cargo Tracking

products.name: service_case
products.description: Customer service case records sourced from Salesforce CRM capturing complaints, service failures, shipment inquiries, claims initiation requests, and general support interactions. Tracks case number, case type, priority, status, root cause category, resolution details, SLA breach flag, escalation history, and linked shipment or AWB references. Distinct from the claim domain which manages financial liability — this entity manages the customer service workflow.

attributes.name: service_case_id

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record associated with this service case, if the case relates to a specific shipment event or delivery failure.

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific customer contact person who submitted or is the primary point of contact for this service case.

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Service cases frequently address customs declaration issues (rejections, amendments, duty disputes). Required for: case-to-declaration traceability, root cause analysis, SLA tracking for customs clear

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_order. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.incoterms_assignment. attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_event. Business justification: When network disruptions (port closures, weather events) cause service failures, cases are opened referencing the triggering event. root_cause_category is plain text. Linking to network_event enables

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_partner. Business justification: Service cases often involve non-carrier network partners (warehouse damage, customs clearance delays, 3PL errors). Customer service teams need direct partner attribution for escalation, performance tr

attributes.name: penalty_clause_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.penalty_clause. Business justification: When a service case results in a penalty (late delivery, damage, SLA breach), the specific penalty clause being invoked must be referenced for claims resolution, credit note generation, and dispute ma

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_plan. Business justification: Service cases reference specific route plans that experienced execution failures. Essential for route execution issue tracking, delivery failure investigation, operational exception root cause analysi

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: Last-mile service cases (delivery failures, surcharge disputes, window violations) are zone-specific. Linking service_case to route_delivery_zone enables zone-level exception analysis and SLA breach r

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.segment. Business justification: Service cases are categorized by the customer's account segment for SLA prioritization, escalation routing, and performance reporting (e.g., enterprise-tier cases get different response targets than S

attributes.name: sla_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_entitlement. Business justification: A service case is directly governed by a specific SLA entitlement — when a case is opened for SLA breach (sla_first_response_breached, sla_resolution_breached flags), it must reference the exact entit

attributes.name: spot_quote_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.spot_quote. Business justification: Billing dispute and spot-quote-not-honored cases are a primary service case type in logistics. Customer service agents must reference the original spot_quote when resolving pricing disputes, overcharg

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Root-cause supplier attribution: when a service failure (damage, delay, mis-delivery) is caused by a procurement supplier (e.g., packaging vendor, IT provider, customs broker), the service_case must r

attributes.name: tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Fulfillment failure cases (wrong pick, late dispatch, damaged goods) involve 3PL providers as the responsible party. service_case links to carrier, agent, and partner but not 3PL. Required for 3PL per

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill (AWB) number linked to this service case when the case relates to an air freight shipment. Follows IATA AWB format: 3-digit airline prefix followed by 8-digit serial number. Enables direct cross-reference to air freight documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a — Air Waybill; IATA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading (BOL) number linked to this service case when the case relates to an ocean or road freight shipment. Enables cross-reference to freight forwarding documentation and carrier records.
attributes.references: Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) — Bill of Lading Requirements; IMO

attributes.name: case_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case record was first created in Salesforce CRM. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the customer interaction was formally logged. Used as the baseline for all SLA (Service Level Agreement) calculations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CreatedDate); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the customer's issue, complaint, or inquiry as captured at case creation. May include shipment details, service failure context, or customer-provided evidence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Description); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable case reference number assigned by Salesforce CRM at case creation. Used in all customer-facing communications and SLA tracking. Format: CS- followed by 8–12 digits.

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the service case lifecycle. Drives operational queues, SLA breach monitoring, and customer communication triggers. Transitions: new → in_progress → pending_customer | escalated → resolved → closed.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Status); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service case by the nature of the customer interaction. Drives routing, SLA assignment, and reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipment_inquiry|service_failure|complaint|claims_initiation|billing_dispute|general_support|customs_query|returns_rma — promote to reference product if additional types are added]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Type); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: claims_initiated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service case has triggered the initiation of a formal cargo claim in the claims domain. True when the case type is claims_initiation and a claim record has been created. Provides the handoff signal between customer service workflow and financial liability management.
attributes.references: ISO 9001; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC); IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case was formally closed after customer confirmation or automatic closure policy. Distinct from resolved_timestamp — a case may be resolved but remain open pending customer acknowledgement.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (ClosedDate); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: customer_feedback_notes
attributes.description: Free-text verbatim feedback provided by the customer as part of the post-case satisfaction survey. Complements the numeric CSAT score with qualitative insight for service improvement analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CSAT Comments); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction rating provided by the customer upon case closure, typically on a 1–5 scale. Sourced from Salesforce CRM post-case survey. Key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for service quality measurement and agent performance management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (CSAT); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipment destination location referenced in this service case. Used for cross-border service failure analysis, last-mile delivery issue routing, and trade compliance case categorization.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; WCO (World Customs Organization); IMO

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: The highest escalation tier reached by this case. Populated when is_escalated is True. Used for escalation pattern analysis and workforce capacity planning. None indicates no escalation occurred.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Escalation Rules; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or structured reason provided by the agent when escalating the case. Documents the business justification for escalation, such as SLA breach risk, high-value customer, or regulatory sensitivity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: escalation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the most recent escalation event was triggered for this case. Null if the case has never been escalated. Used for escalation response time analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: first_response_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the first substantive agent response was sent to the customer after case creation. Used to calculate SLA (Service Level Agreement) first-response compliance and OTD (On-Time Delivery) of service commitments.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Milestone (First Response); SLA governance

attributes.name: is_escalated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this service case has been formally escalated to a senior agent, team lead, or management tier at any point in its lifecycle. True if any escalation event has occurred.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (IsEscalated); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case record was most recently updated in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail maintenance in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (LastModifiedDate); GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy); SOX

attributes.name: last_reopened_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the case was most recently reopened after a prior resolution or closure. Null if the case has never been reopened. Used alongside reopen_count for resolution quality analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: origin_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel through which the customer submitted this service case. Used for channel analytics, staffing optimization, and omnichannel service reporting. EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) channel applies to B2B automated case submissions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Origin); IATA Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the shipment origin location referenced in this service case. Used for cross-border service failure analysis, customs-related case routing, and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; WCO (World Customs Organization); IMO

attributes.name: pod_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether the requested Proof of Delivery (POD) or Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) document has been successfully retrieved and attached to this case. Used to track case resolution blockers.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT; IATA

attributes.name: pod_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Proof of Delivery (POD) or Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) document has been requested as part of resolving this service case. Common for delivery dispute and non-receipt inquiry cases.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT; IATA

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to the service case, determining response time targets and escalation thresholds per the customer SLA entitlement. Critical cases typically involve time-sensitive freight or enterprise account failures.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Priority); SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance

attributes.name: reopen_count
attributes.description: Number of times this service case has been reopened after being marked as resolved or closed. A non-zero value indicates resolution quality issues. Used for first-contact resolution (FCR) KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case History; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolution_code
attributes.description: Standardized code describing the action taken to resolve the service case. Distinct from root cause — this captures what was done, not why it happened. Used for resolution effectiveness analytics and SLA compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: reshipped|refunded|credited|apology_issued|information_provided|escalated_to_claim|no_action_required|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Resolution); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the specific resolution actions taken, agent findings, and any commitments made to the customer. Captured at case closure and retained for audit and quality review.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Resolution); ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: resolved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the service case was first marked as resolved. Used to calculate total resolution time, SLA (Service Level Agreement) resolution compliance, and agent productivity metrics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Milestone (Resolution); SLA governance; ISO 9001

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the underlying root cause identified during case investigation. Critical for operational improvement, KPI (Key Performance Indicator) reporting, and recurring failure analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: carrier_delay|customs_hold|documentation_error|damage_in_transit|lost_shipment|billing_error|system_error|weather_event|address_issue|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; Salesforce CRM — Case Object (custom root cause field)

attributes.name: service_mode
attributes.description: The transport mode or service type associated with the shipment or service failure referenced in this case. Drives routing to specialized service teams (e.g., air freight team vs. last-mile delivery team).
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: sla_first_response_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) First Response Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the first response SLA (Service Level Agreement) target was breached for this case. True if the first_response_timestamp exceeded the sla_response_target_hours from case creation. Key KPI (Key Performance Indicator) for customer service quality reporting.
attributes.references: SLA governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_resolution_breached
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Breach Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resolution SLA (Service Level Agreement) target was breached for this case. True if the resolved_timestamp exceeded the sla_resolution_target_hours from case creation. Drives escalation workflows and executive service quality dashboards.
attributes.references: SLA governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_resolution_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Resolution Target Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the case must be fully resolved, as defined by the applicable SLA (Service Level Agreement) for this account segment and priority combination.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: sla_response_target_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Response Target Hours
attributes.description: The contracted or policy-defined maximum number of hours within which the first agent response must be delivered to the customer, as defined by the applicable SLA (Service Level Agreement) for this account segment and priority combination.
attributes.references: SLA (Service Level Agreement) governance; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: source_system_case_code
attributes.description: The native case identifier from Salesforce CRM (e.g., Salesforce Case ID / 18-character Salesforce record ID). Retained for lineage traceability, reconciliation with the source system, and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) integration cross-referencing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Case Object (Id); SOX; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Short, descriptive title of the service case as entered by the customer or agent. Used for case list views, search, and initial triage. Typically 255 characters or fewer.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Customer-facing parcel or shipment tracking number associated with this service case. Used for last-mile delivery inquiries, POD (Proof of Delivery) disputes, and express parcel service failures.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; US DOT Shipment Tracking Standards

products.name: onboarding

Ensures compliance with regulatory due diligence requirements.

attributes.name: api_connectivity_status

attributes.name: data_sharing_permission_level

attributes.name: denied_party_screen_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent denied party and sanctions screening was performed for this partner. Used to enforce periodic re-screening compliance intervals as required by trade compliance policy and Descartes Customs GTM workflows.

attributes.name: denied_party_screened

attributes.name: edi_connectivity_status

attributes.name: edi_partner_qualifier

attributes.name: effective_from_date

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the partner relationship expires or is scheduled to terminate. Null indicates an open-ended relationship with no fixed end date. Used for contract renewal alerts and SLA expiry management.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_regions

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between the customer and the partner for shipments executed under this relationship. Governs liability transfer points in cross-border shipping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: insurance_certificate_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the partner's cargo and liability insurance certificate. Required for high-value shipment authorization and claims processing. Validated against minimum coverage thresholds defined in the master service agreement.
attributes.references: IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims; IATA Resolution 600b Cargo Liability

attributes.name: insurance_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the partner's cargo and liability insurance certificate expires. Triggers renewal alerts and may result in relationship suspension if insurance lapses before renewal is confirmed.

attributes.name: kyc_verification_date

attributes.name: kyc_verified

Required for financial settlement and high-value freight partnerships.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: onboarding_date

attributes.name: partner_code

attributes.name: performance_rating

attributes.name: relationship_status

domains.description: Manages freight forwarding operations and order lifecycle across air, ocean, road, and rail modes including FTL, LTL, FCL, LCL, and TEU-based container movements. Integrates with SAP TM and Oracle TMS.

Acts as the primary anchor entity linking transport documents, charges, milestones, and exceptions. Sourced from SAP TM freight order management module.

attributes.name: destination_port_or_facility

attributes.name: dim_weight_kg
attributes.description: Calculated dimensional weight in kilograms derived from shipment volume using the applicable DIM factor (e.g., 1:6000 for air). The chargeable weight is the higher of gross weight and DIM weight. Stored as a business field to support charge audit and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: eta

attributes.references: IATA; IMO; FourKites Predictive ETA; SAP TM

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) from the origin port or facility. Used for vessel/flight scheduling, carrier coordination, and customer notification. Sourced from SAP TM and updated via FourKites real-time visibility.

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Base freight charge amount for this order before surcharges and adjustments, in the billing currency. Represents the core revenue line for freight forwarding. Used for revenue recognition, P&L reporting, and freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 15

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the shipment in kilograms as declared by the shipper. Used for freight charge calculation, carrier capacity planning, and customs declarations. Mandatory field per IATA and IMO regulations.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; WCO; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: incoterms_code

attributes.name: payment_terms

attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS; SLA (Service Level Agreement) frameworks
