attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the first intermediate transit/transfer point in the routing, if applicable. Null for direct flights. Used for multi-leg routing documentation on the AWB.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: freight_charge_amount
attributes.description: Total base freight charge for the shipment calculated as chargeable weight multiplied by the rate per kg, in the billing currency. Represents the primary revenue line for the air freight service. Used for revenue recognition per IFRS 15.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total actual gross weight of the shipment in kilograms as declared by the shipper, including packaging and pallets. Used for load planning, aircraft weight and balance, and freight charge calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ICAO Annex 18; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: hawb_number
attributes.description: The House Air Waybill number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC to the individual shipper when consolidating multiple shipments under a single MAWB. Null when the AWB is a direct shipment not consolidated under a master. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Cargo Services Conference Resolutions Manual

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The ICC Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between shipper and consignee (e.g., EXW, FOB, CIF, DDP). Determines freight charge responsibility and customs clearance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WCO Data Model; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the shipment contains dangerous goods as classified under IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) and ICAO Technical Instructions. When true, additional DGR documentation and handling procedures are mandatory.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR); ICAO Technical Instructions for the Safe Transport of Dangerous Goods by Air; IMDG Code

attributes.name: isf_filing_number
attributes.description: The US Customs and Border Protection Importer Security Filing (ISF, also known as 10+2) reference number. Required for ocean and air cargo imports into the United States for advance security screening.
attributes.references: US CBP ISF Regulations (19 CFR 149); C-TPAT; US DOT

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the air waybill was formally issued and signed, representing the principal business event timestamp for this contract of carriage. Corresponds to the execution date of the freight contract between shipper and carrier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: issue_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time (with timezone offset) when the air waybill was issued in SAP TM. Provides sub-day precision for operational sequencing and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; SAP TM Air Freight Module

attributes.name: mawb_number
attributes.description: The Master Air Waybill number issued by the airline or ground handling agent, formatted as the 3-digit IATA airline prefix followed by an 8-digit serial number (e.g., 176-12345678). Serves as the primary contract of carriage between the shipper and the airline. Sourced from SAP TM air freight module.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: origin_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the airport of departure where the cargo is tendered to the airline (e.g., DXB, FRA, JFK). Used for routing, rate determination, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Coding Directory; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country where the goods were manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations, preferential tariff determination, and trade compliance screening.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO Rules of Origin; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: pieces_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual pieces, packages, or handling units included in this shipment as declared on the AWB. Used for cargo acceptance, loading, and delivery verification.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: pod_signatory_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual who signed for receipt of the cargo at delivery, as captured on the electronic or paper proof of delivery (ePOD). Used for delivery confirmation and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cargo was confirmed as delivered to the consignee and proof of delivery (POD) was captured. Used for OTD measurement, SLA compliance, and triggering final invoice settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Tracking and Tracing; ISO 9001; FourKites ePOD

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: IATA rate class code indicating the type of rate applied to this shipment (e.g., N=Normal, Q=Quantity, M=Minimum, B=Basic, C=Specific Commodity, E=Express, R=Reduced, S=Surcharge, U=Unit Load Device, X=Express). Determines the applicable tariff structure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: N|Q|M|B|C|E|R|S|U|X — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Tariff Coordinating Conference Resolutions; IATA Rate Construction Manual

attributes.name: rate_per_kg
attributes.description: The agreed freight rate applied per kilogram of chargeable weight for this shipment, in the billing currency. Commercially sensitive pricing data used for revenue recognition and freight audit.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Rate Construction Manual; IFRS 15

attributes.name: second_transit_airport_code
attributes.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the second intermediate transit/transfer point in the routing, if applicable. Null for direct or single-transit flights. Supports complex multi-leg air freight routing.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Air Waybill Handbook

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The service level or product type for this air freight shipment (e.g., EXPRESS for next-flight-out priority, STANDARD for regular scheduled service, DEFERRED for economy/consolidation, CHARTER for full aircraft charter, COURIER for express parcel). Determines SLA commitments and pricing tier.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; SAP TM Air Freight Module

attributes.name: special_handling_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of IATA Special Handling Codes (SHC) applicable to this shipment (e.g., DGR=Dangerous Goods, PER=Perishables, VAL=Valuables, HUM=Human Remains, AVI=Live Animals, COL=Cold Chain). Drives handling instructions, storage requirements, and regulatory compliance checks.
attributes.references: IATA Special Handling Codes; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IATA Live Animals Regulations; IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations

attributes.name: total_charge_amount
attributes.description: Grand total of all charges on the AWB including base freight charge and all other charges (surcharges, fees, taxes). Represents the total amount due from the shipper or consignee. Used for invoice generation and accounts receivable.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA CASS; IFRS 15; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The 4-digit United Nations identification number for dangerous goods (e.g., UN1263 for paint, UN3480 for lithium ion batteries). Mandatory when is_dangerous_goods is true. Used for emergency response, handling, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; ICAO Technical Instructions; UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the air waybill record in the source system. Used for change detection, incremental loads, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric measurement of the shipment in cubic meters (CBM). Used to calculate dimensional weight (DIM weight) and determine the chargeable weight when volume weight exceeds actual weight.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IATA Rate Construction Manual

products.name: bill_of_lading

Stores MBL and HBL numbers, vessel name, voyage number, port of loading (POL), port of discharge (POD), place of delivery, container numbers, seal numbers, commodity description, number of packages, gross weight, CBM, freight terms (prepaid/collect), and NVOCC details. Governed by FMC and IMO regulations. Sourced from SAP TM ocean freight module.

attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the bill of lading record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse. Primary key for the bill_of_lading data product. TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: consignee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignee (importer/receiver) party to whom the cargo is consigned. Links to the consignee_profile in the customer domain.

The existing consignee_id points to fulfillment.consignee, not customer.consignee_profile. A direct link to consignee_pr

attributes.description: Reference to the party to be notified upon arrival of the vessel at the port of discharge. Typically the customs broker or freight forwarder. Links to the customer domain.

attributes.name: actual_arrival_date
attributes.description: Actual date the vessel arrived at the port of discharge. Used for transit time calculation, demurrage and detention computation, customs import filing, and on-time delivery (OTD) KPI reporting.

attributes.name: actual_departure_date

attributes.name: bol_status

Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS minimum category.

Determines negotiability and title transfer rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: master|house|seaway|straight|order|surrender — promote to reference product if additional types emerge]

attributes.name: container_count

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the cargo is destined. Used for import customs declarations, denied party screening, and trade compliance checks via Descartes Customs.

attributes.name: eta
attributes.description: Estimated date and time the vessel is scheduled to arrive at the port of discharge. Used for consignee notification, customs pre-arrival filing, port berth planning, and on-time delivery (OTD) performance measurement. Updated dynamically via FourKites predictive ETA.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; SAP TM; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; AMS 19 CFR 4.7

attributes.name: etd
attributes.description: Estimated date and time the vessel is scheduled to depart from the port of loading. Used for cargo cut-off planning, shipper notification, and SLA monitoring. Sourced from SAP TM ocean freight module and updated via FourKites real-time visibility.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; SAP TM; FourKites Real-Time Visibility

attributes.name: freight_amount
attributes.description: Base ocean freight charge amount as stated on the bill of lading, before surcharges. Expressed in the currency indicated by freight_currency_code. Used for freight invoice reconciliation, revenue recognition in SAP S/4HANA Finance, and freight audit in Oracle TMS. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (base amount component).
attributes.references: FMC 46 CFR Part 515; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA Finance; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: freight_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the freight charges are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, CNY). Required for multi-currency freight invoice processing and foreign exchange revaluation in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET minimum category (currency code component).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 21 (Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates); SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: freight_surcharge_amount

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Indicates who is responsible for paying the ocean freight charges: prepaid (shipper pays), collect (consignee pays), or third party (a nominated third party pays). Drives accounts receivable and accounts payable processing in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Total gross weight of the cargo including packaging, as declared by the shipper, expressed in kilograms. Used for vessel stability calculations, freight charge computation, customs declarations, and dangerous goods compliance under IMDG Code.
attributes.references: IMO SOLAS Chapter VI; IMDG Code; Hague-Visby Rules; FMC 46 CFR Part 515

attributes.name: hbl_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier issued by the NVOCC or freight forwarder to the shipper for the house bill of lading. Represents the contract of carriage between the forwarder and the shipper. Distinct from the MBL number issued by the ocean carrier.

attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); SOLAS Chapter VII; US DOT 49 CFR 172

attributes.description: Unique 7-digit IMO vessel identification number assigned by IHS Markit on behalf of IMO. Provides a permanent, globally unique identifier for the vessel independent of name changes or flag changes. Used for regulatory compliance and vessel tracking.

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: ICC Incoterms 2020 code defining the division of costs, risks, and responsibilities between the shipper and consignee. attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; UCP 600 (ICC); WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: is_hazardous

attributes.name: is_negotiable

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the bill of lading was officially issued by the carrier or NVOCC. attributes.name: mbl_number

attributes.name: place_of_issue

attributes.name: place_of_receipt
attributes.description: Location where the carrier takes custody of the cargo, which may differ from the port of loading (e.g., an inland container depot (ICD) or container freight station (CFS)). Defines the start of the carrier's responsibility under the contract of carriage.

attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the cargo is discharged from the ocean vessel. Represents the destination port for the ocean leg. Used for customs import filing, terminal handling charge (THC) calculation, and delivery planning.

attributes.name: port_of_loading
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the port where the cargo is loaded onto the ocean vessel. Represents the origin port for the ocean leg of the shipment. Used for freight rate calculation, customs export filing, and carrier scheduling.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the ocean freight service: Full Container Load (FCL), Less than Container Load (LCL), Roll-on/Roll-off (RORO), bulk, or break-bulk. Determines container allocation, consolidation requirements, and applicable tariff structures.

attributes.description: Weight of the cargo contents excluding packaging, measured in kilograms. Required for customs declarations and commodity valuation.

attributes.name: packaging_type

attributes.name: piece_count

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number used to identify the cargo across systems and documentation such as bills of lading and shipping instructions.

attributes.name: special_handling_instructions

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo can be stacked upon during storage and transport, affecting load plan optimization and warehouse utilization.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo requires temperature-controlled transport and storage (reefer equipment).

attributes.name: teu_count
attributes.description: Number of TEUs (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) this cargo occupies, used for ocean freight capacity planning and terminal operations.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for which this cargo is configured, determining applicable regulations and handling procedures.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: Four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous substance or article, prefixed with 'UN'. Required for dangerous goods documentation and placarding.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the cargo measured in cubic meters. Used for volumetric weight calculations, container utilization, and load planning.

attributes.name: width_cm

domains.name: warehouse
domains.description: Governs all warehouse and distribution center operations including inbound receiving, putaway, slotting optimization, inventory control, order picking, packing, and outbound dispatch. Owns SKU master, FIFO/LIFO inventory positions, ASN processing, WIP tracking, labor productivity metrics, and returns management. Powered by Manhattan WMS and supports e-commerce fulfillment and contract logistics.

products.name: facility
products.description: Master record for each warehouse and distribution center operated by Transport Shipping. Captures physical facility attributes including location, type (DC, CFS, ICD, FTZ, cross-dock), total floor area in CBM, dock door count, temperature zones, WMS instance identifier, operating hours, capacity thresholds, and certifications (C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 9001). SSOT for warehouse identity referenced across all warehouse domain products.

attributes.name: address_line2

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: closed_date

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_bonded_warehouse
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is a customs bonded warehouse authorized to store imported goods before duties and taxes are paid.

attributes.name: dock_door_count
attributes.description: Total number of loading and unloading dock doors available at the facility for inbound and outbound freight operations.

attributes.name: facility_code
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the facility, used across operational systems and customer communications. Typically a short alphanumeric code.

attributes.name: facility_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the warehouse or distribution center facility.

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facility. DC = Distribution Center, CFS = Container Freight Station, ICD = Inland Container Depot, FTZ = Free Trade Zone, cross-dock = Cross-Docking Facility, fulfillment = E-Commerce Fulfillment Center.

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Official FTZ designation number if the facility operates within a free trade zone, allowing duty deferral and other trade benefits.

attributes.name: has_cold_storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility has refrigerated or frozen storage capabilities for temperature-sensitive goods.

attributes.name: has_hazmat_storage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility is certified and equipped to store hazardous materials per IMDG Code and local regulations.

attributes.name: is_aeo_certified

attributes.name: is_ctpat_certified

attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds C-TPAT certification for enhanced supply chain security and expedited customs processing.

attributes.name: is_iso28000_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the facility holds ISO 28000 certification for supply chain security management.

attributes.name: is_iso9001_certified

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: latitude

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the current facility lease expires, if applicable. Used for real estate planning and contract renewal tracking.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the facility in decimal degrees for GPS tracking and route optimization.

attributes.name: max_daily_inbound_volume_units
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Daily Inbound Volume in Units
attributes.description: Maximum number of units (pallets, cartons, or SKUs) the facility can receive and process in a single day. Used for capacity planning and load balancing.

attributes.name: max_daily_outbound_volume_units
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Daily Outbound Volume in Units
attributes.description: Maximum number of units (pallets, cartons, or SKUs) the facility can pick, pack, and ship in a single day. Used for capacity planning and order fulfillment forecasting.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date when the facility first became operational. Used for lifecycle tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekday
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekdays in format HH:MM-HH:MM (e.g., 08:00-18:00). Used for scheduling inbound and outbound operations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_weekend
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for weekends in format HH:MM-HH:MM. May be different from weekday hours or closed.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the facility.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the facility address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: renewable_energy_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of facility energy consumption sourced from renewable energy (solar, wind, etc.). Used for sustainability KPIs and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric storage capacity of the facility in cubic meters. CBM is a standard logistics measurement for warehouse capacity.

attributes.name: temperature_zone_count
attributes.description: Number of distinct temperature-controlled zones within the facility (e.g., ambient, refrigerated, frozen) for specialized inventory storage.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the facility location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London) used for scheduling and operational hours.

attributes.name: total_floor_area_sqm
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Floor Area in Square Meters
attributes.description: Total usable floor area of the facility measured in square meters, used for capacity planning and utilization analysis.

attributes.name: wms_instance_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Manhattan WMS instance managing this facility. Used for system integration and operational tracking.

products.name: storage_location
products.description: Granular storage location and zone master within a facility representing every bin, slot, rack, bay, aisle, floor position, and logical zone managed by Manhattan WMS. Tracks location code, zone assignment, zone type (receiving, bulk, pick-face, staging, dispatch, cold-chain, hazmat, quarantine, returns, VAS), aisle, rack, level, bin, location type, weight/volume capacity, temperature class, hazmat suitability, automation type, and current occupancy status. After merge with zone, also carries zone-level attributes (floor area, height, temperature range). Enables slotting optimization, directed putaway, and compliance segregation.

attributes.name: storage_location_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the storage location within the warehouse management system. Primary key.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent warehouse or distribution center facility where this storage location resides.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logical zone within the warehouse to which this storage location is assigned.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location became active and available for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: Date when this storage location was deactivated or retired from warehouse operations. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: aisle
attributes.description: Aisle designation within the warehouse where the storage location is physically situated. Used for route optimization and labor management.

attributes.name: automation_type
attributes.description: Level and type of automation technology deployed at this storage location. Impacts labor planning and throughput capacity.

attributes.name: bin
attributes.description: Specific bin or slot position within the level. Represents the most granular storage position.

attributes.name: bonded_warehouse_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is within a bonded warehouse zone where goods are stored without payment of customs duties until released for domestic consumption.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Bonded Warehouse Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was first created in the Manhattan Warehouse Management System (WMS).

attributes.name: cross_dock_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is used for cross-docking operations where inbound shipments are directly transferred to outbound without long-term storage.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Scheduled frequency for physical inventory cycle counting at this storage location. Supports inventory accuracy and compliance with ISO 9001 quality management.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_zone
attributes.description: Fire suppression system zone identifier covering this storage location. Critical for safety compliance and insurance requirements.

attributes.name: free_trade_zone_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is within a Free Trade Zone (FTZ) where goods can be stored, processed, or re-exported without customs intervention.

attributes.name: hazmat_class_permitted
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of International Maritime Organization (IMO) hazard classes permitted in this storage location (e.g., 1.1, 2.2, 3, 4.1, 5.1, 6.1, 8, 9). Empty if not hazmat suitable.

attributes.name: hazmat_suitable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the storage location is certified and equipped for storing hazardous materials per International Maritime Dangerous Goods (IMDG) Code and International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: Physical height dimension of the storage location in centimeters.

attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent physical cycle count was performed at this storage location.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this storage location record was last updated in the Manhattan Warehouse Management System (WMS).

attributes.name: length_cm
attributes.description: Physical length dimension of the storage location in centimeters.

attributes.name: location_barcode
attributes.description: Scannable barcode identifier for the storage location used by handheld Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) devices and mobile scanning equipment during warehouse operations.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Human-readable unique code identifying the storage location within the warehouse. Used for directed putaway and picking operations in Manhattan Warehouse Management System (WMS).

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the storage location indicating availability for putaway and picking operations.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Physical storage infrastructure type defining the structural characteristics and handling requirements of the location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pallet_rack|floor_stack|shelf|bin|drive_in|push_back|flow_rack|cantilever|mezzanine|automated_storage_retrieval — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: occupancy_status
attributes.description: Current inventory occupancy state of the storage location based on capacity utilization.

attributes.name: pick_face_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location is designated as a pick-face position for order fulfillment operations. Pick-face locations are optimized for high-velocity Stock Keeping Units (SKUs).

attributes.name: quarantine_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for quarantine inventory pending quality inspection, customs clearance, or Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) processing.

attributes.name: rack
attributes.description: Rack or bay identifier within the aisle where the storage location is positioned.

attributes.name: replenishment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this location requires periodic replenishment from bulk storage. Used in First In First Out (FIFO) and Last In First Out (LIFO) inventory management strategies.

attributes.name: returns_processing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for processing customer returns and Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) inventory.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Security classification of the storage location. High-value and bonded locations require additional access controls per Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) and Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs.

attributes.name: storage_location_level
attributes.description: Vertical level or shelf position within the rack structure. Used for slotting optimization based on Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) velocity and weight.

attributes.name: temperature_class
attributes.description: Temperature control classification of the storage location. Critical for cold-chain logistics and pharmaceutical shipments.

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum allowable temperature in Celsius for the storage location. Used for cold-chain compliance and quality assurance.

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum allowable temperature in Celsius for the storage location. Used for cold-chain compliance and quality assurance.

attributes.name: value_added_services_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this storage location is designated for value-added services such as kitting, labeling, repackaging, or customization operations.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Value Added Services Configuration

attributes.name: volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity of the storage location in cubic meters. Used for dimensional weight (DIM Weight) calculations and space optimization.

attributes.name: weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight capacity of the storage location in kilograms. Used for slotting optimization and safety compliance.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: Physical width dimension of the storage location in centimeters.

products.name: sku

Captures SKU code, description, product category, unit of measure, dimensions (length, width, height), weight, DIM weight factor, hazmat class (IMDG/ICAO), temperature requirement, country of origin, HS Code reference, FIFO/LIFO indicator, shelf life days, barcode/RFID identifiers, and storage class. SSOT for item identity within the warehouse domain.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the stock keeping unit. Primary key for the SKU master data product.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.origin_determination. Linking SKU to origin_determination replaces the

attributes.name: abc_classification
attributes.description: The ABC inventory classification (A=high-value/high-velocity, B=medium, C=low) used for prioritization and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: active_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this SKU became active and available for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: active_to_date
attributes.description: The date on which this SKU was discontinued or became inactive. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: height_cm
attributes.description: The height dimension of the SKU in centimeters, used for slotting optimization and space planning.

attributes.name: hs_code

attributes.name: inventory_method
attributes.description: The inventory valuation and rotation method applied to this SKU: FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), FEFO (First Expired First Out), or standard.

attributes.name: length_cm

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: The name of the manufacturer or producer of this SKU, used for quality tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: The manufacturers own part number or SKU identifier for this item, used for cross-referencing and procurement.

attributes.name: max_stack_height
attributes.description: The maximum number of units that can be safely stacked vertically. Null if not stackable or no limit.

attributes.name: pick_type
attributes.description: The standard picking method or unit used for order fulfillment of this SKU (each-pick, case-pick, pallet-pick, or bulk).

attributes.name: product_category
attributes.description: High-level classification category for this SKU used for inventory segmentation, slotting optimization, and reporting.

attributes.name: product_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed subcategory classification within the product category for granular inventory management and analytics.

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: The inventory quantity threshold that triggers replenishment or reorder action for this SKU.

attributes.name: rfid_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU is tagged with RFID technology for automated tracking and inventory visibility.

attributes.name: rfid_tag_code
attributes.description: The RFID tag identifier or Electronic Product Code (EPC) associated with this SKU for automated identification.
attributes.references: ISO/IEC 18000 RFID Standards, GS1 EPC Standards

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: The minimum buffer inventory quantity maintained to prevent stockouts and ensure service level for this SKU.

attributes.name: serial_tracking_required
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU requires individual serial number tracking at the unit level for high-value or regulated items.

attributes.name: shelf_life_days
attributes.description: The number of days from receipt or manufacture date that the SKU remains usable or saleable before expiration. Null for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: sku_code
attributes.description: The externally-known unique alphanumeric code identifying this SKU across all warehouse operations and systems. Used for scanning, picking, and inventory transactions.

attributes.name: sku_description
attributes.description: Detailed human-readable description of the product or item represented by this SKU, including key characteristics and specifications.

attributes.name: sku_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the SKU indicating whether it is available for warehouse operations, discontinued, or pending activation.

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this SKU can be safely stacked vertically in storage and transport.

attributes.name: storage_class
attributes.description: The warehouse storage class or zone assignment for this SKU based on handling requirements, velocity, and physical characteristics (e.g., fast-pick, bulk, secure, hazmat).

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: The maximum allowable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled SKUs. Null for ambient items.

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: The minimum allowable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-controlled SKUs. Null for ambient items.

attributes.name: temperature_requirement
attributes.description: The temperature control requirement for storing and handling this SKU, determining warehouse zone assignment.

attributes.name: un_number
attributes.description: The four-digit UN number identifying the hazardous substance if applicable, used for compliance with international dangerous goods regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The standard unit of measure used for inventory counting, picking, and tracking of this SKU.

attributes.name: velocity_code
attributes.description: The movement velocity classification indicating how frequently this SKU is picked or shipped (fast, medium, slow movers).

attributes.name: vendor_code
attributes.description: The code or identifier of the primary vendor or supplier for this SKU, used for procurement and replenishment.

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: The total volume of the SKU in cubic meters, calculated or measured for warehouse space utilization and freight planning.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: The actual gross weight of the SKU in kilograms, used for handling, labor planning, and freight calculations.

attributes.name: width_cm
attributes.description: The width dimension of the SKU in centimeters, used for slotting optimization and space planning.

products.name: inventory_position
products.description: Real-time and point-in-time inventory position record for each SKU at each storage location within a facility. Tracks on-hand quantity, available quantity, reserved quantity, quarantine quantity, damaged quantity, lot number, serial number, expiry date, receipt date, FIFO/LIFO sequence number, inventory status (available, hold, damaged, expired), and last cycle count date. Core operational record powering WMS inventory control and order fulfillment allocation.

attributes.name: inventory_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inventory position record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.description: Identifier of the warehouse or distribution center where the inventory is held.

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.hold. Business justification: Bonded warehouse management: customs holds placed on specific inventory positions (CBP exam, FDA hold) must be tracked with hold reason, issuing authority, and expected release date. WMS uses this to

attributes.name: inbound_receipt_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.inbound_receipt. Business justification: An inventory position record is created or updated when goods are physically received via an inbound receipt event. Linking inventory_position to inbound_receipt establishes the receiving event that c

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Inventory positions must be traceable to originating POs for inventory valuation, landed cost allocation, and financial audit. purchase_order_number is a denormalized text field; a typed FK enables PO

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity available for allocation to new orders. Calculated as on-hand minus reserved, quarantine, hold, damaged, and expired quantities.

attributes.name: cost_per_unit
attributes.description: Standard or actual cost per unit of the inventory item. Used for inventory valuation, cost of goods sold calculations, and financial reporting.

attributes.name: country_of_origin
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166 country code indicating where the product was manufactured or produced. Required for customs declarations and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this inventory position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: damaged_quantity

attributes.name: expiry_date

attributes.name: fifo_sequence_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) Sequence Number
attributes.description: Sequential number assigned based on receipt date to enforce FIFO picking logic. Lower numbers are picked first to ensure oldest inventory is consumed before newer stock.

attributes.name: hazmat_indicator

attributes.name: hold_quantity

attributes.name: hs_code

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current status of the inventory position indicating availability for order fulfillment. attributes.name: last_cycle_count_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory position was last physically counted during cycle count operations. Used to schedule next count and track inventory accuracy.

attributes.name: last_movement_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent inventory transaction affecting this position (receipt, pick, adjustment, transfer). Used for slow-moving inventory analysis.

attributes.name: pick_face_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this inventory position is in an active pick face location (forward pick area) versus reserve storage. Pick face locations are optimized for high-velocity picking.

attributes.name: putaway_zone
attributes.description: Warehouse zone designation where the inventory was placed during putaway operations. Used for slotting optimization and pick path planning.

attributes.name: quarantine_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity held for quality inspection or pending release approval. Not available for order fulfillment until cleared.

attributes.name: receipt_date
attributes.description: Date when the inventory was received into the facility. Used for FIFO/LIFO sequencing and aging analysis.

attributes.name: replenishment_trigger_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity threshold that triggers automatic replenishment from reserve storage to pick face. Used to maintain optimal pick face inventory levels.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity committed to existing orders or work orders but not yet picked. Reduces available quantity for new allocations.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for individual item-level tracking. Used for high-value or serialized inventory items.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the inventory requires temperature-controlled storage (refrigerated or frozen). Drives storage zone assignment and handling requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature for temperature-controlled inventory. Used to monitor cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature for temperature-controlled inventory. Used to monitor cold chain compliance.

attributes.name: temperature_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for temperature range values. Standard units are celsius or fahrenheit.

attributes.name: un_number

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which inventory quantities are tracked and reported. Standard units include each (individual items), case (inner pack), pallet (shipping unit), carton, box, or generic unit.

attributes.name: volume_per_unit
attributes.description: Physical volume or cubic measurement of a single unit of the SKU. Used for warehouse space planning, slotting optimization, and freight rating.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association Standards

attributes.name: volume_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the volume per unit value. Standard units include CBM (cubic meter), CFT (cubic foot), liter, gallon.

attributes.name: weight_per_unit
attributes.description: Physical weight of a single unit of the SKU. Used for dimensional weight calculations, freight rating, and capacity planning.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association Standards

attributes.name: weight_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the weight per unit value. Standard units include kg (kilogram), lb (pound), g (gram), oz (ounce), ton (short ton), mt (metric ton).

attributes.name: short_ship_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity not fulfilled due to inventory shortage, damage, or other constraints. Calculated as ordered quantity minus shipped quantity.

attributes.description: Code indicating special handling requirements for this line item. Drives warehouse labor instructions and quality control procedures.

attributes.name: weight_kg

products.name: inventory_movement
products.description: Atomic inventory transaction record capturing every movement, adjustment, or transfer of stock within or between warehouse locations. Records movement type (receipt, putaway, pick, replenishment, transfer, adjustment, cycle count, damage write-off, return), SKU, from-location, to-location, quantity moved, movement timestamp, operative ID, reference document number, and reason code. Provides full inventory audit trail required for FIFO/LIFO position recalculation, stock reconciliation, and regulatory compliance (SOX, customs bonded warehouse reporting).

attributes.name: movement_timestamp

attributes.name: movement_type

attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the inventory movement. Captures exception details, special handling instructions, or operator observations.

attributes.name: project_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the project or contract logistics engagement associated with this inventory. Used for project-based inventory segregation and billing.

attributes.name: quantity_moved
attributes.description: Quantity of inventory units moved in this transaction. Positive for additions, negative for reductions. Supports fractional quantities for catch-weight items.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code explaining the business reason for the movement. Required for adjustments, write-offs, and exception transactions.

attributes.name: reference_document_number

attributes.name: reference_document_type

attributes.name: reference_line_number

attributes.name: reversal_flag

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number for serialized inventory items. Enables unit-level tracking for high-value or regulated goods.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system that originated this inventory movement record. Supports multi-system data integration and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the inventory requires temperature-controlled storage (cold chain). Triggers special handling and monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: temperature_max_c
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-sensitive inventory. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: temperature_min_c
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable storage temperature in Celsius for temperature-sensitive inventory. Used for cold chain compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: to_location_code
attributes.description: Destination warehouse location code to which inventory is being moved. Null for shipment/dispatch transactions. Supports multi-level location hierarchy (zone-aisle-bay-level-position).

attributes.name: total_cost

attributes.name: un_number

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Total volume of the inventory moved, measured in cubic meters. Used for warehouse space utilization and slotting optimization.

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Total weight of the inventory moved, measured in kilograms. Used for capacity planning, freight calculation, and dimensional weight analysis.

products.name: cycle_count
products.description: Cycle count program record representing a scheduled or ad-hoc physical inventory count event for a defined set of storage locations or SKUs within a facility. Captures count program name, count type (full, cycle, spot, ABC-velocity), facility, zone scope, scheduled date, count start timestamp, count end timestamp, total locations counted, total SKUs counted, variance quantity, variance value, count status (scheduled, in-progress, completed, approved), and approver. Supports inventory accuracy KPI and regulatory stock reconciliation.
products.reference: Cycle Count / Physical Inventory Count (Manhattan WMS)

attributes.name: cycle_count_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cycle count event. Primary key.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: In 3PL multi-client warehouses, cycle counts are performed on customer-owned inventory and results are reported to and billed against the specific customer account. Inventory accuracy reporting, SLA c

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count is performed.

attributes.name: zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.zone. Business justification: cycle_count has zone_code (STRING) indicating which zone is being counted. Adding a proper zone_id FK enables JOIN to zone master for zone details. zone_code removed as it can be retrieved via the FK

attributes.name: accuracy_percentage
attributes.description: Inventory accuracy percentage for this count event. Calculated as (locations with zero variance / total locations counted) * 100. Key performance indicator for warehouse operations.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether inventory adjustments resulting from count variances have been posted to the WMS and financial systems.

attributes.name: adjustment_posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when inventory adjustments were posted to the system. Used for financial reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: aisle_range_end
attributes.description: Ending aisle identifier for the count scope. Used to define physical location boundaries.

attributes.name: aisle_range_start
attributes.description: Starting aisle identifier for the count scope. Used to define physical location boundaries.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count results were approved by the authorized approver.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Name of the warehouse manager or supervisor who approved the cycle count results and variances.

attributes.name: count_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the physical count activity was completed. Marks the end of the count execution window.

attributes.name: count_method
attributes.description: Method used to perform the physical count. Manual = paper-based or visual; RFID = radio frequency identification; Barcode Scan = handheld scanner; Automated = robotic or sensor-based.

attributes.name: count_program_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cycle count program or event. Externally-known code used for tracking and reporting.

attributes.name: count_program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the cycle count program or event.

attributes.name: count_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or trigger for the cycle count. Examples: scheduled rotation, exception investigation, audit requirement, pre-physical inventory, post-receiving verification.

attributes.name: count_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the physical count activity began. Marks the beginning of the count execution window.

attributes.name: count_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cycle count event. Scheduled = planned but not started; In-Progress = counting underway; Completed = count finished awaiting approval; Approved = variances reviewed and accepted; Cancelled = count aborted; On-Hold = temporarily suspended.

attributes.name: count_type
attributes.description: Classification of the count event. Full = complete facility inventory; Cycle = scheduled rotating count; Spot = ad-hoc targeted count; ABC-Velocity = frequency-based on SKU velocity; Blind = count without system quantity reference; Location-Directed = system-assigned location count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was first created in the system. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: fifo_lifo_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: First In First Out (FIFO) / Last In First Out (LIFO) Method
attributes.description: Inventory valuation method applied during count variance adjustment. FIFO = First In First Out; LIFO = Last In First Out; FEFO = First Expired First Out; Not Applicable = no specific method.

attributes.name: hazmat_count_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count includes hazardous materials requiring special handling and compliance procedures.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code

attributes.name: labor_hours_actual
attributes.description: Actual labor hours spent performing the cycle count. Used for labor productivity analysis and cost allocation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cycle count record was last updated. Audit trail field.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the cycle count event. May include variance explanations, operational issues, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for the cycle count event. Critical = immediate count required; High = urgent; Medium = standard; Low = routine.

attributes.name: recount_count
attributes.description: Number of times this cycle count has been recounted. Used to track count quality and identify problematic locations or SKUs.

attributes.name: recount_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a recount is required due to significant variances or count discrepancies exceeding tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: regulatory_audit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count is part of a regulatory audit or compliance requirement (e.g., customs bonded warehouse audit, ISO certification audit).

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: Planned date for the cycle count event to be executed. Used for count program planning and resource allocation.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cycle count includes temperature-controlled or cold storage inventory.

attributes.name: total_locations_counted
attributes.description: Total number of storage locations physically counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: total_skus_counted
attributes.description: Total number of unique SKUs physically counted during this cycle count event.

attributes.name: total_units_counted
attributes.description: Total quantity of inventory units physically counted across all SKUs and locations.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: Net difference between physical count quantity and system quantity (physical minus system). Positive indicates overage; negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable variance threshold percentage for this count event. Variances exceeding this threshold trigger recount or approval workflows.

attributes.name: variance_value_usd
attributes.description: Financial value of the inventory variance in USD. Calculated as variance quantity multiplied by unit cost. Used for financial reconciliation and inventory accuracy KPI.

attributes.name: wms_batch_reference
attributes.description: Batch identifier from the source WMS system. Used for traceability and integration with Manhattan WMS.

Drives inventory adjustment postings and discrepancy investigation workflows.

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warehouse or distribution center where the cycle count was performed.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.storage_location. Business justification: Cycle count lines MUST reference the authoritative storage location master. attributes.description: The date and time when the cycle count line was approved or rejected. Nullable if not yet approved.

attributes.description: Current status of this cycle count line in the workflow. Tracks progression from initial count through approval and adjustment.

attributes.name: counted_quantity
attributes.description: The actual physical quantity counted by the warehouse associate during the cycle count.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count line record was first created in the system. Audit trail timestamp.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cost and variance value amounts. Typically USD for US operations.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The expiration or best-before date of the lot counted. Used for FEFO (First Expired First Out) inventory management. Nullable for non-perishable items.

attributes.name: inventory_condition_code
attributes.description: The condition or quality status of the inventory counted. Determines whether inventory is available for sale or fulfillment.

attributes.name: investigation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this variance requires formal investigation due to high value, high percentage, or recurring pattern. True if investigation is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the variance investigation workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through resolution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this cycle count line record was last updated. Audit trail timestamp for tracking changes.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the cycle count header. Used for ordering and referencing specific count lines.

attributes.name: lot_number
attributes.description: The lot or batch number of the inventory counted. Used for traceability and FIFO/LIFO inventory management. Nullable for non-lot-tracked items.

attributes.name: recount_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity recorded during the recount verification. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: recount_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line requires a recount due to variance exceeding threshold or other business rules. True if recount is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: recount_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the recount verification was performed. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: recount_variance_quantity
attributes.description: The variance between recount quantity and system quantity. Nullable if no recount was performed.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The serial number of the specific unit counted. Used for serialized inventory tracking. Nullable for non-serialized items.

attributes.name: system_quantity
attributes.description: The book stock quantity recorded in the WMS system before the physical count. Also known as expected quantity or on-hand quantity.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the quantities recorded. Common values: EA (Each), CS (Case), PL (Pallet), BX (Box), KG (Kilogram), LB (Pound), LT (Liter), GL (Gallon). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|CS|PL|BX|KG|LB|LT|GL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS Item Master UOM Standards

attributes.name: variance_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes explaining the variance, investigation findings, or corrective actions taken. Used for audit trail and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance expressed as a percentage of system quantity. Calculated as (variance_quantity / system_quantity) * 100. Used for threshold-based recount triggers.

attributes.name: variance_quantity
attributes.description: The difference between counted quantity and system quantity. Calculated as counted_quantity minus system_quantity. Positive indicates overage, negative indicates shortage.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: The root cause category assigned to explain the inventory variance. Used for discrepancy investigation and process improvement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: damage|theft|miscount|system_error|receiving_error|picking_error|putaway_error|shrinkage|obsolescence|unknown|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance_value_amount
attributes.description: The financial value of the variance, calculated as variance_quantity multiplied by cost_per_unit. Used for financial reporting and variance analysis.

products.name: zone
