attributes.name: penalty_clause_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.penalty_clause. Business justification: Incident-driven penalty enforcement: incidents (cargo damage, delays, safety violations) directly trigger specific penalty clauses in contracts. This link enables automated penalty event creation from

attributes.name: service_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_case. Business justification: Fleet incidents involving cargo damage or delivery failure directly trigger customer service cases. Linking incident to service_case enables customer service teams to reference the root fleet incident

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) involved in the incident.

attributes.name: trip_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.trip. Business justification: Incidents (accidents, near-misses, cargo damage) occur during specific trips. Adding trip_id links the incident to the trip record for trip-level safety analysis and reporting. Nullable for incidents

attributes.name: asset_damage_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the asset damage estimated cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: asset_damage_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of damage to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) in the incident currency. Includes repair or replacement costs.

attributes.name: cargo_damage_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the cargo damage estimated cost (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: cargo_damage_estimated_cost
attributes.description: Estimated cost of damage to cargo or goods in the incident currency. Used for cargo claim processing.

attributes.name: cargo_damage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether cargo or goods being transported were damaged in the incident. True if cargo damaged, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of corrective actions taken or planned to prevent recurrence, including training, maintenance, policy changes, or process improvements.

attributes.name: corrective_action_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective actions are required to prevent recurrence of similar incidents. True if corrective actions required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_status
attributes.description: Current status of corrective actions identified for this incident. Not_required: no actions needed. Pending: actions identified but not started. In_progress: actions being implemented. Completed: all actions finished. Overdue: actions past due date.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was first created in the fleet management system.

attributes.name: datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the incident occurred in the field. This is the real-world event timestamp, distinct from when the incident was reported or recorded in the system.

attributes.name: dot_report_submitted_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DOT (Department of Transportation) Report Submitted Date
attributes.description: Date when the DOT accident report was submitted to the regulatory authority (if applicable).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Part 390

attributes.name: dot_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incident meets the US Department of Transportation (DOT) criteria for mandatory accident reporting. True if DOT reportable, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) 49 CFR Part 390

attributes.name: fatality_count
attributes.description: Total number of fatalities resulting from the incident.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique incident reference number used for tracking and reporting. Format: INC-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: incident_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the incident record. Reported: initial notification received. Under_investigation: active investigation in progress. Pending_review: investigation complete, awaiting management review. Closed: incident resolved and closed. Reopened: closed incident reopened for additional investigation.

attributes.name: incident_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incident: accident (collision or crash), near_miss (potential accident avoided), breakdown (mechanical failure), cargo_damage (damage to goods), security_incident (unauthorized access or threat), theft (asset or cargo stolen).

attributes.name: injuries_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any injuries (to driver, passengers, or third parties) were reported as a result of the incident. True if injuries reported, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: injury_count
attributes.description: Total number of individuals injured in the incident, including driver, passengers, and third parties.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: investigation_assigned_to
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the safety officer, manager, or team assigned to investigate this incident.

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident investigation was completed and findings documented.

attributes.name: location_address
attributes.description: Human-readable street address or location description where the incident occurred. May include route number, mile marker, or landmark.

attributes.name: location_city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: location_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the incident occurred (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU).

attributes.name: location_latitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) latitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees. Range: -90 to +90.

attributes.name: location_longitude
attributes.description: GPS (Global Positioning System) longitude coordinate of the incident location in decimal degrees. Range: -180 to +180.

attributes.name: location_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the incident location.

attributes.name: location_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the incident occurred.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, observations, witness statements, or supplementary information about the incident.

attributes.name: police_department
attributes.description: Name of the law enforcement agency or police department that responded to the incident.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: police_report_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a police report was filed for this incident. True if police report filed, False otherwise.
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: police_report_number
attributes.description: Official police report or case number assigned by law enforcement agency (if applicable).
attributes.references: US Department of Transportation (DOT) Accident Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reported_datetime
attributes.description: The date and time when the incident was first reported to the fleet management system or control center.

attributes.name: root_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the root cause of the incident. Driver_error: human error by driver. Mechanical_failure: asset malfunction. Road_conditions: poor road surface or infrastructure. Weather: adverse weather conditions. Third_party_fault: caused by external party. Cargo_shift: improper cargo loading or securing. Unknown: cause not yet determined. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: driver_error|mechanical_failure|road_conditions|weather|third_party_fault|cargo_shift|unknown — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: root_cause_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the root cause analysis findings and contributing factors to the incident.

attributes.name: severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the incident based on impact to personnel, asset, cargo, and operations. Minor: no injuries, minimal damage. Moderate: minor injuries, moderate damage. Major: serious injuries, significant damage. Critical: fatalities or catastrophic damage.

attributes.name: third_party_contact
attributes.description: Contact phone number or email address for the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: third_party_insurance_provider
attributes.description: Name of the insurance company covering the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: third_party_involved_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a third party (another vehicle, pedestrian, property owner, or external entity) was involved in the incident. True if third party involved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: third_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the third party individual or organization involved in the incident (if applicable).

attributes.name: third_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number of the third party involved in the incident.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this incident record was last modified or updated.

products.name: asset_utilisation
products.description: Periodic operational record (daily/weekly snapshot) capturing fleet utilisation metrics for each transport asset. Tracks asset reference, reporting period (date), total available hours, total operational hours, total idle hours, total downtime hours (maintenance + breakdown), distance travelled (km/miles), load factor (actual payload vs capacity), number of trips completed, fuel efficiency (litres per 100km or MPG), and utilisation rate percentage. This is an operational Silver Layer record — NOT an analytics aggregate — representing the daily operational state of each asset for fleet management decisions.

attributes.name: asset_utilisation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset utilisation record. Primary key for this operational snapshot.

attributes.name: assigned_depot_id
attributes.description: Reference to the depot, terminal, or home location where the asset is based during the reporting period.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary driver or operator assigned to the asset during the reporting period. Links to workforce management for driver assignment tracking.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Lane-level asset utilization reporting (load factor, revenue per lane, CO2 per lane) is a standard logistics network optimization report. asset_utilisation has plan_id but no direct lane_id; direct FK

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary route or network lane the asset operated on during the reporting period. Links to route and network domain for route execution analysis.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the transport asset (vehicle, aircraft, vessel, container) for which utilisation is being tracked.

attributes.name: volume_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_volume_commitment. Business justification: Volume commitment tracking: fleet utilisation records (actual TEUs, weight, trips) are the source data for measuring attainment against contracted volume commitments. This link enables automated short

attributes.name: actual_payload_kg
attributes.description: Total actual payload weight carried by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilograms.

attributes.name: co2_emissions_kg
attributes.description: Total greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions produced by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilograms of carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e). Critical for sustainability reporting and compliance with EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) and Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA).

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance status of the asset during the reporting period. Indicates whether the asset met Department of Transportation (DOT), International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO), International Maritime Organization (IMO), or other applicable regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for revenue and cost amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: distance_travelled_km
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by the asset during the reporting period, measured in kilometers. Captured from GPS (Global Positioning System) telematics or odometer readings.

attributes.name: distance_travelled_miles
attributes.description: Total distance travelled by the asset during the reporting period, measured in miles. Provided for regions using imperial units.

attributes.name: fuel_consumed_liters
attributes.description: Total fuel consumed by the asset during the reporting period, measured in liters.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_liters_per_100km
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency metric representing liters consumed per 100 kilometers travelled. Key operational expense (OPEX) and sustainability metric.

attributes.name: fuel_efficiency_mpg
attributes.description: Fuel efficiency metric representing miles per gallon (MPG). Provided for regions using imperial units.

attributes.name: load_factor_percent
attributes.description: Percentage representing the ratio of actual payload to maximum payload capacity. Key performance indicator (KPI) for asset efficiency.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, exceptions, or contextual information about the asset utilisation during the reporting period.

attributes.name: number_of_trips
attributes.description: Total count of completed trips or delivery runs performed by the asset during the reporting period.

attributes.name: on_time_delivery_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of trips completed on time during the reporting period. Key service level agreement (SLA) metric for customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: operating_cost
attributes.description: Total operating expenditure (OPEX) incurred by the asset during the reporting period, including fuel, maintenance, tolls, and driver costs.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the asset during the reporting period. Indicates whether the asset was actively deployed, idle, under maintenance, experiencing breakdown, retired, or reserved.

attributes.name: payload_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum payload capacity of the asset in kilograms. Used to calculate load factor.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The granularity of the reporting period: daily, weekly, or monthly snapshot.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilisation record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this utilisation record was last modified. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: reporting_period_date
attributes.description: The date for which this utilisation snapshot is recorded. Represents the business event date for daily or weekly operational reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_generated
attributes.description: Total revenue generated by the asset during the reporting period. Used for profitability and return on investment (ROI) analysis.

attributes.name: safety_incidents_count
attributes.description: Total number of safety incidents or accidents involving the asset during the reporting period. Critical for risk management and insurance reporting.

attributes.name: telematics_data_quality_score
attributes.description: Quality score (0-100) representing the completeness and accuracy of GPS (Global Positioning System) telematics and Internet of Things (IoT) sensor data captured during the reporting period. Used to assess data reliability for analytics.

attributes.name: total_available_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was available for operational use during the reporting period, excluding scheduled downtime.

attributes.name: total_breakdown_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was unavailable due to unplanned breakdowns or failures during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was out of service during the reporting period, combining maintenance and breakdown hours.

attributes.name: total_idle_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was idle (available but not in use) during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was undergoing scheduled or preventive maintenance during the reporting period.

attributes.name: total_operational_hours
attributes.description: Total number of hours the asset was actively in operation (moving, transporting cargo, or performing its primary function) during the reporting period.

attributes.name: utilisation_rate_percent
attributes.description: Overall utilisation rate calculated as the ratio of operational hours to available hours, expressed as a percentage. Primary KPI for fleet management decisions.

attributes.name: volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volume capacity of the asset in cubic meters (CBM). Used to calculate volume utilisation rate.

attributes.name: volume_utilised_cbm
attributes.description: Total cargo volume utilised during the reporting period, measured in cubic meters (CBM). Relevant for container and warehouse assets.

products.name: depot
products.description: Master record for all fleet depots, vehicle yards, maintenance workshops, and staging areas that serve as home bases or operational hubs for fleet assets. Captures depot name, depot code, depot type (vehicle depot, maintenance workshop, fuel station, container yard, ICD), address, GPS coordinates, country, region, capacity (number of vehicles/containers), available maintenance bays, fuel types available, operating hours, and managing business unit. Provides the geographic and operational context for asset assignment and maintenance planning.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fleet depot. Primary key for the fleet depot entity.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.partner. Business justification: Depots are frequently operated by, co-located with, or contractually tied to network partners (terminal operators, port authorities, intermodal hubs). Partner performance reporting by depot, partner-o

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as building name, suite number, or floor.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the depot is located.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the depot was officially commissioned and began operational service for fleet management activities.

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.description: Maximum container storage capacity expressed in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units), applicable for container yards and ICDs.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the depot is located.

attributes.name: covered_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total covered or indoor area of the depot measured in square meters, including maintenance workshops, warehouses, and covered parking structures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customs_bonded_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depot is a customs-bonded facility authorized to store goods under customs supervision without immediate duty payment. Applicable for ICDs and container yards handling international freight.

attributes.name: decommissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the depot was or is planned to be decommissioned and removed from active operational service.

attributes.name: depot_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for the depot used across operational systems and documentation. Typically a short alphanumeric code assigned by the business.

attributes.name: depot_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the fleet depot, vehicle yard, maintenance workshop, or staging area.

attributes.name: depot_type
attributes.description: Classification of the depot based on its primary operational function. Vehicle depot for fleet parking and assignment, maintenance workshop for repairs and servicing, fuel station for refueling operations, container yard for container storage, inland container depot (ICD) for customs clearance and container handling, or staging area for temporary asset holding.

attributes.name: electric_charging_stations
attributes.description: Number of electric vehicle charging stations available at this depot for electric and hybrid fleet assets.

attributes.name: environmental_certification

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Free Trade Zone designation or license number if this depot operates within or as an FTZ, allowing duty-deferred or duty-exempt storage and processing of goods.

attributes.name: fuel_types_available

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the depot is certified and equipped to handle, store, and process hazardous materials in compliance with IMDG, IATA Dangerous Goods, and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods, 49 CFR Hazardous Materials Regulations

attributes.name: last_inspection_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this depot record was most recently updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the depot location in decimal degrees format, used for GPS tracking, route planning, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the current lease agreement for this depot expires, applicable only for leased facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and CAPEX forecasting.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the depot location in decimal degrees format, used for GPS tracking, route planning, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: maintenance_bays
attributes.description: Number of maintenance bays or service stations available at this depot for vehicle and equipment servicing and repairs.

attributes.name: managing_business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit, division, or department responsible for managing and operating this depot.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next mandatory safety, compliance, or operational inspection of the depot facility.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional operational notes, special instructions, facility constraints, or other relevant information about the depot that does not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: operates_24_7_flag

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily end time of depot operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling asset assignments and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily start time of depot operations in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling asset assignments and maintenance activities.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the depot indicating whether it is actively serving fleet operations, temporarily unavailable, or permanently closed.

attributes.name: ownership_type

attributes.name: postal_code

attributes.name: region

attributes.name: security_level

attributes.name: state_province

attributes.name: time_zone

attributes.name: total_area_sqm

attributes.name: vehicle_capacity

attributes.name: asset_type_id

attributes.name: asset_category

attributes.name: asset_type_code

attributes.name: asset_type_description

attributes.name: asset_type_name

attributes.name: maintenance_interval_km

attributes.name: standard_length_m

attributes.name: standard_payload_capacity_kg
