attributes.name: screened_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: The denied_party_screening table has denormalized party attributes (name, address, city, state, postal_code, country_code, tax_number) that correspond to trade_party master data. Linking to trade_part

attributes.name: analyst_review_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the compliance analyst review for potential or confirmed matches (approved, rejected, escalated, pending review).

attributes.name: analyst_review_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether manual analyst review is required for this screening result (true for potential matches, false for clear results).

attributes.name: analyst_review_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the compliance analyst completed their review of the screening result.

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this screening record to the complete audit trail for regulatory reporting and compliance verification.

attributes.name: compliance_program
attributes.description: Trade compliance program under which this screening was performed (C-TPAT, AEO, Partners in Protection, Customs Self Assessment, Secure Exports Scheme).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this screening record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Level of escalation for high-risk matches requiring senior management or legal review (none, tier 1, tier 2, tier 3, executive).

attributes.name: false_positive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the match was determined to be a false positive after analyst review.

attributes.name: hold_release_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the regulatory hold was released and the shipment was cleared for processing.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this screening record was last updated.

attributes.name: match_score
attributes.description: Numerical confidence score (0.00 to 100.00) indicating the strength of the match between the screened party and denied party list entries.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Result of the screening check indicating whether the party matched any denied party list (clear, potential match, confirmed match, false positive).

attributes.name: matched_entity_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the matched entity on the denied party list (e.g., OFAC SDN number).

attributes.name: matched_entity_name
attributes.description: Name of the denied party entity from the sanctions list that matched the screened party.

attributes.name: matched_entity_program
attributes.description: Sanctions program or regulatory program associated with the matched denied party (e.g., Iran Sanctions, Counter-Terrorism, Narcotics Trafficking).

attributes.name: matched_list_name
attributes.description: Name of the specific denied party list where a match was found (e.g., OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List).

attributes.name: override_justification
attributes.description: Detailed justification provided by the compliance analyst for overriding a potential or confirmed match and approving the shipment.

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Type of shipment party being screened (shipper, consignee, notify party, manufacturer, broker, carrier, freight forwarder). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: shipper|consignee|notify_party|manufacturer|broker|carrier|freight_forwarder — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the shipment is placed on regulatory hold due to denied party screening results, preventing further processing until cleared.

attributes.name: risk_score
attributes.description: Overall risk score (0.00 to 100.00) assigned to this screening result based on match quality, party type, and destination country risk.

attributes.name: screening_engine_version
attributes.description: Version number of the denied party screening engine used to perform this check.

attributes.name: screening_list_sources
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of denied party and restricted entity lists checked during this screening (OFAC SDN, BIS Entity List, EU Consolidated List, UN Sanctions, C-TPAT denied parties, HMT Sanctions, DFAT Sanctions, etc.).
attributes.references: OFAC, BIS, EU, UN, C-TPAT Standards

attributes.name: screening_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments recorded during the screening process or analyst review.

attributes.name: screening_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number for this screening transaction, used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: screening_rule_set_version
attributes.description: Version number of the screening rule set and list data used during this check.

attributes.name: screening_run_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the denied party screening check was executed. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: screening_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the screening check workflow.

products.name: trade_party
products.description: Master record for all parties involved in international trade transactions managed by the customs domain — importers of record, exporters, manufacturers, suppliers, consignees, notify parties, and customs brokers. Captures party type, legal name, trading name, tax identification number, EORI number (EU), CBP importer number (US), AEO certificate number, C-TPAT status, country of establishment, address, contact details, party status (active/suspended/blocked), and denied party screening clearance status. Distinct from the customer domain's account entity — trade_party covers all supply chain counterparties, not just Transport Shipping's direct customers.
products.reference: WCO Customs Data Model — Party Entity

attributes.name: partner_id

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the specific reason for the hold (e.g., random inspection, high-risk commodity, incomplete documentation, valuation discrepancy, denied party screening hit).

attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of why the customs hold was placed, including any specific regulatory concerns or compliance issues identified.

attributes.name: resolution_action_code
attributes.description: Code representing the action taken to resolve the hold (e.g., documentation provided, duty paid, goods returned, goods destroyed, appeal filed).

attributes.description: Detailed notes describing how the hold was resolved, including any corrective actions taken, documentation submitted, or negotiations with customs authorities.

attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the total financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit was permanently revoked by the issuing authority. Indicates when the authorization was terminated prior to its natural expiry date.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or regulatory justification for the revocation of this license or permit. Provides context for compliance enforcement and audit trail.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this license or permit record was extracted. Typically Descartes Customs GTM trade compliance module or equivalent customs management system.

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this license or permit record in the source operational system. Used for data lineage and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Additional terms, restrictions, or conditions imposed by the issuing authority on the use of this license or permit. May include handling requirements, reporting obligations, or geographic restrictions.

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date on which the license or permit was suspended by the issuing authority. Indicates when the authorization was temporarily invalidated due to compliance issues or regulatory action.

attributes.name: suspension_reason

attributes.name: un_number

attributes.name: utilized_quantity

attributes.name: utilized_value_amount

products.name: trade_agreement
products.description: Reference master for free trade agreements (FTAs), preferential trade arrangements, and customs unions applicable to Transport Shipping's trade lanes. Captures agreement name, agreement type (FTA/customs union/GSP/EBA/bilateral), participating countries, effective date, expiry date, key provisions (tariff elimination schedule, rules of origin criteria, cumulation rules), administering authority, and agreement status (in_force/under_renegotiation/suspended). Enables automated preferential duty rate lookup and origin criterion validation in Descartes Customs GTM.
products.reference: WTO Regional Trade Agreements Database / UNCTAD TRAINS

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trade agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: commercial_agreement_id

attributes.name: administering_authority
attributes.description: Name of the international body, secretariat, or national agency responsible for administering and monitoring compliance with the trade agreement (e.g., WTO Secretariat, European Commission DG Trade, USTR).

attributes.name: agreement_code
attributes.description: Standardized short code or abbreviation for the trade agreement (e.g., USMCA, CPTPP, EU-UK_TCA). Used for system lookups and operational references.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Agreement Database

attributes.name: agreement_name

attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Information System

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trade agreement. FTA (Free Trade Agreement) = reciprocal tariff elimination; Customs Union = common external tariff; GSP (Generalized System of Preferences) = unilateral preference; EBA (Everything But Arms) = duty-free for LDCs; Bilateral = two parties; Multilateral = three or more parties.

attributes.name: amendment_count
attributes.description: Total number of formal amendments, protocols, or annexes that have modified the original trade agreement since its entry into force. Used to track agreement evolution.

attributes.name: authority_website_url

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_format
attributes.description: Standardized format or form type required for the Certificate of Origin under this agreement (e.g., Form A for GSP, EUR.1 for EU agreements, self-certification for USMCA).

attributes.name: certificate_of_origin_required

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade agreement record was first created in the lakehouse. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cumulation_rules
attributes.description: Type of origin cumulation permitted under the agreement. Bilateral = materials from partner country count as originating; Diagonal = materials from multiple FTA partners cumulate; Full = all processing in partner countries cumulates; None = no cumulation allowed.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or database from which this trade agreement record was ingested (e.g., Descartes Customs GTM, WTO RTA Database, internal trade compliance repository).

attributes.name: digital_trade_provisions

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_mechanism

attributes.name: effective_date

attributes.name: environmental_provisions

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement ceases to be in force. Nullable for open-ended agreements without a fixed termination date.
attributes.references: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) - Date Recognition

attributes.name: government_procurement_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement opens government procurement markets to suppliers from member countries on a non-discriminatory basis. True = procurement provisions included; False = no procurement provisions.

attributes.name: intellectual_property_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes chapters or provisions on intellectual property rights protection, enforcement, and cooperation. True = IP provisions included; False = no IP provisions.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS)

attributes.name: investment_provisions
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes provisions on foreign direct investment protection, investor-state dispute settlement, and national treatment for investors. True = investment provisions included; False = no investment provisions.

attributes.name: labor_standards_provisions

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date when the most recent amendment, protocol, or annex to the trade agreement entered into force.
attributes.references: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trade agreement record was most recently updated in the lakehouse. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review or assessment of the trade agreement by member countries or the administering authority.

attributes.name: last_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement details were last verified against official sources by Transport Shipping's trade compliance team. Used to ensure data accuracy for preferential duty rate calculations.

attributes.name: mutual_recognition_agreements
attributes.description: Description of any mutual recognition agreements for conformity assessment, product standards, professional qualifications, or Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) programs included in or linked to the trade agreement.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Technical Barriers to Trade (TBT)

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review or renegotiation of the trade agreement. Used for compliance planning and tariff rate updates in Descartes Customs GTM.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review Mechanism

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, implementation guidance, or special considerations relevant to Transport Shipping's use of this trade agreement in customs declarations and duty calculations.

attributes.name: participating_countries
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing all member countries or customs territories party to the agreement (e.g., USA,CAN,MEX for USMCA).

attributes.name: product_coverage_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of goods and services covered by the trade agreement. All Goods = comprehensive coverage; Industrial Goods Only = excludes agriculture; Agricultural Excluded = industrial focus; Services Included = covers trade in services; Limited Product List = specific HS Codes only.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) General Agreement on Trade in Services (GATS)

attributes.name: publication_reference
attributes.description: Official publication citation or document reference number for the trade agreement text (e.g., treaty series number, official journal citation, UN registration number).

attributes.name: quota_provisions
attributes.description: Description of any tariff-rate quotas (TRQs) or quantitative restrictions included in the agreement. Specifies product categories subject to quota limits and the preferential in-quota duty rates.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Agriculture - Tariff Rate Quotas

attributes.name: review_cycle_years
attributes.description: Number of years between scheduled reviews or renegotiations of the trade agreement by member countries. Used to track when agreement terms may be updated or modernized.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Policy Review Mechanism

attributes.name: rules_of_origin_criteria
attributes.description: Summary of the origin determination rules required to qualify for preferential treatment under this agreement (e.g., change in tariff classification, regional value content percentage, specific processing requirements). Full rules are maintained in tariff_rate product.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Revised Kyoto Convention - Origin Rules

attributes.name: safeguard_measures
attributes.description: Summary of bilateral safeguard provisions that allow temporary suspension or modification of preferential treatment if imports cause or threaten serious injury to domestic industry.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Safeguards

attributes.name: signature_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade agreement was formally signed by participating parties, prior to ratification and entry into force.
attributes.references: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

attributes.name: superseded_by_agreement_code
attributes.description: Agreement code of the successor trade agreement that replaced this agreement, if applicable. Used to maintain historical lineage when agreements are renegotiated or replaced (e.g., NAFTA superseded by USMCA).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Information System

attributes.name: tariff_elimination_schedule
attributes.description: Classification of the duty reduction timeline under the agreement. Immediate = zero duty on entry into force; Staged = phased reduction over specified years; Partial = some products excluded; Product Specific = varies by HS Code.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the trade agreement. In Force = active and applicable; Under Negotiation = being drafted; Signed Not Ratified = awaiting legislative approval; Suspended = temporarily inactive; Terminated = ended by parties; Expired = reached end date.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Monitoring Database

attributes.name: trade_facilitation_provisions
attributes.description: Description of customs procedures simplification, advance rulings, single window systems, and other trade facilitation commitments included in the agreement to reduce border clearance times and costs.
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: wto_notification_number
attributes.description: WTO Regional Trade Agreement notification number assigned when the agreement was notified to the WTO under GATT Article XXIV or GATS Article V (e.g., WT/REG123/N/1).
attributes.references: World Trade Organization (WTO) Regional Trade Agreements Database

products.name: declaration_compliance_benefit
products.description: This association product represents the application of trade compliance program benefits to specific customs declarations. It captures which compliance programs (C-TPAT, AEO, trusted trader certifications) were invoked for each declaration to obtain expedited processing, reduced examination rates, or other program-specific benefits. Each record links one declaration to one compliance program with attributes documenting the specific benefits applied and their effectiveness. This is a recognized operational record in customs management systems used for program performance measurement and audit trail requirements.. Existence Justification: In customs clearance operations, a single declaration can invoke multiple compliance program benefits simultaneously (e.g., C-TPAT for security, AEO for EU recognition, and ISO 28000 for supply chain certification), and each compliance program is applied to thousands of declarations over time. Customs authorities require tracking which specific program benefits were claimed and verified for each declaration for audit, program performance measurement, and mutual recognition reporting. This is an operational business entity called 'declaration compliance benefit' or 'program benefit application' that is actively managed in trade compliance systems.

attributes.business_glossary_term: Declaration Compliance Benefit - Compliance Program Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the compliance program whose benefits were applied to this declaration

attributes.name: declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the customs declaration that invoked compliance program benefits

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the importer or declarant holds AEO status, which provides trade facilitation benefits and reduced customs controls in the EU and other jurisdictions. [Moved from declaration: This boolean flag indicates AEO certification status, which is a specific compliance program benefit. It should be represented as a relationship record in declaration_compliance_benefit rather than a direct attribute on declaration, allowing tracking of which specific AEO program was applied and when.]
attributes.references: EU AEO Program / WCO SAFE Framework

attributes.name: benefit_application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the compliance program benefit was applied to this declaration in the customs processing system

attributes.name: benefit_applied_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the compliance program benefit was successfully applied to this declaration during customs processing

attributes.name: benefit_claimed_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the party (importer, broker, carrier) that claimed the compliance program benefit on this declaration

attributes.name: benefit_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the compliance program benefit was applied or became effective for this declaration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this declaration compliance benefit record was first created in the system

attributes.name: ctpat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the importer or declarant is C-TPAT certified, which may expedite customs clearance and reduce inspections. [Moved from declaration: This boolean flag indicates C-TPAT certification status, which is a specific compliance program benefit. It should be represented as a relationship record in declaration_compliance_benefit rather than a direct attribute on declaration, allowing tracking of which specific C-TPAT tier was applied and when.]

attributes.name: customs_verification_status
attributes.description: Status of customs authority verification that the compliance program benefit was validly claimed and applied (verified, pending, rejected, not_applicable)

attributes.name: expedited_release_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether expedited customs release processing was granted based on this compliance program membership

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments regarding the application of this compliance program benefit to the declaration

attributes.name: program_benefit_type
attributes.description: Type of compliance program benefit applied to this declaration (e.g., expedited_release, reduced_examination, priority_processing, dedicated_lane, fee_reduction)

attributes.name: reduced_examination_applied

domains.name: pricing
domains.description: SSOT for all tariff structures, rate cards, surcharge schedules, and dynamic pricing rules governing freight forwarding, express delivery, and contract logistics. Owns base rates, DIM weight calculations, fuel surcharges, GRI/BAF adjustments, THC, accessorial charges, Incoterms-based charge allocation (DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW), spot quote generation, and contract pricing. Feeds billing and contract domains for revenue recognition.
domains.references: IATA TACT Rates, FMC Tariff Filing

products.name: rate_card
products.description: Master rate card defining published or contracted base freight rates for a specific service type, trade lane, and validity period. Serves as the foundational pricing instrument across freight forwarding, express delivery, and contract logistics. Captures rate card name, version, effective/expiry dates, service mode (air/ocean/road/rail), rate basis (per kg, per CBM, per TEU, per shipment), currency, approval status, and zone structure. Includes validity lifecycle (activation, expiry, extension, supersession). SSOT for all base rate structures feeding spot quote generation, contract pricing, and billing.

attributes.name: source_system

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version sequence number for this pricing rule. Incremented each time the rule is modified. Supports audit trail and rollback capabilities.

attributes.description: Maximum volume commitment (in rate basis units) covered by this buy rate. Exceeding this may trigger renegotiation.

attributes.name: volume_commitment_min
attributes.description: Minimum volume commitment (in rate basis units) required to maintain this buy rate. Part of carrier capacity agreements.

attributes.name: weight_break_max_kg
attributes.description: Maximum weight threshold in kilograms for this rate tier. Null indicates no upper limit.

attributes.name: weight_break_min_kg
attributes.description: Minimum weight threshold in kilograms for this rate tier. Used for tiered pricing structures.

domains.name: route
domains.description: SSOT for network topology, lane definitions, hub-and-spoke configurations, and transport route planning across all modes and geographies. Owns origin-destination lane master, service corridors, transit time standards, last-mile delivery zones, carrier lane allocations, ETA/ETD management, and network optimization outputs from Blue Yonder. Supports predictive ETA calculation, load optimization, carrier selection, and FourKites real-time visibility integration.
domains.references: IATA SSIM, IMO Route Planning Standards, DOT

products.name: lane
products.description: Master origin-destination lane definition representing a directional transport corridor between two network nodes (city, port, airport, ICD, CFS, or postal zone pair). Owns the canonical lane identifier used across SAP TM, Oracle TMS, and Blue Yonder for rate lookup, carrier selection, and network optimization. Captures lane type (express, freight, last-mile), transport mode (air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal), lane status, standard transit time, distance (km/miles), lane tier classification, applicable Incoterms, operational restrictions (embargo, DG prohibition, seasonal closure, capacity freeze), restriction effective dates, and restriction authority. SSOT for all O-D lane master data referenced by pricing, freight, and shipment domains.

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the origin-destination lane record. Primary key used across SAP TM, Oracle TMS, and Blue Yonder for rate lookup, carrier selection, and network optimization.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or customer contract governing rates, SLAs, and operational terms for this lane. Links to the Contract and Agreement domain for rate lookup and charge calculation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Coupa Procurement; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary contracted carrier allocated to this lane for standard shipment execution. Used by SAP TM carrier selection engine and Oracle TMS for freight audit and load optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Selection; Oracle TMS Carrier Management

attributes.name: contracted_carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Lanes are often contracted under specific carrier service products with defined service levels. Required for rate application during quoting, service-level routing decisions, and contracted service va

attributes.name: destination_location_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination network node (city, port, airport, ICD, CFS, or postal zone) at which this lane terminates. Paired with origin_location_id to define the directional transport corridor.
attributes.references: SAP TM Location Master; IATA Airport Codes; IMO Port Codes

attributes.name: lane_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin network node (city, port, airport, Inland Container Depot (ICD), Container Freight Station (CFS), or postal zone) from which this lane departs. Drives carrier selection and rate lookup in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Location Master; IATA Airport Codes; IMO Port Codes

attributes.name: aeo_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification is required for carriers or shippers operating on this lane. Enforced during carrier selection in SAP TM and compliance screening in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: AEO Program; C-TPAT; WCO SAFE Framework of Standards

attributes.name: blue_yonder_lane_code
attributes.description: External lane identifier assigned by Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning system for network optimization, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization workflows. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse and Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM Integration

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.description: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emission factor in kilograms of Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) per tonne-kilometre for this lane and transport mode. Used for sustainability reporting under EU ETS, CORSIA, and GHG Protocol Scope 3 calculations.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; GHG Protocol Scope 3; ISO 14064

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lane record was first created in the system of record and ingested into the Silver Layer. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX compliance for master data change management.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 9001 Quality Management; GDPR Article 30

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lane destination. Used for cross-border compliance, Importer Security Filing (ISF), and Automated Manifest System (AMS) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Customs Data Model; US CBP AMS

attributes.name: destination_unlocode
attributes.description: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) for the lane destination node. Used in EDI messages, Air Waybill (AWB), Master Bill of Lading (MBL), and Automated Manifest System (AMS) filings.
attributes.references: UNECE UN/LOCODE; WCO Customs Data Model; US CBP AMS

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Physical distance of the lane corridor in kilometres. Used for freight rate calculation, Dimensional Weight (DIM Weight) pricing, Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emissions estimation, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Network Design; EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA

attributes.name: distance_miles
attributes.description: Physical distance of the lane corridor in miles. Maintained alongside distance_km to support US DOT regulatory reporting and North American carrier rate negotiations where miles are the contractual unit.
attributes.references: US DOT 49 CFR; Oracle TMS Distance Configuration

attributes.name: edi_lane_code
attributes.description: Lane identifier used in Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messages exchanged with carriers, customs authorities, and trading partners. May differ from internal lane_code due to carrier-specific EDI mapping requirements.
attributes.references: EDIFACT; ANSI X12; IATA Cargo-IMP; WCO EDI Standards

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this lane definition becomes operationally active and available for shipment booking, carrier selection, and rate lookup. Supports temporal lane versioning in SAP TM and Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Master; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which this lane definition expires and is no longer available for new bookings. Null indicates an open-ended lane with no planned expiry. Used for lane lifecycle management and network re-optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Master; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: frequency_per_week
attributes.description: Number of scheduled departures per week on this lane. Used for capacity planning, shipment booking availability, and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance management. Sourced from carrier schedules in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: ftz_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane passes through or terminates in a Free Trade Zone (FTZ), enabling duty deferral, bonded warehouse processing, or re-export without full customs clearance. Managed in Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: WCO Free Trade Zone Guidelines; Descartes Global Trade Management; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: Applicable International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) governing risk and cost transfer on this lane. Determines customs brokerage responsibilities, insurance requirements, and freight charge allocation. Aligned with ICC Incoterms 2020. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; WCO Customs Data Model

attributes.name: is_capacity_freeze
attributes.description: Indicates whether capacity on this lane is frozen, preventing new load optimization allocations. Set by Blue Yonder during peak season planning or carrier capacity constraint events. Synchronized to Oracle TMS for load optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: is_cross_border
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane crosses an international border, triggering customs brokerage, Importer Security Filing (ISF), and trade compliance workflows in Descartes Customs. True for international lanes; False for domestic.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; Descartes Global Trade Management; C-TPAT

attributes.name: is_dg_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether Dangerous Goods (DG) shipments are permitted on this lane. False triggers a DG prohibition restriction. Governed by IMDG Code for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR for road transport.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: is_embargo_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether a trade or operational embargo is currently active on this lane, blocking new shipment bookings. Embargo status is managed in Descartes Customs and synchronized to SAP TM for carrier selection exclusion.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; Descartes Global Trade Management; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: is_seasonal_closure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane is subject to a seasonal closure (e.g., weather-related road closures, monsoon port restrictions). When True, the lane is excluded from carrier selection and route planning during the closure window.
attributes.references: SAP TM Operational Restrictions; IMO Weather Routing Guidelines

attributes.name: lane_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the lane, used in SAP TM and Oracle TMS for rate lookup, freight order management, and carrier selection. Serves as the canonical cross-system reference key.
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Master; Oracle TMS Lane Configuration

attributes.name: lane_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the lane, typically formatted as origin-destination pair (e.g., 'Shanghai Port – Los Angeles Port Ocean FCL'). Used in reporting, carrier communications, and network planning dashboards.

attributes.name: lane_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the lane. Active lanes are available for shipment booking and carrier allocation. Suspended lanes are temporarily unavailable. Under_review lanes are pending network optimization assessment in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Master; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: lane_tier
attributes.description: Strategic tier classification of the lane based on volume, revenue contribution, and network criticality. Tier 1 lanes are high-volume strategic corridors; Tier 3 are low-frequency secondary lanes. Used by Blue Yonder for network optimization prioritization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Network Design; SAP TM Carrier Selection

attributes.name: lane_type
attributes.description: Classification of the lane by service category: express (time-definite premium), freight (standard bulk), last_mile (final delivery segment), cross_border (international), domestic (within-country), or multimodal (multiple transport modes). Drives SLA assignment and pricing tier in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express|freight|last_mile|cross_border|domestic|multimodal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Type Configuration; IATA Cargo Services Conference

attributes.name: last_mile_zone_code
attributes.description: Delivery zone code for last-mile operations at the destination, used for postal zone routing, delivery slot assignment, and Door-to-Door (D2D) service configuration. Applicable when lane_type is 'last_mile'.
attributes.references: SAP TM Last-Mile Configuration; Oracle TMS Zone Management

attributes.name: max_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable shipment volume in Cubic Metres (CBM) for a single consignment on this lane. Used alongside Dimensional Weight (DIM Weight) calculations for air freight rating and ocean FCL/LCL capacity planning.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Services Conference; IMO SOLAS; SAP TM Capacity Management

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum allowable gross shipment weight in kilograms for a single consignment on this lane. Enforced during load optimization in Oracle TMS and freight order management in SAP TM. Derived from carrier and infrastructure constraints.
attributes.references: SAP TM Capacity Management; Oracle TMS Load Optimization; IATA ULD Regulations

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Geographic network region grouping for this lane (e.g., Asia-Pacific, Europe, Americas, Middle East Africa). Used for network planning, capacity management, and regional P&L reporting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Network Design; SAP TM Region Configuration

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the lane origin. Used for customs compliance, trade restriction screening, and regulatory reporting to WCO and Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Customs Data Model

attributes.name: origin_unlocode
attributes.description: United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations (UN/LOCODE) for the lane origin node. Five-character code used in EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) messages, customs declarations, and Bill of Lading (BOL) documentation.
attributes.references: UNECE UN/LOCODE; WCO Customs Data Model; IATA Resolution 600

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this lane, capturing special handling instructions, carrier-specific requirements, or network planning context not captured in structured fields. Used by operations and network planning teams.

attributes.name: restriction_authority
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body or internal authority that imposed the current lane restriction (e.g., 'IMO', 'IATA', 'US DOT', 'WCO', 'Internal Network Operations'). Required for compliance audit and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IMO; IATA; US DOT; WCO; ISO 28000

attributes.name: restriction_effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which the current operational restriction on this lane becomes effective. Used by SAP TM to exclude the lane from carrier selection and by Descartes Customs for trade compliance enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Operational Restrictions; Descartes Global Trade Management

attributes.name: restriction_effective_until
attributes.description: Date on which the current operational restriction on this lane expires and normal operations resume. Null indicates an indefinite restriction. Monitored by Blue Yonder for network re-optimization upon restriction lift.
attributes.references: SAP TM Operational Restrictions; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: restriction_type
attributes.description: Categorical type of the most recently applied operational restriction on this lane. Used for exception reporting and compliance audit trails. Detailed restriction history is maintained in the lane_restriction event log.
attributes.references: Descartes Global Trade Management; SAP TM Operational Restrictions; WCO

attributes.name: sap_tm_lane_code
attributes.description: External lane identifier from SAP TM (Transportation Management) used for route planning, freight order management, charge calculation, and carrier selection. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Silver Layer and SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Lane Master; SAP S/4HANA Integration

attributes.name: standard_transit_days
attributes.description: Contractual standard transit time in calendar days from origin pickup to destination delivery for this lane. Used as the baseline for SLA compliance measurement, On-Time Delivery (OTD) KPI calculation, and Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) computation in FourKites.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time Management; FourKites Predictive ETA; IATA Cargo Services Conference

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this lane: air (IATA-governed), ocean (IMO-governed), road (DOT-governed), rail, or multimodal (combination). Determines applicable regulatory framework, carrier pool, and rate structure in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600; IMO SOLAS; US DOT 49 CFR; ISO 28000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this lane record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: visibility_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether FourKites real-time GPS/IoT shipment tracking and predictive ETA calculation is enabled for shipments on this lane. Drives exception management and proactive customer notification workflows.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security

products.name: network_node
products.description: Master record for every physical or logical node in the transport network including origin/destination hubs, gateways, sorting centers, warehouses, ICDs, CFSs, FTZs, ports, airports, and last-mile delivery depots. Captures node code, node type, IATA/UN LOCODE, geographic coordinates (lat/long), country, region, time zone, operating hours, handling capabilities (dangerous goods, temperature-controlled, oversized), and node status. Serves as the geographic backbone for hub-and-spoke topology and route planning in SAP TM and Blue Yonder.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each physical or logical node in the transport network. Primary key for the network_node master record.

attributes.name: operator_network_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.network_partner. Business justification: Many terminals, warehouses, and cross-docks are operated by third-party partners. Required for partner performance tracking, operational coordination, cost allocation, and partner SLA compliance monit

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the network node facility. Used for carrier pickup/delivery instructions, customs documentation in Descartes, and last-mile routing in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node or its operating entity holds Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, enabling expedited customs clearance and reduced inspections. True = AEO certified. Used in Descartes Customs for trade lane compliance scoring.
attributes.references: AEO Authorized Economic Operator Program; WCO World Customs Organization; C-TPAT Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism

attributes.name: blue_yonder_node_code
attributes.description: Node identifier as defined in Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning for network design, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization models. Used to synchronize network topology between the lakehouse silver layer and Blue Yonder planning outputs.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the city or municipality where the network node is located. Used for geographic display in shipment tracking, carrier selection, and last-mile delivery zone mapping.

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.description: Node-level Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emission factor in kg CO2e per CBM processed, used for Greenhouse Gas (GHG) footprint calculation in sustainability reporting. Supports EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) and CORSIA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code of the country where the node is physically located (e.g., 'HKG', 'SGP', 'USA'). Used for customs compliance routing in Descartes, trade lane classification, and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; WCO World Customs Organization; WTO World Trade Organization

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network node record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: ctpat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node is C-TPAT certified, confirming compliance with US Customs and Border Protection supply chain security standards. True = C-TPAT certified. Required for US-bound shipment routing and ISF filing in Descartes.
attributes.references: C-TPAT Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism; US DOT Department of Transportation

attributes.name: customs_bonded
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node operates as a customs bonded warehouse or zone, allowing storage of goods under customs control without duty payment until release. True = bonded facility. Used in Descartes Customs for trade compliance routing and ISF/AMS filing.
attributes.references: WCO World Customs Organization; Descartes Customs Global Trade Management; C-TPAT Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism

attributes.name: dg_handling_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node is certified and equipped to handle Dangerous Goods (DG) shipments. True = DG-certified facility. Used in SAP TM carrier and route selection to ensure DG shipments are only routed through compliant nodes per IMDG Code and ICAO Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code International Maritime Dangerous Goods; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this network node record is valid and the node is available for route planning and shipment assignment. Used for temporal validity management in SAP TM and Blue Yonder network versioning.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this network node record is no longer valid. Null indicates the node is open-ended with no planned end date. Used for network topology versioning, decommissioning planning, and historical route analysis.

attributes.name: folio_visibility_code
attributes.description: Location identifier assigned to this node in the FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform. Used to correlate network node records with live shipment tracking events, predictive ETA calculations, and exception alerts from FourKites.

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node is located within or operates as a Free Trade Zone (FTZ), enabling duty-free handling and value-added services. True = FTZ-designated node. Used for trade compliance routing in Descartes and DDP/DAP Incoterms processing.
attributes.references: WCO World Customs Organization; WTO World Trade Organization; FMC Federal Maritime Commission

attributes.name: handling_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric throughput capacity of the node measured in Cubic Meters (CBM) per day. Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS, capacity planning in Blue Yonder, and network bottleneck analysis.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: hub_tier
attributes.description: Hierarchical tier of the node within the hub-and-spoke network topology. 'primary' = global mega-hub (e.g., main international gateway); 'secondary' = regional hub; 'tertiary' = country-level distribution center; 'spoke' = local delivery depot. Drives routing hierarchy in SAP TM and Blue Yonder network design.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Location Code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA airport or city code assigned to the node where applicable (e.g., 'HKG', 'SIN', 'LHR'). Used for air freight routing, House Air Waybill (HAWB) and Master Air Waybill (MAWB) origin/destination coding, and IATA-compliant carrier communications. Null for non-air nodes.
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; ICAO International Civil Aviation Organization

attributes.name: icao_airport_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Airport Code
attributes.description: Four-letter ICAO airport designator for air cargo terminal nodes (e.g., 'VHHH' for Hong Kong International). Used for air freight routing, MAWB/HAWB coding, and ICAO regulatory compliance. Null for non-airport nodes.
attributes.references: ICAO International Civil Aviation Organization; IATA International Air Transport Association

attributes.name: imo_port_code
attributes.description: Seven-digit IMO port facility code assigned to sea port nodes. Used for ocean freight Bill of Lading (BOL) routing, vessel manifest filing, and IMO regulatory compliance reporting. Null for non-port nodes.
attributes.references: IMO International Maritime Organization; FMC Federal Maritime Commission

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal latitude coordinate of the network node (e.g., 22.308901 for Hong Kong International Airport). Used for GPS-based distance calculations, FourKites real-time shipment proximity tracking, and Blue Yonder network design optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Coordinates; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; WGS-84 Standard

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal longitude coordinate of the network node (e.g., 113.914603 for Hong Kong International Airport). Used in conjunction with latitude for geospatial route planning, ETA calculation, and IoT-based asset tracking integration.
attributes.references: ISO 6709 Geographic Coordinates; FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; WGS-84 Standard

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Weight Handling Capacity in Kilograms
attributes.description: Maximum gross weight in kilograms that the node can handle per shipment or per day (context defined by operational policy). Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS and freight order feasibility checks in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS; IMO International Maritime Organization

attributes.name: node_code
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable unique business code assigned to the node (e.g., 'HKG-HUB-01', 'SIN-CFS-02'). Used as the operational reference key in SAP TM route planning, Blue Yonder network design, and FourKites visibility integration.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: node_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the network node (e.g., 'Hong Kong International Gateway Hub', 'Singapore Container Freight Station'). Used in operational reports, carrier communications, and customer-facing shipment tracking.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: node_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the network node. Controls whether the node is available for route planning and shipment assignment in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. 'active' = fully operational; 'inactive' = temporarily not in use; 'suspended' = operations halted pending review; 'under_construction' = not yet operational; 'decommissioned' = permanently retired from the network.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the node by its operational role in the transport network. Drives hub-and-spoke topology logic in SAP TM and Blue Yonder. Values: hub (major consolidation/distribution center), gateway (international entry/exit point), sorting_center (parcel sorting facility), warehouse (storage and fulfillment), port (sea port terminal), airport (air cargo terminal), icd (Inland Container Depot), cfs (Container Freight Station), ftz (Free Trade Zone), last_mile_depot (final delivery depot). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hub|gateway|sorting_center|warehouse|port|airport|icd|cfs|ftz|last_mile_depot — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO International Maritime Organization; IATA International Air Transport Association; WCO World Customs Organization

attributes.name: operating_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of operating days using ISO weekday abbreviations (e.g., 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI' or 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT'). Used for freight scheduling, carrier dispatch planning, and SLA transit time calculation in SAP TM.

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Local time at which the node ceases operations each day in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., '22:00'). Used by SAP TM for cut-off time enforcement, freight order scheduling, and SLA breach risk assessment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Local time at which the node begins operations each day in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g., '06:00'). Used by SAP TM for freight order scheduling, carrier appointment booking, and last-mile delivery window planning.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: oversized_cargo_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node has the equipment and infrastructure to handle oversized or out-of-gauge cargo (e.g., heavy lift cranes, wide-load bays). True = oversized cargo capable. Used in SAP TM special cargo routing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; US DOT Department of Transportation

attributes.name: parent_node_code
attributes.description: Node code of the parent node in the hub-and-spoke hierarchy (e.g., a spoke depot's parent is its regional hub). Enables hierarchical network topology traversal for route planning and network performance roll-up reporting. Self-referencing relationship resolved in the linking step.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the network node facility address. Used for last-mile delivery zone assignment, carrier rate lookup, and geographic clustering in Blue Yonder network optimization.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Universal Postal Union (UPU) Standards

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Internal geographic region code grouping the node into a commercial or operational region (e.g., 'APAC', 'EMEA', 'AMER', 'MEA'). Used for network performance reporting, regional P&L allocation in SAP S/4HANA Finance, and Blue Yonder network design segmentation.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this network node record was sourced (e.g., 'SAP_TM', 'BLUE_YONDER'). Used for data lineage tracking, reconciliation, and master data management governance in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management; SOX Sarbanes-Oxley Act

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum static storage capacity of the node measured in Cubic Meters (CBM). Used for warehouse capacity planning in Manhattan WMS, inventory optimization in Blue Yonder, and network design decisions.
attributes.references: Manhattan WMS; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: temp_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius that the node's temperature-controlled facility can maintain (e.g., 8.00 for refrigerated). Null if temperature_controlled is False. Used for cold-chain shipment routing and cargo integrity compliance.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: temp_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius that the node's temperature-controlled facility can maintain (e.g., -25.00 for deep freeze). Null if temperature_controlled is False. Used for cold-chain shipment routing and SLA compliance validation.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the node has temperature-controlled storage and handling capabilities (cold chain). True = facility supports temperature-sensitive cargo. Used for pharmaceutical, perishable, and cold-chain shipment routing in SAP TM.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum container throughput capacity of the node measured in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) per day. Applicable to port, ICD, CFS, and FTZ nodes. Used for ocean freight capacity planning and FCL/LCL load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IMO International Maritime Organization; FMC Federal Maritime Commission

attributes.name: timezone_code
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the node's local time zone (e.g., 'Asia/Hong_Kong', 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Critical for accurate ETD/ETA calculation, operating hours enforcement in SAP TM, and SLA compliance measurement across time zones.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IATA International Air Transport Association

attributes.name: tms_location_code
attributes.description: Location identifier code as registered in SAP TM and Oracle TMS for route planning, freight order management, and carrier selection. Serves as the cross-system reference key for transport execution systems.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary transport mode served by this network node. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (IATA for air, IMO for ocean, DOT for road/rail) and routing logic in SAP TM. 'multimodal' indicates the node serves multiple modes (e.g., an intermodal terminal).
attributes.references: IATA International Air Transport Association; IMO International Maritime Organization; US DOT Department of Transportation

attributes.name: un_locode
attributes.description: Five-character UN/LOCODE identifying the geographic location of the node (e.g., 'HKHKG', 'SGSIN'). Used for Bill of Lading (BOL), customs declarations in Descartes, and EDI messaging per WCO standards. Provides a globally standardized location reference across all transport modes.
attributes.references: WCO World Customs Organization; UNECE UN/LOCODE Standard

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this network node record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: wms_facility_code
attributes.description: Facility identifier code as registered in Manhattan WMS for nodes that perform warehousing and fulfillment operations. Used to link network node records to WMS inventory, labor, and slotting data. Null for non-warehouse nodes.

products.name: service_corridor
products.description: Defines a named, multi-leg service corridor connecting a sequence of network nodes for a specific transport mode and service product (e.g., Express Air Asia-Pacific, Ocean FCL Trans-Pacific, Road FTL Europe). Captures corridor name, mode, service type, origin region, destination region, intermediate hub sequence, standard total transit time, frequency (daily/weekly), and operational status. Used by SAP TM for route planning and by Blue Yonder for network design optimization. Distinct from individual lanes — a corridor is a named multi-node path, a lane is a single O-D pair.

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the service corridor record. Primary key for the service_corridor data product within the route domain.

attributes.name: origin_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: service_corridor defines a named multi-leg corridor connecting network nodes. The origin_hub_code STRING field is a denormalized reference to the origin network node. Adding origin_network_node_id as

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_agreement. Business justification: Service corridor planning incorporates trade agreement zones for network optimization. Corridors designed to leverage FTA benefits (e.g., USMCA-compliant routing through Mexico) require explicit agree

attributes.name: awb_prefix
attributes.description: Three-digit IATA Air Waybill (AWB) prefix assigned to the primary carrier operating this air corridor. Applicable only for AIR transport mode corridors. Used for MAWB (Master Air Waybill) and HAWB (House Air Waybill) number generation in SAP TM.

attributes.name: capacity_teu
attributes.description: Weekly or per-departure capacity of this corridor expressed in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) for ocean corridors, or equivalent volumetric capacity for other modes. Used in Blue Yonder capacity planning and SAP TM load optimization.
attributes.references: IMO; FMC; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM

attributes.name: carrier_scac_codes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Standard Carrier Alpha Codes (SCAC) or IATA carrier codes for carriers allocated to operate on this corridor. Used in SAP TM carrier selection and Oracle TMS freight audit. Supports multi-carrier corridor configurations.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC; IATA; SAP TM; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.description: Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emission factor in kg CO2e per tonne-kilometre for this corridor, based on transport mode and carrier mix. Used for GHG (Greenhouse Gas) emissions reporting, EU ETS compliance, CORSIA carbon offsetting calculations, and sustainability KPI dashboards.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; IATA; IMO; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: corridor_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the service corridor, used in SAP TM route planning and Blue Yonder network design (e.g., 'APAC-AIR-EXP-01', 'TPAC-OCN-FCL-02'). Referenced in EDI messages and carrier lane allocations.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: corridor_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the service corridor describing the route path and service product (e.g., 'Express Air Asia-Pacific', 'Ocean FCL Trans-Pacific', 'Road FTL Europe Central'). Used in operational dashboards, carrier communications, and Blue Yonder network design outputs.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: corridor_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the service corridor. ACTIVE corridors are available for shipment routing in SAP TM. SUSPENDED corridors are temporarily unavailable (e.g., due to port congestion, regulatory hold). PLANNED corridors are in network design phase in Blue Yonder. DISCONTINUED corridors are archived.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service corridor record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Audit trail field for data governance, SOX compliance, and lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customs clearance is required for shipments transiting this corridor. TRUE for cross-border corridors requiring Descartes Customs processing, ISF filing, and AMS submission. FALSE for domestic or intra-customs-union corridors (e.g., intra-EU).
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO Program; US CBP AMS/ISF

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether dangerous goods (DG) shipments are permitted on this corridor. Governed by IMDG Code for ocean, ICAO Technical Instructions for air, and ADR for road. Drives carrier selection and compliance checks in SAP TM and Descartes Customs.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; ADR; IATA DGR

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the corridor's destination country (e.g., 'GBR', 'AUS', 'BRA'). Used for customs compliance in Descartes, trade lane reporting, and cross-border regulatory requirements under WCO and WTO frameworks.

attributes.name: destination_hub_code
attributes.description: IATA airport code or UN/LOCODE of the primary destination hub node for this corridor (e.g., 'LHR' for London Heathrow, 'USLAX' for Los Angeles). Anchors the corridor's terminal network node in SAP TM route planning and FourKites real-time visibility.

attributes.name: destination_region
attributes.description: Named geographic region where the service corridor terminates (e.g., 'Europe', 'Middle East', 'Latin America'). Used for network topology grouping, lane allocation, and Blue Yonder network design. Distinct from specific destination node.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM

attributes.name: direction_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the corridor is defined for outbound (origin to destination), inbound (destination to origin), or bilateral (both directions) traffic flow. Drives lane allocation and backhaul optimization in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Total great-circle or road/rail network distance in kilometres for the full corridor from origin hub to destination hub including all intermediate legs. Used for CO2e emissions calculation, freight rate benchmarking, and Blue Yonder network optimization.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; GHG Protocol

attributes.name: edi_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messaging is enabled for carrier communications on this corridor (e.g., EDI 214 shipment status, EDI 210 freight invoice). Drives automated data exchange configuration in SAP TM and Oracle TMS freight audit.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI; EDIFACT; SAP TM; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which this service corridor becomes operationally active and available for shipment routing in SAP TM. Used for corridor lifecycle management, seasonal schedule changes, and network design transitions.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this service corridor ceases to be operationally active. NULL indicates an open-ended corridor with no planned end date. Used for corridor lifecycle management and seasonal schedule deactivation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: freight_product
attributes.description: Specific freight product type carried on this corridor. FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less than Container Load), FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less than Truckload), AIR_FREIGHT, PARCEL, BULK, or BREAKBULK. Governs load optimization rules in Oracle TMS and capacity planning in Blue Yonder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FCL|LCL|FTL|LTL|AIR_FREIGHT|PARCEL|BULK|BREAKBULK — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: frequency_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of days on which the corridor operates (e.g., 'MON,WED,FRI' for tri-weekly ocean service, 'MON,TUE,WED,THU,FRI,SAT,SUN' for daily express). Used in SAP TM departure scheduling and customer-facing ETD commitments.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: Operational frequency at which the service corridor runs (e.g., DAILY for express parcel, WEEKLY for ocean FCL). Drives departure schedule planning in SAP TM, capacity allocation in Blue Yonder, and ETD/ETA commitments communicated to customers.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: hub_spoke_role
attributes.description: Classification of this corridor's role within the hub-and-spoke network topology. HUB_TO_HUB for main trunk routes, HUB_TO_SPOKE for distribution legs, SPOKE_TO_HUB for collection legs, SPOKE_TO_SPOKE for direct point-to-point routes. Used in Blue Yonder network design and SAP TM route planning.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: incoterms_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of Incoterms (International Commercial Terms) applicable to shipments on this corridor (e.g., 'FOB,CIF,DDP,DAP,EXW'). Governs risk transfer and cost responsibility rules for cross-border shipments. Aligned with ICC Incoterms 2020 and WTO trade facilitation requirements.

attributes.name: intermediate_hub_sequence
attributes.description: Ordered, pipe-delimited sequence of intermediate hub codes (IATA or UN/LOCODE) traversed between origin and destination (e.g., 'DXB|FRA' for Dubai then Frankfurt). Defines the multi-node path that distinguishes a corridor from a single O-D lane. Consumed by SAP TM for multi-leg route planning.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; IATA; UN/LOCODE

attributes.name: last_mile_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether last-mile delivery to the final consignee is included within this corridor's scope. TRUE for D2D (Door-to-Door) corridors. FALSE for port-to-port or hub-to-hub corridors where last-mile is handled separately.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: leg_count
attributes.description: Total number of transport legs in this service corridor, including origin-to-first-hub, all intermediate legs, and final leg to destination. Derived from the hub sequence but stored for query performance in SAP TM load optimization and Blue Yonder network design.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: max_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in Cubic Meters (CBM) per shipment or per departure on this corridor. Used alongside DIM Weight (Dimensional Weight) calculations for air freight rating and load optimization in Oracle TMS and SAP TM charge calculation.

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross weight in kilograms permitted per shipment on this corridor, based on carrier capacity constraints, regulatory limits, and infrastructure limitations (e.g., bridge weight limits for road, aircraft payload for air). Used in load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: network_design_code
attributes.description: Reference to the Blue Yonder network design scenario that generated or last optimized this corridor configuration. Enables traceability between network optimization outputs and operational corridor definitions.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the corridor's origin country (e.g., 'CHN', 'USA', 'DEU'). Used for customs compliance in Descartes, trade lane reporting, and cross-border regulatory requirements under WCO and WTO frameworks.

attributes.name: origin_region
attributes.description: Named geographic region where the service corridor originates (e.g., 'Asia-Pacific', 'North America', 'Europe'). Used for network topology grouping, lane allocation, and Blue Yonder network design. Distinct from specific origin node — this is the macro-geographic classification.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM

attributes.name: primary_carrier_code
attributes.description: SCAC or IATA code of the primary/preferred carrier for this corridor. Used as the default carrier in SAP TM carrier selection logic. Distinct from carrier_scac_codes which lists all allocated carriers.
attributes.references: NMFTA SCAC; IATA; SAP TM Transportation Management

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking of this corridor relative to alternative corridors for the same O-D pair. Lower values indicate higher priority in SAP TM carrier selection and load optimization. Used when multiple corridors serve the same origin-destination combination.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: service_level_code
attributes.description: Internal SLA (Service Level Agreement) code that maps this corridor to a defined service level tier (e.g., 'P1-NEXT-DAY', 'P2-2DAY', 'STD-5DAY'). Links to SLA entitlement definitions in Salesforce CRM and drives OTD/OTIF KPI measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Salesforce CRM; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service product offered on this corridor (e.g., EXPRESS for time-definite delivery, STANDARD for deferred, ECONOMY for cost-optimized). Determines SLA commitments, pricing tiers, and priority handling rules in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: standard_transit_days
attributes.description: Standard total transit time in calendar days from origin pickup to destination delivery for this corridor under normal operating conditions. Used as the baseline for SLA commitments, ETA calculation in FourKites, and OTD (On-Time Delivery) KPI measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; FourKites; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: standard_transit_hours
attributes.description: Standard total transit time expressed in hours for sub-day precision, particularly relevant for express air corridors where transit is measured in hours rather than days (e.g., 18 hours for an overnight express air corridor). Complements standard_transit_days for precise ETA calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; FourKites; IATA

attributes.name: suspension_end_date
attributes.description: Expected or actual date on which a suspended corridor resumes operations. NULL if suspension end date is unknown. Used for proactive customer communication in Salesforce CRM and re-routing planning in SAP TM.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; SAP TM; Salesforce CRM

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for corridor suspension. Used for exception reporting, root cause analysis, and regulatory compliance documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PORT_CONGESTION|REGULATORY_EMBARGO|FORCE_MAJEURE|CARRIER_CAPACITY|INFRASTRUCTURE|SEASONAL|OTHER — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: suspension_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which the corridor is temporarily suspended (e.g., due to port congestion, regulatory embargo, force majeure). Populated only when corridor_status is SUSPENDED. Used for exception management in FourKites and customer notification in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; SAP TM; ISO 28000

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this corridor supports temperature-controlled (cold chain) shipments. Relevant for pharmaceutical, perishable food, and chemical cargo. Drives equipment type selection (reefer containers, temperature-controlled vehicles) in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: ISO 28000; SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: tracking_visibility_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: FourKites Real-Time Tracking Visibility Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time shipment tracking and predictive ETA via FourKites is enabled for this corridor. TRUE enables GPS/IoT-based visibility, exception alerts, and predictive ETA updates for shipments on this corridor.

attributes.name: transport_mode
