attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this service corridor. Drives carrier selection, regulatory compliance requirements, and charge calculation in SAP TM. Aligns with IATA (air), IMO (ocean), and DOT (road/rail) regulatory frameworks.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this service corridor record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and audit trail compliance.

products.name: corridor_leg
products.description: Individual transport leg within a service corridor, representing a single node-to-node movement segment. Captures leg sequence number, origin node, destination node, transport mode, carrier type, leg distance, standard leg transit time (hours), cut-off time, departure frequency, and leg status. Enables multi-modal route decomposition for freight forwarding (air + road, ocean + rail) and supports load optimization in Oracle TMS. A corridor has one or more legs; each leg is independently trackable via FourKites.

attributes.name: corridor_leg_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual transport leg within a service corridor. Primary key for the corridor_leg entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contracted carrier or transport operator assigned to execute this leg. Used for carrier lane allocation, freight audit, and carrier performance analytics in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Carrier Management; SAP TM Carrier Selection

attributes.name: destination_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (hub, port, airport, depot, ICD, CFS, or warehouse) where this leg terminates. Together with origin_node_id defines the origin-destination (OD) pair for this leg.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane; Oracle TMS Network Design

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: A corridor_leg represents a single node-to-node movement segment within a service corridor. A lane is the master origin-destination corridor definition for exactly that type of movement. Linking corri

attributes.name: primary_corridor_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (hub, port, airport, depot, ICD, CFS, or warehouse) where this leg originates. Supports hub-and-spoke topology decomposition in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane; Oracle TMS Network Design

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent service corridor that this leg belongs to. A corridor is composed of one or more sequential legs representing the full origin-to-destination route.

attributes.name: trade_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_agreement. Business justification: Corridor leg design must incorporate trade agreement rules (USMCA, EU FTAs) to enable preferential duty routing. Network planners configure legs to maintain origin qualification and minimize duty expo

attributes.name: carrier_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier operating this leg. Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (IATA for airlines, IMO for ocean carriers, DOT for road), rate structures, and liability regimes. NVOCC applies to Non-Vessel Operating Common Carriers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AIRLINE|OCEAN_CARRIER|ROAD_CARRIER|RAIL_OPERATOR|NVOCC|COURIER|INTERMODAL — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC); ICAO

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: CO2 Equivalent Emission Factor (kg CO2e per tonne-km)
attributes.description: Carbon dioxide equivalent (CO2e) emission factor in kg per tonne-kilometre for this leg's transport mode and vehicle type. Used to calculate shipment-level GHG emissions for EU ETS reporting, CORSIA compliance (air legs), and customer sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); GHG Protocol; IFRS S2 Climate Disclosures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corridor leg record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver Layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: cutoff_time
attributes.description: Latest local time (HH:MM, 24-hour) by which freight must be tendered at the origin node to be accepted on this leg's scheduled departure. Critical for shipment booking deadlines in Oracle TMS and customer SLA management.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Cut-Off Time Standards; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: departure_days_mask
attributes.description: 7-character binary string (Mon=pos1 through Sun=pos7) indicating which days of the week this leg operates departures (1=operates, 0=does not operate). Enables precise booking calendar generation in SAP TM and Oracle TMS scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Schedule; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: departure_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which this leg operates departures. Drives shipment booking availability windows, capacity planning in Blue Yonder, and customer-facing transit time commitments. ON_DEMAND applies to charter and FTL legs.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Frequency; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the leg destination. Used for import/export compliance, denied party screening in Descartes, and bilateral trade lane reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Customs Data Model

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized location code for the leg destination — IATA airport code (3-letter) for air legs, UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail legs. Used in AWB, BOL, and HAWB generation and customs declarations in Descartes.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes; UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: distance_km
attributes.description: Physical distance of this transport leg in kilometres. Used for freight rate calculation (per-km tariffs), GHG/CO2e emissions estimation per EU ETS and CORSIA requirements, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this corridor leg definition becomes operationally valid and available for shipment assignment. Supports seasonal route activation, network redesign rollouts from Blue Yonder, and historical lane analytics.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Validity; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: effective_to_date
attributes.description: Date after which this corridor leg definition is no longer operationally valid. Null indicates an open-ended lane with no planned expiry. Used for seasonal route deactivation, carrier contract expiry alignment, and network change management.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Validity; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: fourtites_tracking_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg is enrolled in FourKites real-time visibility tracking (True). When enabled, GPS/IoT telemetry is streamed for predictive ETA updates and exception management. Supports independent leg trackability as defined in the corridor_leg product scope.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: incoterms_applicability
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to this leg, defining the point of risk and cost transfer between shipper and consignee. Governs liability allocation, insurance requirements, and customs filing responsibilities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; WCO Customs Data Model

attributes.name: is_cross_border
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg crosses an international border (True) or is a domestic movement (False). Triggers customs declaration requirements in Descartes, ISF/AMS filing obligations, and AEO/C-TPAT compliance checks.
attributes.references: WCO Customs Data Model; Descartes Global Trade Management; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods_permitted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg is certified and permitted to carry dangerous goods (True) or not (False). Governs shipment acceptance rules per IMDG Code for ocean legs and ICAO Technical Instructions for air legs.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: is_temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg provides temperature-controlled (cold chain) transport capability (True). Relevant for pharmaceutical, perishable, and high-value cargo routing and SLA compliance.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines (Good Distribution Practice); ISO 9001

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this corridor leg definition was last reviewed and validated by the network planning team. Supports data quality governance, periodic lane review cycles, and audit trail for network optimization decisions.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management

attributes.name: leg_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this corridor leg, used in SAP TM route planning, Oracle TMS load optimization, and EDI interchange with carriers. Unique within the parent corridor.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Code; EDI X12 / EDIFACT

attributes.name: leg_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this leg within the parent corridor, starting at 1. Defines the execution order for multi-modal route decomposition (e.g., leg 1 = road pickup, leg 2 = air haul, leg 3 = road delivery). Aligns with Oracle TMS load optimization sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP TM Stage Sequence; Oracle TMS Shipment Leg Sequence

attributes.name: leg_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of this corridor leg. ACTIVE legs are available for shipment assignment; SUSPENDED legs are temporarily unavailable; DISCONTINUED legs are retired from the network. Governs availability in Oracle TMS load optimization.

attributes.name: load_type
attributes.description: Freight load configuration for this leg. FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), PARCEL, BULK, or BREAK_BULK. Drives Oracle TMS load optimization, rate calculation, and capacity planning in Blue Yonder. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTL|LTL|FCL|LCL|PARCEL|BULK|BREAK_BULK — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS Load Optimization; Blue Yonder Inventory Optimization

attributes.name: max_volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in Cubic Metres (CBM) available on this leg per departure. Used alongside max_weight_capacity_kg for DIM weight-based load optimization and capacity utilization analytics in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Capacity Standards; Oracle TMS Load Optimization; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum chargeable or physical weight capacity in kilograms that this leg can accommodate per departure. Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS, capacity planning in Blue Yonder, and freight booking acceptance logic.
attributes.references: IATA Weight and Balance; IMO SOLAS Container Weight Verification; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the leg origin. Used for cross-border compliance checks, customs filing, AEO/C-TPAT screening, and trade lane analytics.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO Customs Data Model

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized location code for the leg origin — IATA airport code (3-letter) for air legs, UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail legs. Used in AWB, BOL, and HAWB generation and AMS/ISF filings.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes; UN/LOCODE (United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations)

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes or remarks about this corridor leg, such as seasonal restrictions, port congestion advisories, special handling requirements, or network planning rationale. Intended for network planners and operations teams.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Lane Notes; Oracle TMS Shipment Remarks

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Service level classification for this leg indicating speed and priority tier. Determines SLA commitments, rate applicability, and carrier selection logic in SAP TM charge calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Level; IATA Service Classification

attributes.name: sla_on_time_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Maximum allowable transit time in hours for this leg before it is classified as a late delivery for OTD (On-Time Delivery) and OTIF (On-Time In-Full) KPI measurement. Sourced from contracted SLA terms and used in FourKites exception management.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Management; FourKites Exception Management; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this corridor leg definition was sourced. SAP_TM for route planning lanes, ORACLE_TMS for shipment execution lanes, BLUE_YONDER for network optimization outputs, or MANUAL for analyst-entered lanes. Supports data lineage and master data governance.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transportation Management; Oracle TMS; Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning

attributes.name: standard_arrival_time
attributes.description: Standard local arrival time (HH:MM, 24-hour) at the destination node for this leg. Used as the baseline Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for downstream leg connections, delivery scheduling, and OTD/OTIF KPI measurement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time Determination; FourKites Predictive ETA

attributes.name: standard_departure_time
attributes.description: Standard local departure time (HH:MM, 24-hour) for this leg at the origin node. Used as the baseline Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for shipment scheduling, FourKites tracking initialization, and customer notification triggers.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600; SAP TM Freight Order Management; FourKites Real-Time Visibility

attributes.name: standard_transit_hours
attributes.description: Contracted or standard transit time for this leg expressed in decimal hours. Used as the baseline for ETA calculation, SLA commitment derivation, and predictive ETA modeling in FourKites. Sourced from SAP TM transit time matrix.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time Determination; FourKites Predictive ETA

attributes.name: temperature_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in degrees Celsius maintained during transport on this leg. Applicable only when is_temperature_controlled is True. Used for cold chain compliance validation and cargo acceptance rules.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: temperature_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in degrees Celsius maintained during transport on this leg. Applicable only when is_temperature_controlled is True. Used for cold chain compliance validation and cargo acceptance rules.
attributes.references: IATA CEIV Pharma; GDP Guidelines; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: timezone_destination
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the destination node (e.g., Asia/Singapore, Europe/Frankfurt). Required to correctly interpret standard_arrival_time and compute accurate ETA in local destination time for delivery scheduling.

attributes.name: timezone_origin
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the origin node (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Required to correctly interpret cutoff_time and standard_departure_time for cross-timezone route planning and ETA calculations.

attributes.name: tracking_method
attributes.description: Method used to track shipment progress on this leg. GPS for road/fleet, AIS (Automatic Identification System) for ocean vessels, EDI_MILESTONE for carrier EDI updates, API_CARRIER for direct carrier API integration, RFID for warehouse handoffs, or MANUAL for exception-based updates. Drives FourKites data ingestion configuration.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility Platform; IMO AIS Requirements; IATA Cargo Tracking Standards; EDI X12/EDIFACT

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this leg. Drives carrier selection, rate calculation, customs filing requirements (IATA for air, IMO for ocean), and ETA computation. Supports multi-modal freight forwarding decomposition (air + road, ocean + rail).
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600; IMO FAL Convention; SAP TM Transportation Mode

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this corridor leg record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act); ISO 8601; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability)

attributes.name: vehicle_type
attributes.description: Type of vehicle, vessel, or aircraft used on this leg (e.g., B747F for air freighter, 20FT_CONTAINER for ocean, SEMI_TRAILER for road, FLATCAR for rail). Determines capacity constraints, dangerous goods handling rules per IMDG/ICAO TI, and emissions factors for CO2e calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Aircraft Type Codes; IMO Ship Type Classification; IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions

products.name: route_delivery_zone
products.description: Geographic zone definition used for last-mile routing, service area delineation, postal zone mapping, and serviceability validation across all transport modes. Captures zone code, zone name, zone type (postal, administrative, custom, last-mile, service-area), country, state/province, city, postal code range, coverage polygon (GeoJSON), assigned hub node, standard transit time, surcharge applicability (remote area, residential), service restrictions (dangerous goods, oversized, COD), applicable service products, and zone status. SSOT for geographic coverage and serviceability master data referenced by pricing (surcharges), fulfillment (dispatch), SAP TM (zone-based routing), and carrier selection.

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the delivery zone record. Primary key for the route_delivery_zone data product. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a geographic zone asset managed by Transport Shipping for last-mile routing and serviceability.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: route_delivery_zone is currently SILOED (no inbound or outbound FKs). It has hub_node_code (STRING) which is a denormalized code reference to the hub serving this last-mile zone. Adding hub_node_id as

attributes.name: servicing_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Last-mile delivery zones are frequently serviced by local agents. Required for agent commission calculation, service coverage validation, and agent performance tracking. Essential for agent-based dist

attributes.name: serving_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_depot. Business justification: Delivery zones are served from specific depots; linking enables territory management, last-mile route planning, depot workload balancing, and service coverage analysis.

attributes.name: aeo_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether AEO (Authorized Economic Operator) certification is required for carriers operating within this zone. Relevant for cross-border and customs-controlled zones. Enforced during carrier selection in Descartes Customs and SAP TM.
attributes.references: AEO Program; WCO SAFE Framework; C-TPAT; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: applicable_service_products
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of service product codes eligible for delivery within this zone (e.g., 'EXPRESS|STANDARD|ECONOMY|FREIGHT'). Drives service product availability validation during shipment booking and carrier selection in SAP TM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product for zone-service-product association]
attributes.references: SAP TM Service Product Configuration; IATA Service Level Standards

attributes.name: area_sqkm
attributes.description: Total geographic area of the delivery zone in square kilometres. Used in network density analysis, carrier capacity planning, and cost-per-delivery benchmarking in Blue Yonder network design.

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code of the primary carrier or last-mile delivery partner assigned to service this zone. Used in carrier selection logic within SAP TM and Oracle TMS. May be overridden by dynamic carrier selection based on capacity and cost.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Selection; Oracle TMS Carrier Configuration; IATA Carrier Codes

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary city or municipality associated with the delivery zone. Used for last-mile dispatch assignment, carrier lane allocation, and customer-facing serviceability lookup.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Configuration; IATA Location Codes

attributes.name: co2e_factor_kg_per_shipment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Emission Factor (kg per Shipment)
attributes.description: Estimated CO2e (Carbon Dioxide Equivalent) emission factor in kilograms per shipment for last-mile delivery within this zone. Used for GHG (Greenhouse Gas) emissions reporting, EU ETS compliance, and CORSIA carbon offsetting calculations.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; GHG Protocol; ISO 14064

attributes.name: cod_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) service is restricted or unavailable within this delivery zone. COD restrictions may apply due to security concerns, carrier capability limitations, or local regulatory requirements. Referenced during e-commerce fulfillment order validation.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SAP TM Service Product Configuration

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code where the delivery zone is located (e.g., GBR, SGP, USA, DEU). Used for customs compliance, regulatory routing rules, and cross-border serviceability validation per WCO and IMO standards.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO; IMO; US DOT

attributes.name: coverage_geojson
attributes.description: GeoJSON-encoded polygon or multipolygon representing the precise geographic boundary of the delivery zone. Used for GPS-based serviceability validation, FourKites real-time visibility geofencing, and last-mile dispatch optimization. Stored as serialized GeoJSON string per RFC 7946.
attributes.references: RFC 7946 GeoJSON; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; ISO 28000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery zone record was first created in the system (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for zone master data governance and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: customs_zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone from a customs and trade compliance perspective: domestic (standard domestic territory), ftz (Free Trade Zone), bonded (customs bonded area), international (cross-border delivery zone), special_economic (Special Economic Zone). Used in Descartes Customs for trade compliance routing and ISF/AMS filing requirements.
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs GTM; C-TPAT; AEO; US DOT; WTO

attributes.name: dg_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the transport of dangerous goods (DG) is restricted or prohibited within this delivery zone. Enforced during shipment booking validation and carrier selection. Aligned with IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, and local regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; US DOT 49 CFR

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this delivery zone definition becomes operationally effective. Used for temporal zone management, ensuring routing and pricing rules apply only within the valid date range. Supports zone versioning and network change management.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Validity Configuration; ISO 9001

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this delivery zone definition is no longer operationally effective. Null for open-ended zones with no planned expiry. Used for zone versioning, network restructuring, and historical serviceability audit.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Validity Configuration; ISO 9001

attributes.name: hub_node_code
attributes.description: Code of the hub, depot, or distribution center assigned to service this delivery zone in the hub-and-spoke network topology. Drives carrier selection, load optimization, and last-mile dispatch routing in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Network Configuration; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: isf_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an Importer Security Filing (ISF) is required for shipments entering this zone. Applicable to US import zones under CBP 10+2 rule. Used in Descartes Customs for automated compliance filing.
attributes.references: US CBP ISF 10+2 Rule; AMS (Automated Manifest System); Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Decimal latitude of the geographic centroid of the delivery zone in WGS84 coordinate system. Used for distance-based routing calculations, GPS geofencing in FourKites, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Decimal longitude of the geographic centroid of the delivery zone in WGS84 coordinate system. Used for distance-based routing calculations, GPS geofencing in FourKites, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: WGS84 Coordinate System; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: max_dim_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum dimensional weight (DIM weight) in kilograms accepted for delivery within this zone. DIM weight is calculated from volumetric dimensions and used alongside actual weight for carrier charge calculation and capacity planning.
attributes.references: IATA DIM Weight Calculation Standards; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: max_length_cm
attributes.description: Maximum allowable length in centimetres for a single shipment piece accepted for delivery within this zone. Used in oversized shipment validation during booking and load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Constraint Configuration; IATA Cargo Handling Manual

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross weight in kilograms for a single shipment accepted for delivery within this zone. Enforced during shipment booking validation and load optimization. Reflects infrastructure, vehicle, and carrier capability constraints.
attributes.references: SAP TM Constraint Configuration; US DOT; EU Road Transport Regulations

attributes.name: otd_target_pct
attributes.description: Target On-Time Delivery (OTD) percentage for this zone, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 98.50 = 98.5%). Used as the KPI benchmark for carrier performance management and network optimization reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP TM KPI Configuration

attributes.name: oversized_restricted
attributes.description: Indicates whether oversized or overweight shipments are restricted within this delivery zone due to infrastructure limitations, road access constraints, or local regulations. Used in load optimization and carrier selection in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: US DOT; EU Road Transport Regulations; SAP TM Constraint Configuration

attributes.name: peak_surcharge
attributes.description: Indicates whether a peak season surcharge is applicable for this zone during designated peak periods (e.g., holiday season, Chinese New Year). Drives dynamic pricing adjustments in SAP TM charge calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; IATA GRI (General Rate Increase) Guidelines

attributes.name: postal_code_from
attributes.description: Starting postal code of the range covered by this delivery zone. Together with postal_code_to, defines the postal code band for zone membership evaluation. Used in SAP TM zone-based routing and pricing surcharge determination.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Configuration; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: postal_code_to
attributes.description: Ending postal code of the range covered by this delivery zone. Together with postal_code_from, defines the postal code band for zone membership evaluation. Null if the zone is defined by a single postal code or polygon only.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Configuration; Universal Postal Union (UPU)

attributes.name: remote_area_surcharge
attributes.description: Indicates whether a remote area surcharge (RAS) applies to shipments delivered within this zone. Remote area surcharges are applied by carriers for zones with limited accessibility or extended delivery routes. Referenced by the pricing and rating domain for charge calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; IATA Tariff Coordination

attributes.name: residential_surcharge
attributes.description: Indicates whether a residential delivery surcharge applies to shipments within this zone. Residential surcharges are levied by carriers for deliveries to non-commercial addresses. Used in pricing and rating charge calculation for B2C and e-commerce fulfillment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; FedEx/UPS Residential Surcharge Standards

attributes.name: service_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local time) by which a shipment must be tendered to the hub to achieve the standard transit time for this zone. Critical for last-mile dispatch scheduling and customer booking cutoff enforcement.
attributes.references: SAP TM Scheduling; IATA Ground Handling Manual

attributes.name: service_days
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of days of the week on which delivery service operates within this zone (e.g., 'MON|TUE|WED|THU|FRI'). Used for ETA calculation, SLA management, and dispatch scheduling. Supports zones with restricted weekend or holiday service.
attributes.references: SAP TM Scheduling; IATA Ground Handling Manual

attributes.name: serviceable
attributes.description: Master serviceability flag indicating whether Transport Shipping currently provides delivery service within this zone. A zone may be defined but temporarily unserviceable due to operational, regulatory, or capacity constraints. Used as the primary gate in shipment booking serviceability checks.

attributes.name: sla_standard_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the standard SLA profile applicable to this delivery zone. Defines OTD (On-Time Delivery) and OTIF (On-Time In-Full) performance targets. Used in SLA entitlement validation and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; SAP TM SLA Configuration

attributes.name: standard_transit_days
attributes.description: Standard number of business days required to deliver a shipment from the assigned hub node to any address within this zone under normal operating conditions. Used as the baseline for SLA commitment, OTD measurement, and customer ETA communication.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Configuration; IATA Ground Handling Manual; ISO 9001

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code for the state, province, or region within the country (e.g., US-CA, GB-ENG, AU-NSW). Used for sub-national routing rules, tax jurisdiction mapping, and regional SLA configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-2; US DOT; EU Emissions Trading System

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether temperature-controlled (cold chain) delivery is available within this zone. Used during shipment booking to validate serviceability for pharmaceutical, perishable, and temperature-sensitive cargo.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; ISO 9001; SAP TM Service Product Configuration

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the delivery zone (e.g., 'Europe/London', 'Asia/Singapore', 'America/New_York'). Used to correctly interpret service cutoff times, ETA/ETD calculations, and SLA breach detection in FourKites and SAP TM.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IATA; ISO 8601

attributes.name: transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Standard transit time expressed in total hours for time-definite and express service products where sub-day precision is required. Complements standard_transit_days for same-day, next-day, and time-critical shipment SLA management.
attributes.references: SAP TM SLA Configuration; IATA Time-Definite Services

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary transport mode used for last-mile delivery within this zone. Determines carrier eligibility, equipment type, and routing logic in SAP TM and Oracle TMS. Multimodal zones support more than one mode.
attributes.references: SAP TM Mode of Transport; IMO; IATA; US DOT; ISO 28000

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this delivery zone record was last modified (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), data lineage tracking, and master data governance audit.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the delivery zone across systems (SAP TM, Oracle TMS, FourKites). Used as the business key for zone-based routing, surcharge lookup, and carrier selection. Maps to the zone identifier in SAP TM zone-based routing configuration.

attributes.name: zone_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the delivery zone, including notable geographic features, operational constraints, special handling instructions, or historical notes. Used by operations and network planning teams.

attributes.name: zone_group_code
attributes.description: Code of the zone group or zone cluster to which this delivery zone belongs. Zone groups aggregate individual zones for pricing rate card application, carrier contract negotiation, and network planning. Used in SAP TM zone group configuration.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Group Configuration; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the delivery zone (e.g., 'Greater London Last-Mile Zone', 'Singapore CBD Service Area'). Used in operational dashboards, carrier communications, and customer-facing serviceability checks.

attributes.name: zone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the delivery zone. Active zones are eligible for shipment routing and serviceability validation. Inactive or retired zones are excluded from new shipment assignments. Suspended zones may be temporarily blocked due to operational or regulatory reasons.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Configuration; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: zone_tier
attributes.description: Service tier classification of the zone reflecting delivery density, infrastructure quality, and cost profile (e.g., tier_1 = major urban centre, tier_4 = remote/rural). Used in pricing rate card assignment, SLA differentiation, and network optimization in Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Network Design; SAP TM Zone Configuration

attributes.name: zone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the zone by its definition methodology: postal (based on postal code ranges), administrative (country/state/city boundaries), custom (business-defined polygon), last_mile (final delivery leg zone), service_area (carrier or hub service coverage area). Drives routing logic and surcharge applicability in SAP TM.
attributes.references: SAP TM Zone Configuration; IATA Ground Handling Manual

products.name: transit_time_standard
products.description: Authoritative transit time standard for a lane, corridor, or service product combination. Captures origin node/zone, destination node/zone, service level (express, standard, economy), transport mode, standard transit days, standard transit hours, cut-off time, first-available-delivery time, day-of-week restrictions, and effective date range. Feeds SLA commitments in the contract domain, ETA calculation in FourKites, and carrier selection logic in SAP TM. Distinct from actual ETA events — this is the planned standard, not the real-time estimate.

attributes.name: transit_time_standard_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the transit time standard record. Primary key for this entity in the route domain Silver layer.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: Transit time standards are contractually committed SLA baselines. Linking to agreement enables automated compliance verification, breach detection, and penalty/incentive calculation. Required for cont

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or transport service provider for whom this transit time standard is defined. Used in SAP TM carrier selection logic.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Reference to the logistics service product (e.g., express parcel, economy freight) for which this transit time standard is defined.

attributes.name: origin_route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Origin Route Delivery Zone Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: transit_time_standard captures origin_zone_code as a STRING, which is a denormalized reference to the origin route_delivery_zone. Adding origin_route_delivery_zone_id as a FK to route.route_delivery_z

attributes.name: primary_transit_lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin-destination lane master record that this transit time standard applies to. Links to the lane product in the route domain.

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.service_corridor. Business justification: transit_time_standard is the authoritative transit time standard for a lane, corridor, or service product combination. The network_corridor_code STRING field is a denormalized reference to a service c

attributes.name: superseded_by_transit_time_standard_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By Transit Time Standard ID
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the newer transit time standard record that replaces this one when lifecycle_status is SUPERSEDED. Enables version chain traversal for historical SLA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: blue_yonder_standard_code
attributes.description: External identifier from Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning that maps this transit time standard to the network design and demand forecasting outputs. Enables traceability between the route domain SSOT and Blue Yonder optimization results.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; Network Design

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this transit time standard record was first created in the system. Audit trail field supporting SOX compliance and data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_days
attributes.description: Number of days allocated for customs clearance included within the standard transit time for cross-border shipments. Used in Descartes Customs integration and trade compliance planning. Relevant for DDP, DAP, and CIF Incoterms.
attributes.references: WCO; Descartes Customs; C-TPAT; AEO; WTO

attributes.name: cutoff_time
attributes.description: The latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local) by which a shipment must be tendered at the origin node to qualify for this transit time standard on a given day. Used in shipment booking, load optimization in Oracle TMS, and SLA management.
attributes.references: SAP TM Freight Order Management; Oracle TMS; IATA

attributes.name: cutoff_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the cut-off time (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of cutoff_time across global operations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: delivery_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the delivery time window at the destination node (e.g., Asia/Singapore, America/Los_Angeles). Ensures unambiguous interpretation of first_available_delivery_time and latest_delivery_time.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the destination location of this transit time standard. Used in cross-border routing, customs compliance, and trade lane analytics.

attributes.name: destination_node_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the destination hub, depot, port, airport, or facility node for this transit time standard. Aligns with IATA airport codes, UN/LOCODE, or internal network node identifiers.
attributes.references: IATA; UN/LOCODE; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: destination_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the destination node (e.g., airport, seaport, Inland Container Depot (ICD), Container Freight Station (CFS), Free Trade Zone (FTZ)). Supports network topology and hub-and-spoke configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AIRPORT|SEAPORT|RAIL_TERMINAL|ROAD_HUB|WAREHOUSE|ICD|CFS|FTZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO; IATA; WCO; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: destination_zone_code
attributes.description: Postal or geographic zone code for the destination area, used in last-mile delivery zone mapping and zone-based transit time calculations in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this transit time standard becomes valid and applicable for SLA commitments, ETA calculation, and carrier selection. Supports temporal versioning of transit standards.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date after which this transit time standard is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended standard with no planned expiry. Used in contract SLA management and carrier selection logic.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: first_available_delivery_time
attributes.description: The earliest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local) at which delivery can be attempted at the destination under this transit time standard. Used in last-mile scheduling, delivery window commitments, and ePOD (Electronic Proof of Delivery) planning.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: frequency_type
attributes.description: Frequency at which this transit service operates on the lane (e.g., daily, weekly, bi-weekly). Used in load planning, capacity allocation, and network optimization outputs from Blue Yonder.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: hazmat_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transit time standard applies to hazardous materials shipments. When true, IMDG Code (ocean) or ICAO Technical Instructions (air) dangerous goods regulations govern the transit. Affects carrier selection and routing.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR; US DOT

attributes.name: hub_routing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transit time standard requires routing through an intermediate hub node (hub-and-spoke configuration). When true, hub transit time is included in standard_transit_days.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: incoterms_applicability
attributes.description: Pipe-separated list of International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) under which this transit time standard applies (e.g., DDP|DAP|FOB|CIF|EXW). Governs responsibility boundaries for transit time SLA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DDP|DAP|FOB|CIF|EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|FAS|CFR|DPU|EXW — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: intermediate_hub_code
attributes.description: Code of the primary intermediate hub node through which shipments are routed when hub_routing_required is true. Aligns with IATA airport codes or internal network node identifiers.
attributes.references: IATA; SAP TM Route Planning; Blue Yonder Network Design

attributes.name: latest_delivery_time
attributes.description: The latest time of day (HH:MM, 24-hour local) by which delivery must be completed at the destination to meet this transit time standard. Used in SLA compliance measurement and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) reporting.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS; IATA

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of this transit time standard in its lifecycle. ACTIVE records are used in ETA calculation and carrier selection. SUPERSEDED records are retained for historical SLA audit. DRAFT records are pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: max_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum shipment volume in Cubic Meters (CBM) eligible for this transit time standard. Used alongside max_weight_kg and Dimensional Weight (DIM Weight) rules for load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM Charge Calculation; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: max_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum gross weight in kilograms of a shipment eligible for this transit time standard. Shipments exceeding this threshold require a different standard or special handling arrangement.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: operating_days_mask
attributes.description: 7-character binary string (Mon-Sun) indicating which days of the week this transit time standard is active (1=active, 0=inactive). Example: '1111100' = Monday to Friday only. Encodes day-of-week restrictions for scheduling and ETA calculation.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the origin location of this transit time standard. Used in cross-border routing, customs compliance, and trade lane analytics.

attributes.name: origin_node_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the origin hub, depot, port, airport, or facility node for this transit time standard. Aligns with IATA airport codes, UN/LOCODE, or internal network node identifiers.
attributes.references: IATA; UN/LOCODE; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: origin_node_type
attributes.description: Classification of the origin node (e.g., airport, seaport, Inland Container Depot (ICD), Container Freight Station (CFS), Free Trade Zone (FTZ)). Supports network topology analysis and hub-and-spoke configuration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AIRPORT|SEAPORT|RAIL_TERMINAL|ROAD_HUB|WAREHOUSE|ICD|CFS|FTZ — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO; IATA; WCO; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: sap_tm_route_code
