attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this leg. Used for special instructions, exception details, or operational remarks that do not fit structured fields.

attributes.name: planned_arrival_datetime
attributes.description: Planned arrival date and time for this leg. Represents the scheduled ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) at the destination node.

attributes.name: planned_departure_datetime
attributes.description: Planned departure date and time for this leg. Represents the scheduled ETD (Estimated Time of Departure) from the origin node.

attributes.name: planned_transit_hours
attributes.description: Planned transit time for this leg in hours. Calculated as the difference between planned arrival and planned departure times. Used for transit time standard compliance and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that created or last updated this route plan leg record. Examples include SAP TM, Oracle TMS, Blue Yonder, FourKites. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leg requires temperature-controlled transport (reefer). True for cold chain shipments requiring refrigeration or climate control.

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-provided tracking number for this leg. Used for real-time shipment visibility and integration with FourKites tracking platform.

attributes.name: trailer_number
attributes.description: Trailer or semi-trailer identification number for road freight legs. Used for FTL and LTL shipments.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transportation used for this leg. Indicates whether the leg is executed via air freight, ocean freight, road transport, rail, parcel delivery, or intermodal combination.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this route plan leg record was last modified. Audit field for tracking changes and data quality management.

attributes.name: voyage_number
attributes.description: Voyage or sailing number for ocean freight legs. Identifies the specific vessel voyage carrying the shipment.

products.name: eta_event
products.description: Real-time and predictive ETA/ETD event record generated by FourKites or SAP TM for a shipment leg or route plan. Captures event timestamp, event source (FourKites, carrier EDI, GPS, manual), shipment reference, leg reference, original planned ETA, current predicted ETA, ETA variance (hours), ETD actual, location at time of event (lat/long, node), prediction confidence score, exception flag, and exception type (delay, early, on-time). SSOT for all ETA updates consumed by customer visibility portals, exception management, and OTD/OTIF KPI calculation.

attributes.name: eta_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Event ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ETA/ETD event record. Primary key for the eta_event product.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or Third-Party Logistics (3PL) provider responsible for transporting the shipment on this leg. Links to the carrier master data. Used for carrier performance analysis and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance tracking.

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment for which this ETA/ETD event was generated. Links to the shipment master record.

attributes.name: destination_location_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the destination location (hub, terminal, warehouse, customer site) for this shipment leg. Links to the location master data. Used for Door-to-Door (D2D) transit time calculation and last-mile delivery zone assignment.

attributes.name: driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the driver or operator responsible for transporting the shipment on this leg. Links to the workforce master data. Used for driver performance tracking and compliance with Hours of Service (HOS) regulations.

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.customs_hold. Business justification: ETA predictions must account for customs holds to maintain accuracy. Required for predictive ETA adjustment when holds occur, customer notification of customs-related delays, and SLA impact analysis.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the route plan that governs this shipment leg. Links to the planned route configuration from SAP TM or Blue Yonder network design.

attributes.name: plan_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.plan_leg. Business justification: eta_event is a real-time and predictive ETA/ETD event record for a shipment leg. It already links to plan (plan_id) at the plan level, but ETA events are inherently leg-specific — each event tracks th

attributes.name: primary_eta_location_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (hub, terminal, warehouse, Container Freight Station (CFS), Inland Container Depot (ICD), or delivery zone) where the shipment was located at the time of this event. Links to the network topology master data.

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific shipment leg or route segment for which this ETA/ETD event applies. A shipment may have multiple legs across different transport modes.

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vehicle (truck, trailer, aircraft, vessel) transporting the shipment on this leg. Links to the fleet master data. Used for fleet utilization analysis and Global Positioning System (GPS) tracking integration.

attributes.name: actual_etd
attributes.description: The actual recorded time of departure when the shipment left the origin location, hub, or intermediate node. Captured from GPS, carrier Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), or manual confirmation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: actual_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: The actual transit time in hours for this shipment leg, calculated from actual Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) to actual Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA). Populated once the leg is completed. Used for Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: The Air Waybill (AWB) number for air freight shipments. This is the Master Air Waybill (MAWB) or House Air Waybill (HAWB) number issued by the carrier or freight forwarder. Used for tracking and customs clearance.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: The Bill of Lading (BOL) number for ocean or ground freight shipments. This is the Master Bill of Lading (MBL) or House Bill of Lading (HBL) number issued by the carrier or Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC). Used for tracking and proof of shipment.

attributes.name: container_number
attributes.description: The unique container number for Full Container Load (FCL) or Less Than Container Load (LCL) ocean freight shipments. Follows International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 6346 standard for container identification. Used for tracking and terminal handling.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ETA/ETD event record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: current_predicted_eta
attributes.business_glossary_term: Current Predicted Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
attributes.description: The most recent predicted estimated time of arrival based on real-time tracking data, traffic conditions, weather, and predictive algorithms from FourKites or SAP TM. This is the current best estimate of when the shipment will arrive. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) that identifies whether a customer notification (email, SMS, Application Programming Interface (API) push) was sent for this ETA/ETD event. True indicates the customer was notified; False indicates no notification was sent. Used for customer communication audit and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance.

attributes.name: customer_notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the customer notification was sent for this ETA/ETD event. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance verification.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_status
attributes.description: The current customs clearance status for cross-border shipments. Indicates whether the shipment is pending clearance, cleared, on hold, requires inspection, or has been released by customs authorities. Captured from Descartes Customs or Automated Manifest System (AMS) / Importer Security Filing (ISF) integration.

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: A standardized code indicating the root cause of any delay or exception. Examples include weather, traffic, customs hold, mechanical failure, carrier capacity issue, or documentation error. Used for root cause analysis and carrier performance scorecarding.

attributes.name: delay_reason_description
attributes.description: A free-text description providing additional context or details about the delay or exception. Captured from carrier Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) messages, driver notes, or customer service case logs.

attributes.name: eta_variance_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Variance Hours
attributes.description: The difference in hours between the original planned ETA and the current predicted ETA. Positive values indicate a delay; negative values indicate the shipment is ahead of schedule. Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) monitoring and On-Time Delivery (OTD) / On-Time In-Full (OTIF) Key Performance Indicator (KPI) calculation.

attributes.name: etd_variance_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) Variance Hours
attributes.description: The difference in hours between the original planned ETD and the actual ETD. Positive values indicate a late departure; negative values indicate an early departure. Used for root cause analysis of delays and transit time performance.

attributes.name: event_source
attributes.description: The system or channel that generated this ETA/ETD event. Indicates whether the event originated from FourKites real-time visibility platform, SAP TM route planning, carrier Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), GPS tracking device, manual operator entry, Oracle TMS, or Blue Yonder supply chain planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FourKites|SAP TM|Carrier EDI|GPS|Manual|Oracle TMS|Blue Yonder — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ETA/ETD event was generated or recorded. Represents the moment the prediction or update was made. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: The type of ETA/ETD event being recorded. Distinguishes between estimated time of arrival updates, estimated time of departure updates, predictive ETA calculations, actual ETD confirmations, exception alerts, and on-time confirmations.
attributes.value_regex: ETA Update|ETD Update|ETA Prediction|ETD Actual|Exception Alert|On-Time Confirmation

attributes.name: exception_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) that identifies whether this ETA/ETD event represents an exception condition requiring attention. True indicates a delay, early arrival, or other deviation from the Service Level Agreement (SLA) or planned schedule. Used to trigger exception management workflows.

attributes.name: exception_severity
attributes.description: The severity level of the exception condition. Critical indicates Service Level Agreement (SLA) breach or customer escalation required; High indicates significant delay; Medium indicates minor delay; Low indicates minimal impact; None indicates no exception.

attributes.name: exception_type
attributes.description: The specific type of exception or status condition associated with this ETA/ETD event. Categorizes the nature of the deviation (delay, early arrival, on-time, weather delay, traffic delay, customs delay, mechanical failure, route deviation, carrier issue). Used for root cause analysis and Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Delay|Early|On-Time|Weather Delay|Traffic Delay|Customs Delay|Mechanical Failure|Route Deviation|Carrier Issue — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: location_latitude
attributes.description: The geographic latitude coordinate of the shipment or vehicle at the time this ETA/ETD event was generated. Captured from Global Positioning System (GPS) or Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tracking devices. Used for real-time visibility and geofencing.

attributes.name: location_longitude
attributes.description: The geographic longitude coordinate of the shipment or vehicle at the time this ETA/ETD event was generated. Captured from Global Positioning System (GPS) or Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) tracking devices. Used for real-time visibility and geofencing.

attributes.name: original_planned_eta
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Planned Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA)
attributes.description: The initial planned estimated time of arrival as defined in the original route plan or shipment booking. This is the baseline ETA against which all subsequent updates and variances are measured. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: original_planned_etd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Planned Estimated Time of Departure (ETD)
attributes.description: The initial planned estimated time of departure as defined in the original route plan or shipment booking. This is the baseline ETD for the origin or intermediate hub. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: planned_transit_time_hours
attributes.description: The planned transit time in hours for this shipment leg as defined in the route plan or service corridor standard. Used as the baseline for On-Time Delivery (OTD) and transit time variance analysis.

attributes.name: pod_status
attributes.description: The Proof of Delivery (POD) status for this shipment leg. Indicates whether the shipment has not been delivered, has been delivered, delivery was attempted, was refused by the consignee, was damaged, or was lost. Used for Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) integration and claims processing.

attributes.name: pod_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when Proof of Delivery (POD) was captured. This is the actual delivery timestamp recorded by the driver or Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) calculation and billing.

attributes.name: prediction_confidence_score
attributes.description: A confidence score (0-100) indicating the reliability of the current predicted ETA. Higher scores indicate greater confidence based on historical accuracy, data quality, and real-time tracking signal strength. Generated by FourKites or SAP TM predictive algorithms.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The service level or product type for this shipment. Indicates express parcel delivery, standard service, economy, same-day, next-day, freight forwarding, Less Than Truckload (LTL), Full Truckload (FTL), Full Container Load (FCL), or Less Than Container Load (LCL). Used for Service Level Agreement (SLA) determination and On-Time Delivery (OTD) measurement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Express|Standard|Economy|Same-Day|Next-Day|Freight|LTL|FTL|FCL|LCL — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) that identifies whether this ETA/ETD event represents a Service Level Agreement (SLA) breach. True indicates the shipment will miss or has missed the committed delivery time; False indicates on-time or early. Used for Key Performance Indicator (KPI) dashboards and customer credits processing.

attributes.name: sla_target_delivery_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Delivery Timestamp
attributes.description: The committed delivery date and time as defined in the Service Level Agreement (SLA) or customer contract. This is the contractual deadline against which On-Time Delivery (OTD) and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance is measured. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: traffic_condition
attributes.description: A description of the traffic conditions at the time of the ETA/ETD event or along the route. Captured from traffic Application Programming Interface (API) integration, Global Positioning System (GPS) data, or driver reports. Used for delay analysis and dynamic route optimization.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: The mode of transportation for this shipment leg. Indicates whether the leg is transported by air, ocean, road, rail, or multimodal combination. Aligns with International Air Transport Association (IATA) and International Maritime Organization (IMO) standards.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this ETA/ETD event record was last updated in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: A description of the weather conditions at the time of the ETA/ETD event or along the route. Examples include clear, rain, snow, fog, storm, hurricane. Captured from weather Application Programming Interface (API) integration or driver reports. Used for delay analysis and predictive modeling.

products.name: hub_spoke_config
products.description: Configuration record defining the hub-and-spoke topology for a specific network region or service product. Captures hub node, spoke nodes list, service product scope (express, freight, e-commerce), transport mode, maximum spoke-to-hub transit time, consolidation frequency, minimum volume threshold for direct lane bypass, effective date range, and configuration status. Managed in SAP TM and Blue Yonder for network design. Distinct from service_corridor (which defines named multi-leg paths) — this defines the structural hub-spoke relationship.

attributes.name: hub_spoke_config_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hub-and-spoke network configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the central hub facility or terminal that serves as the consolidation and distribution center for this configuration. Links to the facility/node master data.

attributes.name: operator_tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Hub consolidation operations frequently outsourced to 3PL providers. Required for operational accountability, cost allocation, performance tracking, and 3PL contract compliance validation. Essential f

attributes.name: primary_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary carrier or 3PL partner assigned to operate this hub-spoke configuration. Links to carrier master data.

attributes.name: spoke_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.fleet_depot. Business justification: Hub-spoke configurations define which depots serve as spokes (in addition to hub_node_id); critical for fleet deployment planning, asset allocation, and last-mile service design.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval status of the configuration before it becomes active. Ensures governance and sign-off by network planning and operations leadership.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved this hub-spoke configuration for operational use.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hub-spoke configuration was approved. Supports audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: carrier_allocation_strategy
attributes.description: Strategy for allocating carriers to hub-spoke lanes: dedicated carriers per lane, shared carrier pool, dynamic selection via TMS, or contract-based assignment.

attributes.name: config_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the hub-spoke configuration, used for external reference and reporting. Typically follows a naming convention combining region, service product, and version.

attributes.name: config_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the hub-spoke configuration, typically including geographic scope and service type (e.g., 'APAC Express Hub-Spoke Q1 2024').

attributes.name: config_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the hub-spoke configuration. Only active configurations are used for operational route planning and shipment execution.

attributes.name: config_version
attributes.description: Version number of this configuration. Incremented when the configuration is updated, supporting change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: consolidation_cutoff_time
attributes.description: Daily cutoff time (HH:MM format, hub local time) by which shipments must arrive at the hub to be included in the next consolidation cycle.

attributes.name: consolidation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which shipments are consolidated at the hub before distribution to spokes. Impacts inventory holding time and service level.

attributes.name: country_scope
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes covered by this hub-spoke configuration. Defines the geographic boundary for customs and trade compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hub-spoke configuration record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customs_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customs clearance is required at the hub for cross-border shipments in this configuration. Triggers Descartes Customs integration.

attributes.name: direct_lane_bypass_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct spoke-to-spoke or spoke-to-destination lanes are allowed when volume/weight thresholds are met, bypassing the hub.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this hub-spoke configuration expires or is superseded by a new configuration. Null indicates an open-ended configuration.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this hub-spoke configuration becomes active and is used for route planning and shipment execution. Supports temporal network design.

attributes.name: ftz_zone_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the hub operates within or has access to a Free Trade Zone, enabling duty deferral and trade compliance benefits.

attributes.name: hub_capacity_pallets
attributes.description: Maximum handling capacity of the hub in standard pallet positions. Relevant for LTL, parcel, and e-commerce fulfillment operations.

attributes.name: hub_capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum handling capacity of the hub in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU) for containerized freight. Used for capacity planning and network design.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hub-spoke configuration record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: max_hub_to_spoke_transit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum allowable transit time in hours from the hub to any spoke node. Critical for On-Time Delivery (OTD) and On-Time In-Full (OTIF) performance.

attributes.name: max_spoke_to_hub_transit_hours
attributes.description: Maximum allowable transit time in hours from any spoke node to the hub. Used for SLA validation, route planning, and network design optimization.

attributes.name: min_volume_threshold_cbm
attributes.description: Minimum shipment volume in cubic meters (CBM) required to bypass the hub and establish a direct lane from spoke to destination. Used for load optimization and cost efficiency.

attributes.name: min_weight_threshold_kg
attributes.description: Minimum shipment weight in kilograms required to qualify for direct lane bypass, avoiding hub consolidation. Supports FTL and FCL optimization logic.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified this hub-spoke configuration record. Supports accountability and audit trails.

attributes.name: network_design_model_code
attributes.description: Reference to the Blue Yonder network design model or optimization run that generated or validated this hub-spoke configuration.

attributes.name: network_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market area covered by this hub-spoke configuration (e.g., 'North America', 'APAC', 'EU West'). Used for regional network planning and optimization.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this hub-spoke configuration, including special handling instructions, seasonal adjustments, or operational constraints.

attributes.name: optimization_objective
attributes.description: Primary objective used by Blue Yonder and SAP TM for network optimization: minimize cost, maximize speed, maximize reliability, or balanced multi-objective.

attributes.name: predictive_eta_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Predictive Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether predictive ETA calculation using FourKites or Blue Yonder is enabled for this configuration, supporting proactive exception management.

attributes.name: real_time_visibility_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether FourKites real-time visibility tracking is enabled for shipments routed through this hub-spoke configuration.

attributes.name: service_product_scope
attributes.description: The service product line or business segment this hub-spoke configuration applies to. Determines operational rules, SLA targets, and routing logic.

attributes.name: sla_target_otd_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target On-Time Delivery (OTD) Percent
attributes.description: Target On-Time Delivery percentage for shipments routed through this hub-spoke configuration. Used for performance monitoring and carrier evaluation.

attributes.name: sla_target_otif_percent
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target On-Time In-Full (OTIF) Percent
attributes.description: Target On-Time In-Full percentage for shipments routed through this hub-spoke configuration. Measures both timeliness and completeness of delivery.

attributes.name: spoke_count
attributes.description: Total number of spoke nodes included in this hub-spoke configuration. Used for network complexity analysis and capacity planning.

attributes.name: spoke_nodes_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of spoke node codes or identifiers that are served by this hub. Represents the delivery/pickup points connected to the hub in this configuration.

attributes.name: sustainability_target_co2e_kg_per_shipment
attributes.business_glossary_term: Sustainability Target Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) Kilograms per Shipment
attributes.description: Target carbon emissions in CO2e kilograms per shipment for this hub-spoke configuration. Supports CORSIA and EU ETS compliance and sustainability reporting.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used for hub-to-spoke and spoke-to-hub movements in this configuration. Aligns with freight forwarding mode definitions.
attributes.references: IATA, IMO, ICAO Transport Mode Standards

products.name: lane_performance
products.description: Operational performance record for a lane over a defined measurement period, capturing actual vs. planned transit time, OTD rate, OTIF rate, average delay hours, shipment volume, exception count, carrier performance score, and CO2e per shipment for that lane. Sourced from FourKites actuals and Oracle TMS freight audit data. Used for lane-level SLA monitoring, carrier scorecard inputs, and network optimization trigger analysis. This is an operational measurement record, not an analytics aggregate — each row represents a lane-period measurement.

attributes.name: lane_performance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each lane-period performance measurement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this operational measurement entity.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (transport service provider) whose performance is being measured on this lane for the defined period. Supports carrier scorecard and selection analytics.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Selection; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Performance metrics must be measured against specific service-level commitments (express vs. standard SLAs differ). Required for service-level SLA compliance reporting, carrier scorecard generation, a

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin-destination lane master record that this performance measurement covers. Links to the route domain lane master.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: Lane performance metrics inform rate card adjustments. Rate_card_id links performance to pricing decisions, enabling performance-based rate optimization, rate card effectiveness analysis, and dynamic

attributes.name: transit_time_standard_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.transit_time_standard. Business justification: lane_performance captures actual vs planned transit performance for a lane over a measurement period. Linking lane_performance to transit_time_standard via transit_time_standard_id enables direct comp

attributes.name: actual_transit_hours
attributes.description: The measured average actual transit time in hours for shipments on this lane during the measurement period. Sourced from FourKites actuals and Oracle TMS freight audit data. Compared against planned_transit_hours to derive delay.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: avg_delay_hours
attributes.description: Average number of hours by which shipments on this lane exceeded the planned transit time during the measurement period. Positive values indicate late delivery; negative values indicate early delivery. Key input for SLA breach analysis.
attributes.references: FourKites Exception Management; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: avg_dim_weight_kg
attributes.description: Average dimensional (volumetric) weight in kilograms per shipment on this lane during the measurement period. DIM weight is used by carriers to price low-density shipments. Sourced from Oracle TMS freight audit.
attributes.references: IATA DIM Weight Standards; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: avg_freight_cost
attributes.description: Average freight cost per shipment on this lane during the measurement period, in the reporting currency. Sourced from Oracle TMS freight audit. Used for cost-per-lane benchmarking and network optimization analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS

attributes.name: avg_shipment_weight_kg
attributes.description: Average actual gross weight in kilograms per shipment on this lane during the measurement period. Used for load optimization, carrier rate benchmarking, and CO2e intensity calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Weight Standards; IMO; SAP TM Load Optimization

attributes.name: carrier_invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of carrier invoices for shipments on this lane that matched the contracted rate without dispute during the measurement period. Sourced from Oracle TMS freight audit. Supports carrier financial performance evaluation.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS

attributes.name: carrier_performance_score
attributes.description: Composite carrier performance score for this lane-period, typically on a 0–100 scale, derived from OTD rate, OTIF rate, exception rate, and transit time adherence. Primary input for carrier scorecard and SAP TM carrier selection decisions.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Selection; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: co2e_per_shipment_kg
attributes.description: Average CO2e emissions in kilograms per shipment on this lane during the measurement period. Calculated from fuel consumption, transport mode, and distance. Supports EU ETS, CORSIA, and GHG sustainability reporting.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; IMO GHG Strategy; ICAO

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the avg_freight_cost and total_freight_cost monetary fields on this record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customs_clearance_delay_hours
attributes.description: Average hours of delay attributable to customs clearance processes for shipments on this lane during the measurement period. Sourced from Descartes Customs. Used for cross-border lane performance root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Descartes Customs Global Trade Management; WCO; C-TPAT; AEO

attributes.name: damage_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane that incurred cargo damage during the measurement period, expressed as a decimal. Used for carrier liability assessment, insurance claims analysis, and lane risk scoring.
attributes.references: IMO IMDG Code; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the lane destination. Used for cross-border compliance, customs reporting, and geographic performance segmentation.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the destination hub, port, airport, or facility of the lane (e.g., IATA airport code, UN/LOCODE). Identifies the arrival point for transit time and OTD measurement.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes; UN/LOCODE; IMO Port Codes

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Total number of shipment exceptions (delays, damages, misroutes, customs holds, etc.) recorded on this lane during the measurement period. Sourced from FourKites exception management. Triggers network optimization review.
attributes.references: FourKites Exception Management; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: exception_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane that incurred at least one exception during the measurement period, expressed as a decimal (exception_count / shipment_count). Used for lane risk scoring and network optimization triggers.
attributes.references: FourKites Exception Management; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: folio_source
attributes.description: Identifies the primary operational system of record from which actuals for this lane-period measurement were sourced (FourKites, Oracle TMS, SAP TM, or manual entry). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; SAP TM

attributes.name: foukites_tracking_coverage_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane that had active FourKites real-time GPS/IoT tracking during the measurement period. Low coverage rates may indicate data quality issues in actuals-based metrics.

attributes.name: last_mile_delay_hours
attributes.description: Average hours of delay attributable specifically to the last-mile delivery segment for shipments on this lane during the measurement period. Enables root cause decomposition of total delay into linehaul vs. last-mile components.
attributes.references: FourKites Exception Management; Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the performance measurement window for this lane-period record. Combined with measurement_period_start_date defines the exact reporting interval.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; FourKites Real-Time Visibility

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the performance measurement window for this lane-period record. Combined with measurement_period_end_date defines the exact reporting interval (e.g., weekly, monthly).
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; FourKites Real-Time Visibility

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this lane-period performance measurement record. Draft = initial load; Confirmed = validated by freight audit; Published = available for scorecard and SLA reporting; Superseded = replaced by a corrected record.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: network_optimization_trigger
attributes.description: Indicates whether this lane-period measurement has triggered a network optimization review in Blue Yonder based on SLA breach, high exception rate, or cost threshold exceedance. True = optimization review triggered.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Supply Chain Planning; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: on_time_shipment_count
attributes.description: Number of shipments on this lane that were delivered on or before the planned delivery date/time during the measurement period. Numerator for OTD rate calculation.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the lane origin. Used for cross-border compliance, customs reporting, and geographic performance segmentation.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Standardized code for the origin hub, port, airport, or facility of the lane (e.g., IATA airport code, UN/LOCODE). Identifies the departure point for transit time and OTD measurement.
attributes.references: IATA Airport Codes; UN/LOCODE; IMO Port Codes

attributes.name: otd_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane delivered on or before the planned delivery date/time during the measurement period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9500 = 95%). Core KPI for SLA monitoring and carrier scorecard.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: otif_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane delivered both on time and in full (no quantity shortfall) during the measurement period, expressed as a decimal. Composite SLA metric used for customer contract compliance and carrier evaluation.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the measurement window for this lane-period record. Determines the aggregation cadence used for SLA monitoring and carrier scorecard reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: planned_transit_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or standard planned transit time in hours for this lane as defined in the SLA or service corridor standard. Sourced from SAP TM route planning master data. Baseline for OTD and delay calculations.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: pod_completion_rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane for which an electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) was captured and confirmed during the measurement period. Supports compliance with customer SLA documentation requirements.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: predictive_eta_accuracy_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Predictive Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) Accuracy Rate
attributes.description: Proportion of shipments on this lane for which FourKites' predictive ETA was within the agreed tolerance window of the actual delivery time during the measurement period. Measures the reliability of the real-time visibility platform's ETA predictions.
attributes.references: FourKites Real-Time Visibility; ETA Management Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lane-period performance measurement record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and incremental processing.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lane-period performance measurement record was last modified in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change tracking, SLA audit, and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: shipment_count
attributes.description: Total number of shipments executed on this lane during the measurement period. Denominator for OTD, OTIF, and exception rate calculations. Sourced from Oracle TMS shipment execution records.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Shipment Execution; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the lane's OTD rate fell below the contracted SLA threshold (sla_threshold_otd) during the measurement period. True = SLA breached; False = SLA met. Triggers escalation and network optimization review workflows.
attributes.references: SAP TM; Oracle TMS Freight Audit; ISO 9001

attributes.name: sla_threshold_otd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) On-Time Delivery (OTD) Threshold
attributes.description: The contracted minimum OTD rate threshold for this lane as defined in the applicable SLA or carrier agreement, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.9500 = 95%). Used to determine SLA compliance status for the period.
attributes.references: SAP TM Charge Calculation; ISO 9001; IATA Service Standards

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: The native record identifier from the operational source system (FourKites or Oracle TMS) from which this lane-period measurement was extracted. Enables back-tracing to the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; FourKites Real-Time Visibility; SOX

attributes.name: total_co2e_kg
attributes.description: Total CO2e emissions in kilograms for all shipments on this lane during the measurement period. Aggregate of co2e_per_shipment_kg × shipment_count. Used for sustainability reporting and carbon offset calculations.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA; IMO GHG Strategy

attributes.name: total_freight_cost
attributes.description: Total freight cost for all shipments on this lane during the measurement period, in the reporting currency. Sourced from Oracle TMS freight audit and SAP S/4HANA Finance. Used for P&L lane-level cost analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle TMS Freight Audit; SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this lane (air, ocean, road, rail, or multimodal). Aligns with IATA for air, IMO for ocean, and DOT for road/rail classifications.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM Route Planning

products.name: carrier_schedule
products.description: Published carrier schedule for a specific lane or corridor leg, capturing carrier reference, service name, origin node, destination node, transport mode, vessel/flight/train service identifier, departure day(s) of week, departure time, arrival day(s) of week, arrival time, frequency, transit time (hours), capacity (TEU/kg/CBM), cut-off time (cargo receipt deadline), effective date range, and schedule status. Sourced from carrier EDI feeds and used by SAP TM for departure planning and Oracle TMS for load optimization.

attributes.name: carrier_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the carrier schedule record in the Transport Shipping lakehouse Silver layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: carrier_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.carrier_agreement. Business justification: Carrier schedules (vessel/flight rotations) operate under specific carrier agreements defining rates, capacity, and service terms. Essential for schedule-to-contract reconciliation, rate validation, a

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier (shipping line, airline, road carrier, or rail operator) that operates this schedule. Used by SAP TM for carrier selection and Oracle TMS for freight audit.
attributes.references: SAP TM Carrier Master; IATA; IMO

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Carrier schedules represent specific service offerings (express, economy, etc.). Link enables service-level performance tracking, rate application, and SLA validation against contracted service commit

attributes.name: destination_node_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (port, airport, hub, depot, ICD, CFS) at which this schedule arrives. Used for ETA/ETD management and last-mile delivery zone assignment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Network Design; IMO; IATA

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the origin-destination lane master record that this schedule serves. Links the schedule to the route domain lane definition for load optimization and carrier selection in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS Load Optimization

attributes.name: primary_carrier_network_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the network node (port, airport, hub, depot, ICD, CFS) from which this schedule departs. Supports hub-and-spoke topology and FourKites real-time visibility integration.
attributes.references: SAP TM Network Design; IMO; IATA

attributes.name: tariff_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.tariff. Business justification: Carrier schedules reference tariffs for published rates. Tariff_id links schedule to pricing, enabling schedule-based tariff rate lookup, carrier schedule costing, and published rate validation agains

attributes.name: alliance_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ocean carrier alliance (e.g., '2M', 'THE Alliance', 'Ocean Alliance') or air cargo alliance to which this schedule belongs. Used for slot-sharing and co-loading capacity management in Blue Yonder and Oracle TMS.

attributes.name: arrival_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday through 7=Sunday) on which this schedule arrives at the destination node. May differ from departure days for multi-day transits. Used for ETA calculation and last-mile delivery zone scheduling.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Weekday Numbering; SAP TM ETA Management

attributes.name: arrival_time
attributes.description: Scheduled local arrival time at the destination node in HH:mm (24-hour) format. Combined with arrival_days_of_week to determine the Estimated Time of Arrival (ETA) for delivery planning and SLA entitlement matching.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM ETA Management; FourKites

attributes.name: arrival_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the destination node (e.g., 'Europe/Rotterdam', 'Asia/Tokyo'). Required to convert local arrival time to UTC for cross-border ETA management and FourKites real-time visibility integration.

attributes.name: capacity_teu
attributes.description: Maximum container capacity of this schedule expressed in Twenty-foot Equivalent Units (TEU). Applicable for ocean FCL/LCL services. Null for non-ocean modes. Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS and capacity planning in Blue Yonder.

attributes.name: capacity_volume_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum volumetric capacity in Cubic Meters (CBM) for this schedule. Used alongside DIM Weight (Dimensional Weight) calculations for air freight and LTL/LCL load optimization in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: capacity_weight_kg
attributes.description: Maximum payload weight capacity in kilograms for this schedule. Applicable across all transport modes (air, ocean, road, rail). Used for load optimization in Oracle TMS and freight order management in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Weight and Balance; IMO; US DOT; SAP TM Charge Calculation

attributes.name: co2e_emission_factor
attributes.description: Carrier-published or calculated Carbon Dioxide Equivalent (CO2e) emission factor for this schedule in kg CO2e per tonne-km. Used for GHG (Greenhouse Gas) reporting, EU ETS compliance, CORSIA carbon offsetting calculations, and sustainability analytics.
attributes.references: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS); CORSIA (Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation); GHG Protocol; IMO DCS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier schedule record was first ingested into the Transport Shipping lakehouse Silver layer. Audit trail field for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.description: Cargo receipt deadline expressed as the number of hours before scheduled departure by which cargo must be tendered to the carrier at the origin node. Used by SAP TM for freight order management and Oracle TMS for shipment execution planning.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Cut-Off Standards; IMO; SAP TM Freight Order Management

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this carrier schedule accepts dangerous goods (DG) shipments (True) or not (False). Drives compliance routing in Descartes Customs and shipment eligibility checks against IMDG Code (ocean) and ICAO Technical Instructions (air).
attributes.references: IMDG Code (International Maritime Dangerous Goods Code); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: departure_days_of_week
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO weekday numbers (1=Monday through 7=Sunday) on which this schedule departs (e.g., '1,3,5' for Mon/Wed/Fri). Used by SAP TM for departure planning and Blue Yonder for network optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 Weekday Numbering; SAP TM Departure Planning

attributes.name: departure_time
attributes.description: Scheduled local departure time at the origin node in HH:mm (24-hour) format. Combined with departure_days_of_week to determine the Estimated Time of Departure (ETD) for shipment planning in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; SAP TM ETD Management

attributes.name: departure_timezone
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the origin node (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Asia/Shanghai'). Required to convert local departure time to UTC for cross-border schedule coordination and FourKites predictive ETA calculation.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the destination node (e.g., 'GBR', 'SGP', 'BRA'). Used for import customs declaration routing in Descartes Customs, denied party screening, and WTO trade compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO; WTO; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: destination_port_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Destination Port / Airport Code (UN/LOCODE or IATA)
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail destinations or IATA 3-letter airport code for air destinations. Denormalised from the destination network node for EDI messaging, customs filing, and carrier schedule matching.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; IATA Airport Codes; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: doc_cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of shipping documents (AWB, BOL, customs declarations) expressed as hours before scheduled departure. Required for Descartes Customs AMS/ISF filing compliance and carrier EDI submission.
attributes.references: AMS (Automated Manifest System); ISF (Importer Security Filing); Descartes Customs; IATA

attributes.name: edi_source_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the EDI feed or carrier data exchange channel from which this schedule record was sourced (e.g., EDIFACT IFTMCS, ANSI X12 204, carrier API). Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer ingestion audit in the Databricks lakehouse.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS; ANSI X12; IATA Cargo-XML

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this carrier schedule is valid and available for booking. Used for schedule versioning, seasonal service management, and SAP TM departure planning.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Management; IATA Season Codes

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this carrier schedule is no longer valid. Null indicates an open-ended schedule with no defined end date. Used for schedule lifecycle management and carrier contract alignment.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Management; IATA Season Codes

attributes.name: frequency_per_week
attributes.description: Number of departures per week for this schedule on the specified lane. Used by Blue Yonder for supply chain planning, capacity allocation, and network design optimization.
attributes.references: Blue Yonder Network Design; SAP TM Route Planning

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Primary fuel type used by the vessel, aircraft, or vehicle operating this schedule. Used for BAF (Bunker Adjustment Factor) surcharge calculation, GHG emissions reporting, and EU ETS compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VLSFO|HFO|MGO|LNG|SAF|DIESEL|ELECTRIC|HYBRID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMO MARPOL Annex VI; EU ETS; CORSIA; IATA SAF Framework

attributes.name: is_direct_service
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule operates as a direct (non-stop) service between origin and destination nodes (True) or involves intermediate port calls / transshipment stops (False). Used for transit time accuracy and customer SLA commitments.
attributes.references: SAP TM Route Planning; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the origin node (e.g., 'CHN', 'USA', 'DEU'). Used for trade compliance routing in Descartes Customs, C-TPAT/AEO screening, and cross-border regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; WCO; C-TPAT; AEO (Authorized Economic Operator)

attributes.name: origin_port_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Origin Port / Airport Code (UN/LOCODE or IATA)
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE (5-character) for ocean/road/rail origins or IATA 3-letter airport code for air origins. Denormalised from the origin network node for EDI messaging, AMS filing, and carrier schedule matching without requiring a node lookup.
attributes.references: UN/LOCODE; IATA Airport Codes; AMS (Automated Manifest System)

attributes.name: published_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the carrier published or last updated this schedule via EDI feed. Represents the principal business event time for this record. Used for schedule freshness validation and EDI reconciliation in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: ref
attributes.description: Carrier's own internal reference or booking system identifier for this schedule, as received via EDI. Enables round-trip reconciliation with the carrier's system and supports freight audit in Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS; Oracle TMS Freight Audit

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known carrier schedule reference number or code as published by the carrier via EDI feed. Used as the business identifier for matching against carrier EDI messages (e.g., EDIFACT IFTMCS) and for reconciliation in SAP TM and Oracle TMS.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS; IATA; IMO; US DOT

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the carrier schedule record. ACTIVE: available for booking and departure planning. SUSPENDED: temporarily unavailable (e.g., port congestion, force majeure). CANCELLED: permanently discontinued. DRAFT: pending carrier confirmation. EXPIRED: past effective_until_date.
attributes.references: SAP TM Schedule Lifecycle; Oracle TMS

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this carrier schedule record, incremented each time the carrier publishes an updated schedule via EDI. Supports schedule change management and historical comparison in the Silver layer.
attributes.references: EDIFACT IFTMCS Version Control; SAP TM Schedule Management

attributes.name: temperature_controlled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule provides temperature-controlled (reefer/cold chain) capacity (True) or ambient-only service (False). Used for perishable cargo eligibility and specialized equipment allocation in SAP TM.
attributes.references: IATA Perishable Cargo Regulations; IMO Reefer Standards; ISO 9001

attributes.name: transit_time_hours
attributes.description: Standard published transit time in hours from origin node departure to destination node arrival for this schedule. Used as the baseline for SLA (Service Level Agreement) commitments, OTD (On-Time Delivery) KPI measurement, and Blue Yonder network optimization.
attributes.references: SAP TM Transit Time Standards; Oracle TMS; ISO 9001

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transport for this carrier schedule. Drives carrier selection logic in SAP TM, load optimization in Oracle TMS, and customs declaration routing in Descartes Customs.

attributes.name: transshipment_port_code
attributes.description: UN/LOCODE of the primary transshipment hub for indirect services (is_direct_service = False). Used for multi-leg ETA calculation, customs transit declaration in Descartes Customs, and FourKites milestone tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier schedule record was last modified in the Transport Shipping lakehouse Silver layer. Used for incremental processing, change data capture, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: vgm_cutoff_hours_before_departure
attributes.business_glossary_term: Verified Gross Mass (VGM) Cut-Off Time (Hours Before Departure)
attributes.description: Deadline for submission of Verified Gross Mass (VGM) declaration expressed as hours before scheduled departure. Mandatory for ocean shipments under SOLAS Amendment 2016. Null for non-ocean modes.

attributes.name: voyage_rotation_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned voyage or rotation number for ocean services, or equivalent rotation identifier for air/rail. Used for Bill of Lading (BOL) and Master Bill of Lading (MBL) cross-referencing and port authority reporting.

domains.name: fulfillment
domains.description: Manages e-commerce and D2D fulfillment execution including order orchestration, pick-pack-ship workflows, last-mile dispatch, carrier selection for parcel delivery, returns processing (RMA), advanced shipping notices (ASN), COD collections, and SLA breach tracking. Owns fulfillment orders, parcel manifests, delivery attempts, ePOD capture, and omnichannel integration via EDI and API channels with merchant e-commerce platforms.
domains.references: ISO 9001, PCI DSS, IATA Resolution 600 Series

products.name: last_mile_dispatch
products.description: Last-mile delivery dispatch record assigning a consignment to a delivery agent/driver for final delivery execution. Captures dispatch date, delivery agent employee ID, vehicle registration, delivery route code, dispatch sequence number within the route, planned delivery time window, actual pickup time from depot, delivery attempt number, dispatch status (dispatched/in_transit/delivered/failed/returned), and return-to-depot timestamp if undelivered. Sourced from Oracle TMS last-mile dispatch module. Enables D2D delivery performance tracking and driver productivity measurement.

attributes.name: last_mile_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the last-mile dispatch record. Primary key for the last_mile_dispatch product.

attributes.name: consignee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.consignee. Business justification: Last-mile dispatch delivers to consignees (end recipients). The recipient_name and recipient_contact_phone should be normalized to consignee_id FK referencing consignee.consignee_id. This enables leve

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consignment being dispatched for final delivery. Links to the shipment or parcel being delivered.

attributes.name: delivery_driver_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.driver_profile. Business justification: Last-mile delivery agent assignment requires driver profile lookup for license validation, HOS compliance verification, performance tracking, and route authorization. Existing delivery_agent_employee_

attributes.name: dispatch_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.dispatch_run. Business justification: A dispatch_run is the operational route/courier trip that groups multiple last-mile dispatches. last_mile_dispatch assigns a single consignment to a driver, while dispatch_run represents the full sche

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.delivery_zone. Business justification: Last-mile dispatch assignments are zone-based. Adding delivery_zone_id FK enables proper zone-based routing, SLA tracking, and delivery agent assignment. The delivery address fields remain (execution-

attributes.name: fulfillment_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent fulfillment order that this dispatch is executing. Links to the e-commerce or D2D order.

attributes.name: hold_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.customs_hold. Business justification: Last-mile dispatch is blocked when customs holds exist. Enables delivery agents to understand delay root cause, provide accurate customer updates, and reschedule delivery attempts based on expected cu

attributes.name: origin_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Dispatches originate from specific network nodes (depots, hubs). Enables dispatch origin tracking, node-level performance analysis, and depot capacity planning. Standard in last-mile operations manage

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.plan. Business justification: Last-mile dispatches execute the final delivery leg of multi-leg route plans. Linking enables end-to-end plan execution tracking, actual-vs-planned variance analysis, and closed-loop feedback for rout

attributes.name: rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.rate_card. Business justification: Last-mile dispatches require rate card linkage for delivery zone pricing application, COD fee calculation, accessorial charge determination, and driver settlement in final-mile delivery operations.

attributes.name: shipment_leg_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_leg. Business justification: Last-mile dispatch executes a specific shipment leg. Operations teams link dispatch events to shipment legs for SLA breach attribution, delay root-cause analysis, and carrier performance reporting. A

attributes.name: transport_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Last-mile dispatch operations assign specific fleet vehicles to delivery routes. Dispatch planning, vehicle utilization tracking, and operational reporting require authoritative link to fleet.transpor

attributes.name: actual_delivery_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the consignment was successfully delivered to the recipient. Null if delivery not yet completed. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: actual_pickup_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the delivery agent picked up the consignment from the depot or hub. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: cod_amount
attributes.description: Cash on Delivery amount to be collected from the recipient at the time of delivery. Null if not a COD shipment.

attributes.name: cod_collected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the COD amount was successfully collected from the recipient. True if collected, False if not collected or not applicable.

attributes.name: cod_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the COD amount. Format: ISO 4217.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this dispatch record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the delivery destination address. Typically contains street number and street name.

attributes.name: delivery_address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the delivery destination address. May contain apartment, suite, or building information.

attributes.name: delivery_attempt_number
attributes.description: Sequential count of delivery attempts for this consignment. Increments with each failed delivery attempt. First attempt = 1.

attributes.name: delivery_city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the delivery destination address.

attributes.name: delivery_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the delivery destination. Format: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3.

attributes.name: delivery_failure_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for delivery failure. Null if delivery was successful. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: recipient_unavailable|address_incorrect|access_denied|refused_by_recipient|damaged_package|weather_delay|vehicle_breakdown — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions provided by the customer or shipper for the delivery. May include gate codes, safe drop locations, or contact preferences.

attributes.name: delivery_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery destination. Used for GPS tracking and route optimization.

attributes.name: delivery_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery destination. Used for GPS tracking and route optimization.

attributes.name: delivery_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the delivery destination address.

attributes.name: delivery_route_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the planned delivery route or zone for this dispatch. Used for route optimization and territory management.

attributes.name: delivery_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or region of the delivery destination address.

attributes.name: dispatch_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the consignment was dispatched for last-mile delivery. Primary business event date for this transaction.

attributes.name: dispatch_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique dispatch reference number used for tracking and communication. Format: DSP-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: dispatch_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this dispatch within the delivery route. Determines the order in which deliveries should be attempted.

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispatch. Tracks progression from dispatch through delivery or return. Values: dispatched (assigned to driver), in_transit (en route to delivery area), out_for_delivery (active delivery attempt), delivered (successfully completed), failed (delivery unsuccessful), returned_to_depot (consignment returned).

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the consignment was dispatched from the depot or hub for final delivery. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: epod_photo_captured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) Photo Captured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a photo was captured as proof of delivery. True if photo captured, False otherwise.

attributes.name: epod_signature_captured_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electronic Proof of Delivery (ePOD) Signature Captured Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an electronic signature was captured as proof of delivery. True if signature captured, False otherwise.

Central to last-mile SLA tracking and OTD/OTIF KPI computation.
