attributes.description: Indicates whether the merchant has returns processing (RMA - Return Merchandise Authorization) enabled through Transport Shipping fulfillment services.

attributes.name: returns_policy_code
attributes.description: Reference code to the merchant's returns policy configuration defining return windows, conditions, and processing rules.

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special handling requirements for the merchant's products (e.g., fragile items, temperature control, hazardous materials, oversized goods).
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number (TIN) or VAT registration number for the merchant, used for tax compliance and invoicing purposes.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date when the merchant relationship was terminated or the contract ended. Null for active merchants.

attributes.name: termination_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for merchant relationship termination: contract_expiry, mutual_agreement, breach (contract violation), non_payment, business_closure, migration (moved to another provider).

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: The commercial trading name or brand name under which the merchant operates and is known to consumers. May differ from legal name.

products.name: merchant_integration
products.description: Configuration and operational record for a merchant's integration channel with the fulfillment platform. Captures integration type (EDI 204/856/997, REST API, SFTP, webhook), endpoint URL or EDI qualifier/ISA ID, authentication method, message format version, polling frequency, last successful sync timestamp, error count, integration status (active, suspended, degraded), and supported transaction types. Enables omnichannel order ingestion from merchant e-commerce platforms.
products.reference: EDI Integration / API Channel / Merchant Connector

attributes.name: merchant_integration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the merchant integration configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: merchant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the merchant customer account that owns this integration channel.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date when the integration channel was first activated and began processing live transactions.

attributes.name: api_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Base URL or endpoint address for REST/SOAP API integration. Contains the target server address for API calls.
attributes.references: REST API Best Practices, SOAP Web Services Standards

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the API specification being used (e.g., v1, v2.1, 2023-Q4). Ensures compatibility between systems.

attributes.name: authentication_credential
attributes.description: Encrypted or hashed authentication credential (API key, token, certificate reference) used to authenticate with the merchant platform. Stored securely.

attributes.name: authentication_method
attributes.description: Security authentication mechanism used to establish identity and authorize access to the integration endpoint.
attributes.references: OAuth 2.0 RFC 6749, API Security Best Practices

attributes.name: average_response_time_ms
attributes.description: Average response time in milliseconds for API calls or message exchanges through this integration channel. Performance metric.

attributes.name: batch_processing_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether messages are processed in batches rather than individually. Improves throughput for high-volume integrations.

attributes.name: batch_size_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of messages or records that can be included in a single batch transmission. Applicable when batch processing is enabled.

attributes.name: compression_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether message payloads are compressed before transmission to reduce bandwidth usage.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this integration configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_error_count
attributes.description: Total number of integration errors or failures since activation. Used for reliability metrics and trend analysis.

attributes.name: data_encryption_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether data transmitted through this integration channel is encrypted in transit (TLS/SSL).

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the integration channel was deactivated or suspended. Null if currently active.

attributes.name: edi_identifier
attributes.description: EDI interchange sender or receiver ID used in ISA segment to uniquely identify the trading partner in EDI transactions.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards - ISA Segment

attributes.name: edi_qualifier
attributes.description: EDI interchange ID qualifier code identifying the type of sender/receiver identifier (e.g., ZZ for mutually defined, 01 for DUNS number). Used in ISA segment.
attributes.references: ANSI X12 EDI Standards - ISA Segment

attributes.name: edi_transaction_set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of supported EDI transaction set codes (e.g., 204 for Motor Carrier Load Tender, 856 for Advanced Shipping Notice, 997 for Functional Acknowledgment). Applicable only when integration_type is EDI.

attributes.name: error_count_24h
attributes.description: Number of integration errors or failed synchronization attempts in the last 24 hours. Used for health monitoring and alerting.

attributes.name: integration_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or label for this integration channel, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: integration_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the integration channel. Determines whether messages are processed or queued.

attributes.name: integration_type
attributes.description: Technical protocol or method used for data exchange with the merchant platform. Determines message format and connectivity requirements.
attributes.references: EDI X12 Standard, REST API Best Practices

attributes.name: last_error_code
attributes.description: Error code or identifier for the most recent integration failure. Used for diagnostics and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: last_error_message
attributes.description: Detailed error message or description for the most recent integration failure. Provides context for troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_error_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the most recent integration error or failure occurred.

attributes.name: last_successful_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization or message exchange through this integration channel.

attributes.name: last_sync_attempt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent synchronization attempt, regardless of success or failure. Used for monitoring and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this integration configuration record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: max_retry_attempts
attributes.description: Maximum number of automatic retry attempts for failed synchronization before escalating to manual intervention.

attributes.name: message_format
attributes.description: Data serialization format used for message payloads exchanged through this integration channel.
attributes.references: JSON RFC 8259, XML W3C Standard, EDI X12 Standard

attributes.name: message_format_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the message format specification or schema being used (e.g., 1.0, 4010 for EDI X12).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special configuration details, or operational instructions related to this integration channel.

attributes.name: polling_frequency_minutes
attributes.description: Interval in minutes at which the system polls or checks the integration endpoint for new messages or data. Null for push-based integrations.

attributes.name: rate_limit_requests_per_minute
attributes.description: Maximum number of API requests or message transmissions allowed per minute. Prevents overloading the merchant platform.

attributes.name: retry_policy
attributes.description: Strategy for retrying failed integration attempts. Defines timing and behavior for automatic retry logic.

attributes.name: sftp_directory_path
attributes.business_glossary_term: Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) Directory Path
attributes.description: Remote directory path on SFTP server where files are exchanged (inbound and outbound).

attributes.name: sftp_host
attributes.description: SFTP server hostname or IP address for file-based integration. Applicable when integration_type is SFTP.

attributes.name: sftp_port
attributes.description: TCP port number for SFTP connection. Standard port is 22.

attributes.name: success_rate_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of successful synchronization attempts over a defined measurement period. Key performance indicator for integration reliability.

attributes.name: supported_transaction_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of business transaction types supported by this integration (e.g., ORDER_INGEST, ASN_OUTBOUND, SHIPMENT_STATUS, INVENTORY_SYNC, RMA_NOTIFICATION).

attributes.name: timeout_threshold_seconds
attributes.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a response from the integration endpoint before timing out and marking the attempt as failed.

attributes.name: webhook_callback_url
attributes.description: URL endpoint on the fulfillment platform that receives push notifications from the merchant system. Applicable when integration_type is WEBHOOK.

products.name: consignee
products.description: Master record for the end recipient (consignee) of a fulfillment delivery. Captures consignee name, structured delivery address (street, city, state, postal code, country ISO), address validation status and geocode, address type (residential, commercial, locker, PUDO point), contact phone, contact email, delivery preferences (leave at door, signature required, neighbor, time-slot preference), failed delivery history flag, and blacklist flag. Distinct from the customer domain's account/profile — the consignee is the physical delivery recipient, not necessarily the ordering customer or merchant.

attributes.name: consignee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the consignee record. Primary key.

attributes.name: consignee_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.consignee_profile. Business justification: Links fulfillment-side delivery recipient entity to customer's consignee master profile. Essential for delivery planning, address validation, delivery preference enforcement, denied-party screening, a

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.fulfillment_delivery_zone. Business justification: A consignee's address maps to a specific fulfillment delivery zone, which drives carrier selection, SLA windows, COD availability, and surcharge applicability. Storing fulfillment_delivery_zone_id on

attributes.name: importer_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Consignees receiving international shipments are registered trade parties for customs purposes. Enables denied party screening, AEO certification verification, importer-of-record validation, and custo

attributes.name: access_code
attributes.description: Security access code or gate code required to enter the delivery location (e.g., building entry code, gated community code).

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee record is currently active and available for use in fulfillment operations. True if active, false if deactivated or archived.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for delivery location. Includes street number, street name, and building identifier.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as apartment number, suite, floor, building name, or care-of information.

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery address type: residential home, commercial business, automated locker, PUDO (Pick-Up Drop-Off) point, CFS (Container Freight Station), or ICD (Inland Container Depot).

attributes.name: address_validation_status
attributes.description: Status of address validation process: validated (confirmed accurate), unvalidated (not yet checked), corrected (modified by validation service), or failed (could not be validated).

attributes.name: alternate_contact_phone
attributes.description: Secondary contact phone number for the consignee. Used when primary contact is unavailable or for escalation during delivery attempts.

attributes.name: blacklist_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee is blacklisted due to fraud, repeated delivery failures, abusive behavior, or security concerns. True if blacklisted, false otherwise.

attributes.name: blacklist_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the consignee was blacklisted (e.g., fraud, repeated refusal to accept delivery, security threat, denied party screening match).

attributes.name: business_hours_end
attributes.description: End time of business hours for commercial consignees in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling delivery attempts during operating hours.

attributes.name: business_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time of business hours for commercial consignees in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). Used for scheduling delivery attempts during operating hours.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the delivery address.

attributes.name: cod_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee is eligible to receive COD (Cash on Delivery) shipments. True if COD is permitted, false if COD is restricted due to payment history or risk assessment.

attributes.name: cod_payment_method_preference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Payment Method Preference
attributes.description: Preferred payment method for COD (Cash on Delivery) collections: cash, card (credit/debit), mobile_payment (digital wallet), or bank_transfer.

attributes.name: consignee_name
attributes.description: Full legal name or business name of the delivery recipient (consignee). May be an individual person or a company name.

attributes.name: consignee_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consignee entity type: individual person, business organization, government entity, or non-governmental organization.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the consignee. Used for delivery notifications, ePOD (Electronic Proof of Delivery) transmission, and customer communication.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the consignee. Used for delivery coordination, notifications, and exception handling.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the delivery address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consignee record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customs_id_number
attributes.description: Customs-specific identifier for the consignee (e.g., importer of record number, customs registration number). Used for cross-border shipments and customs declarations.

attributes.name: delivery_instructions
attributes.description: Free-text special instructions for the delivery agent regarding access, location, handling, or recipient preferences (e.g., ring doorbell twice, use side entrance, fragile items).

attributes.name: delivery_preference_leave_at_door
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee permits unattended delivery at the door. True if leave-at-door is acceptable, false if recipient presence is required.

attributes.name: delivery_preference_neighbor_delivery
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee permits delivery to a neighbor if the primary recipient is unavailable. True if neighbor delivery is acceptable.

attributes.name: delivery_preference_safe_place
attributes.description: Free-text instructions specifying a safe place to leave the parcel if the consignee is not present (e.g., back porch, garage, with building concierge).

attributes.name: delivery_preference_signature_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee requires a signature for delivery confirmation. True if signature is mandatory, false if signature can be waived.

attributes.name: delivery_time_window_preference
attributes.description: Preferred time window for delivery attempts: morning (before noon), afternoon (noon to 5pm), evening (after 5pm), business_hours (9am-5pm weekdays), or anytime (no preference).

attributes.name: denied_party_screening_status
attributes.description: Result of screening against denied party lists (e.g., OFAC, EU sanctions, UN sanctions): cleared (no match), flagged (potential match requiring review), pending (screening in progress), or not_screened.
attributes.references: OFAC, EU Sanctions, UN Security Council, C-TPAT

attributes.name: failed_delivery_count
attributes.description: Total number of failed delivery attempts recorded for this consignee address across all historical shipments. Used for delivery risk scoring.

attributes.name: failed_delivery_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consignee has a history of failed delivery attempts. True if previous deliveries have failed, false otherwise. Used for risk assessment and route planning.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates: rooftop (exact building), street (street-level), postal_code (postal code centroid), city (city centroid), or region (regional approximation).

attributes.name: geocode_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the delivery address in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization and GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation.

attributes.name: geocode_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the delivery address in decimal degrees. Used for route optimization and GPS (Global Positioning System) navigation.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO language code for the consignee's preferred communication language (e.g., en, es, fr, de, zh). Used for delivery notifications and customer communications.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this consignee record was most recently modified. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: notification_preference_email
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via email. True if email notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: notification_preference_push
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via mobile app push notifications. True if push notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: notification_preference_sms
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consignee has opted in to receive delivery notifications via SMS text message. True if SMS notifications are enabled.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal code or ZIP code for the delivery address. Format varies by country (e.g., 5-digit US ZIP, alphanumeric UK postcode).

attributes.name: residential_commercial_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the delivery location as residential (home address), commercial (business address), or mixed_use (building with both residential and commercial units). Affects delivery routing and surcharges.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this consignee record (e.g., SAP_TM, ORACLE_TMS, MANHATTAN_WMS, SALESFORCE_CRM, ECOMMERCE_API).

attributes.name: special_handling_requirements
attributes.description: Free-text description of any special handling requirements for deliveries to this consignee (e.g., temperature-sensitive, fragile, hazardous materials, security protocols).
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, ADR

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region for the delivery address. Format varies by country (e.g., two-letter US state codes, full province names).

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Tax identification number for the consignee (e.g., EIN, VAT number, GST number). Required for customs clearance and DDP (Delivered Duty Paid) shipments.

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the consignee location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Shanghai). Used for accurate delivery time window calculations and notifications.

products.name: center
products.description: Master record for fulfillment center facilities operated or contracted by Transport Shipping for e-commerce fulfillment and D2D operations. Captures facility code, facility name, address, facility type (owned, 3PL, 4PL, cross-dock, dark store), total floor area (sqm), storage capacity (CBM and pallet positions), WMS system instance, operating hours, supported service types, last-mile zone coverage, and operational status. Distinct from warehouse domain's general warehouse master — this entity is scoped to fulfillment-specific facilities.

attributes.name: center_id
attributes.description: Primary key for center

attributes.name: customs_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Fulfillment centers in FTZs or bonded warehouses have assigned customs agents for facility-level clearance operations, entry filing, and compliance audits. Tracking the facility's customs agent is req

attributes.name: facility_id
attributes.description: FK to warehouse.facility.facility_id — MUST-HAVE: Links fulfillment centers to the warehouse facility master. Required for inventory visibility, capacity planning, and operational reporting across fulfillment and warehouse domains.

attributes.name: mro_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Fulfillment centers procure MRO supplies, equipment, and consumables from suppliers. Tracks primary supplier relationship for facility operations, enabling spend analysis and supplier performance mana

attributes.name: network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.network_node. Business justification: Fulfillment centers are network nodes in the routing topology. Enables facility integration into network design, routing optimization, and capacity planning. Standard practice in integrated logistics

attributes.name: operator_tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Fulfillment centers may be operated by 3PL providers. Business process: 3PL facility management, operational oversight, cost center allocation. Role-prefixed as centers may have multiple 3PL relations

attributes.name: operator_trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Fulfillment centers operating as importers/exporters, bonded warehouses, or FTZ operators are registered trade parties. Enables facility-level customs compliance tracking, AEO certification management

attributes.name: servicing_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.depot. Business justification: Fulfillment centers are operationally served by a fleet depot for vehicle staging, dispatch, and returns. This FK enables fleet capacity planning relative to fulfillment throughput and is a standard o

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the fulfillment center facility location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for suite, building, or unit information. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: annual_throughput_capacity_units
attributes.description: Maximum annual throughput capacity of the fulfillment center measured in units (SKUs) that can be processed per year, representing operational capacity for planning purposes.

attributes.name: automation_level
attributes.description: Classification of the degree of automation deployed in the fulfillment center operations, ranging from manual labor-intensive to fully robotic systems.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the fulfillment center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for operational communications with the fulfillment center. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the fulfillment center facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the fulfillment center is located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customs_bonded_warehouse_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment center operates as a customs bonded warehouse, allowing storage of imported goods before customs duties are paid.
attributes.references: World Customs Organization (WCO) Revised Kyoto Convention

attributes.name: facility_type
attributes.description: Classification of the fulfillment center based on ownership and operational model. Owned = company-operated, 3PL = Third-Party Logistics provider, 4PL = Fourth-Party Logistics provider, cross_dock = transshipment facility, dark_store = retail-to-fulfillment conversion, micro_fulfillment = urban compact facility.

attributes.name: ftz_designation
attributes.description: Free Trade Zone designation or license number if the fulfillment center operates within an FTZ, enabling duty deferral and trade facilitation benefits.

attributes.name: go_live_date
attributes.description: Date when the fulfillment center commenced operational activities and began processing orders.

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment center is certified to handle and store hazardous materials according to IMDG, IATA, and local regulations.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: labor_workforce_size
attributes.description: Total workforce size at the fulfillment center measured in Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) employees, including permanent and temporary staff.

attributes.name: last_mile_zone_coverage
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of last-mile delivery zone codes or postal code prefixes that this fulfillment center serves, defining its geographic service area for direct delivery.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fulfillment center record was last modified, used for audit trail and change tracking purposes.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location in decimal degrees, used for routing, distance calculations, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: lease_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the lease agreement for the fulfillment center facility expires, applicable for leased or 3PL/4PL facilities. Null for owned facilities.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the fulfillment center location in decimal degrees, used for routing, distance calculations, and geospatial analytics.

attributes.name: operating_days_per_week
attributes.description: Number of days per week the fulfillment center operates, typically ranging from 5 (weekdays only) to 7 (continuous operations).

attributes.name: operating_hours_end
attributes.description: Daily operating hours end time for the fulfillment center in HH:MM format (24-hour clock), representing when the facility ceases operations.

attributes.name: operating_hours_start
attributes.description: Daily operating hours start time for the fulfillment center in HH:MM format (24-hour clock), representing when the facility begins operations.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fulfillment center indicating whether it is operational and available for order fulfillment activities.

attributes.name: pallet_positions
attributes.description: Total number of pallet storage positions available in the fulfillment center, representing discrete storage locations for palletized inventory.
attributes.references: ISO 6780 Flat Pallets for Intercontinental Materials Handling

attributes.name: peak_daily_order_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of orders the fulfillment center can process in a single day during peak periods, used for capacity planning and load balancing.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the fulfillment center address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: quality_certification
attributes.description: Quality management certifications held by the fulfillment center (e.g., ISO 9001, Six Sigma), demonstrating adherence to quality standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: iso_9001|six_sigma|lean|tqm|gmp|haccp|brc — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: security_certification
attributes.description: Security certifications held by the fulfillment center (e.g., C-TPAT, AEO, ISO 28000), demonstrating compliance with supply chain security standards. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: c_tpat|aeo|iso_28000|tapa_a|tapa_b|tapa_c|pip — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the source operational system from which this fulfillment center master record originated (e.g., Manhattan WMS, SAP TM).

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region where the fulfillment center is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Total volumetric storage capacity of the fulfillment center measured in cubic meters (CBM), representing the three-dimensional space available for inventory storage.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: supported_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types supported by this fulfillment center (e.g., standard_delivery, express_delivery, same_day, next_day, cod, returns_processing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: standard_delivery|express_delivery|same_day|next_day|two_day|cod|returns_processing|gift_wrapping|kitting — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sustainability_certification
attributes.description: Environmental and sustainability certifications held by the fulfillment center (e.g., LEED, ISO 14001, carbon neutral), demonstrating commitment to environmental responsibility.

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fulfillment center has temperature-controlled storage zones for perishable or temperature-sensitive goods.

attributes.name: total_floor_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area of the fulfillment center facility measured in square meters, representing the physical footprint available for operations.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-3 Quantities and Units - Space and Time

attributes.name: wms_instance_code
attributes.description: Unique instance identifier for the WMS deployment at this facility, used for system integration and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: wms_system_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the WMS system instance deployed at this fulfillment center. Used to route integration messages and identify the source system for inventory and order data.

products.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone
products.description: Reference master defining geographic delivery zones used for last-mile dispatch planning and carrier assignment. Captures zone code, zone name, country, state/province, postal code ranges covered, zone type (urban, suburban, rural, remote), serviceable flag, standard transit days, express transit days, carrier coverage map, and surcharge applicability flag. Used by carrier assignment logic and SLA promise calculation.
products.reference: Delivery Zone / Last-Mile Zone / Service Zone

attributes.name: fulfillment_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the delivery zone record. Primary key.

attributes.name: hub_fulfillment_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.center. Business justification: Delivery zones are served by specific fulfillment centers (hubs). The hub_location_code STRING should be normalized to FK referencing center.fulfillment_center_id. This enables proper zone-to-hub assi

attributes.name: lane_rate_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to pricing.lane_rate_zone. Business justification: Delivery zones map to pricing rate zones for zone-based tariff application. Business process: zone-based rating applies distance/geography-based pricing to delivery zones for accurate freight costing.

attributes.name: route_delivery_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.route_delivery_zone. Business justification: Fulfillment delivery zones map to route delivery zones for service coverage alignment and SLA management. Enables zone harmonization across fulfillment and routing systems, critical for multi-system l

attributes.name: service_scope_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.service_scope. Business justification: Delivery zones must map to contracted service scopes to determine serviceability, rate applicability, SLA targets, and service restrictions per agreement terms. Critical for order acceptance decisions

attributes.name: servicing_depot_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.depot. Business justification: Delivery zones are covered by vehicles dispatched from a specific fleet depot. This FK drives depot-to-zone routing assignments, fleet capacity planning per zone, and SLA commitment analysis — a funda

attributes.name: tax_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.tax_schedule. Business justification: Delivery zones determine applicable tax rates for cross-border and domestic shipments. Direct link required for accurate tax calculation, customs duty assessment, and regulatory compliance in internat

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this delivery zone record is active in the system. Inactive zones are retained for historical reference.

attributes.name: average_delivery_attempts
attributes.description: Historical average number of delivery attempts required to successfully complete deliveries in this zone. Used for operational planning.

attributes.name: carrier_coverage_level
attributes.description: Level of carrier network coverage available in this zone. Affects service availability and delivery reliability.

attributes.name: city_name
attributes.description: Primary city or municipality name associated with this delivery zone.

attributes.name: cod_service_available_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cash on Delivery (COD) Service Available Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Cash on Delivery (COD) service is available for deliveries in this zone based on carrier capabilities and risk assessment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country in which this delivery zone is located.

products.name: allocation
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment between a merchant and a fulfillment center. It captures the formal allocation of merchant inventory and order fulfillment capacity across Transport Shipping's fulfillment network. Each record links one merchant to one center with allocation percentages, priority rankings, service type enablement, and storage capacity assignments that exist only in the context of this specific merchant-center pairing.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's fulfillment operations, merchants are formally allocated to one or more fulfillment centers based on geographic coverage, capacity, and service requirements. This is an actively managed operational relationship where fulfillment planners assign merchants to centers with specific allocation percentages (for load balancing), priority rankings (for routing logic), storage capacity allocations, and service type enablement. The business tracks both current and historical allocations for billing reconciliation, SLA audit, and capacity planning purposes.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this merchant-center allocation became or will become operationally active. Required for historical tracking and future-dated allocation changes.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was most recently modified

Service type availability varies by merchant-center combination based on contract terms and center capabilities.

domains.name: contract
domains.description: Contract and agreement management for customer service contracts, carrier agreements, 3PL/4PL partnerships, and vendor contracts. Manages SLA thresholds, OTD/OTIF KPI commitments, Incoterms (DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW), rate validity periods, volume commitments, penalty/incentive clauses, contract terms, renewals, and compliance tracking. Interfaces with pricing, billing, and customer domains.

products.name: agreement

Captures contract type, status, effective and expiry dates, governing Incoterms (DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW), jurisdiction, signatory parties, contract owner, auto-renewal flags, notice period, and contract tier classification. Serves as the SSOT for all contractual relationships across the enterprise.

products.name: agreement_version
products.description: Tracks the full version history, amendment lifecycle, and approval workflow of each contract agreement. Captures version number, amendment type (initial, renewal, addendum, termination), effective date of each version, change summary, document reference, and the complete approval workflow: workflow stage (draft, legal review, commercial review, finance review, executive approval, executed), assigned approver(s), approval action (approved, rejected, returned), action date, comments, escalation flag, and SOX-compliant authorization controls. Enables audit trail and compliance tracking for contract changes over time.

products.name: sla_performance
products.description: Transactional record of actual contract performance measured against committed thresholds for each measurement period, covering both SLA performance (OTD, OTIF, transit time) and volume attainment (TEU, kg, CBM, shipment count). Captures measurement type (SLA or volume), period start and end dates, actual value achieved, committed/target value, variance, attainment percentage, breach or shortfall flag, breach severity, number of shipments in scope, and the data source system used for measurement. Feeds penalty and incentive calculations and contract compliance reporting.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SLA performance measurement record.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent contract or agreement under which this SLA performance is measured.

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the carrier or service provider whose performance is being measured. Applicable for carrier agreements and 3PL/4PL partnerships.

attributes.name: carrier_service_id

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for whom this SLA performance is being measured. Applicable for customer service contracts.

attributes.name: service_lane_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service lane or route for which this SLA performance is measured (e.g., USA-EUR air express, Asia-USA ocean FCL).

attributes.name: sla_commitment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SLA clause or commitment being measured (e.g., OTD threshold, OTIF target, transit time commitment).

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Actual performance measurement of supplier-delivered transport services. Business process: supplier scorecarding, performance reviews, and rebate/penalty calculations require linking measured performa

attributes.name: actual_value
attributes.description: The actual value achieved during this measurement period (e.g., 92.5 for 92.5% OTD achieved, 9500 for 9,500 TEU delivered).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person or role who approved this SLA performance measurement record.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA performance measurement was approved.

attributes.name: attainment_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of target achieved, calculated as (actual_value / target_value) * 100. Values above 100 indicate over-achievement.

attributes.name: breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the SLA was breached (True) or met (False) during this measurement period. True if actual performance fell below the committed threshold.

attributes.name: breach_severity
attributes.description: The severity level of the SLA breach, if any. none = no breach, minor = slight miss, moderate = noticeable shortfall, major = significant breach, critical = severe breach triggering penalties.

attributes.name: compliant_shipment_count
attributes.description: The number of shipments that met the SLA criteria during this measurement period. Used as the numerator for percentage-based SLA calculations.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA performance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for penalty and incentive amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this SLA performance measurement is under dispute (True) or not (False). Disputes may arise from disagreements on measurement methodology or data accuracy.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for disputing this SLA performance measurement, if applicable.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: The calculated financial incentive or bonus amount earned for exceeding the SLA target, if applicable. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: incentive_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual incentive or bonus is applicable for exceeding the SLA target (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: incoterm
attributes.description: The International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to this SLA measurement, defining the division of responsibilities between buyer and seller (e.g., DDP, DAP, FOB, CIF, EXW). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this SLA performance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: measurement_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the measurement: service_level (OTD, OTIF, transit time), volume_attainment (TEU, kg, CBM, shipment count), quality (damage rate, accuracy), compliance (regulatory adherence).

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the methodology or calculation logic used to measure this SLA performance (e.g., 'OTD calculated as shipments delivered within committed window / total shipments', 'OTIF calculated as shipments delivered on-time and in-full / total shipments').

attributes.name: measurement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the measurement period for this SLA performance record.

attributes.name: measurement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the measurement period for this SLA performance record (e.g., beginning of month, quarter, or custom period).

attributes.name: measurement_source_system
attributes.description: The system or platform used to capture and calculate this SLA performance measurement (e.g., SAP TM, Oracle TMS, FourKites, internal BI platform).

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: The current status of this SLA performance measurement record in its lifecycle (e.g., draft, finalized, under_review, disputed, approved, archived).

attributes.name: measurement_type
attributes.description: The type of SLA or commitment being measured. OTD = On-Time Delivery, OTIF = On-Time In-Full, transit_time = delivery speed commitment, volume_commitment = shipment count target, weight_commitment = weight volume target, teu_commitment = TEU volume target.

attributes.name: non_compliant_shipment_count
attributes.description: The number of shipments that failed to meet the SLA criteria during this measurement period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to this SLA performance measurement, including context, exceptions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The calculated financial penalty amount due to the SLA breach, if applicable. Expressed in the contract currency.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: penalty_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a contractual penalty is applicable for this SLA breach (True) or not (False). Penalties are typically triggered when performance falls below a defined threshold.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of logistics service for which this SLA performance is measured (e.g., express_parcel, air_freight, ocean_freight, road_freight, rail_freight, last_mile, warehousing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|air_freight|ocean_freight|road_freight|rail_freight|last_mile|warehousing — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shipment_count_in_scope
attributes.description: The total number of shipments included in this SLA performance measurement period. Used as the denominator for percentage-based SLA calculations.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The committed or target value for this measurement period (e.g., 95.0 for 95% OTD, 10000 for 10,000 TEU commitment).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the target and actual values are expressed. percentage for OTD/OTIF, TEU for container volume, kg for weight, CBM for cubic meters, shipment_count for number of shipments, hours/days for transit time. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: percentage|TEU|kg|CBM|shipment_count|hours|days — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: variance
attributes.description: The difference between actual and target values (actual_value - target_value). Negative values indicate shortfall; positive values indicate over-achievement.

Aligned to IMO, IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention, CMR Convention, and Hague-Visby liability frameworks. Serves as the SSOT for all claim identity, status, valuation, and lifecycle data.

attributes.name: maintenance_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.maintenance_order. Business justification: When poor or deferred maintenance caused cargo damage, the liability determination must reference the specific maintenance order (fault codes, work performed, post-maintenance status). This is a stand

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Liability determination for purchased goods claims requires PO contract terms (incoterms, insurance, liability caps) to allocate responsibility correctly. Critical for contractual liability assessment

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cargo insurer involved in this liability determination. Required for insurer correspondence, subrogation processes, and reserve accounting.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR; IFRS 17

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fleet.transport_asset. Business justification: Liability determinations often hinge on asset condition, maintenance compliance, inspection records, and equipment certification status. Links claim liability analysis to specific vehicle/container in

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the liability determination was formally approved by the authorised approver. Marks the transition from under_review to approved status.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 9001; Internal Claims Governance Policy

attributes.name: cargo_declared_value
attributes.description: The value of the cargo as declared by the shipper on the Air Waybill (AWB) or Bill of Lading (BOL). Used when ad valorem liability basis applies or when declared value exceeds the convention limit.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22(2); Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; CMR Convention Article 24

attributes.name: cargo_declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the cargo declared value. Required for multi-currency settlement and insurer correspondence.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Montreal Convention 1999; Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: cargo_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight of the cargo in kilograms as recorded on the transport document (AWB or BOL). Used to calculate the per-kg liability limit under applicable conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23(3); Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5

attributes.name: carrier_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the carrier's fault or negligence, expressed as a value between 0.00 and 100.00. Used in proportional settlement calculations.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17; COGSA Section 4; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV; Montreal Convention Article 20

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cargo claim type that this liability determination addresses. Determines applicable convention provisions and liability cap calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Articles 17-23; Hague-Visby Rules; IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: consignee_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the consignee's contributory negligence or fault (e.g., failure to mitigate, improper handling at destination). Complements carrier and shipper liability percentages.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20

attributes.name: contributory_negligence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether contributory negligence by the shipper or consignee has been identified and factored into the liability determination, reducing the carrier's proportional liability.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; COGSA Section 4(2)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this liability determination record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo involved in the claim is classified as dangerous goods, triggering additional liability provisions under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations; IMO

attributes.name: delay_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours by which the shipment was delayed beyond the agreed or scheduled delivery time. Applicable for delay claims under Montreal Convention Article 19 and CMR Convention Article 23(5).
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 19; CMR Convention Article 23(5); Oracle TMS Shipment Execution

attributes.name: determination_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the formal liability assessment was completed and the determination was issued. Distinct from the record creation timestamp.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA

attributes.name: determination_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number for this liability determination, used in insurer correspondence, legal filings, and settlement documentation. Format: LD-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IATA Resolution 600a; CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: determination_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the liability determination record. Drives workflow routing for settlement calculation and insurer correspondence.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Lifecycle Standard; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal dispute against this liability determination was raised. Used to track statutory limitation periods under applicable conventions.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 32; Montreal Convention Article 35; COGSA Section 3(6); Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Narrative description of the grounds on which the liability determination has been disputed by the claimant or carrier. Populated when determination_status is 'disputed'.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 32; Montreal Convention Article 35; COGSA Section 3(6); ISO 9001

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: The Incoterms code applicable to the shipment, determining the point at which risk transfers from seller to buyer. Influences the liability determination by establishing which party bears risk at the time of loss or damage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ICC Incoterms 2020; WTO; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA

attributes.name: legal_basis_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the legal and factual basis for the liability determination, including specific convention articles, exclusions applied (e.g., act of God, inherent vice, shipper fault), and supporting evidence references.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COGSA; IMO; WTO

attributes.name: liability_basis
attributes.description: The unit basis on which the carrier liability limit is calculated — per kilogram, per package, per unit, or based on declared/ad valorem value. Drives the settlement calculation formula.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis; CMR Convention Article 23; COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: liability_convention
attributes.description: The international legal convention or regulatory framework applied to determine carrier liability limits for this claim. Governs the applicable liability cap per kg or per package. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Warsaw-Montreal|CMR|Hague-Visby|COGSA|CIM-COTIF|Montreal-1999|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999; CMR Convention 1956; Hague-Visby Rules 1968; COGSA 1936; CIM-COTIF 1999; IMO

attributes.name: liability_exclusion_type
attributes.description: Category of liability exclusion applied to reduce or eliminate carrier liability under the applicable convention. Drives the legal basis narrative and settlement outcome.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(2); Hague-Visby Rules Article IV Rule 2; COGSA Section 4(2); Montreal Convention Article 18(2)

attributes.name: liability_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the liability limit per unit is expressed. Typically SDR (Special Drawing Rights) for international conventions, or USD for COGSA.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Montreal Convention 1999; IMF Special Drawing Rights; COGSA

attributes.name: liability_limit_per_unit
attributes.description: The maximum carrier liability amount per unit (kg or package) as prescribed by the applicable convention. For Montreal Convention air freight: 22 SDR/kg. For Hague-Visby ocean: 666.67 SDR/package or 2 SDR/kg. Used in settlement calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; CMR Convention Article 23(3); COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: limitation_period_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the statutory limitation period for legal action expires under the applicable convention. Montreal Convention: 2 years; CMR: 1 year (3 for wilful misconduct); Hague-Visby: 1 year.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 35; CMR Convention Article 32; Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6; COGSA Section 3(6)

attributes.name: maximum_liability_amount
attributes.description: The calculated maximum monetary amount the carrier is liable for under the applicable convention, derived from liability_limit_per_unit multiplied by the applicable weight or package count. Cap for settlement calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Montreal Convention 1999 Article 22; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; CMR Convention Article 23; COGSA Section 4(5)

attributes.name: maximum_liability_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the maximum liability amount is expressed for settlement purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IATA Montreal Convention 1999; IMF Special Drawing Rights

attributes.name: negligence_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the contributory negligence factors identified for the shipper or consignee, including evidence basis (e.g., improper packaging, misdeclared weight, inadequate labelling).
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; ISO 9001

attributes.name: package_count
attributes.description: Number of packages or units in the shipment as declared on the transport document. Used to calculate per-package liability limits under Hague-Visby Rules and COGSA.
attributes.references: Hague-Visby Rules Article IV bis Rule 5; COGSA Section 4(5); CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The financial reserve amount set aside in the general ledger for this liability determination, representing the estimated carrier liability exposure. Feeds SAP S/4HANA Finance reserve accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance GL; IFRS 17; SOX Section 404; IFRS 9

attributes.name: reserve_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the claims reserve amount. Required for multi-currency financial reporting and IFRS compliance.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance; SOX

attributes.name: settlement_recommendation_amount
attributes.description: The recommended monetary settlement amount derived from this liability determination, factoring in the maximum liability cap, carrier liability percentage, and contributory negligence. Input to the settlement calculation process.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Settlement Policy; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance AR

attributes.name: settlement_recommendation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the settlement recommendation amount.

attributes.name: shipper_liability_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of total loss or damage attributed to the shipper's contributory negligence or fault (e.g., improper packaging, misdeclaration). Complements carrier_liability_pct.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 17(5); Montreal Convention Article 20; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV Rule 2

attributes.name: subrogation_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount the insurer is seeking to recover from the carrier through subrogation after having settled the claim with the insured party.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IFRS 17; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has exercised or intends to exercise subrogation rights against the carrier following settlement of the cargo claim.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Standard; IFRS 17; ISO 28000

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport applicable to the shipment leg on which the loss, damage, or delay occurred. Determines which liability convention and limit applies.
attributes.references: IATA; IMO; US DOT; CMR Convention; CIM-COTIF; ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this liability determination record. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.

The settlement table has liability_basis which is defined authoritatively on the liability_determination record (which has liabili
