attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Settlements on purchased goods require PO reference for payment offset, supplier deduction processing, warranty settlement, and accounting reconciliation. Real business process: supplier payment recon

attributes.name: reserve_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.reserve. Business justification: When a cargo claim is settled, the financial reserve established for that claim is released or reduced. The settlement record should reference the reserve it is releasing to enable reserve reconciliat

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance carrier or underwriter involved in the settlement. Used for insurer recovery tracking and subrogation processes.

attributes.name: acceptance_date
attributes.description: Date on which the claimant formally accepted the settlement offer. Triggers payment processing and reserve release in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; SOX

attributes.name: acceptance_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claimant has formally accepted the settlement offer. Pending means offer made but not yet responded to; accepted means claimant signed off; disputed means claimant contests the amount; withdrawn means claimant retracted acceptance.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: actual_settlement_days
attributes.description: Actual number of calendar days taken to settle the claim from claim registration date to settlement_date. Used to measure SLA compliance and KPI performance against sla_settlement_target_days.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IATA Service Standards; CMR Convention Article 32

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross base amount agreed to be paid to the claimant as settlement for the cargo claim, expressed in the settlement currency. This is the pre-deduction gross figure before any excess, deductible, or recovery offsets. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement was internally approved by the authorized claims manager or finance controller. Required for SOX internal controls and audit trail.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 9001; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Category of the underlying cargo claim being settled. Determines applicable liability framework and maximum settlement limits per governing conventions (Warsaw-Montreal for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMDG Code

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Original amount claimed by the claimant as submitted in the claim registration. Used to calculate settlement ratio and measure liability exposure versus actual payout for analytics and reserve adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 9

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the settlement record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and SLA compliance tracking. Satisfies the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the settlement amount is denominated and paid (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial reporting and FX conversion. Part of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 9; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo claim involves dangerous goods shipments. When true, triggers additional regulatory compliance checks under IMDG Code (ocean), ICAO Technical Instructions (air), and ADR (road) for settlement processing.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IMO; IATA DGR

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Policy excess or deductible amount subtracted from the gross settlement before net payment to the claimant. Represents the adjustment component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 9

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for claimant dispute when acceptance_status is 'disputed'. Captures the basis of disagreement (e.g., valuation methodology, liability limit application, deductible amount) for escalation and resolution tracking.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert the settlement amount from the settlement currency to the company's functional reporting currency at the time of settlement. Required for multi-currency financial consolidation under IFRS.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates; SOX

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Net settlement amount converted to the company's functional reporting currency using the exchange rate at settlement date. Used for financial consolidation, P&L reporting, and reserve release accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: insurer_correspondence_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or file number assigned by the cargo insurer for their internal tracking of this claim settlement. Used for insurer correspondence, recovery claims, and co-insurance coordination.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO

attributes.name: insurer_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered from the cargo insurer or underwriter as part of the settlement, reducing the net cost to Transport Shipping. Relevant for subrogation processes and insurer correspondence tracking.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 9; IMO

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the settlement record. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and incremental data pipeline processing. Satisfies the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum carrier liability amount applicable to this claim under the governing convention or contract (e.g., SDR per kg under Warsaw-Montreal, SDR per kg under CMR). Used to validate that settlement does not exceed statutory limits.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV

attributes.name: liability_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 currency code or SDR (Special Drawing Rights) denomination in which the liability limit is expressed under the applicable convention. Typically SDR for international conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IMF SDR

attributes.name: net_settlement_amount
attributes.description: Final net amount payable to the claimant after deducting the policy excess/deductible from the gross settlement amount. Represents the net total component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IFRS 9; SOX

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional context, negotiation notes, special conditions, or remarks relevant to the settlement. Includes basis for ex gratia payments, dispute resolution notes, or partial settlement justification.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement payment was actually disbursed to the claimant. May differ from settlement_date (agreement date) due to payment processing lead times. Used for cash flow reporting and SLA measurement.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; IFRS 9; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method by which the settlement amount is disbursed to the claimant. Bank transfer is the standard for large settlements; credit note offsets against outstanding freight invoices; cheque for legacy or specific jurisdictions.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: Bank payment reference, cheque number, or transaction ID from the payment system confirming disbursement of the settlement amount to the claimant. Used for payment reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA Finance AP.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP; PCI DSS

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: Financial reserve amount set aside in SAP S/4HANA Finance for this claim at the time of claim registration. Used to track reserve adequacy and calculate reserve release upon settlement.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; IAS 37 Provisions; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance GL

attributes.name: reserve_release_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the financial reserve released back to the P&L upon settlement of the claim. Equals the difference between the reserve amount and the net settlement amount. Interfaces with SAP S/4HANA Finance for reserve accounting journal entries.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; IAS 37 Provisions; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the settlement was formally agreed and accepted by all parties. Represents the principal real-world business event date for this transaction. Satisfies the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 29; CMR Convention Article 32; IFRS 9

attributes.name: settlement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the settlement transaction. Used in correspondence with claimants, insurers, and finance teams. Satisfies the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the claim settlement workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval, payment, and closure. Satisfies the LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: settlement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the settlement by nature of resolution. Full settlement closes the claim entirely; partial settlement covers a portion; ex gratia is a goodwill payment without liability admission; subrogation involves insurer recovery; credit note offsets against future billing.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability

attributes.name: sla_settlement_target_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Settlement Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Days
attributes.description: Target number of calendar days within which the claim settlement must be completed from claim registration date, as defined in the applicable SLA or service contract. Used for KPI and OTD performance measurement.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management; IATA Service Standards; CMR Convention Article 32

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this settlement record originated. SAP S/4HANA Finance is the primary system for reserve accounting and payment processing; Salesforce CRM for claim case management. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: subrogation_amount
attributes.description: Amount pursued or recovered through subrogation against a third-party carrier, vendor, or responsible party after Transport Shipping has paid the claimant. Distinct from insurer recovery; represents direct third-party liability recovery.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 37; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Convention

attributes.name: subrogation_initiated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a subrogation action has been initiated against a third-party carrier, vendor, or responsible party following payment of the settlement to the claimant.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 37; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport under which the cargo claim arose. Determines the applicable international liability convention and maximum compensation limits (e.g., IATA Warsaw-Montreal for air, Hague-Visby for ocean, CMR for road).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMO IMDG Code

products.name: status_history
products.description: Lifecycle tracking entity recording every status transition of a cargo claim from registration through closure. Captures status code, transition timestamp, responsible party, reason code, and notes for each state change (e.g., Registered → Under Investigation → Survey Commissioned → Liability Determined → Settlement Offered → Settled/Rejected/Subrogated). Enables SLA monitoring and regulatory audit trails.

attributes.name: status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim status history record. Primary key of the claim_status_history entity.

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cargo claim record for which this status transition is being recorded. Links each history entry to its owning claim.

attributes.name: claim_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific individual or organizational unit responsible for actioning this status transition. References the workforce or party entity depending on responsible_party_type.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: responsible_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Status transitions (claim filed, survey completed, settlement offered) may involve agent actions or require agent notifications. Tracks agent responsibility for status changes, agent response times, a

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cargo insurer involved at this stage of the claim lifecycle. Populated when the transition involves insurer correspondence, liability determination, or settlement negotiation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with the shipment underlying this claim. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and to support regulatory reporting under IATA frameworks without requiring joins to the shipment domain.

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with the ocean or road shipment underlying this claim. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and regulatory reporting under IMO and CMR frameworks.
attributes.references: IMO Hague-Visby Rules; CMR Convention; Federal Maritime Commission (FMC) Regulations

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier of the cargo claim (e.g., CLM-2024-00012345). Denormalized here to support audit trail queries without joining to the parent claim table.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO Guidelines on Cargo Claims

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim status history record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation timestamp, distinct from the business event transition_timestamp. Used for data lineage and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: credit_note_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the credit note issued to the claimant as part of the settlement at this status transition. Links to the billing system credit note for financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cargo claim involves dangerous goods, triggering additional regulatory handling requirements under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions. Affects claim processing procedures and liability frameworks.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations

attributes.name: days_in_previous_status
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the claim remained in the from_status_code before transitioning. Calculated at the time of transition and stored for SLA monitoring, aging analysis, and claims processing efficiency KPIs.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: delay_claim_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this claim is a delay claim (as opposed to loss or damage), which has distinct liability limits and processing rules under the Warsaw-Montreal Convention and CMR Convention.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 19; CMR Convention Article 23

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition was triggered by or resulted in an escalation of the claim to a higher authority (e.g., senior claims manager, legal counsel, or executive review). Used for management reporting and SLA breach tracking.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for escalation when escalation_flag is True. Documents the specific circumstances requiring senior review or intervention.

attributes.name: from_status_code
attributes.description: The claim lifecycle status code immediately before this transition occurred (e.g., REGISTERED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, SURVEY_COMMISSIONED, LIABILITY_DETERMINED, SETTLEMENT_OFFERED, SETTLED, REJECTED, SUBROGATED, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGISTERED|UNDER_INVESTIGATION|SURVEY_COMMISSIONED|LIABILITY_DETERMINED|SETTLEMENT_OFFERED|SETTLED|REJECTED|SUBROGATED|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: insurer_reference_number
attributes.description: The cargo insurer's own reference or file number for this claim, as communicated during insurer correspondence. Used to cross-reference claim records between Transport Shipping and the insurer's system.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: liability_convention_code
attributes.description: The international liability convention governing this claim at the time of this status transition (e.g., WARSAW_MONTREAL for air freight, CMR for road, HAGUE_VISBY for ocean, CIM for rail). Determines liability limits and procedural requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; CIM Convention

attributes.name: liability_determination_code
attributes.description: The outcome of the liability assessment at this status transition (FULL_LIABILITY, PARTIAL_LIABILITY, NO_LIABILITY, SHARED_LIABILITY, PENDING). Populated when to_status_code is LIABILITY_DETERMINED. Governs settlement calculation and reserve accounting.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum monetary liability applicable to this claim under the governing convention or contract at the time of liability determination. Expressed in settlement_currency_code. Used for settlement calculation and reserve accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General free-text notes recorded by the claims handler at the time of this status transition. Captures additional context, instructions, or observations not covered by structured fields. Supports audit trail and claims review processes.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggers a mandatory regulatory notification obligation (e.g., dangerous goods incident reporting to IMO/IATA, customs authority notification under C-TPAT or AEO programs). Drives compliance workflow automation.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions; C-TPAT; AEO Program; WCO Framework

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification has been dispatched following this status transition. Used in conjunction with regulatory_notification_required_flag to track compliance obligations and identify outstanding notifications.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: reserve_amount
attributes.description: The financial reserve amount set aside in the general ledger for this claim at this status transition point. Updated at each significant status change (e.g., when liability is determined or settlement is offered). Feeds SAP S/4HANA Finance reserve accounting.
attributes.references: IFRS 37 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Full name or organizational name of the party responsible for this status transition. Denormalized for audit trail completeness and regulatory reporting without requiring joins.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Category of the party responsible for initiating or actioning this status transition (e.g., CLAIMS_HANDLER, SURVEYOR, INSURER, LEGAL_COUNSEL, CUSTOMER, SYSTEM for automated transitions).
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the settlement offer amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Applicable when settlement_offer_amount is populated.

attributes.name: settlement_offer_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the settlement offer made to the claimant at this status transition. Populated when to_status_code is SETTLEMENT_OFFERED. Expressed in the currency defined by settlement_currency_code.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 37 Provisions

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the status transition occurred after the sla_target_resolution_date, constituting an SLA breach. True if the transition_timestamp exceeded the target date; False otherwise. Used for SLA KPI reporting and escalation tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: sla_target_resolution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Date
attributes.description: The contractual or regulatory target date by which the claim must be resolved or advanced to the next status, based on the applicable SLA for this claim type and transport mode. Used for SLA breach monitoring and KPI reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this status transition record (e.g., SALESFORCE_CRM for customer-facing claim cases, SAP_S4HANA for finance-driven transitions, ORACLE_TMS for transport-triggered events, MANUAL for manually entered transitions).

attributes.name: source_system_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction or record identifier from the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Case ID, SAP document number) that triggered this status transition. Enables traceability back to the system of record.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition initiates or is associated with a subrogation process, where Transport Shipping or the insurer pursues recovery from a third party responsible for the loss or damage.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: subrogation_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number assigned to the subrogation recovery action initiated at this status transition. Populated when subrogation_flag is True and to_status_code is SUBROGATED.

attributes.name: survey_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the cargo survey report commissioned or received during this status transition. Applicable when to_status_code is SURVEY_COMMISSIONED or when survey findings trigger a transition. Links to the cargo survey report document.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO Guidelines on Cargo Claims

attributes.name: to_status_code
attributes.description: The claim lifecycle status code immediately after this transition occurred (e.g., REGISTERED, UNDER_INVESTIGATION, SURVEY_COMMISSIONED, LIABILITY_DETERMINED, SETTLEMENT_OFFERED, SETTLED, REJECTED, SUBROGATED, CLOSED, WITHDRAWN). This is the new current state of the claim following this event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REGISTERED|UNDER_INVESTIGATION|SURVEY_COMMISSIONED|LIABILITY_DETERMINED|SETTLEMENT_OFFERED|SETTLED|REJECTED|SUBROGATED|CLOSED|WITHDRAWN — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Frameworks

attributes.name: transition_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining why the status transition occurred (e.g., SURVEY_REQUESTED, DOCS_RECEIVED, LIABILITY_ACCEPTED, LIABILITY_DENIED, SETTLEMENT_AGREED, INSURER_DECLINED, SUBROGATION_INITIATED, CLAIMANT_WITHDREW). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SURVEY_REQUESTED|DOCS_RECEIVED|LIABILITY_ACCEPTED|LIABILITY_DENIED|SETTLEMENT_AGREED|INSURER_DECLINED|SUBROGATION_INITIATED|CLAIMANT_WITHDREW — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transition_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context or explanation for the status transition, supplementing the structured transition_reason_code. Used by claims handlers to document specific circumstances, exceptions, or instructions.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone offset) at which the claim status transitioned from the from_status_code to the to_status_code. This is the principal business event time for this history record and is used for SLA monitoring and regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport associated with the underlying cargo claim (AIR, OCEAN, ROAD, RAIL, MULTIMODAL). Determines the applicable liability convention (e.g., Warsaw-Montreal for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; IMDG Code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this claim status history record was last modified. Supports data lineage tracking and identifies records that have been amended post-creation (e.g., corrections to reason codes or notes).
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

products.name: claim_document
products.description: Master record cataloguing all documents and formal correspondence attached to a cargo claim file. Captures document type (AWB, BOL, commercial invoice, packing list, survey report, photos, ePOD, customs declaration, dangerous goods manifest, insurer correspondence, demand letters, settlement offers), document source, communication channel, sent/received timestamp, response status, upload timestamp, document status, and storage reference. Ensures claim file completeness for liability determination, insurer SLA compliance, and regulatory compliance under IATA, IMO, and WCO requirements.

attributes.name: claim_document_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each document or formal correspondence record attached to a cargo claim file in the Transport Shipping claims management system.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: air_waybill_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.air_waybill. Business justification: Air cargo claim documents must reference AWB for transport document verification. Replaces denormalized awb_number with proper FK for linking POD, damage reports, and survey photos to air waybill.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.bill_of_lading. Business justification: Ocean cargo claim documents must reference B/L for transport document verification. Replaces denormalized bol_number with proper FK for linking POD, damage reports, and survey photos to bill of lading

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.booking. Business justification: Claim documents may reference booking confirmation for pre-shipment disputes (booking confirmation emails, rate quotes, space rejection notices). Supports booking-level evidence management and pre-shi

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cargo claim record to which this document belongs. Links the document to its claim file for completeness tracking and liability determination.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Claim documents are submitted by/to customer accounts (POD, invoices, packing lists). Enables customer-specific document management, compliance tracking, and customer portal access control. Critical f

attributes.name: customs_declaration_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.declaration. Business justification: Claims documentation routinely includes customs declarations as supporting evidence. Essential for validating declared values, verifying HS codes, establishing cargo legitimacy in fraud investigations

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: Claim documents (POD, packing lists, commercial invoices, photos) are submitted per freight order. Essential for linking supporting evidence to shipment, verifying cargo value, and substantiating dama

attributes.name: issuing_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Claim documents (survey reports, damage certificates, delivery receipts) are often issued by or submitted to agents. Standard document workflow in agent-involved claims for document provenance, authen

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Claim evidence documents (packing lists, quality certificates, commercial invoices) tied to POs are critical for claim substantiation. Real business process: procurement claim evidence management and

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Claim documents (supplier correspondence, quality certificates, investigation reports) need supplier linkage for complete supplier claim file management and audit trail. Essential for supplier claim d

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the document was transmitted or received. Captures whether the document arrived via EDI (Electronic Data Interchange), email, carrier portal, postal mail, fax, or API integration. Supports audit trail and SLA measurement.

attributes.name: country_of_origin_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the country where the document was issued or originated. Relevant for customs declarations, certificates of origin, and cross-border claim regulatory compliance under WCO and trade compliance frameworks.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; ISO 3166-1; WTO Rules of Origin Agreement

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this claim document record was first created in the system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage, SOX compliance, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: declared_value_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value declared on the document (e.g., commercial invoice value, declared cargo value on AWB or BOL). Used as the basis for liability calculation and settlement offer determination under applicable liability conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; CMR Convention; IFRS 17

attributes.name: declared_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the declared value amount on the document (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency claim settlement calculations and financial reporting under IFRS.

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the document was received by Transport Shipping (inbound) or sent by Transport Shipping to an external party (outbound). Distinguishes correspondence flow for insurer SLA compliance and claim file completeness checks.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: document_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the document type for claim file organisation and regulatory compliance reporting. Enables structured retrieval of document sets required by IATA, IMO, and WCO frameworks.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO FAL Convention; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The official date printed or stated on the document itself (e.g., invoice date, survey report date, AWB issue date). Distinct from upload or received timestamps; represents the document's own declared date for legal and regulatory validity.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: document_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the document content, purpose, or any relevant notes about the document's role in the claim file. Provides context for claim handlers and insurers reviewing the document.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number or identifier assigned to the document (e.g., AWB number, BOL number, invoice number, survey report reference). Serves as the business-facing identifier for the document within the claim file.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO FAL Convention; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: document_source
attributes.description: Originating party or system that provided or generated the document. Identifies whether the document was submitted by the claimant, insurer, carrier, customs authority, independent surveyor, or generated internally. Used for chain-of-custody tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: claimant|insurer|carrier|customs_authority|surveyor|internal|third_party — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO FAL Convention; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: document_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the document within the claim file. Tracks whether the document has been received, reviewed, accepted as valid evidence, rejected, or superseded by a newer version. Drives insurer SLA compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document attached to the claim file. Identifies the nature and purpose of the document within the claims process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: awb|bol|commercial_invoice|packing_list|survey_report|photo_evidence|epod|customs_declaration|dangerous_goods_manifest|insurer_correspondence|demand_letter|settlement_offer|claim_form|certificate_of_origin|delivery_receipt — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMO FAL Convention; WCO Data Model; IMDG Code

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format or MIME type of the stored document. Determines rendering capability and archival requirements. EDI and XML formats indicate structured electronic documents; PDF/image formats indicate scanned or photographed evidence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pdf|jpeg|png|tiff|xlsx|docx|xml|edi — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: file_name
attributes.description: Original file name of the uploaded document as provided by the submitting party. Preserves the source file identity for audit trail and document retrieval purposes.

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: Size of the document file in kilobytes. Used for storage management, upload validation, and ensuring document completeness (e.g., detecting empty or corrupt uploads).

attributes.name: hawb_number
attributes.description: House Air Waybill number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC for the specific consignment within a consolidated air shipment. Distinguishes individual shipper consignments within a master consolidation for claim document traceability.

attributes.name: hbl_number
attributes.description: House Bill of Lading number issued by the freight forwarder or NVOCC for the specific consignment within a consolidated ocean shipment. Used to trace claim documents to individual shipper consignments within LCL (Less Than Container Load) shipments.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System commodity classification code for the cargo described in the document. Required for customs declarations and dangerous goods manifests. Enables tariff classification verification and trade compliance under WCO Harmonized System Convention.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System Convention; Descartes Customs GTM; IMDG Code

attributes.name: insurer_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the cargo insurer to this document or correspondence. Enables cross-referencing between Transport Shipping's claim file and the insurer's own claim management system for settlement negotiations.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO FAL Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document relates to a dangerous goods shipment claim. When True, additional regulatory requirements apply under IMDG Code (ocean), ICAO Technical Instructions (air), or ADR (road). Triggers dangerous goods claims handling workflow.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; ADR Convention

attributes.name: is_latest_version
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document record represents the most current version of the document. Set to True for the active version and False for superseded versions. Prevents use of outdated documents in claim settlement calculations.

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this document type is mandatory for the claim file to be considered complete under applicable regulatory or insurer requirements (e.g., AWB is mandatory for air claims under IATA, BOL for ocean claims under IMO). Drives claim file completeness validation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO FAL Convention; CMR Convention

attributes.name: issuing_authority
attributes.description: Name of the authority, organisation, or party that officially issued or certified the document (e.g., customs authority, classification society, independent surveyor firm, insurer). Validates document authenticity for liability determination.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; IMO FAL Convention; IATA Resolution 600a; C-TPAT; AEO Program

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 two-letter language code of the document (e.g., EN, FR, DE, ZH). Determines whether translation is required for regulatory submission or insurer review. Relevant for cross-border claims under WCO and customs authority requirements.
attributes.references: WCO Data Model; ISO 639-1; GDPR Article 12

attributes.name: page_count
attributes.description: Total number of pages in the document. Used to verify document completeness and detect partial uploads. Particularly relevant for multi-page survey reports, customs declarations, and dangerous goods manifests.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; IMDG Code; WCO Data Model

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was received by Transport Shipping. Applicable for inbound documents. Critical for calculating claim notification deadlines and insurer SLA compliance under IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention and CMR Convention.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason for rejecting the document when document_status is 'rejected'. Captures why the document was deemed invalid or insufficient (e.g., illegible scan, missing signature, expired document, incorrect format). Required for claimant notification and resubmission guidance.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: response_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which a response to this document is required, based on applicable SLA or regulatory timeframe (e.g., insurer acknowledgement deadline, claimant response window under IATA or CMR Convention). Drives SLA compliance monitoring and escalation workflows.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: response_received_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which a response to this document was received. Compared against response_due_date to determine SLA compliance and insurer response performance.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current status of the expected response to this document. Tracks whether a reply is pending, has been received, is not required, or is overdue. Supports insurer SLA compliance reporting and claim escalation management.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600a; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: reviewed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was reviewed by the claims handler. Used to measure internal processing time and SLA compliance for document review workflows.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IATA Resolution 600a

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was dispatched by the sending party. Applicable for outbound documents. Used to measure insurer SLA response times and regulatory submission deadlines under IATA and IMO frameworks.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: storage_reference
attributes.description: Physical or digital storage location reference for the document file (e.g., object storage path, document management system URI, DMS folder reference). Enables retrieval of the actual document from the underlying storage system for claim review and regulatory audit.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport associated with the claim document, determining the applicable liability convention (IATA Warsaw-Montreal for air, CMR Convention for road, Hague-Visby Rules for ocean, CIM Convention for rail). Critical for regulatory compliance and liability framework selection.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; CIM Convention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this claim document record was last modified. Tracks the most recent update to the document record for audit trail, data lineage, and change management purposes.

attributes.name: upload_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the document was uploaded or ingested into the claims management system. Distinct from received_timestamp; captures the system ingestion event for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 28000 Supply Chain Security Management; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document, incremented when a revised or amended version is submitted. Enables tracking of document amendments throughout the claim lifecycle and ensures the latest version is used for liability determination.

products.name: reserve
products.description: Financial reserve record established for an open cargo claim representing estimated liability exposure on the balance sheet. Captures initial reserve amount, reserve currency, reserve establishment date, periodic reserve adjustments (increases/decreases with reason codes), reserve release date and amount upon settlement, and linkage to finance domain cost center and GL account. Required for IFRS 17/IAS 37 provisioning compliance, SOX-compliant financial reporting, and monthly reserve adequacy reviews. Interfaces with SAP S/4HANA Finance for automated reserve posting and release.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the reserve amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency balance sheet consolidation under IFRS.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; IFRS; IAS 21 Effects of Changes in Foreign Exchange Rates

attributes.name: current_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Most recent reserve balance after all adjustments (increases and decreases). Reflects the current best estimate of outstanding liability exposure on the balance sheet. Updated with each reserve adjustment posting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underlying claim involves dangerous goods cargo. Triggers enhanced reserve assessment procedures and compliance checks under IMDG Code and ICAO Technical Instructions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IMO; IATA

attributes.name: days_reserve_open
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the reserve has been open since establishment_date. Used in reserve aging reports and KPI dashboards to identify long-outstanding reserves requiring management escalation.

attributes.name: establishment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the financial reserve was first established in SAP S/4HANA Finance. Used as the IAS 37 provision recognition date for balance sheet reporting and SOX-compliant financial close.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to translate reserve_currency amounts into functional_currency_amount at the reporting date. Sourced from SAP S/4HANA Finance exchange rate tables.

attributes.name: expected_settlement_date
attributes.description: Estimated date by which the underlying claim is expected to be settled and the reserve released. Used for cash flow forecasting, reserve aging analysis, and IFRS 37 disclosure of timing of outflows.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: Current reserve amount translated into the entity's functional currency using the closing exchange rate at the reporting date. Required for IFRS consolidated financial statements and SOX reporting.

attributes.name: functional_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter code for the entity's functional currency used in IFRS consolidated reporting (e.g., USD). Paired with functional_currency_amount.

attributes.name: initial_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Original estimated liability exposure amount posted to the balance sheet at reserve establishment. Represents the best estimate of the probable outflow of economic resources as required by IAS 37. Denominated in reserve_currency.

attributes.name: insurer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insurer was formally notified of the claim and reserve. Used to track compliance with policy notification deadlines and manage insurer correspondence timelines.

attributes.name: insurer_notified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has been formally notified of the claim and reserve establishment. Required for compliance with policy notification obligations and IFRS 17 insurance contract accounting.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the most recent reserve adjustment. Positive values indicate a reserve increase (strengthening); negative values indicate a reserve decrease (release). Denominated in reserve_currency.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent reserve adjustment (increase or decrease). Used to identify stale reserves requiring review during monthly reserve adequacy assessments.

attributes.name: last_adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code explaining the basis for the most recent reserve adjustment. Supports audit trail requirements and reserve movement analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_evidence|survey_update|legal_development|settlement_negotiation|subrogation_recovery|reserve_adequacy_review — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: liability_convention
attributes.description: International liability convention governing the maximum reserve ceiling for this claim. Determines the per-kg or per-SDR liability cap applied during reserve calculation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: warsaw_montreal|cmr|hague_visby|cotif_cim|imdg|domestic — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COTIF-CIM; IMDG Code; IMO

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability exposure ceiling calculated under the applicable liability convention (e.g., SDR per kg under Warsaw-Montreal, SDR per package under Hague-Visby). Reserve cannot exceed this amount. Denominated in reserve_currency.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMO

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative providing additional context for the reserve establishment, adjustment, or release. May include cargo survey findings, legal counsel opinions, or negotiation status relevant to reserve adequacy.

attributes.name: release_amount
attributes.description: Amount released from the reserve upon settlement or closure. May be a partial or full release. Denominated in reserve_currency. Reconciled against settlement_amount in the claim record.

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reserve was fully or partially released upon claim settlement, withdrawal, or closure. Triggers the corresponding SAP S/4HANA Finance reversal posting.

attributes.name: release_reason
attributes.description: Reason for releasing the reserve. Supports audit trail and reserve movement reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: claim_settled|claim_withdrawn|claim_denied|subrogation_recovered|statute_expired|management_decision — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reserve_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the reserve record, assigned at the time of reserve establishment. Used in insurer correspondence, SAP S/4HANA Finance postings, and audit trails. Format: RES-{YYYY}-{8-digit sequence}.
attributes.references: IAS 37; SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance Reserve Object

attributes.name: reserve_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the claim reserve. Drives IFRS 17/IAS 37 provisioning workflows and monthly reserve adequacy reviews. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|adjusted|partially_released|fully_released|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reserve by its business purpose. Initial reserves are established at claim registration; supplemental reserves are created for additional exposure; subrogation reserves track recoverable amounts; salvage reserves reflect recoverable cargo value; litigation reserves cover legal proceedings.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA Finance accounting document number generated when the reserve provision was posted. Provides the audit trail linkage between the claim reserve record and the financial ledger entry.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Finance FI Module

attributes.name: subrogation_potential
attributes.description: Indicates whether the claim has identified subrogation recovery potential (i.e., the right to recover paid amounts from a liable third party such as a carrier or supplier). Triggers subrogation workflow initiation.
attributes.references: IAS 37; CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO

attributes.name: subrogation_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered or expected to be recovered through subrogation from a liable third party. Reduces the net reserve exposure. Denominated in reserve_currency.
attributes.references: IAS 37; CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention

attributes.name: total_adjustments_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative net amount of all reserve adjustments since establishment (sum of all increases and decreases). Denominated in reserve_currency. Supports reserve movement waterfall reporting.

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport associated with the underlying claim. Determines the applicable liability convention and maximum reserve ceiling (e.g., IATA for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; IMO

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to the claim reserve record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trail, and SOX change management compliance.

products.name: line
products.description: Line-item detail record within a cargo claim, representing individual damaged, lost, or short-shipped SKUs or cargo units. Captures SKU reference, commodity description, HS code, quantity claimed, unit value, total claimed value, currency, condition at origin, and condition at destination. Enables granular claim valuation and supports customs and trade compliance reporting under WCO requirements.
products.reference: Claim Line Item / Cargo Loss Detail

attributes.name: line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim line record within the cargo claims management system. Primary key for the claim_line data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: air_waybill_id

attributes.name: bill_of_lading_id

attributes.name: cargo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.cargo. Business justification: Claim line items represent individual cargo pieces or SKUs within a shipment. Direct FK to the cargo entity enables line-level valuation using authoritative commodity codes, declared values, and packa

attributes.name: cargo_survey_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.cargo_survey. Business justification: Individual claim line items may reference specific survey findings that assessed damage to that particular commodity/SKU. N:1 relationship (many line items per survey). Adding cargo_survey_id FK allow

attributes.name: carrier_service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier_service. Business justification: Claim line items reference specific carrier services for per-item liability calculation and service-specific handling requirements. Granular service-level claim tracking enables SKU-level service perf

attributes.name: consignment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment record against which this claim line is raised. Links the damaged or lost cargo line to the originating transport movement for liability and subrogation analysis.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Liability Conventions

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Claim lines track customer-specific cargo items and SKUs. Enables SKU-level claim analysis per customer, customer product risk profiling, and customer-specific packaging/handling recommendations. Crit

attributes.name: freight_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to freight.freight_order. Business justification: Claim lines itemize damaged/lost cargo from specific freight orders. Essential for line-level damage assessment, SKU-level loss calculation, and linking claimed items to original shipment manifest for

attributes.name: hs_classification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.hs_classification. Business justification: Claim line items for specific commodities require direct HS classification reference for customs valuation disputes, duty-related claims, and tariff classification challenges. Critical for claims invo

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Individual claim lines (damaged SKUs) are analyzed by lane for loss-ratio reporting, carrier scorecarding, and commodity-specific risk assessment. Enables lane-level profitability analysis adjusted fo

attributes.name: order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to fulfillment.order_line. Business justification: Claims are filed against specific order line items (SKU-level damage, quantity discrepancies, wrong item shipped). Finance and operations need line-item traceability for accurate settlement calculatio

attributes.name: outbound_order_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.outbound_order_line. Business justification: A claim line for a specific outbound order item must reference the outbound_order_line to verify ordered vs. shipped quantities, unit price, and lot/serial numbers for settlement calculation. This is

attributes.name: package_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shipment.shipment_package. Business justification: Claim lines are filed for specific damaged or missing packages within a consignment. Package-level claim line processing requires direct reference to shipment_package for actual weight, dimensions, de

attributes.name: po_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.po_line. Business justification: Direct claim line to PO line linkage enables precise matching of claimed items to ordered items, quantities, and unit prices for accurate settlement calculation. Real business process: line-item claim

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.purchase_order. Business justification: Claim lines for purchased goods need PO linkage to match claimed items against ordered items and contract pricing. Real business process: procurement claim line-item reconciliation and variance analys

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to warehouse.sku. Business justification: A claim line represents a specific SKU being claimed. Linking to warehouse.sku enables retrieval of product specifications (weight, dimensions, hazmat class, shelf life) for liability calculation and

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Claim line items for supplier goods need supplier linkage for item-level cost recovery, quality tracking, and defect analysis. Real business process: line-item supplier chargeback and quality manageme

attributes.name: approved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity approved by the claims assessor following survey and investigation. May differ from claimed_quantity where partial loss or damage is confirmed. Used in settlement calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; ISO 9001

attributes.name: approved_value
attributes.description: Monetary value approved for settlement on this line item following assessment, survey, and liability determination. May be less than claimed_value due to liability caps, depreciation, or partial loss findings.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 13

attributes.name: claim_filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this claim line was formally filed with the carrier or insurer. Used to assess compliance with statutory filing deadlines under the Montreal Convention (14 days for damage, 21 days for delay) and CMR Convention.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 31; CMR Convention Article 30

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the claim line: loss (cargo not delivered), damage (cargo delivered in damaged condition), shortage (partial quantity missing), delay (late delivery causing financial loss), contamination, or pilferage. Drives liability framework selection.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Liability Conventions

attributes.name: claimed_quantity
attributes.description: Number of units, pieces, or cargo items being claimed on this line. Represents the quantity declared as lost, damaged, or short-shipped by the claimant.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; WCO

attributes.name: claimed_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value claimed by the claimant for this line item, calculated as claimed_quantity multiplied by unit_value plus any ancillary costs. Represents the claimant's gross demand before assessment.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 13

attributes.name: condition_at_destination
attributes.description: Recorded condition of the cargo item upon delivery at destination, as noted on the Proof of Delivery (POD) or cargo survey report. Compared against condition_at_origin to establish loss or damage.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; CMR Convention; ePOD Standards

attributes.name: condition_at_origin
attributes.description: Recorded condition of the cargo item at the point of origin or acceptance by the carrier, as noted on the AWB, BOL, or cargo receipt. Establishes the baseline for damage assessment and liability determination.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Acceptance Standards; CMR Convention; WCO

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim line record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, SLA measurement, and data lineage tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values on this claim line (claimed_value, approved_value, unit_value). Ensures consistent multi-currency claim valuation and financial reporting.

attributes.name: damage_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the damage type for this claim line, enabling trend analysis and root cause reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: physical|water|fire|theft|contamination|temperature|handling|vermin|customs_examination — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions

attributes.name: damage_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text description of the nature and extent of damage, loss, or shortage observed for this claim line item. Captured from cargo survey reports and used in insurer correspondence and settlement negotiations.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; ISO 9001

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_class
attributes.description: IMDG/ICAO dangerous goods classification class or division for the cargo item (e.g., Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Division 6.1 Toxic Substances). Populated only when is_dangerous_goods is true. Required for regulatory incident reporting.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: depreciation_rate
attributes.description: Depreciation rate applied to the cargo item's declared value to reflect age, wear, or market value reduction at the time of loss or damage. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Applied in approved_value calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; IFRS 13

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the cargo destination for this claim line. Used for cross-border claims, import duty recovery, and jurisdictional liability framework determination.

attributes.name: gross_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross weight in kilograms of the cargo items on this claim line as declared on the AWB or BOL. Used for liability cap calculation under weight-based conventions (e.g., Montreal Convention SDR per kg).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IATA AWB Standards

attributes.name: hs_code
attributes.description: Harmonized System (HS) Code classifying the commodity under the World Customs Organization (WCO) nomenclature. Required for customs and trade compliance reporting, particularly for cross-border claims and duty recovery under DDP or DAP Incoterms.
attributes.references: WCO Harmonized System; Descartes Customs GTM

attributes.name: incoterms_code
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to the shipment for this claim line, determining the point of risk transfer between buyer and seller. Influences liability determination and insurable interest. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: insurer_reference
attributes.description: Reference number assigned by the cargo insurer for this claim line. Used for insurer correspondence, subrogation tracking, and recovery management.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; ISO 28000

attributes.name: is_dangerous_goods
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the cargo item on this claim line is classified as dangerous goods under IMDG Code or ICAO Technical Instructions. Triggers specialist handling procedures and regulatory notification requirements for dangerous goods claims.
attributes.references: IMDG Code; ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this claim line record. Supports change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer and audit compliance under SOX.

attributes.name: liability_basis
attributes.description: The legal or contractual framework governing carrier liability for this claim line. Determines the applicable liability cap and burden of proof. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: montreal_convention|cmr_convention|hague_visby|cotif|contractual|waiver — promote to reference product if additional conventions are added]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COTIF; IMO

attributes.name: liability_cap_value
attributes.description: Maximum carrier liability applicable to this claim line under the governing convention or contract (e.g., SDR per kg under Montreal Convention for air, or CMR limits for road). Constrains the approved_value ceiling.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IMO

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number ordering this item within the parent claim. Used for display, sorting, and referencing individual line items in insurer correspondence and settlement documentation.

attributes.name: line_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this individual claim line item. Tracks the workflow state from initial registration through assessment, approval or rejection, and final settlement or withdrawal.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: loss_discovery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the loss, damage, or shortage for this claim line was first discovered or reported by the consignee or shipper. Critical for determining claim filing timeliness under applicable liability conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 31; CMR Convention Article 30; Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the cargo origin for this claim line. Used for cross-border claims, customs duty recovery, and WCO trade compliance reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the claimed quantity (e.g., PCS for pieces, KG for kilograms, CBM for cubic metres, CTN for cartons, PLT for pallets, BAG for bags). Aligns with the unit declared on the AWB or BOL.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for rejection of this claim line, populated when line_status is 'rejected'. Documents the basis for denial (e.g., late filing, inherent vice, force majeure, insufficient evidence) for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; CMR Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: Residual monetary value of the damaged cargo recovered through salvage operations for this claim line. Deducted from the approved_value to determine the net settlement payable.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; IFRS 13 Fair Value

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the claim line was financially settled and payment was made or credit note issued to the claimant. Used for finance reserve accounting and SAP S/4HANA AR reconciliation.
attributes.references: IFRS 9 Financial Instruments; SOX; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: subrogation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether subrogation rights have been exercised or are being pursued for this claim line, enabling the insurer to recover costs from the liable carrier or third party after settlement.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; IMO Liability Conventions

attributes.name: subrogation_recovery_value
attributes.description: Monetary amount recovered through subrogation proceedings for this claim line. Populated after recovery is confirmed. Used in finance for net claims cost reporting and P&L impact analysis.
attributes.references: IFRS 9; SOX; IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the cargo survey or physical inspection was conducted for this claim line item. Used to track assessment timelines and SLA compliance for claims processing.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual; ISO 9001

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport applicable to this claim line, determining the governing liability convention (IATA Warsaw-Montreal for air, Hague-Visby/CMR for ocean/road, COTIF for rail). Critical for liability cap calculation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; COTIF Convention; IMO

attributes.name: unit_value
attributes.description: Declared or assessed value per unit of the cargo item at origin, as stated on the commercial invoice. Used as the basis for claim valuation and liability cap comparison under applicable conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IFRS 13 Fair Value

attributes.name: volume_cbm
attributes.description: Volume in cubic metres (CBM) of the cargo items on this claim line. Used for dimensional weight (DIM Weight) calculations and ocean freight LCL/FCL claim assessments.
attributes.references: IATA DIM Weight Standards; IMO; WCO

products.name: claim_party
products.description: Association entity linking all parties involved in a cargo claim to their respective roles and responsibilities. Captures party type (claimant, carrier, sub-carrier, insurer, underwriter, surveyor, legal counsel, customs authority, port operator, freight handler), party reference ID, contact details, notification status, response deadlines, and role-specific attributes. Enables multi-party claim management across complex intermodal and cross-border shipments where liability may be shared among multiple carriers and intermediaries.

attributes.name: claim_party_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each claim party association record in the Transport Shipping claims management system. Primary key for the claim_party entity.

attributes.name: agent_id

attributes.name: cargo_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent cargo claim record to which this party is associated. Links the party to the specific claim event.

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claimant. Business justification: A claim_party record represents all parties involved in a cargo claim, including the claimant themselves. When the party_role is 'claimant', the claim_party record should reference the master claimant
