attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: claim_party carries denormalized contact_email, contact_name, contact_phone duplicating customer.contact. Linking enables authorized signatory verification, notification preference management, and GDP

attributes.name: contract_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master party record (organisation or individual) involved in this claim. Enables lookup of full party profile from the master party registry.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Claim parties (shipper, consignee, notify party) are registered customer accounts. Linking enables party identity verification against KYC/AML records, denied-party screening, credit exposure tracking

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to claim.claim_policy. Business justification: Claim party involvement (especially insurer parties) is under a specific insurance policy. N:1 relationship (many party records per policy). Adding claim_policy_id FK allows normalization of policy_nu

attributes.name: tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Third-party logistics providers can be claim parties as liable parties (warehouse damage, handling errors) or claimants (subrogation). Captures 3PL involvement in claims for liability management and 3

attributes.name: trade_party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customs.trade_party. Business justification: Claimants and respondents in customs-related claims are often registered trade parties (importers, exporters, brokers). Direct link required for AEO/C-TPAT status verification, compliance validation,

attributes.name: aeo_number
attributes.description: AEO certification number of the party where applicable (carriers, freight handlers, customs brokers). Relevant for customs authority and freight handler roles in cross-border claims.
attributes.references: AEO Programme; WCO SAFE Framework; C-TPAT; Descartes Customs

attributes.name: awb_number
attributes.description: Air Waybill number associated with this party's involvement in the claim, applicable when the transport mode is air freight. Links to the specific air cargo consignment under IATA conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; HAWB/MAWB standards

attributes.name: bol_number
attributes.description: Bill of Lading number associated with this party's involvement in the claim, applicable for ocean freight shipments. Identifies the specific consignment under Hague-Visby or similar maritime rules.
attributes.references: Hague-Visby Rules; FMC; IMO; MBL/HBL standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the party's registered jurisdiction. Determines applicable national regulations, customs authority jurisdiction, and governing law for the claim.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this claim party association record was first created in the Transport Shipping claims management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: dispute_raised
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party has formally raised a dispute against the claim amount, liability determination, or settlement terms. Triggers escalation to legal proceedings or arbitration.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 32; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 29; ISO 9001

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the dispute raised by this party. Categorises the basis of the dispute to guide resolution strategy and legal response.
attributes.references: CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; ISO 9001

attributes.name: document_submission_deadline
attributes.description: Deadline by which this party must submit supporting documentation (e.g., survey reports, invoices, packing lists, customs declarations) to support or defend the claim.

attributes.name: documents_received
attributes.description: Indicates whether all required supporting documents have been received from this party. Drives claim processing workflow and completeness checks.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.description: IATA airline or agent code assigned to this party, applicable for air carrier and freight forwarder roles. Used to identify the party in air freight claim proceedings under IATA conventions.

attributes.name: imo_number
attributes.description: IMO vessel or company identification number for ocean carrier parties. Used to identify the maritime carrier in ocean freight claims under Hague-Visby or similar rules.
attributes.references: IMO Resolution A.1078(28); Hague-Visby Rules; FMC

attributes.name: legal_representation_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is represented by in-house legal counsel, external legal counsel, or has no legal representation in the claim proceedings.
attributes.references: CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; ISO 28000

attributes.name: liability_accepted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party has formally accepted liability for the cargo loss, damage, or delay. Drives settlement calculation and subrogation recovery processes.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability

attributes.name: liability_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the liability limit amount is expressed (e.g., USD, EUR, XDR for Special Drawing Rights).
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMF Special Drawing Rights

attributes.name: liability_framework
attributes.description: International or contractual liability convention governing this party's exposure in the claim. Determines maximum liability limits and burden of proof requirements.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COTIF Convention; IMO

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary liability cap applicable to this party under the governing convention or contract (e.g., SDR per kg under Warsaw-Montreal, SDR per kg under CMR). Used in settlement calculations.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; Hague-Visby Rules Article IV

attributes.name: liability_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total claim liability attributed to this party in cases of shared or apportioned liability across multiple carriers or intermediaries in intermodal shipments.
attributes.references: CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: notification_method
attributes.description: Channel used to formally notify this party of the claim. Relevant for legal admissibility of notice under applicable conventions and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 30; IATA Resolution 600; EDI standards

attributes.name: notification_status
attributes.description: Status of the formal claim notification sent to this party. Tracks whether the party has been formally notified per applicable convention timelines (e.g., 14-day notice under CMR, 7-day notice under Warsaw-Montreal).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 31; CMR Convention Article 30

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the formal claim notification was dispatched to this party. Critical for calculating statutory response deadlines under applicable liability conventions.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 31; CMR Convention Article 30

attributes.name: party_role
attributes.description: Functional role of the party within the cargo claim process. Determines liability exposure, notification obligations, and response requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: claimant|carrier|sub_carrier|insurer|underwriter|surveyor|legal_counsel|customs_authority|port_operator|freight_handler — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Convention on Limitation of Liability for Maritime Claims

attributes.name: party_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this party's involvement in the claim. Tracks progression from initial notification through response, dispute resolution, and final settlement or withdrawal.
attributes.references: IATA Resolution 600; CMR Convention; ISO 9001 Quality Management

attributes.name: party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party as an organisation, individual, government body, or regulatory authority. Drives applicable liability frameworks and communication protocols.

attributes.name: power_of_attorney
attributes.description: Indicates whether a power of attorney has been received from this party authorising a representative to act on their behalf in the claim proceedings.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CMR Convention; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention

attributes.name: primary_party
attributes.description: Indicates whether this party is the primary counterparty for the claim (e.g., the main claimant or the primary liable carrier) as opposed to a secondary or supporting party.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the party to this claim (e.g., insurer claim reference, carrier incident number, surveyor job number). Enables cross-referencing with counterparty systems.

attributes.name: response_deadline
attributes.description: Contractual or statutory deadline by which this party must respond to the claim notification. Derived from notification date plus applicable convention or SLA response period.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; SLA frameworks

attributes.name: response_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this party's formal response to the claim notification was received. Used to assess timeliness of response against statutory deadlines.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention Article 30

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Agreed monetary settlement amount attributed to or recoverable from this party. Populated upon settlement agreement and used for finance reserve accounting and credit note generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance; IFRS 37 Provisions; SOX Financial Reporting

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the settlement amount with this party is denominated.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the financial settlement with this party was agreed and confirmed. Triggers finance reserve release and credit note issuance in SAP S/4HANA.

attributes.name: subrogation_applicable
attributes.description: Indicates whether subrogation rights apply to this party's involvement, enabling the insurer to pursue recovery from the liable carrier or third party after settling the claimant.
attributes.references: Insurance subrogation principles; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention

attributes.name: subrogation_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Amount recovered or expected to be recovered from this party through subrogation proceedings. Relevant for insurer and underwriter roles in the claim.
attributes.references: Insurance subrogation principles; IFRS 37; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: survey_report_reference
attributes.description: Reference number of the cargo survey report issued by the surveyor party. Links the party's assessment findings to the claim record for loss quantification and liability determination.

attributes.name: surveyor_accreditation
attributes.description: Professional accreditation or certification number of the cargo surveyor party. Validates the surveyor's authority to conduct loss and damage assessments for insurance and legal purposes.

attributes.name: time_bar_date
attributes.description: Statutory limitation date by which legal action must be commenced against this party under the applicable liability convention (e.g., 2 years under Warsaw-Montreal, 1 year under CMR). Critical for claim management and legal escalation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 35; CMR Convention Article 32; Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Mode of transport under which this party's liability or involvement arises. Determines the applicable international convention (Warsaw-Montreal for air, CMR for road, Hague-Visby for ocean, COTIF for rail).
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; Hague-Visby Rules; COTIF Convention

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this claim party association record was last modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.

products.name: policy
products.description: Reference entity defining the cargo insurance policy under which a claim is filed. Captures policy number, insurer name, policy type (all-risk, named perils, war risk), coverage limit, deductible amount, policy period, covered transport modes, and special conditions. Serves as the contractual basis for claim eligibility assessment and settlement calculation. Distinct from the contract domain which manages carrier and customer service contracts.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the cargo insurance policy record within the Transport Shipping data platform. Primary key for the claim_policy entity.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Insurance policies may cover agent networks or specific agent relationships (agent E&O insurance, agent liability coverage). Agent coverage under insurance policies for risk management, agent selectio

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Insurance policies often cover specific carrier relationships or carrier-provided insurance programs. Policy-carrier coverage mapping for carrier liability insurance, carrier selection based on insura

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_account. Business justification: Cargo insurance policies are held by specific customer accounts (shippers or consignees). Policy management, premium allocation, coverage verification during claim adjudication, and open-cover declara

attributes.name: aggregate_annual_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total insurer liability across all claims filed within the policy year, expressed in coverage_limit_currency. Once exhausted, no further claims are payable under this policy until renewal. Critical for reserve accounting in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; SOX Section 404; Institute Cargo Clauses

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy automatically renews at expiry without requiring explicit action from Transport Shipping. When True, cancellation notice must be given before the renewal_date to prevent automatic continuation.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; Institute Cargo Clauses

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance broker or intermediary who placed this policy on behalf of Transport Shipping. The broker is the primary point of contact for policy renewals, endorsements, and claim escalations.
attributes.references: IATA Cargo Insurance Guidelines; FMC Regulations

attributes.name: broker_reference
attributes.description: Broker's own reference number for this policy placement. Used in broker correspondence, premium invoices, and claim notifications routed through the broker.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Minimum number of calendar days' written notice required by either party to cancel this policy before its expiry_date. Breach of this period may result in premium liability for the full policy term.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: cargo_category
attributes.description: Classification of cargo types covered under this policy. Determines applicable liability frameworks and special conditions. 'dangerous_goods' aligns to IMDG Code and ICAO Technical Instructions; 'high_value' triggers enhanced survey requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: general|perishable|dangerous_goods|high_value|fragile|bulk|pharmaceutical|automotive — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; IATA DGR

attributes.name: claims_filing_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days after the loss event within which a formal claim must be filed with the insurer. Distinct from the notification period; this is the hard deadline for submitting full claim documentation.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 35; CMR Convention Article 32; IMO Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: claims_notification_period_days
attributes.description: Maximum number of calendar days after discovery of loss or damage within which a claim must be notified to the insurer to remain eligible for settlement. Breach of this period may void the claim. Aligned to IATA, CMR, and IMO convention time limits.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 31; CMR Convention Article 30; IMO Hague-Visby Rules Article III Rule 6

attributes.name: co_insurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy is co-insured by multiple underwriters sharing the risk proportionally. When True, the co_insurance_lead_insurer and individual underwriter shares must be tracked for claim apportionment.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association Co-Insurance Clauses; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: co_insurance_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the total risk retained by the lead insurer named in insurer_name when this is a co-insured policy. Expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 60.00 for 60%). Only applicable when co_insurance_flag is True.
attributes.references: Lloyd's Market Association Co-Insurance Clauses; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: coverage_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount the insurer will pay for any single claim or in aggregate under this policy, expressed in the policy currency. Serves as the upper bound for settlement calculations. Critical for claim eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention Article 23; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: coverage_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the coverage limit amount and deductible are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency settlement calculations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: covered_transport_modes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of transport modes covered under this policy (e.g., 'air|ocean|road|rail'). Determines claim eligibility based on the mode used for the shipment. Aligned to IATA (air), IMO (ocean), CMR Convention (road), and CIM/COTIF (rail) liability frameworks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: air|ocean|road|rail|multimodal|courier — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; CMR Convention; CIM/COTIF Rail Convention

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim policy record was first created in the Transport Shipping data platform. Populated automatically at insert time. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and SOX compliance. Maps to RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED canonical category.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy explicitly covers dangerous goods shipments as classified under the IMDG Code (ocean), ICAO Technical Instructions (air), or ADR/RID (road/rail). When True, the policy must reference applicable DG endorsements and special conditions.
attributes.references: IMDG Code (IMO); ICAO Technical Instructions for Dangerous Goods; ADR/RID Regulations

attributes.name: declaration_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days after shipment dispatch within which a declaration must be submitted to the insurer under an open cover policy. Only applicable when declaration_required_flag is True. Null for specific voyage policies.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association

attributes.name: declaration_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual shipment declarations must be submitted to the insurer under this open cover policy. When True, each shipment must be declared within the agreed declaration period to activate coverage for that consignment.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Cargo Insurance Guidelines

attributes.name: deductible_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monetary amount that Transport Shipping must absorb before the insurer's liability commences on any individual claim. Deducted from gross claim settlement to arrive at net insurer payment. Expressed in coverage_limit_currency.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention

attributes.name: deductible_type
attributes.description: Method by which the deductible is applied. 'fixed' is a flat monetary amount; 'percentage' is a proportion of the claim value; 'franchise' means the deductible is waived if the claim exceeds the threshold; 'nil' means no deductible applies.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Agreed mechanism for resolving disputes between Transport Shipping and the insurer regarding claim settlements or policy interpretation. 'arbitration' is most common in international cargo insurance under Lloyd's and London Market policies.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; IATA Resolution 600a; ICC Arbitration Rules

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Document management system reference or URL pointing to the signed policy wording, schedule, and endorsements stored in the enterprise content management system. Enables auditors and claims handlers to retrieve the authoritative policy text.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Document Retention; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the cargo insurance policy becomes binding and coverage commences. Used to determine claim eligibility based on shipment date. Maps to EFFECTIVE_FROM canonical category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: exclusions
attributes.description: Structured description of risks, cargo types, or circumstances explicitly excluded from coverage under this policy. Common exclusions include inherent vice, delay, inadequate packing, and nuclear risks. Used during claim eligibility assessment.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses (A, B, C) — Lloyd's Market Association; IMDG Code (IMO)

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the cargo insurance policy coverage terminates. Claims for shipments dispatched after this date are not eligible under this policy. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen open cover policies. Maps to EFFECTIVE_UNTIL canonical category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Territorial extent of coverage under this policy. 'worldwide' covers all global shipments; 'regional' covers a defined geographic region; 'domestic' covers in-country shipments only; 'cross_border' covers international shipments excluding domestic legs.
attributes.references: WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; IMO FAL Convention; WCO Framework of Standards

attributes.name: governing_law
attributes.description: Jurisdiction whose laws govern the interpretation and enforcement of this insurance policy (e.g., 'English Law', 'New York Law', 'German Law'). Determines dispute resolution forum and applicable legal standards for claim settlement.
attributes.references: IMO FAL Convention; WTO Trade Facilitation Agreement; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: insurer_name
attributes.description: Legal trading name of the insurance company or underwriting syndicate that issued the cargo insurance policy. Used in insurer correspondence, claim submissions, and settlement negotiations.

attributes.name: insurer_policy_reference
attributes.description: Insurer's own internal reference or certificate number for this policy, distinct from the policy_number used by Transport Shipping. Required for direct insurer correspondence and electronic claim submission via EDI.
attributes.references: IATA e-freight EDI Standards; IMO FAL Convention

attributes.name: issuing_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction in which this insurance policy was issued. Determines applicable regulatory oversight (e.g., FCA in GBR, BaFin in DEU, NAIC in USA) and tax treatment of premiums.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: liability_basis
attributes.description: Valuation method used to calculate the insured value of cargo for settlement purposes. 'invoice_value' uses the commercial invoice amount; 'declared_value' uses the shipper-declared value on the AWB or BOL; 'market_value' uses prevailing market price at destination; 'replacement_cost' uses the cost to replace the goods.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention; CMR Convention; IMO Hague-Visby Rules; Institute Cargo Clauses

attributes.name: open_cover_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this policy is structured as an open cover (blanket policy covering all qualifying shipments automatically without individual declaration) rather than a specific voyage or shipment policy. Open cover policies are common for high-volume freight forwarders.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Cargo Insurance Guidelines

attributes.name: per_shipment_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum insurer liability for any single shipment event under this policy, expressed in coverage_limit_currency. May be lower than the aggregate coverage_limit_amount. Used in claim settlement calculations for individual AWB, BOL, or consignment note events.
attributes.references: IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 22; CMR Convention Article 23; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned by the insurer to uniquely identify the cargo insurance policy. Used in all insurer correspondence, claim filings, and settlement documentation. Maps to the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER canonical category for MASTER_AGREEMENT role.

attributes.name: policy_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the cargo insurance policy. 'active' indicates the policy is in force and eligible for claim filing; 'suspended' indicates temporary coverage halt; 'expired' indicates the policy period has ended without renewal; 'cancelled' indicates early termination; 'pending_renewal' indicates renewal is in progress; 'lapsed' indicates non-renewal after expiry. Maps to LIFECYCLE_STATUS canonical category.
attributes.references: ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems; IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts

attributes.name: policy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the cargo insurance policy by coverage scope. 'all_risk' covers all physical loss or damage except named exclusions; 'named_perils' covers only explicitly listed risks; 'war_risk' covers war, strikes, and political risks; 'total_loss_only' covers only complete cargo loss; 'open_cover' is a continuous blanket policy for multiple shipments. Maps to CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE canonical category.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses (A, B, C) — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Cargo Insurance Guidelines

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Annual or periodic insurance premium paid by Transport Shipping to the insurer for this policy. Used in finance for cost allocation, OPEX reporting, and profitability analysis per trade lane or business unit.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; SOX Section 404 Financial Reporting

attributes.name: premium_payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the insurance premium is paid to the insurer. Drives accounts payable scheduling in SAP S/4HANA Finance and cash flow forecasting.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; SAP S/4HANA Finance AP Module

attributes.name: reinsurance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer has placed reinsurance for this policy. Relevant for large-value cargo policies where the insurer's net retention is limited. Affects claim recovery timelines and insurer solvency risk assessment.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; Lloyd's Market Association Reinsurance Clauses

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the policy is due for renewal. Used to trigger renewal negotiations, premium reviews, and coverage reassessment. Typically aligns with or precedes the expiry_date.
attributes.references: IFRS 17 Insurance Contracts; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

attributes.name: special_conditions
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing policy-specific endorsements, exclusions, warranties, or special clauses that modify the standard Institute Cargo Clauses terms. Examples include temperature warranty for perishables, packing warranty, or exclusion of specific trade lanes.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Cargo Insurance Guidelines

attributes.name: subrogation_rights
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insurer retains the right of subrogation to pursue recovery from liable third parties (carriers, handlers, customs authorities) after settling a claim. When True, Transport Shipping must cooperate with insurer recovery actions and preserve evidence.
attributes.references: CMR Convention Article 37; IATA Warsaw-Montreal Convention Article 37; IMO Hague-Visby Rules

attributes.name: survey_required_threshold_amount
attributes.description: Minimum claim value (in coverage_limit_currency) above which an independent cargo survey report is mandatory before the insurer will process the claim. Below this threshold, claims may be settled on documentary evidence alone.
attributes.references: Institute Cargo Clauses — Lloyd's Market Association; IATA Cargo Claims Handling Manual

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim policy record was last modified in the Transport Shipping data platform. Updated on every write operation. Used for change data capture, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5(2) Accountability; ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems

domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all revenue transactions, invoicing, freight audit and payment, payment processing, and accounts receivable across all service lines. Owns customer invoices, carrier payables, COD collections, credit notes, dispute resolution, charge-back management, and revenue recognition aligned to IFRS 15. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA Finance and Coupa for end-to-end procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.

products.name: invoice
products.description: Master billing document issued to customers for logistics services rendered across all service lines (express parcel, freight forwarding, customs brokerage, warehousing, e-commerce fulfillment). Captures invoice header data including invoice number, invoice date, due date, billing period, currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, invoice status (draft, issued, sent, partially_paid, paid, overdue, disputed, cancelled, written_off), invoice type (standard, proforma, credit_note, debit_note, consolidated, recurring), payment terms (NET30, NET60, COD, prepaid), IFRS 15 revenue recognition status, SAP S/4HANA document reference, and originating service line. SSOT for all customer-facing billing documents.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the invoice record. Primary key. TRANSACTION_HEADER role inferred.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master contract or service agreement under which this invoice was generated. Links invoice to contractual terms, pricing, and SLA commitments.

attributes.name: bill_to_address_book_id

attributes.name: bill_to_contact_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.contact. Business justification: Invoice-to-contact billing workflow: logistics billing teams direct invoice delivery, payment chasing, and dispute escalation to a specific billing contact. bill_to_name is a denormalized contact name

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.account. Business justification: Invoice should reference the billing account master (billing.account) for in-domain linking. Currently invoice only has customer_account_id pointing to customer domain. The billing.account product is

attributes.name: carrier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.carrier. Business justification: Invoices for carrier-provided transport services (e.g., carrier haulage, carrier-direct bookings) require carrier reference for service delivery tracking, dispute resolution, and carrier performance r

attributes.name: lane_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.lane. Business justification: Invoices bill shipments moving on specific lanes. Lane determines pricing structure, transit time commitments, and service level. Essential for invoice validation, lane revenue analysis, pricing dispu

attributes.name: originating_agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Agent-originated shipments generate invoices that must track the originating agent for commission calculation, agent performance reporting, and revenue attribution by sales channel. Critical for agent

attributes.name: payment_term_id

attributes.name: service_corridor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to route.service_corridor. Business justification: Invoices for corridor-based services (hub-to-hub networks, regional express). Required for corridor profitability analysis, service product revenue tracking, and network design ROI assessment. Common

attributes.name: sla_entitlement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.sla_entitlement. Business justification: SLA-based billing: logistics invoices for SLA-governed shipments reference the applicable SLA entitlement to apply penalty deductions or incentive credits (penalty_rate_pct, incentive_rate_pct). Billi

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Additional adjustments applied to the invoice. Includes surcharges, fuel adjustment factors (BAF), currency adjustment factors, and other miscellaneous charges or credits.

attributes.name: amount_outstanding
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on the invoice. Calculated as total_amount minus amount_paid. Used for accounts receivable reporting and collections.

attributes.name: amount_paid
attributes.description: Total amount received from customer to date. Used to calculate outstanding balance and track partial payments.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the period covered by this invoice. Relevant for consolidated and recurring invoices that cover a range of services.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the period covered by this invoice. Relevant for consolidated and recurring invoices that cover a range of services.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User identifier of the person or system that created this invoice record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this invoice record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice. Determines currency for subtotal, tax, discount, and total amounts.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the invoice was or will be delivered to the customer. Email is electronic delivery; postal_mail is physical mail; EDI is electronic data interchange; customer_portal is self-service download; fax is facsimile transmission.

attributes.name: discount_amount

attributes.name: dispute_date

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: credit_note_reference

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the disputed amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_rating
attributes.description: Customer-provided satisfaction rating for the dispute resolution process, typically on a scale of 1-5 or 1-10. Captured via post-resolution survey.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA or UN/LOCODE for the shipment destination location associated with the disputed charges.

attributes.name: dispute_category

attributes.name: dispute_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dispute. Values: open (newly raised, awaiting review), under_review (being investigated by billing or operations team), escalated (requires senior management or legal review), resolved_accepted (dispute validated, customer claim accepted), resolved_rejected (dispute investigated and rejected), partially_accepted (partial credit issued). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|under_review|escalated|resolved_accepted|resolved_rejected|partially_accepted|withdrawn|pending_customer_response|pending_carrier_response — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispute_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispute by root cause. Values: rate_dispute (incorrect rate applied), weight_dispute (chargeable weight calculation error), service_failure (service not delivered as promised), duplicate_charge (same charge billed multiple times), unauthorized_surcharge (surcharge applied without authorization), sla_breach_deduction (customer claims SLA breach and requests deduction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: rate_dispute|weight_dispute|service_failure|duplicate_charge|unauthorized_surcharge|sla_breach_deduction|customs_duty_dispute|dimensional_weight_dispute|fuel_surcharge_dispute|accessorial_charge_dispute — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: disputed_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount being disputed by the customer. Represents the portion of the invoice that the customer challenges as incorrect.

attributes.name: disputed_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight value that the customer claims is correct, if the dispute is related to weight calculation discrepancies.

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Numeric indicator of how many times the dispute has been escalated. 0 = no escalation, 1 = first escalation (supervisor), 2 = second escalation (manager), 3+ = senior management or legal.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the dispute was escalated beyond the initial assigned team (e.g., high value, customer VIP status, complex legal issue, repeated dispute).

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA Finance to which the dispute resolution amount is posted (e.g., revenue adjustment account, bad debt account).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments related to the dispute. Used for supplementary information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: Three-letter IATA or UN/LOCODE for the shipment origin location associated with the disputed charges.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for dispute resolution based on customer tier, disputed amount, or business impact. Values: low, medium, high, critical.

attributes.name: raised_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the dispute was submitted. Values: email, phone, web_portal (customer self-service portal), edi (Electronic Data Interchange), salesforce_case (CRM service case), manual_entry (internal team entry).

attributes.name: raised_date
attributes.description: The date the dispute was formally raised by the customer or internal team. Represents the business event timestamp for dispute initiation.

attributes.name: reason_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the customer or internal team explaining the reason for the dispute. Captures detailed justification and supporting context.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible unique reference number assigned to the dispute for tracking and communication purposes. Format: DSP-XXXXXXXXXX.

attributes.name: resolution_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount credited or adjusted as a result of the dispute resolution. May be equal to, less than, or zero relative to disputed_amount.

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date the dispute was formally resolved and closed. Represents the business event timestamp for dispute closure.

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the investigation findings, resolution rationale, and actions taken. Provides audit trail for dispute outcome.

attributes.name: resolution_type
attributes.description: The type of resolution action taken. Values: full_credit (entire disputed amount credited), partial_credit (portion of disputed amount credited), no_credit (dispute rejected, no adjustment), rate_adjustment (rate corrected and invoice adjusted), rebill (invoice cancelled and reissued), waiver (charge waived as goodwill gesture).

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the underlying root cause of the dispute (e.g., system error, manual entry mistake, rate table outdated, service failure). Used for trend analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: service_failure_type
attributes.description: Specific type of service failure if dispute_type is service_failure (e.g., late_delivery, damaged_goods, lost_shipment, incorrect_routing, missed_pickup). Used for operational performance analysis.

attributes.name: shipment_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the shipment associated with the disputed charges. May reference AWB, BOL, or internal shipment tracking number.

attributes.name: sla_breach_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether the dispute resolution exceeded the SLA target resolution date. True if breached, False otherwise.

attributes.name: sla_target_resolution_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Resolution Date
attributes.description: The target date by which the dispute must be resolved per the customer SLA or internal policy. Calculated from dispute_raised_date plus SLA resolution window.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dispute record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

products.name: billing_account

Distinct from the customer identity record (owned by the customer domain), this entity captures billing-specific attributes: billing account number, billing currency, payment terms (NET30, NET60, prepaid, COD), credit limit, credit status (active, suspended, on_hold, blacklisted), billing cycle (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, on-demand), invoice delivery method (email, EDI, portal, post), tax registration number (VAT/GST), tax exemption status, billing address, preferred payment method, dunning profile, and SAP S/4HANA customer account code. SSOT for billing configuration per customer.

attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing account if this account is part of a hierarchical billing structure. Used for consolidated invoicing and corporate account management.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Account currently has payment_terms as STRING. This should be normalized to reference billing.payment_term master table. The payment_term_id FK allows joining to get code, name, net_days, discount ter

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.tax_schedule. Business justification: A billing account has a default tax schedule that governs the applicable tax rules, rates, and jurisdictions for all invoices generated under that account. This is standard in logistics billing where

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name for the billing account, typically reflecting the customer legal entity or division name for this billing relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Customer Account Master

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique billing account number used in invoices, statements, and customer communications. This is the business identifier for the billing relationship.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Customer Account Master

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing account. Active accounts can transact and be invoiced. Suspended accounts have temporary restrictions due to payment issues. On-hold accounts are pending review. Closed accounts are terminated. Blacklisted accounts are permanently blocked due to fraud or severe non-compliance.

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing account based on customer segment and billing complexity. Corporate accounts typically have negotiated terms, individual accounts are retail customers, government accounts follow public sector procurement rules, and partner accounts are for strategic alliances.

attributes.name: auto_pay_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment processing is enabled for this account. When true, invoices are automatically charged to the preferred payment method on the due date.

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this account is billed. All invoices and payments for this account are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: SAP business area code representing the service line or division (e.g., express parcel, freight forwarding, contract logistics) for internal P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity within Transport Shipping that owns this billing relationship. Used for financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: consolidated_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account participates in consolidated billing where multiple accounts or locations are invoiced together under a master account.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dunning_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections reminders) is blocked for this account. True when account is in dispute resolution, under special payment arrangement, or managed by dedicated account manager.

attributes.name: dunning_profile
attributes.description: Collections strategy profile defining the escalation sequence and tone for overdue payment reminders. Standard for typical accounts. Aggressive for high-risk accounts. Gentle for strategic customers. VIP for top-tier accounts with relationship managers. Legal for accounts in litigation.

attributes.description: Date when this billing account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Once set, no new transactions can be posted to this account.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this billing account became active and eligible for transactions and invoicing. Marks the beginning of the billing relationship.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default general ledger account code in the chart of accounts to which revenue from this billing account is posted. Typically an accounts receivable control account.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Primary method by which invoices are delivered to the customer. Email for electronic PDF delivery. EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated system-to-system transmission. Portal for customer self-service download. Post for physical mail. Fax for legacy customers.

attributes.name: invoice_email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address to which electronic invoices are sent. May differ from the customer contact email if invoices go to accounts payable department.

attributes.name: last_invoice_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent invoice generated for this billing account. Used for billing cycle tracking and customer service inquiries.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent payment received from this billing account. Used for credit monitoring and collections management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional billing account information, special instructions, payment arrangements, or historical context not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted for paperless billing. When true, all invoices and statements are delivered electronically only, with no postal mail.

attributes.name: preferred_payment_method
attributes.description: Customer preferred payment instrument. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for US bank transfers. Wire transfer for international payments. Credit card for smaller accounts. Check for traditional payment. Direct debit for automated recurring payments.

attributes.name: sap_customer_account_code
attributes.description: Customer account number in SAP S/4HANA Finance system. Used for integration and reconciliation between lakehouse and ERP system of record.

attributes.name: tax_exemption_certificate_number

attributes.name: tax_exemption_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing account is subject to standard taxation, fully exempt (e.g., government entities, non-profits), or partially exempt for specific service types.

attributes.name: tax_registration_number
attributes.description: Customer tax registration identifier such as VAT (Value Added Tax) number in EU, GST (Goods and Services Tax) number in other jurisdictions, or EIN (Employer Identification Number) in US. Used for tax compliance and invoice generation.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing account record was last modified. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and data synchronization.

products.name: tax_schedule
products.description: Reference master defining applicable tax rules, rates, and jurisdictions for logistics billing. Captures tax schedule code, tax type (VAT, GST, WHT, customs duty, excise, service tax), jurisdiction (country, state/province, free trade zone), tax rate percentage, tax basis (freight value, declared value, CIF value, DDP value), applicable service types, exemption categories, effective date, expiry date, regulatory authority reference, and SAP S/4HANA tax condition type. Supports multi-jurisdictional tax compliance for cross-border shipments and ensures correct tax calculation on customer invoices.

attributes.name: tax_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the tax schedule record. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types to which this tax schedule applies (e.g., express_parcel, air_freight, ocean_freight, road_freight, rail_freight, warehousing, customs_brokerage, last_mile_delivery).
attributes.references: IATA (International Air Transport Association), IMO (International Maritime Organization)

attributes.name: compound_tax_flag
