attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax schedule record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code in which the minimum and maximum taxable amounts are denominated.

attributes.name: destination_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the goods destination, relevant for destination-based tax calculations. Nullable if not destination-dependent.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this tax schedule becomes active and applicable to transactions. Must be on or before the transaction date for the schedule to apply.

attributes.name: exemption_category
attributes.description: Category or code identifying the type of tax exemption that may apply (e.g., diplomatic, humanitarian, re-export, AEO certified, C-TPAT certified). Nullable if no exemption applies.
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), C-TPAT (Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism), AEO (Authorized Economic Operator)

attributes.name: exemption_certificate_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a tax exemption certificate must be provided to apply this schedule. True if certificate is required, False otherwise.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tax schedule ceases to be applicable. Nullable for schedules with indefinite validity.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which tax amounts calculated using this schedule are posted in the financial system.
attributes.references: IFRS, SAP S/4HANA Finance, SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act)

attributes.name: hs_code_range_end
attributes.description: Ending HS Code in the range of commodity codes to which this tax schedule applies. Nullable if not commodity-specific.

attributes.name: hs_code_range_start
attributes.description: Starting HS Code in the range of commodity codes to which this tax schedule applies. Nullable if not commodity-specific.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the tax jurisdiction country where this tax schedule applies.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or regional subdivision within the country where this tax schedule applies. Nullable for country-level taxes.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_zone_type
attributes.description: Type of economic or customs zone. FTZ (Free Trade Zone), ICD (Inland Container Depot), CFS (Container Freight Station), or special economic zone with distinct tax treatment.
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), FMC (Federal Maritime Commission)

attributes.name: maximum_taxable_amount
attributes.description: Maximum transaction amount threshold above which this tax schedule does not apply or a different schedule takes effect. Nullable if no maximum threshold exists.

attributes.name: minimum_taxable_amount
attributes.description: Minimum transaction amount threshold below which this tax schedule does not apply. Nullable if no minimum threshold exists.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information, special instructions, or clarifications regarding the application of this tax schedule.

attributes.name: origin_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code of the goods origin, relevant for preferential tax treatment under trade agreements. Nullable if not origin-dependent.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3, WCO Rules of Origin

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric rank used to determine precedence when multiple tax schedules could apply to the same transaction. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: regulatory_authority
attributes.description: Name of the government or regulatory body that mandates this tax schedule (e.g., IRS, HMRC, GST Council, Customs Authority).
attributes.references: WCO (World Customs Organization), Local Tax Authority

attributes.name: regulatory_reference_number
attributes.description: Official reference number, gazette notification, or legal citation from the regulatory authority that establishes this tax schedule.

attributes.name: reverse_charge_applicable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether reverse charge mechanism applies, where the recipient of goods or services is responsible for tax payment instead of the supplier. True if reverse charge applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: EU VAT Directive, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: sap_tax_code
attributes.description: SAP tax code identifier used in SAP S/4HANA for GL posting and tax reporting. Links to SAP tax determination logic.

attributes.name: sap_tax_condition_type
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA tax condition type code used for integration with the financial system. Maps this tax schedule to SAP pricing and billing configuration.

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the tax schedule used in billing and invoicing systems. Externally known reference code.

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the tax schedule for business user identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: tax_basis
attributes.description: The valuation basis on which the tax is calculated. CIF (Cost Insurance and Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid), FOB (Free on Board), EXW (Ex Works), or other Incoterms-based valuation.

attributes.name: tax_rate_percentage
attributes.description: The applicable tax rate expressed as a percentage (e.g., 15.0000 for 15%). Supports up to four decimal places for precision in multi-jurisdictional tax calculations.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_category
attributes.description: Category used for grouping tax amounts in statutory tax returns and regulatory reports (e.g., domestic sales, export sales, import duties, inter-state supplies).
attributes.references: IFRS 15, Local Tax Authority Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: tax_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax schedule. Active schedules are in use, inactive are retired, pending are awaiting approval, superseded have been replaced by newer schedules.

attributes.name: tax_type
attributes.description: Classification of the tax applied. VAT (Value Added Tax), GST (Goods and Services Tax), WHT (Withholding Tax), customs duty, excise tax, or service tax.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 (Revenue from Contracts with Customers), WCO (World Customs Organization), WTO (World Trade Organization)

attributes.name: trade_agreement_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bilateral or multilateral trade agreement under which preferential tax rates or exemptions apply (e.g., USMCA, EU-UK TCA, RCEP). Nullable if no trade agreement applies.
attributes.references: WTO (World Trade Organization), Regional Trade Agreements

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this tax schedule record.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this tax schedule record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule represents a withholding tax that must be deducted at source. True if withholding tax applies, False otherwise.
attributes.references: OECD Model Tax Convention, Local Tax Authority Regulations

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this tax schedule record in the system.

products.name: payment_term
products.description: Reference master defining standard payment terms offered to customers and applied to carrier payables. Captures payment term code, payment term description (NET30, NET60, NET90, COD, prepaid, 2/10 NET30), number of days, early payment discount percentage, early payment discount days, late payment penalty rate, applicable customer segments, applicable service lines, currency restrictions, and SAP S/4HANA payment term key. Provides standardized payment term taxonomy used across invoice issuance, contract agreements, and carrier payable management.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment term. Primary key.

attributes.name: applicable_customer_segments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer segments to which this payment term is applicable (e.g., enterprise, SMB, government, retail). Used to enforce eligibility rules during contract setup and invoicing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: enterprise|smb|government|retail|ecommerce|3pl|freight_forwarder — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: applicable_service_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service lines to which this payment term applies (e.g., express_parcel, freight_forwarding, warehousing, customs_brokerage, ecommerce_fulfillment). Ensures payment terms align with service-specific billing policies. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express_parcel|freight_forwarding|warehousing|customs_brokerage|ecommerce_fulfillment|contract_logistics|last_mile — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the finance manager or credit manager who approved this payment term for use. Null if approval is not required or pending. Supports governance and compliance.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term was approved for use. Null if approval is not required or pending. Supports governance and compliance audit trail.

attributes.name: auto_dunning_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (collections reminder) processes are enabled for invoices using this payment term. True for standard credit terms. False for prepaid or special arrangement terms.

attributes.name: cod_collection_method
attributes.description: Specifies the acceptable payment collection method for COD (Cash on Delivery) terms. Applicable only when type is cash_on_delivery. Not_applicable for non-COD terms.

attributes.name: coupa_payment_term_code
attributes.description: Payment term code used in Coupa Procurement and Spend Management system for carrier payables and supplier invoice processing. Ensures alignment between customer receivables and carrier payables payment terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_restrictions
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes for which this payment term is valid (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Null or empty if the term applies to all currencies. Used to enforce currency-specific payment policies.

attributes.name: default_for_customer_segment
attributes.description: Customer segment for which this payment term is the default option during contract setup or customer onboarding. Null if not a default term. Streamlines contract creation workflows.

attributes.name: default_for_service_line
attributes.description: Service line for which this payment term is the default option during contract setup or service agreement creation. Null if not a default term. Ensures service-specific billing alignment.

attributes.name: dunning_start_days_after_due
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dunning Start Days After Due Date
attributes.description: Number of days after the invoice due date when automated dunning (collections reminder) process begins. Null if auto_dunning_enabled_flag is false.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be made to qualify for the early payment discount (e.g., 10 for 2/10 NET30 terms). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered if payment is made within the early payment discount period (e.g., 2.00 for 2% discount in 2/10 NET30 terms). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this payment term is no longer valid for new contracts or invoices. Null for open-ended terms. Used to phase out deprecated payment terms while preserving historical data.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this payment term becomes valid and available for use in contracts and invoicing. Supports time-based payment term changes and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA Finance to which revenue or payables using this payment term are posted. Supports financial reporting and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of additional days after the net due date before late payment penalties are applied. Provides a buffer period for customers. Zero or null if no grace period is offered.

attributes.name: installment_count
attributes.description: Number of installment payments allowed under this payment term. Applicable for installment-based payment terms. Null or 1 for single-payment terms.

attributes.name: installment_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between each installment payment. Applicable for installment-based payment terms. Null for single-payment terms.

attributes.name: late_payment_penalty_rate
attributes.description: Percentage penalty or interest rate applied to overdue balances after the net payment due date. Expressed as an annual percentage rate (APR) or per-period rate. Null if no late payment penalty applies.

attributes.name: maximum_credit_limit
attributes.description: Maximum outstanding accounts receivable balance allowed for customers using this payment term. Enforces credit exposure limits. Null if no limit applies (e.g., for prepaid or COD terms).

attributes.name: minimum_credit_score_required
attributes.description: Minimum credit risk score a customer must have to be eligible for this payment term. Used to enforce credit policy and reduce bad debt risk. Null if no minimum score is required.

attributes.name: net_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date by which full payment is due. Standard payment window for the term (e.g., 30 for NET30, 60 for NET60). Zero for immediate payment terms like COD or PREPAID.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or exceptions related to this payment term. Used by finance and credit teams for context and clarification.

attributes.name: payment_term_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code representing the payment term (e.g., NET30, NET60, NET90, COD, PREPAID, 2_10_NET30). Used as the business identifier across invoicing, contracts, and carrier payable management.

attributes.name: payment_term_description
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of the payment term, including conditions, discount eligibility, and any special instructions. Provides clarity for finance teams and customers.

attributes.name: payment_term_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the payment term (e.g., Net 30 Days, Cash on Delivery, Prepaid, 2% 10 Net 30). Human-readable label used in customer-facing documents and internal reports.

attributes.name: payment_term_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment term. Active terms are available for use in new contracts and invoices. Inactive or deprecated terms are retained for historical reference but not available for new transactions.

attributes.name: payment_term_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment term based on its structure and purpose. Determines how the term is applied in billing and collections workflows.

attributes.name: prepayment_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether full payment must be received before service delivery or shipment. True for prepaid terms. False for post-service payment terms.

attributes.name: requires_credit_approval_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether assignment of this payment term to a customer requires credit manager approval. True for extended terms (e.g., NET90) or high-risk terms. False for standard or prepaid terms.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Specifies the IFRS 15 revenue recognition method associated with this payment term. Point_in_time for immediate recognition (e.g., COD, prepaid). Over_time or deferred for extended terms. Guides accounting treatment.
attributes.references: IFRS 15 Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: sap_payment_term_key
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric key used in SAP S/4HANA Finance to represent this payment term. Enables seamless integration with SAP AR, AP, and revenue recognition modules.

attributes.name: updated_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last updated this payment term record. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment term record was last modified. Supports audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: usage_count
attributes.description: Total number of active customer accounts, contracts, or invoices currently using this payment term. Provides insight into term popularity and impact of changes. Updated periodically via batch process.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this payment term record in the system. Supports audit trail and accountability.

products.name: cycle
products.description: Master configuration record defining the billing cycle parameters for a billing account or customer segment. Captures billing cycle code, cycle name, cycle frequency (daily, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, quarterly, on-demand), cycle start day, cycle end day, invoice generation trigger (cycle-end, shipment-completion, milestone, manual), invoice delivery lead time (days), payment due offset (days from invoice date), applicable service lines, applicable customer tiers, and effective date range. Governs when invoices are generated and dispatched for each customer billing account.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing cycle configuration record.

attributes.name: applicable_customer_tiers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of customer tier codes or segments to which this billing cycle applies (e.g., ENTERPRISE, SMB, RETAIL, PLATINUM, GOLD). Empty means applicable to all customer tiers.

attributes.name: applicable_service_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service lines to which this billing cycle applies (e.g., Express Parcel, Air Freight, Ocean Freight, LTL, FTL, Warehousing, Customs Brokerage, E-Commerce Fulfillment). Empty means applicable to all service lines.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices generated under this billing cycle require manual approval before being dispatched to customers.

attributes.name: approver_role_code
attributes.description: Role code or job function authorized to approve invoices generated under this billing cycle (e.g., BILLING_MANAGER, FINANCE_CONTROLLER). Null if no approval required.

attributes.name: auto_invoice_generation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoices are automatically generated by the billing system when the trigger event occurs (True) or require manual approval (False).

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Business unit or division code to which this billing cycle belongs (e.g., EXPRESS, FREIGHT, ECOMMERCE, WAREHOUSING).

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity under which invoices are issued for this billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Company Code Structure

attributes.name: consolidation_level
attributes.description: Defines the level at which charges are consolidated into invoices for this billing cycle (e.g., shipment-level for individual AWB/BOL invoices, account-level for consolidated monthly statements).

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Default cost center code for financial reporting and cost allocation of invoices generated under this billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for invoices generated under this billing cycle (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Can be overridden at customer account level.

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the billing cycle configuration (e.g., MONTHLY_STD, WEEKLY_EXPRESS, ONDEMAND_FCL).

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the billing cycle (e.g., Standard Monthly Billing, Weekly Express Parcel Cycle).

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle configuration.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_sla_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dispute Resolution Service Level Agreement (SLA) Days
attributes.description: Target number of days for resolving billing disputes for invoices generated under this billing cycle, as defined in customer SLA agreements.

attributes.name: dunning_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated dunning (payment reminder) processes are enabled for overdue invoices generated under this billing cycle.

attributes.name: dunning_grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after payment due date before the first dunning notice is sent. Null if dunning is not enabled.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date within which payment must be received to qualify for early payment discount. Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: early_payment_discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount offered for early payment (e.g., 2% discount if paid within 10 days). Null if no early payment discount applies.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this billing cycle configuration is no longer active and cannot be assigned to new customer billing accounts. Null indicates no end date (indefinite validity).

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this billing cycle configuration becomes active and can be assigned to customer billing accounts.

attributes.name: end_day
attributes.description: Day of the month or week when the billing cycle period ends (1-31 for monthly, 1-7 for weekly). Null for on-demand cycles.

attributes.name: frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which invoices are generated for accounts assigned to this billing cycle. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|bi-weekly|monthly|quarterly|annual|on-demand — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: Default General Ledger account code for revenue posting of invoices generated under this billing cycle in SAP S/4HANA Finance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days between invoice generation and invoice delivery/dispatch to the customer.

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Default method for delivering invoices to customers under this billing cycle (e.g., email, EDI transmission, customer portal, postal mail, API push).

attributes.name: invoice_format
attributes.description: Default format for invoice delivery under this billing cycle (e.g., PDF for email, EDI-810 for Electronic Data Interchange, XML for API integration).

attributes.name: invoice_generation_trigger
attributes.description: Business event that triggers invoice generation for this billing cycle (e.g., cycle-end for periodic billing, shipment-completion for transactional billing, pod-confirmed for proof-of-delivery based billing).

attributes.name: late_payment_fee_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage fee applied to overdue invoice amounts for late payment under this billing cycle. Null if no late fees apply.

attributes.name: minimum_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Minimum invoice amount threshold below which invoices are not generated and charges are carried forward to the next billing cycle. Null if no minimum applies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle configuration record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special instructions, or business context related to this billing cycle configuration.

attributes.name: payment_due_offset_days
attributes.description: Number of days from invoice date when payment is due, defining the payment terms for this billing cycle (e.g., 30 for Net 30, 15 for Net 15).

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Default profit center code for profitability analysis of invoices generated under this billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method for recognizing revenue for invoices generated under this billing cycle, aligned to IFRS 15 performance obligation satisfaction (e.g., point-in-time for express delivery, over-time for warehousing, pod-based for proof-of-delivery confirmation).

attributes.name: start_day
attributes.description: Day of the month or week when the billing cycle period begins (1-31 for monthly, 1-7 for weekly). Null for on-demand cycles.

attributes.name: tax_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method for calculating and displaying tax on invoices generated under this billing cycle (e.g., inclusive for tax-included pricing, exclusive for tax added at invoice time, reverse-charge for VAT reverse charge mechanism).

products.name: performance_obligation
products.description: Master reference table for performance_obligation. Referenced by performance_obligation_id.

attributes.description: Primary key for performance_obligation

attributes.name: agreement_id

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer to whom the obligation is owed.

attributes.name: parent_performance_obligation_id

attributes.name: sla_commitment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.contract_sla_commitment. Business justification: Performance obligations in revenue recognition often map to specific SLA commitments (delivery milestones, service completion events). Required for ASC 606 compliance and milestone-based revenue recog

attributes.name: sla_entitlement_id

attributes.name: allocated_amount

attributes.name: billed_amount

attributes.name: billing_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency or trigger for invoicing the obligation.

attributes.name: collection_method

attributes.name: collection_status
attributes.description: Current status of cash collection for the obligation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time when the performance obligation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three‑letter ISO 4217 code of the currency used for the obligation.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Monetary discount granted against the obligation.

attributes.name: discount_type
attributes.description: Method by which the discount is applied.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the customer must satisfy the performance obligation.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the performance obligation ends or expires; null for open‑ended contracts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: is_partial_obligation
attributes.description: True if the obligation represents a portion of a larger contract obligation.

attributes.name: metric_actual_value
attributes.description: Actual measured value of the performance metric to date.

attributes.name: metric_target_value
attributes.description: Target value for the performance metric that triggers revenue recognition.

attributes.name: metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the performance metric.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free‑form field for additional remarks or special conditions.

attributes.name: obligation_number
attributes.description: External identifier assigned to the performance obligation by the billing system.

attributes.name: obligation_type
attributes.description: Category of the promised deliverable underlying the obligation.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms governing when payment is due (e.g., Net 30).

attributes.name: performance_metric
attributes.description: Metric used to measure progress toward satisfying the obligation (e.g., shipped_weight, miles_travelled).

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Free‑form text describing the goods or services promised.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_status

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_date
attributes.description: Date on which revenue for the obligation was recognized.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize revenue for this obligation.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_status
attributes.description: Current status of revenue recognition for the obligation.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax component applied to the obligation amount.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Code representing the tax jurisdiction and rate applied.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate monetary value of the performance obligation at contract inception.

attributes.name: unbilled_amount
attributes.description: Remaining monetary value of the obligation that has not yet been invoiced.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date‑time of the most recent update to the performance obligation record.

domains.name: procurement
domains.description: Manages sourcing, supplier onboarding, purchase order lifecycle, carrier procurement, and spend management for operational and capital expenditures. Owns supplier master, RFQ/RFP processes, purchase orders, invoice matching, and contract compliance monitoring. Powered by Coupa and integrates with SAP S/4HANA Finance for budget control and with fleet and warehouse domains for asset procurement.

products.name: supplier
products.description: Master record for all suppliers, vendors, and service providers engaged by Transport Shipping. Captures supplier identity, classification (carrier, fuel supplier, IT vendor, facility lessor, etc.), onboarding status, risk tier, AEO/C-TPAT certification status, payment terms, preferred currency, tax identifiers, and geographic coverage. This is the SSOT for supplier identity within the procurement domain and serves as the anchor for all sourcing, purchasing, and spend management activities. Sourced from Coupa Supplier Management module.
products.reference: Coupa Supplier Master / SAP Vendor Master

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.agent. Business justification: Suppliers in international trade often designate customs brokers or freight forwarders (agents) for cross-border shipments. Tracks the preferred agent relationship for customs clearance coordination,

attributes.name: tpl_provider_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.tpl_provider. Business justification: Many suppliers in logistics ARE 3PL providers offering warehousing/distribution services; this link enables dual-role tracking (supplier of goods AND provider of logistics services), essential for int

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: First line of the supplier's primary business address (street number and name).

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Second line of the supplier's primary business address (suite, floor, building name).

attributes.name: aeo_certification_number
attributes.description: The unique AEO certification identifier issued by the customs authority.

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier holds AEO certification, demonstrating compliance with customs and supply chain security standards. AEO status enables expedited customs clearance and reduced inspections.
attributes.references: WCO SAFE Framework (World Customs Organization Secure and Facilitate Global Trade)

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality of the supplier's primary business address.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current master service agreement or contract with the supplier expires. Used for contract renewal planning and supplier relationship management.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the supplier's primary business address (e.g., USA, GBR, CHN, DEU).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this supplier record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: ctpat_certification_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) Certification Number
attributes.description: The unique C-TPAT certification identifier issued by US Customs and Border Protection.

attributes.name: ctpat_certified

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade name or doing-business-as name if different from legal name.

attributes.name: duns_number

attributes.name: geographic_coverage

attributes.name: iso_14001_certified

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified

attributes.name: last_audit_date

attributes.name: minority_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the supplier is certified as a minority-owned business enterprise (MBE). Used for diversity and inclusion reporting and supplier diversity programs.

attributes.name: next_audit_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next supplier audit or compliance review.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone

attributes.name: service_capabilities

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual supply relationship between a supplier and an item. It captures the approved supplier list (ASL) and supplier item catalog maintained in procurement systems (Coupa, SAP SRM). Each record links one supplier to one item with pricing, lead time, minimum order quantities, and contract terms that exist only in the context of this specific supplier-item pairing. This is the foundation for sourcing decisions, RFQ evaluation, and preferred supplier management.. Existence Justification: In Transport Shipping's procurement operations, suppliers provide multiple items (fuel, packaging materials, IT equipment, facility services, vehicle parts), and each item can be sourced from multiple suppliers to ensure supply chain resilience and competitive pricing. The supply agreement (also known as Approved Supplier List or Supplier Item Catalog in Coupa/SAP SRM) is a recognized business entity that procurement teams actively manage, with each supplier-item pairing having distinct pricing, lead times, minimum order quantities, and contract terms.

attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where carrier provides service (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU, CHN).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_border_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier handles cross-border international shipments including customs clearance coordination.

attributes.name: customs_brokerage_included
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides in-house customs brokerage services as part of their offering.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier is certified to handle dangerous goods (hazmat) shipments.
attributes.references: IMDG Code, ICAO Technical Instructions, 49 CFR

attributes.name: dg_classes_handled
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of UN dangerous goods classes the carrier is certified to handle (e.g., Class 1 Explosives, Class 3 Flammable Liquids, Class 8 Corrosives). Null if not DG certified.
attributes.references: UN Recommendations on the Transport of Dangerous Goods

attributes.name: edi_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier supports EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) for automated document exchange (e.g., 214, 210, 990 transaction sets).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile became effective and available for operational use.

attributes.name: equipment_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of equipment types operated: dry_van, reefer, flatbed, tanker, container_20ft, container_40ft, container_40ft_hc, aircraft_freighter, rail_car, barge. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dry_van|reefer|flatbed|tanker|container_20ft|container_40ft|container_40ft_hc|aircraft_freighter|rail_car|barge|lowboy|chassis — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO 6346 Container Type Codes, DOT Equipment Classifications

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile expires or is scheduled for review. Null if open-ended.

attributes.name: geographic_coverage_scope
attributes.description: Overall geographic reach of the carrier: global (worldwide), regional (multi-country region), national (single country), local (city/metro), or trade-lane-specific (dedicated corridors).

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier offers cargo insurance coverage as part of their service or through a partner.

attributes.name: last_mile_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides last-mile delivery services to final consignee addresses (residential or commercial).

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: Date when this carrier profile was last reviewed and validated by the carrier management team.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this carrier profile record was last modified.

attributes.name: max_insurance_value_usd
attributes.description: Maximum cargo value in USD that can be insured per shipment. Null if insurance not available.

attributes.name: max_volume_capacity_cbm
attributes.description: Maximum single shipment volume capacity in cubic meters (CBM) that this carrier can handle.

attributes.name: max_weight_capacity_kg
attributes.description: Maximum single shipment weight capacity in kilograms that this carrier can handle.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the carrier profile indicating availability for shipment assignment and booking.

attributes.name: otd_percentage
attributes.description: Historical on-time delivery performance percentage for this carrier profile (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated from actual shipment data.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Internal performance tier classification based on OTD (On-Time Delivery), claims ratio, and service quality: platinum (best), gold, silver, bronze, or standard.

attributes.name: profile_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier code for this carrier profile used in operational systems and partner integrations.

attributes.name: profile_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name for this carrier operational profile (e.g., 'Global Express Air', 'Regional LTL Network').

attributes.name: profile_type
attributes.description: Classification of the carrier operational model: asset-based (owns fleet), non-asset-based (broker/3PL), hybrid, NVOCC (Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier), or freight forwarder.

attributes.name: quality_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of quality and compliance certifications held by the carrier (e.g., ISO 9001, C-TPAT, AEO, TAPA, GDP).
attributes.references: ISO 9001, C-TPAT, AEO, TAPA, GDP Standards

attributes.name: real_time_tracking_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier provides real-time GPS or milestone-based shipment tracking visibility.

attributes.name: regions_served
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of geographic regions where carrier operates (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East, Latin America, Africa).

attributes.name: security_rating
attributes.description: Security risk rating assigned to the carrier based on compliance, incident history, and certifications: high (best), medium, low, or not rated.

attributes.name: service_types
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of service types offered: FTL (Full Truckload), LTL (Less Than Truckload), FCL (Full Container Load), LCL (Less Than Container Load), express, economy, standard, same_day, next_day, deferred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ftl|ltl|fcl|lcl|express|economy|standard|same_day|next_day|deferred|white_glove — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sustainability_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier holds sustainability or environmental certifications (e.g., SmartWay, ISO 14001, carbon neutral).

attributes.name: temperature_controlled_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the carrier has temperature-controlled (reefer) capability for cold chain shipments.

attributes.name: temperature_range_max_celsius
attributes.description: Maximum temperature in Celsius that carrier can maintain for temperature-controlled shipments. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: temperature_range_min_celsius
attributes.description: Minimum temperature in Celsius that carrier can maintain for temperature-controlled shipments. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: teu_capacity
attributes.description: Container capacity measured in TEU (Twenty-foot Equivalent Units) for ocean carriers. Null for non-ocean modes.

attributes.name: tracking_granularity
attributes.description: Level of tracking detail provided: real-time GPS, milestone-based (pickup/in-transit/delivery), daily update, manual, or none.

attributes.name: trade_lanes_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major trade lanes or corridors served (e.g., Transpacific, Transatlantic, Asia-Europe, Intra-Asia, US-Mexico).

attributes.name: transport_modes
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport modes this carrier operates: air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal, barge, courier. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: air|ocean|road|rail|multimodal|barge|courier|parcel — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA, IMO, DOT Transport Mode Standards

products.name: agent
products.description: Master record for freight agents, general sales agents (GSAs), handling agents, and ground handling agents in the Transport Shipping partner network. Captures agent legal name, agent type (freight agent, GSA, handling agent, customs agent, co-loader), IATA agent code, FIATA membership, country and city of operation, principal carrier relationships, bonding and financial guarantee status, commission structure type, and operational scope. Agents are distinct from carriers — they act as intermediaries and representatives rather than transport operators.

attributes.name: agent_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the freight agent, general sales agent (GSA), handling agent, or ground handling agent in the Transport Shipping partner network.

attributes.name: parent_agent_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on agent (parent_agent_id)

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to network.partner. Business justification: Agent is an external organization participating in the Transport Shipping network. The partner table is the unified master for all external organizations. Linking agent to partner enables unified part

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: The primary street address line for the agent's registered business location, including street number and name.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as suite number, building name, floor, or department for the agent's business location.

attributes.name: aeo_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds AEO certification, a trusted trader status granted by customs authorities that provides expedited clearance and reduced inspections for compliant supply chain partners.

attributes.name: agent_status
attributes.description: The current lifecycle status of the agent relationship. Active agents are authorized to conduct business; inactive agents are temporarily not operating; suspended agents have had privileges revoked pending review; pending approval agents are undergoing onboarding; terminated agents have had their relationship permanently ended.

attributes.name: agent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agent based on their primary operational role in the logistics network. Freight agents represent carriers for cargo booking; GSAs (General Sales Agents) represent airlines for sales and marketing; handling agents provide ground services at airports/ports; customs agents facilitate trade compliance; co-loaders consolidate shipments; ground handling agents provide airport ramp and terminal services.

attributes.name: bond_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the customs bond or financial guarantee held by the agent, expressed in the agent's local currency. Represents the maximum liability coverage for customs duties and taxes.

attributes.name: bond_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the bond amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: bonding_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid customs bond or financial guarantee required for handling in-bond cargo movements and customs clearance activities. Bonded status is mandatory for customs agents.

attributes.name: business_registration_number
attributes.description: The official company registration or incorporation number assigned by the government registry in the agent's country of operation, proving legal entity status.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: The primary city where the agent maintains their main operational office or headquarters.

attributes.name: commission_structure_type
attributes.description: The method by which the agent earns compensation for services rendered. Percentage commissions are based on shipment value or freight charges; flat fees are fixed per transaction; tiered structures vary by volume thresholds; hybrid combines multiple methods.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent agreement or partnership contract is scheduled to expire or was terminated. Null for open-ended agreements.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agent agreement or partnership contract became effective, marking the beginning of the authorized business relationship.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country of operation for the agent.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ctpat_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is certified under the U.S. Customs and Border Protection C-TPAT program, which validates supply chain security practices and provides trade facilitation benefits.

attributes.name: dangerous_goods_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is certified and authorized to handle dangerous goods (DG) shipments in accordance with IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations (DGR) or IMDG Code requirements.

attributes.name: fiata_member
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Federation of Freight Forwarders Associations (FIATA) Member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is a member of FIATA, the global representative body for freight forwarders and logistics providers, which provides industry standards and advocacy.

attributes.name: iata_agent_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agent Code
attributes.description: The unique numeric code assigned by IATA to accredited cargo and passenger sales agents, typically 7 or 8 digits. Required for agents handling air waybills (AWBs) and airline bookings.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of liability insurance coverage maintained by the agent for cargo loss, damage, and professional indemnity, expressed in the agent's local currency.

attributes.name: insurance_currency_code
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the insurance coverage amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: iso_9001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds ISO 9001 certification for quality management systems, demonstrating adherence to international standards for process consistency and customer satisfaction.

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent operational or compliance audit conducted on the agent's facilities, processes, and documentation practices.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this agent record was most recently updated, used for change tracking and data synchronization.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: The full legal registered name of the agent entity as it appears on official business registration documents and contracts.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next periodic audit of the agent's operations and compliance status, typically conducted annually or biennially.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional operational notes, special handling instructions, service limitations, or relationship management comments about the agent.

attributes.name: nvocc_licensed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid NVOCC license, allowing them to issue house bills of lading (HBLs) and operate as a carrier without owning vessels.

attributes.name: operational_scope
attributes.description: The geographic reach of the agent's service capabilities. Local agents serve a single city or metro area; regional agents cover multiple cities or provinces; national agents operate across an entire country; international agents have cross-border capabilities.

attributes.name: performance_rating
attributes.description: The most recent performance evaluation rating assigned to the agent based on service quality, compliance, on-time delivery (OTD), documentation accuracy, and customer satisfaction metrics.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: The postal or ZIP code for the agent's registered business address, used for mail delivery and geographic identification.

attributes.name: primary_contact_email
attributes.description: The main email address for operational communication with the agent, used for booking confirmations, documentation, and business correspondence.

attributes.name: primary_contact_phone
attributes.description: The main telephone number for reaching the agent's operations team, including country code and area code.

attributes.name: principal_carrier_relationships
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of carrier names or IATA/SCAC codes for which this agent acts as an authorized representative or sales agent. Defines the agent's network affiliations and booking authority.

attributes.name: standard_commission_rate
attributes.description: The default commission percentage or flat fee amount applied to transactions handled by the agent, expressed as a percentage (e.g., 5.00 for 5%) or monetary value depending on commission structure type.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: The agent's tax registration number or VAT identification number issued by the relevant tax authority in their country of operation, used for invoicing and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: trade_name
attributes.description: The commercial or trading name under which the agent operates in the market, which may differ from the legal name.

attributes.name: transport_modes_supported
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of transport modes the agent is authorized and equipped to handle (e.g., air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal). Indicates the agent's operational versatility across different freight types.

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The agent's official website address, providing access to service information, contact details, and online booking capabilities.

products.name: agent_appointment
products.description: Formal appointment record authorizing a freight agent or GSA to act on behalf of Transport Shipping or a carrier partner in a defined territory or for a defined service scope. Captures appointment reference, appointing party, appointed agent, territory (country/region), authorized service lines, appointment start and expiry dates, commission rate agreed, exclusivity flag, performance bond requirement, and appointment status (active, suspended, terminated). Manages the lifecycle of agent authority grants across the network.

attributes.name: agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the agent appointment record. Primary key for the agent appointment entity.

attributes.name: appointed_agent_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the freight agent or General Sales Agent (GSA) being appointed to act on behalf of the appointing party.

attributes.name: partner_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the party granting the appointment authority. May reference Transport Shipping or a carrier partner on whose behalf the appointment is made.

attributes.name: renewed_agent_appointment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on agent_appointment (renewed_agent_appointment_id)

attributes.name: aeo_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds Authorized Economic Operator (AEO) certification, demonstrating secure and compliant supply chain practices. True means certified; False means not certified.

attributes.name: appointment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment becomes active and the agent is authorized to begin operations on behalf of the appointing party.

attributes.name: appointment_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment expires and the agent authority terminates. Nullable for open-ended appointments subject to termination notice.

attributes.name: appointment_reference_number
attributes.description: External business reference number for the agent appointment, used in contracts and communications with the appointed agent.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the agent appointment. Active indicates the agent is authorized to operate; suspended indicates temporary halt of authority; terminated indicates permanent revocation; expired indicates natural end of appointment term.

attributes.name: appointment_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the appointment term expressed in months. Used for fixed-term appointments. Null for indefinite appointments.

attributes.name: appointment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the agent appointment indicating the nature of the agency relationship. GSA (General Sales Agent) represents full sales authority; freight agent handles specific services; correspondent provides local representation; sub-agent operates under another agent.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the agent appointment was formally approved by the appointing party. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: authorized_service_lines
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of service lines the agent is authorized to sell or manage. May include express parcel, air freight, ocean freight, road freight, rail freight, customs brokerage, warehousing, last-mile delivery, e-commerce fulfillment.

attributes.name: authorized_transport_modes
attributes.description: Semicolon-separated list of transport modes the agent is authorized to handle. May include air, ocean, road, rail, multimodal.

attributes.name: commission_basis
attributes.description: Basis on which the commission is calculated. Gross revenue includes all charges; net revenue excludes certain pass-through costs; margin is based on profit; per-shipment is fixed fee per transaction; tiered varies by volume thresholds.

attributes.name: commission_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which commission payments are denominated.

attributes.name: commission_rate_percent
attributes.description: Percentage commission rate paid to the agent on revenue generated within their territory and service scope. Expressed as percentage (e.g., 5.50 for 5.5%).

attributes.name: contract_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the formal contract or agreement document governing this agent appointment. May link to document management system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent appointment record was first created in the system. Immutable audit field.

attributes.name: ctpat_certification_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customs-Trade Partnership Against Terrorism (C-TPAT) Certification Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds C-TPAT certification, a US Customs and Border Protection program for supply chain security. True means certified; False means not certified.
attributes.references: US Customs and Border Protection C-TPAT Standards

attributes.name: customs_broker_license_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid customs broker license, required for handling customs clearance and trade compliance services. True means licensed; False means not licensed.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent has exclusive rights to represent the appointing party in the defined territory. True means no other agents may be appointed in the same territory for the same services; False allows multiple agents.

attributes.name: iata_accreditation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Accreditation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds valid IATA accreditation, required for handling air freight and issuing Air Waybills (AWB). True means accredited; False means not accredited.

attributes.name: iata_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Agent Code
attributes.description: IATA-issued numeric code uniquely identifying the accredited cargo agent. Required for air freight operations. Null if agent is not IATA-accredited.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Minimum liability insurance coverage amount the agent must maintain, if required. Null if no insurance is required.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the insurance coverage amount is denominated.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is required to maintain liability insurance coverage as a condition of the appointment. True requires insurance; False does not.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the agent appointment record was last updated. Updated on every modification to track change history.

attributes.name: minimum_revenue_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum revenue the agent commits to generate during the appointment term. Failure to meet this may trigger penalties or termination. Null if no minimum is specified.

attributes.name: minimum_revenue_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the minimum revenue commitment is denominated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or remarks related to the agent appointment. May include operational instructions, historical context, or exceptions.

attributes.name: nvocc_license_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier (NVOCC) License Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent holds a valid NVOCC license, required for ocean freight consolidation and issuing House Bills of Lading (HBL). True means licensed; False means not licensed.

attributes.name: performance_bond_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the performance bond or financial guarantee required from the agent, if applicable. Null if no bond is required.

attributes.name: performance_bond_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the performance bond amount is denominated.

attributes.name: performance_bond_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agent is required to post a performance bond or financial guarantee as a condition of the appointment. True requires bond; False does not.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Terms under which the appointment may be renewed at expiry. Automatic renews unless terminated; mutual consent requires both parties to agree; appointing party option allows appointing party to renew unilaterally; agent option allows agent to renew; no renewal means appointment ends at expiry.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the appointment was terminated or suspended. Null for active appointments.

attributes.name: termination_notice_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate the appointment. Null if termination is not permitted or governed by other terms.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of the reason for termination or suspension of the appointment. Populated when appointment status changes to terminated or suspended.

attributes.name: territory_country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code defining the geographic territory where the agent is authorized to operate.

attributes.name: territory_region
attributes.description: Specific region, state, province, or sub-national area within the country where the agent appointment is valid. May include multiple regions separated by semicolons.

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Granularity level of the geographic territory covered by the appointment. National covers entire country; regional covers specific provinces/states; city/port/airport/station covers specific locations.

products.name: interline_agreement
products.description: Master record for interline agreements between Transport Shipping and partner carriers enabling the exchange of traffic, co-loading, and through-billing across carrier networks. Captures agreement reference, partner carrier, agreement type (interline, code-share, blocked space, SPA — Special Prorate Agreement), transport mode, trade lanes covered, prorate methodology, revenue split terms, minimum volume commitments, IATA prorate rules reference, effective and expiry dates, and agreement status. Governs the commercial and operational terms for traffic interchange.
products.reference: Interline Agreement / SPA / Blocked Space Agreement

attributes.name: interline_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the interline agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: partner_carrier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the partner carrier organization with whom this interline agreement is established.

attributes.name: renewed_interline_agreement_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on interline_agreement (renewed_interline_agreement_id)

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the interline agreement, used in communications with partner carriers and operational systems.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interline agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|under_review — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interline agreement defining the nature of the commercial relationship. SPA = Special Prorate Agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interline|code_share|blocked_space|spa|prorate|joint_service|slot_exchange — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATA Multilateral Interline Traffic Agreements (MITA), IMO Slot Charter Agreements

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline agreement was formally approved and moved to active status.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement automatically renews at expiry unless either party provides termination notice.

attributes.name: awb_prefix_allocation
attributes.description: IATA-assigned three-digit AWB prefix(es) that may be used under this interline agreement for through-billing. Applicable to air cargo agreements.

attributes.name: billing_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which interline settlements and revenue splits are calculated and paid.

attributes.name: commitment_period
attributes.description: Time period over which the minimum volume commitment is measured and enforced.

attributes.name: confidentiality_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes a confidentiality or non-disclosure clause restricting the sharing of agreement terms.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: destination_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country codes where shipments are delivered under this agreement. May be comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional identifiers.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_method
attributes.description: Agreed method for resolving disputes arising from this interline agreement. IATA arbitration refers to IATA arbitration procedures for cargo disputes.
attributes.references: IATA Arbitration Rules, Internal Legal Standard

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this interline agreement becomes active and enforceable.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement grants exclusive interline rights to the partner carrier for the specified trade lanes or service types.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this interline agreement expires or terminates. Null if the agreement is open-ended or evergreen.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law under which this interline agreement is executed and disputes are resolved (e.g., 'New York, USA', 'England and Wales', 'Singapore').

attributes.name: iata_prorate_rule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: International Air Transport Association (IATA) Prorate Rule Reference
attributes.description: Reference to specific IATA Resolution 780 prorate rule or tariff provision governing revenue allocation for air cargo interline agreements.

attributes.name: insurance_requirement
attributes.description: Type of insurance coverage required or provided under this interline agreement for cargo in transit.
attributes.references: Internal Risk Management Policy, Institute Cargo Clauses

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interline agreement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: liability_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum liability amount per shipment or per unit weight that each carrier assumes under this interline agreement. Confidential commercial term.
attributes.references: Montreal Convention (Air), Hague-Visby Rules (Ocean), CMR Convention (Road)

attributes.name: liability_limit_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the liability limit amount.

attributes.name: minimum_volume_commitment
attributes.description: Minimum shipment volume (in TEU, tons, or shipment count depending on mode) that Transport Shipping commits to provide under this agreement within the commitment period. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, special conditions, or operational instructions related to this interline agreement.

attributes.name: origin_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or country codes where shipments originate under this agreement. May be comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional identifiers.

attributes.name: penalty_for_non_compliance
attributes.description: Description of financial or operational penalties applied if either party fails to meet volume commitments or SLA targets. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the parties conduct formal performance reviews of the interline agreement against SLA commitments and volume targets.

attributes.name: prorate_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to allocate revenue between carriers for through-shipments. IATA standard refers to IATA Resolution 780 prorate rules.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to expiry that either party must provide notice if they wish to terminate or renegotiate the agreement.

attributes.name: revenue_split_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total revenue allocated to Transport Shipping under this agreement. Remaining percentage goes to partner carrier. Confidential commercial term.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of logistics service covered under the agreement. LTL = Less Than Truckload, FTL = Full Truckload, FCL = Full Container Load, LCL = Less Than Container Load. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: express|freight|parcel|ltl|ftl|fcl|lcl|bulk — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: settlement_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which interline revenue settlements are calculated and exchanged between Transport Shipping and the partner carrier.

attributes.name: sla_on_time_delivery_target_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) On-Time Delivery Target Percentage
attributes.description: Target percentage for on-time delivery performance that both carriers commit to achieve under this interline agreement.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for suspension if agreement_status is 'suspended'. Examples: partner non-compliance, volume shortfall, regulatory restriction, operational disruption.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the agreement was terminated, if applicable. Distinct from expiry_date which is the planned end date.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for early termination if the agreement was terminated before its expiry date. Examples: breach of contract, strategic realignment, partner insolvency, regulatory change.

attributes.name: through_billing_enabled

products.name: partner_certification

Enables partner compliance monitoring and ensures only certified partners are used for regulated trade lanes and commodity types.

attributes.name: partner_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the partner certification record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Reference to the network partner (carrier, agent, 3PL provider, correspondent office) holding this certification.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on partner_certification (renewed_partner_certification_id)

attributes.description: The name of the accreditation body that accredited the issuing authority or certification body (e.g., UKAS, ANAB, DAkkS). Applicable primarily to ISO certifications where the certification body itself must be accredited.

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification record is currently active and should be considered in partner compliance checks. True if active, False if logically deleted or archived.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the certification is set up for automatic renewal by the partner or issuing authority. True if auto-renewal is enabled, False otherwise.

attributes.description: URL or file path to the digital copy of the certification certificate or official documentation stored in the document management system.
